nodes.name: fields.py
nodes.body_text: """Ground that is not just a colour: fields, pools in a marsh, rock fields. Farmland was a plain light-grass plain from hedge to hedge. A farmed landscape is plots: a few hundred metres of ploughed rows, some standing in corn, some bare, the odd one left fallow, and a hedgerow along some of the boundaries. Stock WorldEd already has the tiles - "Horizontal Dirt" and "Vertical Dirt" are furrowed soil, and "Farm Corn 1/2" are standing stalks - and KnoxMap never used them. Fields are drawn on OSM `landuse=farmland` and on WorldCover cropland that OSM left blank. Wetland gets pools and rock-ground classes get rocks, here too, since all three repaint the ground before anything is planted on it. """ from __future__ import annotations import math import numpy as np from PIL import Image, ImageDraw from .. import pz_colors as C # How big a plot is, metres, drawn per field (OSM) or per row and column of # the grid (WorldCover). A field no longer than the top of this is one plot. FIELD_CELL_M = (60.0, 150.0) CORN_SHARE = 0.5 # of plots: standing corn on furrows BARE_SHARE = 0.35 # ...bare furrows; the rest lie fallow HEDGE_CHANCE = 0.4 # a plot whose boundary is a hedgerow FALLOW_TUFTS = 0.2 # of a fallow plot's tiles, a tuft of grass FIELD_SEED = 4421 STRIP_ROWS = 512 # --- pools in wetland ------------------------------------------------------- # # A marsh mapped as solid reeds is a hedge maze. Real ones are broken by open # water: small pools among the reeds, banked by the thickest growth. They come # from a small-scale noise field cut at the top tenth, which gives separate # blobs a few to a dozen tiles across rather than one lake. Water cannot be # walked through in Project Zomboid, so the share is kept low and the pools # stay off roads, paths, buildings and the marsh's own edge. POOL_SHARE = 0.10 POOL_CELL_M = 10.0 POOL_CLEAR_TILES = 2 POOL_SEED = 7001 # --- rock fields ---------------------------------------------------------- # # Moss and lichen is tundra or bare upland: low ground cover broken by stone. # Bare / sparse vegetation is scree, quarry spoil, desert. Both get clumps of # low rocks you can walk over and the odd boulder that blocks the way, kept # off roads and paths so it never closes a route; tundra also gets patches of # moss (dark grass) and the odd low bush. ROCK_SHARE = {100: 0.30, 60: 0.10} BOULDER_SHARE = {100: 0.03, 60: 0.01} MOSS_SHARE = 0.30 ROCK_CLUMP_M = 25.0 MOSS_CELL_M = 30.0 ROCK_CLEAR_TILES = 2 ROCK_SEED = 8123 TUNDRA_BUSH = 0.02

nodes.name: _hash01
nodes.body_text: def _hash01(values, salt: int): """A uniform number in [0, 1) for each integer in `values`, the same every run and independent of what order anything is painted in (splitmix64).""" with np.errstate(over="ignore"): z = values.astype(np.uint64) + np.uint64((salt * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) z = (z ^ (z >> np.uint64(30))) * np.uint64(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9) z = (z ^ (z >> np.uint64(27))) * np.uint64(0x94D049BB133111EB) z = z ^ (z >> np.uint64(31)) return (z >> np.uint64(11)).astype(np.float64) / float(1 << 53)

nodes.name: _borders
nodes.body_text: def _borders(field, pid): """Tiles of the field with a 4-neighbour outside it or in another plot.""" h, w = field.shape edge = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool) pad_f = np.pad(field, 1, constant_values=False) pad_p = np.pad(pid, 1, constant_values=-1) for dy, dx in ((-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)): nf = pad_f[1 + dy:1 + dy + h, 1 + dx:1 + dx + w] np_ = pad_p[1 + dy:1 + dy + h, 1 + dx:1 + dx + w] edge |= ~nf | (np_ != pid) return field & edge

nodes.name: _paint_plots
nodes.signature: def _paint_plots(land, veg, field, pid, furrow_h, tile_ids, salt: int)
nodes.body_text: def _paint_plots(land, veg, field, pid, furrow_h, tile_ids, salt: int): """Paint plots into the (rows, cols, 3) arrays `land` and `veg`, in place. `pid` numbers each tile's plot, `furrow_h` says per tile whether its plot's rows run across (else down). `tile_ids` are unique per tile on the map, for the per-tile tufts. Returns the plot ids painted. """ if not field.any(): return set() border = _borders(field, pid) inside = field & ~border kind = _hash01(pid, salt) corn = kind < CORN_SHARE fallow = kind >= CORN_SHARE + BARE_SHARE ploughed = inside & ~fallow empty = np.all(veg == 0, axis=2) land[ploughed & furrow_h] = C.DIRT_ROWS_H land[ploughed & ~furrow_h] = C.DIRT_ROWS_V second = _hash01(pid, salt + 1) < 0.5 veg[ploughed & corn & ~second & empty] = C.CORN_1 veg[ploughed & corn & second & empty] = C.CORN_2 tufts = inside & fallow & empty & (_hash01(tile_ids, salt + 2) < FALLOW_TUFTS) veg[tufts] = C.SHORT_GRASS hedged = border & empty & (_hash01(pid, salt + 3) < HEDGE_CHANCE) veg[hedged] = C.BUSHES return set(np.unique(pid[field]).tolist())

nodes.name: _polygon_field
nodes.signature: def _polygon_field(landscape, veg, proj, ring, index: int, blocked=None) -> int
nodes.body_text: def _polygon_field(landscape, veg, proj, ring, index: int, blocked=None) -> int: from shapely.geometry import Polygon poly = Polygon(ring) if not poly.is_valid: poly = poly.buffer(0) if poly.is_empty or poly.area < 4: return 0 w, h = landscape.size minx, miny, maxx, maxy = poly.bounds x0, y0 = max(0, int(math.floor(minx))), max(0, int(math.floor(miny))) x1, y1 = min(w, int(math.ceil(maxx)) + 1), min(h, int(math.ceil(maxy)) + 1) if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0: return 0 mask = Image.new("L", (x1 - x0, y1 - y0), 0) ImageDraw.Draw(mask).polygon([(x - x0, y - y0) for x, y in ring], fill=255) box = (x0, y0, x1, y1) land = np.array(landscape.crop(box)) vegp = np.array(veg.crop(box)) field = (np.asarray(mask) > 0) & np.all(land == C.LIGHT_GRASS, axis=2) if blocked is not None: field &= ~blocked[y0:y1, x0:x1] if not field.any(): return 0 # The long side of the field sets which way the plots and the rows run. rect = list(poly.minimum_rotated_rectangle.exterior.coords) e1 = (rect[1][0] - rect[0][0], rect[1][1] - rect[0][1]) e2 = (rect[2][0] - rect[1][0], rect[2][1] - rect[1][1]) long_edge, short_edge = (e1, e2) if math.hypot(*e1) >= math.hypot(*e2) else (e2, e1) theta = math.atan2(long_edge[1], long_edge[0]) across = abs(math.cos(theta)) >= abs(math.sin(theta)) cx, cy = poly.centroid.x, poly.centroid.y seed = int((int(cx) * 73856093) ^ (int(cy) * 19349663) ^ FIELD_SEED) & 0xFFFFFFFF rng = np.random.default_rng(seed) biggest = FIELD_CELL_M[1] / proj.meters_per_tile ys, xs = np.mgrid[y0:y1, x0:x1] if math.hypot(*long_edge) <= biggest: pid = np.zeros(field.shape, dtype=np.int64) else: cu = rng.uniform(*FIELD_CELL_M) / proj.meters_per_tile cv = rng.uniform(*FIELD_CELL_M) / proj.meters_per_tile u = xs * math.cos(theta) + ys * math.sin(theta) + rng.uniform(0, cu) v = -xs * math.sin(theta) + ys * math.cos(theta) + rng.uniform(0, cv) iu = np.floor(u / cu).astype(np.int64) iv = np.floor(v / cv).astype(np.int64) iu -= iu.min() iv -= iv.min() pid = iu * (int(iv.max()) + 1) + iv pid = pid + (index + 1) * (1 << 32) furrow_h = np.full(field.shape, across) tile_ids = ys.astype(np.int64) * w + xs painted = _paint_plots(land, vegp, field, pid, furrow_h, tile_ids, FIELD_SEED) landscape.paste(Image.fromarray(land, "RGB"), (x0, y0)) veg.paste(Image.fromarray(vegp, "RGB"), (x0, y0)) return len(painted)

nodes.name: _cuts
nodes.body_text: def _cuts(length: int, cell, rng): """Boundaries of plots along one side of the map: plot index per tile, and each plot's size.""" sizes = [] total = 0 while total < length: size = max(4, int(round(rng.uniform(*cell)))) sizes.append(size) total += size index = np.repeat(np.arange(len(sizes)), sizes)[:length] return index, np.array(sizes)

nodes.name: _cropland
nodes.body_text: def _cropland(landscape, veg, proj, cropland) -> int: h, w = cropland.shape rng = np.random.default_rng(FIELD_SEED + 1) cell = (FIELD_CELL_M[0] / proj.meters_per_tile, FIELD_CELL_M[1] / proj.meters_per_tile) col, col_w = _cuts(w, cell, rng) row, row_h = _cuts(h, cell, rng) painted = set() for top in range(0, h, STRIP_ROWS): bottom = min(h, top + STRIP_ROWS) a, b = max(0, top - 1), min(h, bottom + 1) field = cropland[a:b] if not field[top - a:top - a + (bottom - top)].any(): continue r = row[a:b][:, None] c = col[None, :] pid = (r * len(col_w) + c).astype(np.int64) furrow_h = col_w[c] >= row_h[r] tile_ids = np.arange(a, b, dtype=np.int64)[:, None] * w + np.arange(w)[None, :] land = np.array(landscape.crop((0, a, w, b))) vegp = np.array(veg.crop((0, a, w, b))) painted |= _paint_plots(land, vegp, field, pid, furrow_h, tile_ids, FIELD_SEED) keep = slice(top - a, top - a + (bottom - top)) landscape.paste(Image.fromarray(land[keep], "RGB"), (0, top)) veg.paste(Image.fromarray(vegp[keep], "RGB"), (0, top)) return len(painted)

nodes.name: paint_fields
nodes.signature: def paint_fields(landscape, veg, proj, polygons, cropland, blocked=None) -> int
nodes.body_text: def paint_fields(landscape, veg, proj, polygons, cropland, blocked=None) -> int: """Plots on each OSM farmland polygon (pixel rings) and on the `cropland` mask (WorldCover, bool, or None). Only light-grass ground is ploughed, so a road or a track OSM drew across a field stays, and nothing `blocked` (bool: buildings and their yards) is. Returns plots painted.""" plots = 0 for index, ring in enumerate(polygons): if len(ring) >= 3: plots += _polygon_field(landscape, veg, proj, ring, index, blocked) if cropland is not None and blocked is not None: cropland = cropland & ~blocked if cropland is not None and cropland.any(): plots += _cropland(landscape, veg, proj, cropland) return plots

nodes.name: _reach
nodes.body_text: def _reach(mask, radius: int, outside: bool): """True wherever `mask` is true within `radius` tiles; past the map edge counts as `outside`.""" from .vegetation import _box_any if not outside: return _box_any(mask, radius) padded = np.pad(mask, radius, constant_values=True) return _box_any(padded, radius)[radius:-radius, radius:-radius]

nodes.name: _threshold
nodes.body_text: def _threshold(region, lats, share: float): """The noise value above which `share` of `region` lies, read off every fourth tile.""" from .noise import smooth_noise h, w = region.shape sy, sx = np.arange(0, h, 4), np.arange(0, w, 4) sample = smooth_noise(sy.astype(np.float32), sx.astype(np.float32), lats) sample = sample[region[::4, ::4]] if sample.size == 0: return None return float(np.quantile(sample, 1.0 - share))

nodes.name: _strips
nodes.body_text: def _strips(h: int): for top in range(0, h, STRIP_ROWS): yield top, min(h, top + STRIP_ROWS)

nodes.name: paint_pools
nodes.signature: def paint_pools(landscape, veg, proj, wet, blocked) -> int
nodes.body_text: def paint_pools(landscape, veg, proj, wet, blocked) -> int: """Open-water pools in the `wet` tiles, none on or near `blocked` ones (buildings) or the edge of the wet. Returns the pool tiles.""" from .noise import lattices, smooth_noise if wet is None or not wet.any(): return 0 h, w = wet.shape allowed = wet & ~_reach(~wet | blocked, POOL_CLEAR_TILES, outside=True) if not allowed.any(): return 0 cell = max(3, int(round(POOL_CELL_M / proj.meters_per_tile))) lats = lattices(h, w, [(cell, 1.0)], POOL_SEED) edge = _threshold(wet, lats, POOL_SHARE) if edge is None: return 0 pool = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool) xs = np.arange(w, dtype=np.float32) for top, bottom in _strips(h): if not allowed[top:bottom].any(): continue n = smooth_noise(np.arange(top, bottom, dtype=np.float32), xs, lats) pool[top:bottom] = allowed[top:bottom] & (n > edge) if not pool.any(): return 0 bank = wet & ~pool & _reach(pool, 1, outside=False) for top, bottom in _strips(h): p, b = pool[top:bottom], bank[top:bottom] if not (p.any() or b.any()): continue land = np.array(landscape.crop((0, top, w, bottom))) vegp = np.array(veg.crop((0, top, w, bottom))) land[p] = C.WATER vegp[p] = C.VEG_NOTHING land[b] = C.DARK_GRASS vegp[b] = C.DENSE_BUSHES_GRASS landscape.paste(Image.fromarray(land, "RGB"), (0, top)) veg.paste(Image.fromarray(vegp, "RGB"), (0, top)) return int(pool.sum())

nodes.name: paint_rocks
nodes.signature: def paint_rocks(landscape, veg, proj, grid, owned) -> int
nodes.body_text: def paint_rocks(landscape, veg, proj, grid, owned) -> int: """Rock fields on WorldCover moss and lichen (100) and bare ground (60) that OSM left blank. Returns the rock and boulder tiles.""" from .noise import lattices, smooth_noise if grid is None or owned is None: return 0 h, w = owned.shape open_ = ~_reach(~owned, ROCK_CLEAR_TILES, outside=False) clump = max(3, int(round(ROCK_CLUMP_M / proj.meters_per_tile))) moss_cell = max(3, int(round(MOSS_CELL_M / proj.meters_per_tile))) xs = np.arange(w, dtype=np.float32) tile_ids = None placed = 0 for code, share in ROCK_SHARE.items(): region = owned & (grid == code) if not region.any(): continue lats = lattices(h, w, [(clump, 0.8), (max(2, clump // 3), 0.2)], ROCK_SEED + code) edge = _threshold(region, lats, min(1.0, 2 * share)) moss_lats = lattices(h, w, [(moss_cell, 1.0)], ROCK_SEED + 1000 + code) moss_edge = _threshold(region, moss_lats, MOSS_SHARE) if code == 100 else None boulder_p = BOULDER_SHARE[code] / max(1e-6, 2 * share) for top, bottom in _strips(h): r = region[top:bottom] if not r.any(): continue ys = np.arange(top, bottom, dtype=np.float32) tile_ids = (np.arange(top, bottom, dtype=np.int64)[:, None] * w + np.arange(w, dtype=np.int64)[None, :]) land = np.array(landscape.crop((0, top, w, bottom))) vegp = np.array(veg.crop((0, top, w, bottom))) land[r] = C.DIRT if moss_edge is not None: land[r & (smooth_noise(ys, xs, moss_lats) > moss_edge)] = C.DARK_GRASS inside = r & (smooth_noise(ys, xs, lats) > edge) roll = _hash01(tile_ids, ROCK_SEED + code) rocks = inside & (roll < 0.5) boulders = rocks & open_[top:bottom] & (_hash01(tile_ids, ROCK_SEED + code + 1) < boulder_p) vegp[rocks] = C.ROCKS vegp[boulders] = C.BOULDERS if code == 100: bush = r & ~rocks & (_hash01(tile_ids, ROCK_SEED + 2) < TUNDRA_BUSH) vegp[bush] = C.BUSHES placed += int(rocks.sum()) landscape.paste(Image.fromarray(land, "RGB"), (0, top)) veg.paste(Image.fromarray(vegp, "RGB"), (0, top)) return placed

nodes.name: homesteads.py
nodes.body_text: """Room around a building: no field or water under it, a clearing in the woods. A house mapped in a wood stood in the trees up to its walls, and nothing led to it: the woods were painted over its yard and its drive. A house on ground WorldCover calls cropland or water stood in a ploughed field or a lake, since the 10 m grid does not know the farmyard is there. Here every building keeps a small yard clear of fields and water, and a building with woods around it gets a clearing of its own - 10 to 30 m out from its walls, never a neat ring - thinning into the trees at its edge, and a gently bent drive to the nearest road. The drive is dark tarmac, which is what knoxbuild's own drives are (knoxbuild/yards.py), so a house's front path stops at it rather than running beside it to the street. """ from __future__ import annotations import math import numpy as np from PIL import Image, ImageDraw from .. import pz_colors as C from .fields import _hash01 YARD_M = 6.0 # no field or water this near a building YARD_CLASSES = (40, 80) # WorldCover cropland and water CLEAR_M = (10.0, 30.0) # how far a clearing runs out from the walls WOBBLE = 0.35 # ...varying this much round the building EDGE_M = 4.0 # the thinned fringe past it EDGE_THIN = 0.5 # of the fringe's trees, the share stepped down IN_WOODS = 0.15 # of a clearing's ground, the woods it needs to get one DRIVE_MIN_M2 = 40.0 # sheds and garages get no drive of their own DRIVE_MAX_M = 400.0 DRIVE_MIN_TILES = 3 # a road this close is the drive already DRIVE_WIDTH = 3 DRIVE_BEND = 0.2 # the bend, as a share of the drive's length DRIVE_SHARE_M = 10.0 # a drive this near a building serves it too HOME_SEED = 5381 # What a clearing takes away: the woods, not a garden's flowers or a field. WOODS = (C.TREES, C.TREES_DARK_GRASS, C.SPARSE_TREES, C.TREE_SMALL, C.LOT_OF_GRASS_AND_TREES, C.BUSHES_TREES_DARK_GRASS, C.BUSHES, C.DENSE_BUSHES_GRASS, C.TREE_BIG, C.TREE_HUGE, C.TREE_GIANT) # One grade thinner, for the fringe. THINNER = {C.TREES: C.TREES_DARK_GRASS, C.TREES_DARK_GRASS: C.SPARSE_TREES, C.LOT_OF_GRASS_AND_TREES: C.SPARSE_TREES, C.BUSHES_TREES_DARK_GRASS: C.BUSHES} # Ground a drive may be laid on: grass, dirt and fields, never a road or water. DRIVE_GROUND = (C.DARK_GRASS, C.MEDIUM_GRASS, C.LIGHT_GRASS, C.DIRT, C.DIRT_ROWS_H, C.DIRT_ROWS_V)

nodes.name: footprint_mask
nodes.body_text: def footprint_mask(footprints, size) -> np.ndarray: """Bool (h, w), True inside any footprint (pixel rings).""" mask = Image.new("L", size, 0) draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask) for ring in footprints: if len(ring) >= 3: draw.polygon([tuple(p) for p in ring], fill=255) return np.asarray(mask) > 0

nodes.name: keep_yards_clear
nodes.signature: def keep_yards_clear(landscape, grid, owned, footprints, meters_per_tile) -> np.ndarray
nodes.body_text: def keep_yards_clear(landscape, grid, owned, footprints, meters_per_tile) -> np.ndarray: """Turn WorldCover cropland and water under a building, or within its yard, into lawn, and take it out of `owned` (in place). Returns the yards (bool), which OSM farmland is kept off as well.""" from .vegetation import _box_any size = landscape.size yards = _box_any(footprint_mask(footprints, size), max(1, int(round(YARD_M / meters_per_tile)))) if grid is None or owned is None: return yards lawn = yards & owned & np.isin(grid, YARD_CLASSES) if lawn.any(): land = np.array(landscape) land[lawn] = C.MEDIUM_GRASS landscape.paste(Image.fromarray(land, "RGB")) owned &= ~lawn return yards

nodes.name: _is_woods
nodes.body_text: def _is_woods(arr) -> np.ndarray: out = np.zeros(arr.shape[:2], dtype=bool) for colour in WOODS: out |= np.all(arr == colour, axis=2) return out

nodes.name: _wobbly
nodes.signature: def _wobbly(poly, radius: float, seed: int, extra: float = 0.0)
nodes.body_text: def _wobbly(poly, radius: float, seed: int, extra: float = 0.0): """`poly` grown by about `radius`, more on some sides than others: each point of the plain buffer is pushed out or in along its way from the walls by a few smooth waves round the building.""" from shapely.geometry import Point, Polygon rng = np.random.default_rng(seed) waves = [(k, rng.uniform(0.3, 1.0), rng.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)) for k in (2, 3, 5)] norm = sum(a for _k, a, _p in waves) plain = poly.buffer(radius, quad_segs=8) if plain.geom_type != "Polygon": plain = max(plain.geoms, key=lambda g: g.area) ring = plain.exterior.segmentize(2.0) cx, cy = poly.centroid.x, poly.centroid.y out = [] for x, y in ring.coords: theta = math.atan2(y - cy, x - cx) wave = sum(a * math.sin(k * theta + p) for k, a, p in waves) / norm reach = radius * (1.0 + WOBBLE * wave) + extra q = poly.exterior.interpolate(poly.exterior.project(Point(x, y))) dx, dy = x - q.x, y - q.y d = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0 out.append((q.x + dx / d * reach, q.y + dy / d * reach)) shape = Polygon(out) return shape if shape.is_valid else shape.buffer(0)

nodes.name: _rasterise
nodes.signature: def _rasterise(shape, x0, y0, w, h) -> np.ndarray
nodes.body_text: def _rasterise(shape, x0, y0, w, h) -> np.ndarray: if w <= 0 or h <= 0: return np.zeros((max(0, h), max(0, w)), dtype=bool) mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0) draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask) polys = [shape] if shape.geom_type == "Polygon" else list(getattr(shape, "geoms", [])) for p in polys: if p.geom_type == "Polygon" and not p.is_empty: draw.polygon([(x - x0, y - y0) for x, y in p.exterior.coords], fill=255) return np.asarray(mask) > 0

nodes.name: _bezier
nodes.signature: def _bezier(p, q, bend: float, step: float = 1.0)
nodes.body_text: def _bezier(p, q, bend: float, step: float = 1.0): """Points along a gentle curve from p to q, bowed sideways by `bend` of its length.""" (px, py), (qx, qy) = p, q length = math.hypot(qx - px, qy - py) nx, ny = -(qy - py) / (length or 1.0), (qx - px) / (length or 1.0) cx = (px + qx) / 2 + nx * bend * length cy = (py + qy) / 2 + ny * bend * length n = max(2, int(length / step) + 1) t = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n) xs = (1 - t) ** 2 * px + 2 * (1 - t) * t * cx + t ** 2 * qx ys = (1 - t) ** 2 * py + 2 * (1 - t) * t * cy + t ** 2 * qy return list(zip(xs.tolist(), ys.tolist()))

nodes.name: clear_homesteads
nodes.signature: def clear_homesteads(veg, landscape, footprints, roads, meters_per_tile) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict]
nodes.body_text: def clear_homesteads(veg, landscape, footprints, roads, meters_per_tile) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict]: """Clearings and drives for buildings standing in woods. `footprints` are pixel rings, `roads` pixel polylines (the roads a drive may join). Returns the tiles cleared or paved (bool), for the planting passes after this to leave alone, and counts.""" from shapely.geometry import LineString, Polygon, box from shapely.ops import nearest_points from shapely.strtree import STRtree w, h = landscape.size land = np.array(landscape) vegp = np.array(veg) done = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool) counts = {"clearings": 0, "drives": 0} mpt = meters_per_tile # Only the stretches on the map: a road running off its edge would send a # drive off it too. edge = box(0, 0, w - 1, h - 1) lines = [] for r in roads: if len(r) < 2: continue part = LineString(r).intersection(edge) for piece in getattr(part, "geoms", [part]): if piece.geom_type == "LineString" and piece.length > 0: lines.append(piece) tree = STRtree(lines) if lines else None buildings = footprint_mask(footprints, (w, h)) water = np.all(land == C.WATER, axis=2) drive_ground = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool) for colour in DRIVE_GROUND: drive_ground |= np.all(land == colour, axis=2) reach_max = CLEAR_M[1] * (1 + WOBBLE) / mpt + EDGE_M / mpt + 2 polys = [] for ring in footprints: if len(ring) < 3: continue poly = Polygon(ring) if not poly.is_valid: poly = poly.buffer(0) if not poly.is_empty and poly.geom_type == "Polygon": polys.append(poly) # The biggest first: the house gets the drive, and the garage or shed # beside it shares it rather than getting one of its own. polys.sort(key=lambda p: (-p.area, p.centroid.x, p.centroid.y)) tarmac = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool) # the drives laid so far share = max(1, int(round(DRIVE_SHARE_M / mpt))) for poly in polys: minx, miny, maxx, maxy = poly.bounds x0, y0 = max(0, int(minx - reach_max)), max(0, int(miny - reach_max)) x1, y1 = min(w, int(maxx + reach_max) + 1), min(h, int(maxy + reach_max) + 1) if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0: continue seed = int((int(poly.centroid.x) * 73856093) ^ (int(poly.centroid.y) * 19349663) ^ HOME_SEED) & 0xFFFFFFFF roll = float(_hash01(np.array([seed]), HOME_SEED)[0]) radius = (CLEAR_M[0] + roll * (CLEAR_M[1] - CLEAR_M[0])) / mpt clearing = _wobbly(poly, radius, seed) fringe = _wobbly(poly, radius, seed, extra=EDGE_M / mpt) bw, bh = x1 - x0, y1 - y0 inside = _rasterise(clearing, x0, y0, bw, bh) edge = _rasterise(fringe, x0, y0, bw, bh) & ~inside win = vegp[y0:y1, x0:x1] woods = _is_woods(win) own = _rasterise(poly, x0, y0, bw, bh) ground = inside & ~own if not ground.any() or woods[ground].mean() < IN_WOODS: continue # The clearing: no woods, and lawn where the woods had dark grass. cut = inside & woods win[cut] = C.VEG_NOTHING lw = land[y0:y1, x0:x1] dark = inside & ~own & np.all(lw == C.DARK_GRASS, axis=2) lw[dark] = C.MEDIUM_GRASS # The fringe: some trees a grade thinner, so the wood fades out. ids = (np.arange(y0, y1, dtype=np.int64)[:, None] * w + np.arange(x0, x1, dtype=np.int64)[None, :]) thin = edge & woods & (_hash01(ids, HOME_SEED + 1) < EDGE_THIN) for colour, to in THINNER.items(): sel = thin & np.all(win == colour, axis=2) win[sel] = to sel = thin & np.all(win == C.SPARSE_TREES, axis=2) win[sel] = C.VEG_NOTHING done[y0:y1, x0:x1] |= inside counts["clearings"] += 1 # The drive, to the nearest road, if it is a house and not a shed. if tree is None or poly.area * mpt * mpt < DRIVE_MIN_M2: continue nx0, ny0 = max(0, int(minx) - share), max(0, int(miny) - share) nx1, ny1 = min(w, int(maxx) + share + 1), min(h, int(maxy) + share + 1) if nx1 > nx0 and ny1 > ny0 and tarmac[ny0:ny1, nx0:nx1].any(): near = _rasterise(poly.buffer(share), nx0, ny0, nx1 - nx0, ny1 - ny0) if (near & tarmac[ny0:ny1, nx0:nx1]).any(): continue line = lines[int(tree.nearest(poly))] gap = poly.distance(line) if gap <= DRIVE_MIN_TILES or gap * mpt > DRIVE_MAX_M: continue p, q = nearest_points(poly, line) bend = DRIVE_BEND * (2 * float(_hash01(np.array([seed]), HOME_SEED + 2)[0]) - 1) for b in (bend, 0.0): path = _bezier((p.x, p.y), (q.x, q.y), b) xs = [x for x, _ in path] ys = [y for _, y in path] dx0, dy0 = max(0, int(min(xs)) - DRIVE_WIDTH), max(0, int(min(ys)) - DRIVE_WIDTH) dx1 = min(w, int(max(xs)) + DRIVE_WIDTH + 1) dy1 = min(h, int(max(ys)) + DRIVE_WIDTH + 1) if dx1 <= dx0 or dy1 <= dy0: break mask = Image.new("L", (dx1 - dx0, dy1 - dy0), 0) ImageDraw.Draw(mask).line([(x - dx0, y - dy0) for x, y in path], fill=255, width=DRIVE_WIDTH) drive = np.asarray(mask) > 0 own_d = _rasterise(poly, dx0, dy0, dx1 - dx0, dy1 - dy0) others = buildings[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1] & ~own_d if (drive & (others | water[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1])).any(): continue lay = drive & ~own_d & drive_ground[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1] land[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1][lay] = C.DARK_ASPHALT tarmac[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1] |= lay # Nothing grows on it, and the trees stand back a tile either side. from .vegetation import _box_any verge = _box_any(drive, 1) & ~own_d vw = vegp[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1] vw[verge & _is_woo

nodes.name: landcover_veg.py
nodes.body_text: """What grows on each WorldCover class, on ground OpenStreetMap left blank. The class was painted as a ground colour and nothing else knew it, so a WorldCover wood was dark grass with no trees, and shrubland and grassland were the same lawn with random scrub thrown on both. Here each class gets the growth that belongs to it. Tree cover is not planted here: it is handed back as a mask for the woodland pass, so it grows exactly as a mapped wood does, with a thinner edge, big trees and the Forest density dial. Cropland (fields), bare ground and moss (rock fields) and the wetland's pools are ground, painted before this in generator/rendering/fields.py. Built-up land gets the garden pass's planting, like any other yard. """ from __future__ import annotations import numpy as np from PIL import Image from .. import pz_colors as C from .fields import _hash01, _strips SHRUB_CLUMP_M = 40.0 # how far a thicket or an opening runs SHRUB_IN = 0.35 # chance per tile inside a thicket SHRUB_OUT = 0.08 # ...and in the open between them SHRUB_BUSH = 0.65 # of what grows on shrubland: bushes, SHRUB_YOUNG = 0.25 # young trees, and the rest sparse trees GRASS_TUFTS = 0.20 # grassland: a tuft of grass GRASS_BUSH = 0.01 # ...or a bush MARSH = 0.6 # wetland: dense bush and marsh grass MARSH_TREE = 0.03 # ...or a stunted tree VEG_SEED = 6203 FOREST = 10 SHRUB = 20 GRASS = 30 WETLAND = (90, 95)

nodes.name: plant_landcover
nodes.signature: def plant_landcover(veg, landscape, grid, owned, proj, density: float = 1.0)
nodes.body_text: def plant_landcover(veg, landscape, grid, owned, proj, density: float = 1.0): """Plant shrubland, grassland and wetland on `owned` tiles whose vegetation is still empty. Returns `(forest, counts)`: the tree-cover tiles for the woodland pass, and tiles planted per class.""" from .noise import lattices, smooth_noise from .vegetation import tree_rules_ready h, w = owned.shape forest = owned & (grid == FOREST) counts = {SHRUB: 0, GRASS: 0, 90: 0} if density <= 0: return forest, counts young = C.TREE_SMALL if tree_rules_ready() else C.SPARSE_TREES clump = max(3, int(round(SHRUB_CLUMP_M / proj.meters_per_tile))) lats = lattices(h, w, [(clump, 1.0)], VEG_SEED) xs = np.arange(w, dtype=np.float32) shrub_in = min(1.0, SHRUB_IN * density) shrub_out = min(1.0, SHRUB_OUT * density) tufts = min(1.0, GRASS_TUFTS * density) grass_bush = min(1.0, GRASS_BUSH * density) marsh = min(1.0, MARSH * density) marsh_tree = min(1.0, MARSH_TREE * density) for top, bottom in _strips(h): o = owned[top:bottom] g = grid[top:bottom] live = o & ((g == SHRUB) | (g == GRASS) | np.isin(g, WETLAND)) if not live.any(): continue vegp = np.array(veg.crop((0, top, w, bottom))) land = np.array(landscape.crop((0, top, w, bottom))) empty = np.all(vegp == 0, axis=2) tile_ids = (np.arange(top, bottom, dtype=np.int64)[:, None] * w + np.arange(w, dtype=np.int64)[None, :]) roll = _hash01(tile_ids, VEG_SEED) pick = _hash01(tile_ids, VEG_SEED + 1) shrub = live & empty & (g == SHRUB) if shrub.any(): thick = smooth_noise(np.arange(top, bottom, dtype=np.float32), xs, lats) > 0.5 grows = shrub & (roll < np.where(thick, shrub_in, shrub_out)) bush = grows & (pick < SHRUB_BUSH) small = grows & (pick >= SHRUB_BUSH) & (pick < SHRUB_BUSH + SHRUB_YOUNG) sparse = grows & ~bush & ~small vegp[bush] = C.BUSHES vegp[small] = young vegp[sparse] = C.SPARSE_TREES # Sparse trees are a dark-grass rule, as in the woods. land[(sparse | small) if young == C.SPARSE_TREES else sparse] = C.DARK_GRASS counts[SHRUB] += int(grows.sum()) grass = live & empty & (g == GRASS) if grass.any(): bush = grass & (roll < grass_bush) tuft = grass & ~bush & (roll < grass_bush + tufts) vegp[bush] = C.BUSHES vegp[tuft] = C.SHORT_GRASS counts[GRASS] += int((bush | tuft).sum()) wet = live & empty & np.isin(g, WETLAND) if wet.any(): tree = wet & (roll < marsh_tree) reed = wet & ~tree & (roll < marsh_tree + marsh) vegp[tree] = C.SPARSE_TREES vegp[reed] = C.DENSE_BUSHES_GRASS land[tree | reed] = C.DARK_GRASS counts[90] += int((tree | reed).sum()) veg.paste(Image.fromarray(vegp, "RGB"), (0, top)) landscape.paste(Image.fromarray(land, "RGB"), (0, top)) return forest, counts

nodes.name: noise.py
nodes.body_text: """Smooth value noise on coarse lattices, for anything that should clump. Random numbers on a coarse grid, smoothstep-interpolated to every tile: blobs, not a grid of squares. Several lattices of different cell sizes are summed by weight, a big one for the shape and a small one for a ragged edge. The woods on open ground (`_paint_groves`) were the first to use it; fields, pools and rock fields use the same. """ from __future__ import annotations import numpy as np

nodes.name: lattices
nodes.signature: def lattices(h: int, w: int, specs, seed: int) -> list
nodes.body_text: def lattices(h: int, w: int, specs, seed: int) -> list: """(lattice, cell, weight) for each (cell, weight) in `specs`, in order, all drawn from one generator seeded with `seed`.""" rng = np.random.default_rng(seed) out = [] for cell, weight in specs: cell = max(1, int(cell)) out.append((rng.random((h // cell + 3, w // cell + 3), dtype=np.float32), cell, weight)) return out

nodes.name: _lattice
nodes.body_text: def _lattice(lat, cell, ys, xs): fy, fx = ys / cell, xs / cell y0, x0 = fy.astype(int), fx.astype(int) ty, tx = fy - y0, fx - x0 ty, tx = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty), tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx) # smoothstep y1, x1 = y0 + 1, x0 + 1 top = lat[np.ix_(y0, x0)] * (1 - tx) + lat[np.ix_(y0, x1)] * tx bot = lat[np.ix_(y1, x0)] * (1 - tx) + lat[np.ix_(y1, x1)] * tx return top * (1 - ty[:, None]) + bot * ty[:, None]

nodes.name: smooth_noise
nodes.signature: def smooth_noise(ys: np.ndarray, xs: np.ndarray, lats) -> np.ndarray
nodes.body_text: def smooth_noise(ys: np.ndarray, xs: np.ndarray, lats) -> np.ndarray: """The noise at rows `ys` and columns `xs` (float32 arrays of tile coordinates), as a (len(ys), len(xs)) array.""" total = None for lat, cell, weight in lats: part = weight * _lattice(lat, cell, ys, xs) total = part if total is None else total + part return total

nodes.name: exp.py
nodes.body_text: """Controlled WorldEd experiments: change one map feature, compile, compare the lot files. exp.py <variant> [...] variants: base water forest road house park Output goes to scratchpad/exp/<variant>/ ; the lot files are decoded and summarised. """ import collections import contextlib import io import os import shutil import sys sys.path.insert(0, "C:/KnoxMap") from generator import renderer from generator.osm import OSMFeature from knoxbuild.build import build from knoxbuild.settings import Settings from tools import compile_map as cm S, W, N, E = 40.0000, 20.0000, 40.0054, 20.0070 HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) # experiments write to ./exp/<variant> ids = iter(range(1, 10 ** 6)) VARIANTS = { "base": [], "water": [box(0.55, 0.55, 0.8, 0.8, {"natural": "water"})], "forest": [box(0.55, 0.55, 0.8, 0.8, {"natural": "wood"})], "road": [line((0.1, 0.05), (0.9, 0.95), {"highway": "residential"})], "house": [box(0.2, 0.2, 0.26, 0.27, {"building": "house"})], "park": [box(0.55, 0.55, 0.8, 0.8, {"leisure": "park"})], } if __name__ == "__main__": for v in sys.argv[1:]: out = make(v) print("==", v, out) tot = collections.Counter() blocks = 0 hdr = collections.Counter() for f, (cnt, nb) in summarise(out).items(): if f.startswith("chunkdata_"): tot.update(cnt) blocks += nb else: hdr.update(cnt) print(" chunkdata values", dict(sorted(tot.items())), "blocks", blocks) print(" header bytes", dict(sorted(hdr.items())))

nodes.name: box
nodes.signature: def box(s, w, n, e, tags)
nodes.body_text: def box(s, w, n, e, tags): """A rectangle given as fractions of the area (0..1), south-west origin.""" la, lo = N - S, E - W pts = [(S + s * la, W + w * lo), (S + s * la, W + e * lo), (S + n * la, W + e * lo), (S + n * la, W + w * lo), (S + s * la, W + w * lo)] return OSMFeature(next(ids), "way", tags, pts)

nodes.name: line
nodes.body_text: def line(a, b, tags): la, lo = N - S, E - W pts = [(S + a[0] * la, W + a[1] * lo), (S + b[0] * la, W + b[1] * lo)] return OSMFeature(next(ids), "way", tags, pts)

nodes.name: make
nodes.body_text: def make(name): out = f"{HERE}/exp/{name}" shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True) os.makedirs(out) feats = VARIANTS[name] renderer.render(feats, S, W, N, E, meters_per_tile=1.0, output_dir=out, map_name=name) with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): build(out, settings=Settings(seed=1, true_map=1)) cm.compile_map(out, batch=2, incremental=False) return out

nodes.name: summarise
nodes.body_text: def summarise(out): lots = f"{out}/lots" res = {} for f in sorted(os.listdir(lots)): if f.startswith("chunkdata_"): c = open(f"{lots}/{f}", "rb").read() res[f] = (collections.Counter(c[2:1026]), (len(c) - 1026) // 64) elif f.endswith(".lotheader"): h = open(f"{lots}/{f}", "rb").read()[-1024:] res[f] = (collections.Counter(h), 0) return res

nodes.name: allcheck.py
nodes.body_text: """Compare buildtiles with WorldEd on every building of a compiled map. allcheck.py <map folder under real/> [--worst N] [--show] [--exclude-overlaps] Overlap exclusion is conservative: another lot's rectangle, including its south/east wall ring, on a level represented by its TBX. Excluded squares remain unverified. """ import collections import os import re import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) from bxshow import load from knoxbuild.buildtiles import level_tiles, parse_tbx H = os.environ.get("KNOXLOTS_FIXTURES", os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) ORIGIN = 21000 TERRAIN = ("blends_", "vegetation_foliage", "e_", "d_", "lighting_outdoor", "overlay_grime_floor", "fencing_", "street_trafficlines") folder = sys.argv[1] proj = f"{H}/real/{folder}" if not os.path.isabs(folder) else folder name = os.path.basename(proj) worst_n = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--worst") + 1]) if "--worst" in sys.argv else 5 # the lots of the project, with the cell each one is listed in lots = [] cell = None for line in open(f"{proj}/{name}.pzw", encoding="utf-8"): m = re.match(r'\s*<cell x="(\d+)" y="(\d+)"', line) if m: cell = (int(m[1]), int(m[2])) m = re.search(r'<lot x="(\d+)" y="(\d+)" level="(\d+)" width="(\d+)" height="(\d+)" map="buildings/([^"]+)\.tbx"', line) if m and cell: x, y, lv, w, h, tbx = m.groups() lots.append((cell[0] * 300 + int(x), cell[1] * 300 + int(y), int(lv), int(w), int(h), tbx)) cells = {} rects = [(x, y, w, h, t) for x, y, lv, w, h, t in lots] exclude_overlaps = "--exclude-overlaps" in sys.argv overlap_rects = [] if exclude_overlaps: for x, y, lv, w, h, t in lots: b = parse_tbx(open(f"{proj}/buildings/{t}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()) overlap_rects.append((x, y, w, h, t, lv, lv + len(b.floors))) results = [] ambiguous = ambiguous_mismatches = 0 prefix_missing = collections.Counter() prefix_extra = collections.Counter() for tx0, ty0, lv, w, h, tbx in lots: if any(k in tbx for k in ("fences", "lights", "structures", "bridge", "monument")): continue try: b = parse_tbx(open(f"{proj}/buildings/{tbx}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()) except Exception as e: # noqa: BLE001 results.append((tbx, 0, 0, [f"parse failed: {e}"])) continue total = same = 0 examples = [] for z in range(len(b.floors)): pred = level_tiles(b, z) for dy in range(-1, b.height + 2): for dx in range(-1, b.width + 2): inside = 0 <= dx < b.width and 0 <= dy < b.height if not inside and owned_by_another(tx0 + dx, ty0 + dy, tbx): continue actual = [t for t in world(tx0 + dx, ty0 + dy, z + lv) if not t.startswith(TERRAIN)] want = pred.get((dx, dy), []) if not actual and not want: continue if exclude_overlaps and any(t != tbx and rx <= tx0 + dx <= rx + rw and ry <= ty0 + dy <= ry + rh and lo <= z + lv < hi for rx, ry, rw, rh, t, lo, hi in overlap_rects): ambiguous += 1 ambiguous_mismatches += actual != want continue total += 1 if actual == want: same += 1 else: for t in set(actual) - set(want): prefix_missing[t.rsplit("_", 1)[0]] += 1 for t in set(want) - set(actual): prefix_extra[t.rsplit("_", 1)[0]] += 1 if len(examples) < 3: examples.append((z, dx, dy, want, actual)) results.append((tbx, same, total, examples)) n = len(results) perfect = sum(1 for _, s, t, e in results if t and s == t) sq_same = sum(s for _, s, t, e in results) sq_total = sum(t for _, s, t, e in results) print(f"{name}: {n} buildings checked; {perfect} match on every compared square; {sq_same} of {sq_total} squares identical" f" ({100 * sq_same / max(sq_total, 1):.2f}%)") if exclude_overlaps: print(f" excluded {ambiguous} ambiguous lot-overlap comparisons ({ambiguous_mismatches} mismatched)") print(" WorldEd has, we lack:", dict(prefix_missing.most_common(8))) print(" we have, WorldEd lacks:", dict(prefix_extra.most_common(8))) bad = sorted((r for r in results if r[2] and r[1] != r[2]), key=lambda r: r[2] - r[1], reverse=True) for tbx, s, t, ex in bad[:worst_n]: print(f" {tbx}: {s} of {t}") if "--show" in sys.argv: for z, dx, dy, want, actual in ex: print(f" level {z} ({dx},{dy})\n ours {want}\n WorldEd {actual}")

nodes.name: world
nodes.body_text: def world(tx, ty, z): cx, cy = (ORIGIN + tx) // 256, ty // 256 if (cx, cy) not in cells: try: cells[(cx, cy)] = load(f"{proj}/lots", cx, cy) except FileNotFoundError: cells[(cx, cy)] = ({}, 0) sq, _ = cells[(cx, cy)] return sq.get(((ORIGIN + tx) - cx * 256, ty - cy * 256, z), [])

nodes.name: owned_by_another
nodes.body_text: def owned_by_another(x, y, me): return any(t != me and rx <= x < rx + rw and ry <= y < ry + rh for rx, ry, rw, rh, t in rects)

nodes.name: make_tbx
nodes.body_text:
def make_tbx(width, height, floors): """floors: list of {"rooms": [[ids per row]...], "objects": [attribute dicts]}""" root = ET.parse(TEMPLATE).getroot() for f in [c for c in root if c.tag == "floor"]: root.remove(f) root.set("width", str(width)) root.set("height", str(height)) # keep only the first few room definitions; ids in the grids are 1-based rooms = [c for c in root if c.tag == "room"] for r in rooms[20:]: root.remove(r) for fl in floors: f = ET.SubElement(root, "floor") for o in fl.get("objects", []): ET.SubElement(f, "object", {k: str(v) for k, v in o.items()}) grid = fl.get("rooms") or [[0] * width for _ in range(height)] rm = ET.SubElement(f, "rooms") rm.text = "
" + ",
".join(",".join(str(v) for v in row) for row in grid) + "
" ET.indent(root) return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")

nodes.name: block
nodes.signature: def block(w, h, room=1, x0=0, y0=0, rw=None, rh=None)
nodes.body_text: def block(w, h, room=1, x0=0, y0=0, rw=None, rh=None): g = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)] for y in range(y0, y0 + (rh or h)): for x in range(x0, x0 + (rw or w)): g[y][x] = room return g

nodes.name: two_rooms
nodes.body_text: def two_rooms(w, h, a=1, b=2): g = [[a] * w for _ in range(h)] for y in range(h): for x in range(w // 2, w): g[y][x] = b return g

nodes.body_text: def roof_obj(rtype, depth, w, h, x, y, caps=""): return dict(type="roof", width=w, height=h, RoofType=rtype, Depth=depth, cappedW=str("W" in caps).lower(), cappedN=str("N" in caps).lower(), cappedE=str("E" in caps).lower(), cappedS=str("S" in caps).lower(), CapTiles=27, SlopeTiles=25, TopTiles=26, x=x, y=y)

nodes.name: make
nodes.body_text: def make(name): w, h, floors = CASES[name] out = f"{H}/bx/{name}" shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True) os.makedirs(f"{out}/buildings") # the flat-grass project, without its lots for f in os.listdir(BASE): src = f"{BASE}/{f}" if f in ("lots", "buildings", "build_cache.json") or f.endswith((".geojson", ".npz")): continue if os.path.isdir(src): shutil.copytree(src, f"{out}/{f}") else: shutil.copy2(src, f"{out}/{f}") # the .pzw is named after the project folder, and points at its own files pzw = open(f"{BASE}/base.pzw", encoding="utf-8").read() pzw = re.sub(r'[A-Za-z]:/[^"]*?/scratchpad/exp/base', out.replace("\\", "/"), pzw, flags=re.I) pzw = pzw.replace("base.bmp", f"{name}.bmp") pzw = re.sub(r"(?<![\w])base(_|\.|\")", lambda m: name + m.group(1), pzw) lot = f' <lot x="{LOT_X}" y="{LOT_Y}" level="0" width="{w}" height="{h}" map="buildings/{name}.tbx"/>\n' pzw = re.sub(r'(<cell x="0" y="0"[^>]*>\n)', lambda m: m.group(1) + lot, pzw, count=1) # the flat project's file names for f in os.listdir(out): if f.startswith("base"): os.rename(f"{out}/{f}", f"{out}/{name}{f[4:]}") for f in os.listdir(f"{out}/tmx"): if f.startswith("base"): os.rename(f"{out}/tmx/{f}", f"{out}/tmx/{name}{f[4:]}") open(f"{out}/{name}.pzw", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pzw) open(f"{out}/buildings/{name}.tbx", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(make_tbx(w, h, floors)) os.makedirs(f"{out}/lots", exist_ok=True) with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): cm.compile_map(out, batch=1, only_cells=[[0, 0, 0, 0]], incremental=False) return out

nodes.name: bxcheck.py
nodes.body_text: """Compare buildtiles' prediction with WorldEd's output for a hand-made building. bxcheck.py <case> [...] """ import os import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) from bxshow import load from knoxbuild.buildtiles import level_tiles, parse_tbx H = os.environ.get("KNOXLOTS_FIXTURES", os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) LOT_X, LOT_Y = 40, 40 ORIGIN = 21000 for case in sys.argv[1:]: b = parse_tbx(open(f"{H}/bx/{case}/buildings/{case}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()) cx = (ORIGIN + LOT_X) // 256 sq, levels = load(f"{H}/bx/{case}/lots", cx, 0) total = same = 0 shown = 0 for z in range(len(b.floors)): pred = level_tiles(b, z) # compare over the building and its ring of outside squares (and a margin to catch extras) for dy in range(-2, b.height + 3): for dx in range(-2, b.width + 3): actual = sq.get((ORIGIN + LOT_X + dx - cx * 256, LOT_Y + dy, z), []) if z == 0 and actual and actual[0].startswith("blends_natural"): actual = actual[1:] want = pred.get((dx, dy), []) if actual or want: total += 1 if actual == want: same += 1 elif shown < 6: shown += 1 print(f" level {z} square ({dx},{dy}): ours {want}\n WorldEd {actual}") print(f"{case}: {same} of {total} squares identical")

nodes.name: bxshow.py
nodes.body_text: """Print what WorldEd put on each square of a hand-made building, level by level. bxshow.py <case> [x0 y0 w h] region in tiles of the first 300 x 300 cell """ import os import struct import sys H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) NONE = 0xFFFFFFFF ORIGIN = 21000 SHORT = [("walls_exterior_house_01_", "WX"), ("walls_exterior_roofs_01_", "RF"), ("walls_interior_house_01_", "WI"), ("floors_interior_tilesandwood_01_", "FT"), ("floors_interior_carpet_01_", "FC"), ("floors_", "F"), ("fixtures_doors_01_", "DR"), ("fixtures_doors_frames_01_", "DF"), ("walls_exterior_", "WE"), ("walls_interior_", "WN"), ("fixtures_windows_01_", "WD"), ("fixtures_stairs_01_", "ST"), ("blends_natural_01_", "g"), ("carpentry_02_", "cp"), ("furniture_", "fu"), ("lighting_", "li")] if __name__ == "__main__": case = sys.argv[1] x0, y0, w, h = (int(a) for a in sys.argv[2:6]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else (38, 38, 10, 9) lots = f"{H}/bx/{case}/lots" cx = (ORIGIN + x0) // 256 sq, levels = load(lots, cx, 0) print(f"{case}: {levels} levels in cell {cx}_0") legend = {} letters = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789" for z in range(levels): print(f"-- level {z} (x {x0}..{x0 + w - 1} across, y {y0}..{y0 + h - 1} down)") for y in range(y0, y0 + h): row = [] for x in range(x0, x0 + w): st = sq.get(((ORIGIN + x) - cx * 256, y, z), []) if z == 0 and st and st[0].startswith("blends_natural"): st = st[1:] key = tuple(st) if not key: row.append(".") else: if key not in legend: legend[key] = letters[len(legend)] if len(legend) < len(letters) else "?" row.append(legend[key]) print(f"{y:3} " + " ".join(row)) print("legend (bottom tile first):") for key, ch in legend.items(): print(f" {ch} = " + " + ".join(key))

nodes.name: short
nodes.body_text: def short(n): for p, s in SHORT: if n.startswith(p): return s + n[len(p):].lstrip("0") if n[len(p):].strip("0") else s + "0" return n

nodes.name: load
nodes.body_text: def load(lots, cx, cy): head = open(f"{lots}/{cx}_{cy}.lotheader", "rb").read() n = struct.unpack_from("<I", head, 8)[0] o = 12 names = [] for _ in range(n): e = head.index(b"\n", o) names.append(head[o:e].decode()) o = e + 1 minz, maxz = struct.unpack_from("<II", head, o + 8) d = open(f"{lots}/world_{cx}_{cy}.lotpack", "rb").read() offs = [struct.unpack_from("<Q", d, 12 + 8 * i)[0] for i in range(1024)] + [len(d)] sq = {} for i in range(1024): ch = d[offs[i]:offs[i + 1]] o = k = 0 while o < len(ch): m = struct.unpack_from("<I", ch, o)[0] o += 4 if m == NONE: k += struct.unpack_from("<I", ch, o)[0] o += 4 else: z, r = divmod(k, 64) a, b = divmod(r, 8) sq[(i // 32 * 8 + a, i % 32 * 8 + b, z)] = [names[t] for t in struct.unpack_from(f"<{m}I", ch, o)[1:]] o += 4 * m k += 1 return sq, maxz - minz + 1

nodes.name: composecheck.py
nodes.body_text: """Compare composed lots, including overlaps, with WorldEd. composecheck.py <map folder> [--show] Terrain prefixes are omitted; remaining background differences stay visible. """ import os from pathlib import Path import sys import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) from knoxbuild.buildtiles import compose_lots, level_tiles, parse_tbx from bxshow import load TERRAIN = ("blends_", "vegetation_foliage", "e_", "d_", "lighting_outdoor", "overlay_grime_floor", "fencing_", "street_trafficlines") UTILITY = ("fences", "lights", "structures", "bridge", "monument") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

nodes.name: compare_project
nodes.body_text: def compare_project(project): project = Path(project) root = ET.parse(project / (project.name + ".pzw")).getroot() placements, coverage, contributors = [], set(), {} buildings = 0 for cell in root.iter("cell"): cx, cy = int(cell.get("x")), int(cell.get("y")) for lot in cell.findall("lot"): path = project / lot.get("map") b = parse_tbx(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) tx, ty = cx * 300 + int(lot.get("x")), cy * 300 + int(lot.get("y")) base = int(lot.get("level")) placements.append((b, tx, ty, base)) utility = any(word in path.stem for word in UTILITY) if not utility: buildings += 1 for z in range(len(b.floors)): for (x, y), tiles in level_tiles(b, z).items(): if any(not t.startswith(TERRAIN) for t in tiles): contributors.setdefault((tx + x, ty + y, base + z), set()).add(len(placements)) coverage.add((tx + x, ty + y, base + z)) if not utility: coverage.update((tx + x, ty + y, base + z) for x in range(-1, b.width + 2) for y in range(-1, b.height + 2)) predicted = compose_lots(placements) cells, total, same, overlaps, overlap_misses, misses = {}, 0, 0, 0, 0, [] for pos in sorted(coverage): tx, ty, z = pos cx, cy = (21000 + tx) // 256, ty // 256 if (cx, cy) not in cells: cells[cx, cy] = load(str(project / "lots"), cx, cy)[0] actual = [t for t in cells[cx, cy].get(((21000 + tx) % 256, ty % 256, z), []) if not t.startswith(TERRAIN)] want = [t for t in predicted.get(pos, []) if not t.startswith(TERRAIN)] if not actual and not want: continue total += 1 overlap = len(contributors.get(pos, ())) > 1 overlaps += overlap same += actual == want if actual != want: overlap_misses += overlap misses.append((pos, want, actual)) return dict(buildings=buildings, same=same, total=total, overlaps=overlaps, overlap_misses=overlap_misses, misses=misses)

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(argv): if not argv: print(__doc__) return 2 result = compare_project(argv[0]) print(f"{result['buildings']} buildings composed: {result['same']} of {result['total']} unique squares identical; " f"{len(result['misses'])} mismatches") print(f"{result['overlaps']} overlapping tile squares checked; {result['overlap_misses']} mismatches") if "--show" in argv: for pos, want, actual in result['misses'][:10]: print(pos, "ours", want, "WorldEd", actual) return int(bool(result['misses']))

nodes.name: furnorder.py
nodes.body_text: """Which furniture tile comes first in WorldEd's stack? Pairwise precedence by (layer, orient).""" import collections import os import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) from bxshow import load from knoxbuild.buildtiles import parse_tbx H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) ORIGIN = 21000 variant, lx, ly, name = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] b = parse_tbx(open(f"{H}/{variant}/buildings/{name}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()) cx, cy = (ORIGIN + lx) // 256, ly // 256 sq, levels = load(f"{H}/{variant}/lots", cx, cy) before = collections.Counter() examples = {} for z, fl in enumerate(b.floors[:levels]): placed = collections.defaultdict(list) # square -> [(category, tile, file order)] for n, o in enumerate(fl.objects): if o.get("type") != "furniture": continue d = b.furniture[int(o["FurnitureTiles"])] for dx, dy, tile in d["orients"].get(o["orient"], []): placed[(int(o["x"]) + dx, int(o["y"]) + dy)].append(((d["layer"] or "-", o["orient"]), tile, n)) for (x, y), items in placed.items(): if len(items) < 2: continue actual = sq.get((ORIGIN + lx + x - cx * 256, ly + y - cy * 256, z), []) pos = {} for cat, tile, n in items: if tile in actual: pos[(cat, tile, n)] = actual.index(tile) keys = sorted(pos, key=pos.get) for i, a in enumerate(keys): for c in keys[i + 1:]: if a[0] != c[0]: before[(a[0], c[0])] += 1 examples.setdefault((a[0], c[0]), (z, x, y, a[1], c[1])) cats = sorted({c for pair in before for c in pair}) print("A before B (counts); a rule needs the reverse to be 0") for (a, c), n in sorted(before.items()): rev = before.get((c, a), 0) flag = "" if rev == 0 else f" <-- conflict, reverse {rev}" print(f" {a} before {c}: {n}{flag}")

nodes.name: headercheck.py
nodes.body_text: """Do the room and building tables built from the .tbx files equal WorldEd's headers? headercheck.py <real/real1 | exp/house | bx/<case>> [--show] Compares, cell by cell and in order, each room's name, level and rectangles, and the building lists. Room objects are not compared (see knoxbuild/buildheader.py). """ import os import re import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/TheTaZe/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--KnoxMap/cf336669-7001-42fe-9302-983424f5daee/scratchpad") from knoxbuild.buildheader import cell_tables, placed_rooms from knoxbuild.buildtiles import parse_tbx H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) proj = f"{H}/{sys.argv[1]}" name = os.path.basename(proj) lots, cell = [], None for line in open(f"{proj}/{name}.pzw", encoding="utf-8"): m = re.match(r'\s*<cell x="(\d+)" y="(\d+)"', line) if m: cell = (int(m[1]), int(m[2])) m = re.search(r'<lot x="(\d+)" y="(\d+)" level="(\d+)" width="(\d+)" height="(\d+)" map="buildings/([^"]+)\.tbx"', line) if m and cell and not any(k in m[6] for k in ("fences", "lights", "struct", "bridge", "monument")): lots.append((cell[0] * 300 + int(m[1]), cell[1] * 300 + int(m[2]), int(m[3]), m[6])) if name != "real1": # hand-made cases: the one building at (40, 40) lots = [(40, 40, 0, name)] if "bx" in sys.argv[1] else lots placed = placed_rooms([(parse_tbx(open(f"{proj}/buildings/{t}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()), tx, ty, lv) for tx, ty, lv, t in lots]) cells = sorted({tuple(int(t) for t in f[:-10].split("_")) for f in os.listdir(f"{proj}/lots") if f.endswith(".lotheader")}) ok_rooms = bad_rooms = ok_cells = 0 same_order = same_set = 0 for cx, cy in cells: want_rooms, want_buildings = cell_tables(cx, cy, placed) got_rooms, got_buildings = read_header(f"{proj}/lots/{cx}_{cy}.lotheader") got_rooms = [{"name": r["name"], "z": r["z"], "rects": [tuple(x) for x in r["rects"]]} for r in got_rooms] in_order = [sig(r) for r in want_rooms] == [sig(r) for r in got_rooms] as_sets = sorted(sig(r) for r in want_rooms) == sorted(sig(r) for r in got_rooms) # a building is the set of its rooms, whatever order they are listed in part = lambda rooms, bl: sorted(tuple(sorted(sig(rooms[i]) for i in b)) for b in bl) same_bl = part(want_rooms, want_buildings) == part(got_rooms, got_buildings) same_order += in_order same_set += as_sets and same_bl if not (as_sets and same_bl) and "--show" in sys.argv: print(f"cell {cx}_{cy}: ours {len(want_rooms)} rooms / {len(want_buildings)} buildings, " f"WorldEd {len(got_rooms)} / {len(got_buildings)}; same rooms (any order): {as_sets}; same buildings: {same_bl}") ours = {sig(r) for r in want_rooms} theirs = {sig(r) for r in got_rooms} for r in sorted(ours - theirs)[:2]: print(" only ours ", r) for r in sorted(theirs - ours)[:2]: print(" only WorldEd", r) print(f"{name}: of {len(cells)} cell headers, {same_set} have the same rooms and the same buildings " f"(room order also identical in {same_order})")

nodes.name: read_header
nodes.body_text: def read_header(path): import struct d = open(path, "rb").read() n = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, 8)[0] o = 12 for _ in range(n): o = d.index(b"\n", o) + 1 u = lambda: struct.unpack_from("<I", d, u.o)[0] pos = o + 16 nr = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, pos)[0] pos += 4 rooms = [] for _ in range(nr): e = d.index(b"\n", pos) name = d[pos:e].decode() pos = e + 1 z, nrect = struct.unpack_from("<II", d, pos) pos += 8 rects = [struct.unpack_from("<4I", d, pos + 16 * i) for i in range(nrect)] pos += 16 * nrect nobj = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, pos)[0] pos += 4 + 12 * nobj rooms.append({"name": name, "z": z, "rects": rects}) nb = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, pos)[0] pos += 4 buildings = [] for _ in range(nb): k = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, pos)[0] buildings.append(list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{k}I", d, pos + 4))) pos += 4 + 4 * k return rooms, buildings

nodes.name: sig

nodes.body_text: """Compare buildtiles with WorldEd on a real KnoxMap building. housecheck.py <variant folder> <lot world x> <lot world y> <tbx name> e.g. housecheck.py exp/house 269 592 house_0000 """ import collections import os import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) from bxshow import load from knoxbuild.buildtiles import level_tiles, parse_tbx H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) ORIGIN = 21000 variant, lx, ly, name = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] b = parse_tbx(open(f"{H}/{variant}/buildings/{name}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()) cx, cy = (ORIGIN + lx) // 256, ly // 256 sq, levels = load(f"{H}/{variant}/lots", cx, cy) print(f"{name}: {b.width}x{b.height}, {len(b.floors)} floors in the file, {levels} levels in the lots, cell {cx}_{cy}") for z in range(min(len(b.floors), levels)): pred = level_tiles(b, z) total = same = 0 only_actual = collections.Counter() only_pred = collections.Counter() for dy in range(-1, b.height + 2): for dx in range(-1, b.width + 2): actual = list(sq.get((ORIGIN + lx + dx - cx * 256, ly + dy - cy * 256, z), [])) if z == 0 and actual and actual[0].startswith("blends_natural"): actual = actual[1:] want = pred.get((dx, dy), []) if not actual and not want: continue total += 1 if actual == want: same += 1 else: for t in set(actual) - set(want): only_actual[prefix(t)] += 1 for t in set(want) - set(actual): only_pred[prefix(t)] += 1 print(f" level {z}: {same} of {total} squares identical") print(" WorldEd has, we lack:", dict(only_actual.most_common(6))) print(" we have, WorldEd lacks:", dict(only_pred.most_common(4))) # ---- examples of squares where we add a wall WorldEd does not --------------------------- if "--extra" in sys.argv: z = 0 pred = level_tiles(b, z) shown = 0 for dy in range(-1, b.height + 2): for dx in range(-1, b.width + 2): actual = list(sq.get((ORIGIN + lx + dx - cx * 256, ly + dy - cy * 256, z), [])) want = pred.get((dx, dy), []) extra = [t for t in want if t not in actual and t.startswith("walls_interior_house")] if extra and shown < 6: shown += 1 r = lambda x, y: b.floors[z].rooms[y][x] if 0 <= x < b.width and 0 <= y < b.height else 0 print(f"square ({dx},{dy}) room {r(dx,dy)} west-neighbour {r(dx-1,dy)} north-neighbour {r(dx,dy-1)}") print(" ours ", want) print(" WorldEd", actual) if "--trim" in sys.argv: z = 0 pred = level_tiles(b, z) shown = 0 for dy in range(-1, b.height + 2): for dx in range(-1, b.width + 2): actual = list(sq.get((ORIGIN + lx + dx - cx * 256, ly + dy - cy * 256, z), [])) if any(t.startswith("walls_interior_detailing") for t in actual) and shown < 8: shown += 1 rr = lambda x, y: b.floors[z].rooms[y][x] if 0 <= x < b.width and 0 <= y < b.height else 0 r = rr(dx, dy) print(f"square ({dx},{dy}) room {r} W-nb {rr(dx-1,dy)} N-nb {rr(dx,dy-1)} trim attr {b.rooms[r-1].get('InteriorWallTrim') if r else None}") print(" ours ", pred.get((dx, dy), [])) print(" WorldEd", actual) if "--diff" in sys.argv: TERRAIN = ("blends_", "vegetation_foliage", "e_", "d_", "lighting_outdoor", "overlay_grime_floor") zsel = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--diff") + 1]) pred = level_tiles(b, zsel) shown = 0 for dy in range(-1, b.height + 2): for dx in range(-1, b.width + 2): actual = list(sq.get((ORIGIN + lx + dx - cx * 256, ly + dy - cy * 256, zsel), [])) want = pred.get((dx, dy), []) a2 = [t for t in actual if not t.startswith(TERRAIN)] if a2 != want and shown < 8: shown += 1 rr = lambda x, y: b.floors[zsel].rooms[y][x] if 0 <= x < b.width and 0 <= y < b.height else 0 print(f"square ({dx},{dy}) room {rr(dx,dy)} W-nb {rr(dx-1,dy)} N-nb {rr(dx,dy-1)}") print(" ours ", want) print(" WorldEd", a2)

nodes.name: roofdump.py
nodes.body_text: """For each roof of a set: its parameters and the roof tiles it produced, relative to its rectangle.""" import os, sys sys.path.insert(0, 'C:/KnoxMap'); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) import bx from bxshow import load import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET from knoxbuild.buildtiles import tile_name H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); ORIGIN = 21000 case = sys.argv[1]; only = [int(a) for a in sys.argv[2:]] root = ET.parse(f"{H}/bx/{case}/buildings/{case}.tbx").getroot() names = {} for e in [c for c in root if c.tag == 'tile_entry']: if e.get('category') in ('roof_slopes', 'roof_caps', 'roof_tops'): for t in e: s = (t.get('enum').replace('Slope', 's').replace('Cap', 'c').replace('Peak', 'k').replace('Rise', 'R') .replace('Fall', 'F').replace('Point', 'p').replace('OnePt5', '1p5').replace('TwoPt5', '2p5').replace('Pt5', 'p5')) names.setdefault(tile_name(t.get('tile')), []).append(s) cx = (ORIGIN + bx.LOT_X) // 256 sq, levels = load(f"{H}/bx/{case}/lots", cx, 0) for i, (rt, d, w, h, caps) in enumerate(bx.ROOF_SETS[case]): if only and i not in only: continue x0, y0 = 2 + i * 13, 2 print(f"-- roof {i}: {rt} {d} {w}x{h} caps={caps or '-'}") for z in range(1, levels): rows = [] for y in range(y0 - 1, y0 + h + 2): row = [] for x in range(x0 - 1, x0 + w + 2): st = sq.get((ORIGIN + bx.LOT_X + x - cx * 256, bx.LOT_Y + y, z), []) toks = [names.get(t, ['?' + t.rsplit('_', 1)[-1]])[0] for t in st if not t.startswith('ceilings')] row.append(('/'.join(toks) or '.').ljust(7)) rows.append(' '.join(row)) if any(set(r.replace(' ', '').replace('.', '')) for r in rows): print(f" level {z}:"); [print(' ' + r) for r in rows]

nodes.name: roofshow.py
nodes.body_text: """Show roof tiles by their BuildingEd names. roofshow.py <case> <level> <x0> <y0> <w> <h> region in tiles from the lot's corner """ import os import sys import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) import bx from bxshow import load from knoxbuild.buildtiles import tile_name H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) ORIGIN = 21000 case, z, x0, y0, w, h = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), *(int(a) for a in sys.argv[3:7]) root = ET.parse(f"{H}/bx/{case}/buildings/{case}.tbx").getroot() ents = [c for c in root if c.tag == "tile_entry"] names = {} # tile -> [short enum names] for n, e in enumerate(ents, start=1): cat = e.get("category") if cat not in ("roof_slopes", "roof_caps", "roof_tops", "ceiling"): continue for t in e: short = (t.get("enum").replace("Slope", "s").replace("Cap", "c").replace("Peak", "pk") .replace("Rise", "R").replace("Fall", "F").replace("Point", "pt").replace("OnePt5", "1p5") .replace("TwoPt5", "2p5").replace("Pt5", "p5").replace("Shallow", "sh")) names.setdefault(tile_name(t.get("tile")), []).append(short) cx = (ORIGIN + bx.LOT_X) // 256 sq, levels = load(f"{H}/bx/{case}/lots", cx, 0) print(f"{case}: level {z} of {levels}, region x {x0}..{x0 + w - 1}, y {y0}..{y0 + h - 1} (c = ceiling)") for y in range(y0, y0 + h): row = [] for x in range(x0, x0 + w): st = sq.get((ORIGIN + bx.LOT_X + x - cx * 256, bx.LOT_Y + y, z), []) toks = [] for t in st: if t.startswith("ceilings"): toks.append("c") elif t in names: toks.append("|".join(names[t][:2]) + ("+" if len(names[t]) > 2 else "")) elif t.startswith(("roofs", "walls_exterior_roofs", "roofs_30")): toks.append("?" + t.rsplit("_", 1)[1]) row.append(" ".join(toks) or ".") print(f"{y:3} " + " ".join(r.ljust(11) for r in row))

nodes.name: winvar.py
nodes.body_text: """Which window variant does WorldEd pick, and what does it depend on?""" import collections import os import re import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_DIR", ".")) sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))) from bxshow import load from knoxbuild.buildtiles import parse_tbx, _entry H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) ORIGIN = 21000 proj = f"{H}/real/{sys.argv[1]}" name = os.path.basename(proj) cells = {} lots, cell = [], None for line in open(f"{proj}/{name}.pzw", encoding="utf-8"): m = re.match(r'\s*<cell x="(\d+)" y="(\d+)"', line) if m: cell = (int(m[1]), int(m[2])) m = re.search(r'<lot x="(\d+)" y="(\d+)" level="(\d+)" width="(\d+)" height="(\d+)" map="buildings/([^"]+)\.tbx"', line) if m and cell: x, y, lv, w, h, t = m.groups() lots.append((cell[0] * 300 + int(x), cell[1] * 300 + int(y), int(lv), t)) rows = collections.Counter() by = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter) for tx0, ty0, lv, tbx in lots: if any(k in tbx for k in ("fences", "lights", "structures", "bridge", "monument")): continue b = parse_tbx(open(f"{proj}/buildings/{tbx}.tbx", encoding="utf-8").read()) for z, fl in enumerate(b.floors): for o in fl.objects: if o.get("type") != "window": continue x, y = int(o["x"]), int(o["y"]) d = "North" if o.get("dir") == "N" else "West" stack = world(tx0 + x, ty0 + y, z + lv) r = fl.rooms[y][x] if 0 <= x < b.width and 0 <= y < b.height else 0 ent = _entry(b, b.attrs["ExteriorWall"]) if r == 0 else _entry(b, b.rooms[r - 1]["InteriorWall"]) nums = sorted({int(re.sub(r"\D", "", e) or 0) for e, t in ent.items() if e.startswith(d + "Window") and t in stack}) win = _entry(b, o.get("Tile")).get(d, "?") cur = _entry(b, o.get("CurtainsTile")).get("North" if d == "North" else "West", "-") sh = _entry(b, o.get("ShuttersTile")).get("NorthLeft" if d == "North" else "WestAbove", "-") key = ("ext" if r == 0 else "int", win[-18:], cur[-12:], sh[-12:]) rows[key] += 1 by[key][tuple(nums)] += 1 print("(side, window tile, curtain tile, shutter tile) -> candidate variant numbers (0 = plain)") for key, c in sorted(rows.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:24]: print(f" {key}: {c} {dict(by[key].most_common(3))}")

nodes.name: world
nodes.body_text: def world(tx, ty, z): cx, cy = (ORIGIN + tx) // 256, ty // 256 if (cx, cy) not in cells: try: cells[(cx, cy)] = load(f"{proj}/lots", cx, cy) except FileNotFoundError: cells[(cx, cy)] = ({}, 0) return cells[(cx, cy)][0].get(((ORIGIN + tx) - cx * 256, ty - cy * 256, z), [])

nodes.body_text: class ChunkedVegetationTests(unittest.TestCase): def setUp(self): self.proj = DummyProjector() def test_wild_growth_chunked_deterministic(self): size = (400, 400) land = Image.new("RGB", size, C.MEDIUM_GRASS) # Add a strip of road that wild growth must avoid for x in range(size[0]): for y in range(80, 90): land.putpixel((x, y), C.DARK_ASPHALT) veg = Image.new("RGB", size, C.VEG_NOTHING) planted = V._paint_wild_growth(veg, land, self.proj, 1.0) self.assertGreater(planted, 0) # Verify no trees planted on road px = veg.load() for x in range(size[0]): for y in range(80, 90): self.assertEqual(px[x, y], C.VEG_NOTHING) def test_groves_chunked_output(self): size = (500, 500) land = Image.new("RGB", size, C.MEDIUM_GRASS) veg = Image.new("RGB", size, C.VEG_NOTHING) planted = V._paint_groves(veg, land, self.proj, 1.0) self.assertGreater(planted, 0) # Trees sit on dark grass veg_arr = np.array(veg) land_arr = np.array(land) has_tree = (veg_arr == C.TREES).all(axis=2) if has_tree.any(): self.assertTrue((land_arr[has_tree] == C.DARK_GRASS).all()) def test_gardens_chunked_placement(self): size = (400, 400) land = Image.new("RGB", size, C.MEDIUM_GRASS) veg = Image.new("RGB", size, C.VEG_NOTHING) # Building footprint at (100, 100) -> (150, 150) feats = [ OSMFeature(1, "way", {"building": "yes"}, [(100, 100), (100, 150), (150, 150), (150, 100), (100, 100)]) ] planted = V._paint_gardens(veg, land, feats, self.proj, 1.0) self.assertGreater(planted, 0) # Verify no trees inside building footprint px = veg.load() for y in range(101, 149): for x in range(101, 149): self.assertEqual(px[x, y], C.VEG_NOTHING) def test_parks_chunked_placement(self): size = (400, 400) land = Image.new("RGB", size, C.DARK_GRASS) veg = Image.new("RGB", size, C.VEG_NOTHING) park_feats = [ OSMFeature(1, "way", {"leisure": "park"}, [(50, 50), (50, 250), (250, 250), (250, 50), (50, 50)]) ] planted = V._paint_parks(veg, land, park_feats, self.proj, 1.0) self.assertGreater(planted, 0) # Verify vegetation was planted inside the park veg_arr = np.array(veg) park_interior = veg_arr[60:240, 60:240] self.assertTrue((park_interior != C.VEG_NOTHING).any()) def test_plant_big_trees_chunked(self): size = (300, 300) land = Image.new("RGB", size, C.DARK_GRASS) veg = Image.new("RGB", size, C.TREES) # Big trees only exist where the game's tree rules were written; a # machine without Project Zomboid's tiles plants none, and the pass # says so by returning an empty count. with mock.patch.object(V, "tree_rules_ready", return_value=True): counts = V._plant_big_trees(veg, land, [], [], [], self.proj, 1.0) self.assertIsInstance(counts, dict) self.assertGreater(sum(counts.values()), 0)

nodes.name: rect_ring
nodes.signature: def rect_ring(x0, y0, x1, y1, angle_deg=0.0)
nodes.body_text: def rect_ring(x0, y0, x1, y1, angle_deg=0.0): cx, cy = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2 a = math.radians(angle_deg) out = [] for x, y in ((x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)): dx, dy = x - cx, y - cy out.append((cx + dx * math.cos(a) - dy * math.sin(a), cy + dx * math.sin(a) + dy * math.cos(a))) return out

nodes.body_text: class OsmFieldTest(unittest.TestCase): def test_long_field_is_split_along_its_axis(self): land, veg = blank(500, 200) n = F.paint_fields(land, veg, P(), [rect_ring(40, 50, 440, 150)], None) self.assertGreaterEqual(n, 3) self.assertTrue(colour_mask(land, C.DIRT_ROWS_H).any()) self.assertFalse(colour_mask(land, C.DIRT_ROWS_V).any()) inside = np.asarray(land)[55:145, 45:435] allowed = np.zeros(inside.shape[:2], dtype=bool) for colour in (C.DIRT_ROWS_H, C.LIGHT_GRASS): allowed |= np.all(inside == colour, axis=2) self.assertTrue(allowed.all()) def test_upright_field_gets_vertical_rows(self): land, veg = blank(200, 500) F.paint_fields(land, veg, P(), [rect_ring(50, 40, 150, 440)], None) self.assertTrue(colour_mask(land, C.DIRT_ROWS_V).any()) self.assertFalse(colour_mask(land, C.DIRT_ROWS_H).any()) def test_small_field_is_one_plot(self): land, veg = blank(200, 200) self.assertEqual(F.paint_fields(land, veg, P(), [rect_ring(50, 50, 130, 110)], None), 1) def test_road_over_a_field_survives(self): land, veg = blank(500, 200) ImageDraw.Draw(land).rectangle((200, 0, 205, 199), fill=C.MEDIUM_ASPHALT) F.paint_fields(land, veg, P(), [rect_ring(40, 50, 440, 150)], None) self.assertTrue(colour_mask(land, C.MEDIUM_ASPHALT)[:, 200:206].all()) self.assertFalse((np.asarray(veg)[:, 200:206] != 0).any()) def test_only_light_grass_outside_is_untouched(self): land, veg = blank(500, 200, C.DARK_GRASS) ImageDraw.Draw(land).polygon(rect_ring(40, 50, 440, 150), fill=C.LIGHT_GRASS) F.paint_fields(land, veg, P(), [rect_ring(40, 50, 440, 150)], None) self.assertTrue(colour_mask(land, C.DARK_GRASS)[0:45].all())

nodes.body_text: """Clearings and drives for buildings in woods; no field or lake under a house.""" import math import unittest from collections import deque import numpy as np from PIL import Image from generator import pz_colors as C from generator.rendering import homesteads as H W = HGT = 300 HOUSE = [(140, 140), (152, 140), (152, 150), (140, 150)] # 12 x 10 m ROAD = [(0, 260), (299, 260)] # 110 m south if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

nodes.name: woods
nodes.body_text: def woods(width=W, height=HGT): land = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), C.DARK_GRASS) veg = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), C.TREES) road = np.array(land) road[258:263, :] = C.MEDIUM_ASPHALT land = Image.fromarray(road, "RGB") return land, veg

nodes.name: is_
nodes.body_text: def is_(arr, *colours): out = np.zeros(arr.shape[:2], dtype=bool) for c in colours: out |= np.all(arr == c, axis=2) return out

nodes.name: distance_to_house
nodes.body_text: def distance_to_house(y, x): cx = min(max(x, 140), 152) cy = min(max(y, 140), 150) return math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy)

nodes.name: ClearingTest
nodes.body_text: class ClearingTest(unittest.TestCase): def setUp(self): self.land, self.veg = woods() self.done, self.counts = H.clear_homesteads(self.veg, self.land, [HOUSE], [ROAD], 1.0) self.v = np.asarray(self.veg) self.g = np.asarray(self.land) def test_a_clearing_10_to_30_m_out(self): self.assertEqual(self.counts["clearings"], 1) bare = ~is_(self.v, *H.WOODS) lo = H.CLEAR_M[0] * (1 - H.WOBBLE) - 1 hi = H.CLEAR_M[1] * (1 + H.WOBBLE) + H.EDGE_M + 1 for y in range(100, 200): for x in range(100, 200): d = distance_to_house(y, x) if d < lo: self.assertTrue(bare[y, x], (x, y, d)) if d > hi and not self.done[y, x]: self.assertFalse(bare[y, x], (x, y, d)) def test_not_a_ring(self): # The edge of the clearing is not the same distance all the way round. bare = ~is_(self.v, *H.WOODS) reach = [] for angle in range(0, 360, 15): dx, dy = math.cos(math.radians(angle)), math.sin(math.radians(angle)) r = 0 while bare[int(145 + dy * (r + 1)), int(146 + dx * (r + 1))]: r += 1 if r > 80: break reach.append(r) self.assertGreater(max(reach) - min(reach), 4, reach) def test_lawn_in_the_clearing(self): self.assertTrue(np.all(self.g[145, 125] == C.MEDIUM_GRASS)) def test_drive_reaches_the_road(self): self.assertEqual(self.counts["drives"], 1) tarmac = is_(self.g, C.DARK_ASPHALT) road = is_(self.g, C.MEDIUM_ASPHALT) self.assertTrue(tarmac.any()) # From next to the house, along the drive, to the road. start = next((x, y) for y in range(138, 154) for x in range(138, 156) if tarmac[y, x]) seen, queue, reached = {start}, deque([start]), False while queue: x, y = queue.popleft() for nx, ny in ((x + 1, y), (x - 1, y), (x, y + 1), (x, y - 1)): if not (0 <= nx < W and 0 <= ny < HGT) or (nx, ny) in seen: continue if road[ny, nx]: reached = True queue.clear() break if tarmac[ny, nx]: seen.add((nx, ny)) queue.append((nx, ny)) self.assertTrue(reached) self.assertFalse(is_(self.v, *H.WOODS)[tarmac].any()) def test_deterministic(self): land, veg = woods() H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE], [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertEqual(veg.tobytes(), self.veg.tobytes()) self.assertEqual(land.tobytes(), self.land.tobytes())

nodes.body_text: class WhoGetsOneTest(unittest.TestCase): def test_house_in_the_open_untouched(self): land, _ = woods() veg = Image.new("RGB", (W, HGT), C.VEG_NOTHING) veg.putpixel((120, 120), C.TREES) # one tree is not a wood before = land.tobytes() _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE], [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts, {"clearings": 0, "drives": 0}) self.assertEqual(land.tobytes(), before) self.assertEqual(veg.getpixel((120, 120)), C.TREES) def test_shed_gets_a_clearing_but_no_drive(self): land, veg = woods() shed = [(140, 140), (145, 140), (145, 144), (140, 144)] _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [shed], [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts, {"clearings": 1, "drives": 0}) def test_no_drive_across_water(self): land, veg = woods() g = np.array(land) g[200:215, :] = C.WATER land = Image.fromarray(g, "RGB") _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE], [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts["drives"], 0) self.assertFalse(is_(np.asarray(land), C.DARK_ASPHALT).any()) def test_no_drive_through_another_building(self): land, veg = woods() barn = [(100, 200), (200, 200), (200, 230), (100, 230)] _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE, barn], [ROAD], 1.0) g = np.asarray(land) self.assertFalse(is_(g[201:230, 101:200], C.DARK_ASPHALT).any()) def test_road_running_off_the_map(self): land, veg = woods() # Nearest to the house past the map's edge; only its on-map part counts. road = [(-400, 145), (-50, 145), (-50, 262), (299, 262)] _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE], [road], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts["drives"], 1) def test_house_and_garage_share_one_drive(self): land, veg = woods() garage = [(156, 140), (163, 140), (163, 147), (156, 147)] # 49 m2, 4 m off _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [garage, HOUSE], [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts["drives"], 1) # And it is the house's: it starts at the house, not the garage. g = np.asarray(land) self.assertTrue(is_(g[150:154, 139:154], C.DARK_ASPHALT).any()) def test_houses_far_apart_get_one_each(self): land, veg = woods() other = [(40, 140), (52, 140), (52, 150), (40, 150)] _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE, other], [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts["drives"], 2) def test_buildings_at_and_past_the_edge(self): land, veg = woods() edge_houses = [[(x, y) for x, y in ((290, 60), (305, 60), (305, 72), (290, 72))], [(x, y) for x, y in ((310, 60), (322, 60), (322, 72), (310, 72))], [(x, y) for x, y in ((-20, 60), (-8, 60), (-8, 72), (-20, 72))], # Over ten tiles past the edge, and smaller than HOUSE so # it comes after a drive is laid: its window's far end # was a negative index, read from the other end. [(x, y) for x, y in ((-40, 60), (-32, 60), (-32, 66), (-40, 66))], [(x, y) for x, y in ((140, -18), (148, -18), (148, -12), (140, -12))], [(x, y) for x, y in ((100, -15), (112, -15), (112, -5), (100, -5))]] _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE] + edge_houses, [ROAD], 1.0) self.assertGreaterEqual(counts["drives"], 2) def test_road_close_by_needs_no_drive(self): land, veg = woods() _, counts = H.clear_homesteads(veg, land, [HOUSE], [[(0, 152), (299, 152)]], 1.0) self.assertEqual(counts["drives"], 0)

nodes.body_text: """WorldCover ground is painted in marker colours, so what OSM painted over it can be told apart even where OSM used the very same colour.""" import unittest import numpy as np from PIL import Image, ImageDraw from generator import pz_colors as C from generator.rendering import landcover as L if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

nodes.body_text: class MarkerTest(unittest.TestCase): def test_markers_are_not_ground(self): for code, colour in L.MARKER.items(): self.assertNotIn(colour, C.LANDSCAPE_COLORS, code) self.assertEqual(len(set(L.MARKER.values())), len(L.MARKER)) def test_osm_in_the_same_colour_still_claims(self): grid = grid_half() land = Image.new("RGB", (20, 20), C.DARK_GRASS) L.paint_markers(land, grid) # A residential polygon (medium grass, class 30's own colour). ImageDraw.Draw(land).rectangle((14, 0, 19, 4), fill=C.MEDIUM_GRASS) owned = L.settle_markers(land, grid) self.assertFalse(owned[0:5, 14:20].any()) self.assertTrue(owned[5:, 10:].all()) self.assertTrue(owned[:, :10].all()) arr = np.asarray(land) for colour in L.MARKER.values(): self.assertFalse(np.all(arr == colour, axis=2).any()) self.assertTrue(np.all(arr[10, 2] == C.DARK_GRASS)) self.assertTrue(np.all(arr[10, 15] == C.MEDIUM_GRASS)) def test_class_zero_is_left_alone(self): grid = np.zeros((10, 10), dtype="uint8") grid[:5] = 40 land = Image.new("RGB", (10, 10), C.DARK_GRASS) L.paint_markers(land, grid) owned = L.settle_markers(land, grid) self.assertTrue(owned[:5].all()) self.assertFalse(owned[5:].any()) self.assertTrue(np.all(np.asarray(land)[7, 7] == C.DARK_GRASS)) def test_grid_resized_to_image(self): grid = grid_half(10, 10) land = Image.new("RGB", (40, 40), C.DARK_GRASS) L.paint_markers(land, grid) owned = L.settle_markers(land, grid) self.assertEqual(owned.shape, (40, 40)) self.assertTrue(owned.all()) def test_refine_drops_repainted(self): grid = grid_half() land = Image.new("RGB", (20, 20), C.DARK_GRASS) L.paint_markers(land, grid) owned = L.settle_markers(land, grid) land.putpixel((3, 3), C.PALE_CONCRETE) L.refine_owned(land, grid, owned) self.assertFalse(owned[3, 3]) self.assertTrue(owned[4, 4]) self.assertEqual(L.resized_grid(grid, land.size).shape, (20, 20))
