nodes.signature: def furnish_office(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, keep_clear: set, keeps_open=None) -> tuple[list[str], bool]
nodes.body_text: def furnish_office(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, keep_clear: set, keeps_open=None) -> tuple[list[str], bool]: """Workstations across the floor, a filing cabinet or a plant in the gaps between them. Returns what is left for the walls, and whether the floor was fitted out (a room too small for a desk in the open is not, and is furnished from its walls like any other).""" L = _layout() desk = rng.choice(OFFICE_DESKS) long_desk = len(C.FURNITURE[desk]["N"]) == 3 group = [(desk, 0, 1, "S"), ("office_chair", 1 if long_desk else 0, 0, "N")] cabinet = rng.choice(["filing_cabinet", "filing_cabinet_pale"]) plant = "plant" rows, (gx0, gy0, gw, gh, pieces) = pack_stations( plan, idx, room, group, occupied, keep_clear, keeps_open) if not rows: # Too small for a desk in the open: one against the wall, as before. walls = [desk, "office_chair", cabinet, cabinet, "water_cooler", "whiteboard", plant, cabinet, "corkboard", "bookshelf"] return walls, False def put_extra(role: str, x: int, y: int, orient: str) -> bool: got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, occupied | keep_clear) if got is None or (keeps_open and not keeps_open(set(got))): return False plan.furniture.append((role, x, y, orient)) occupied.update(got) return True # Between neighbours on a row, on the desk's line a filing cabinet and on # the chair's line a plant, and a cabinet at the end of the row. desk_dy = pieces[0][2] chair_dy = pieces[1][2] for oy, *xs in rows: for c, ox in enumerate(xs): gap = ox + gx0 + gw if c % 2 == 0: put_extra(cabinet, gap, oy + desk_dy, L._facing(cabinet, "S")) elif c % 3 == 1: put_extra(plant, gap, oy + chair_dy, "N") return ["water_cooler", "whiteboard", "corkboard", "bookshelf", cabinet, plant], True

nodes.name: put_extra
nodes.signature: def put_extra(role: str, x: int, y: int, orient: str) -> bool
nodes.body_text: def put_extra(role: str, x: int, y: int, orient: str) -> bool: got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, occupied | keep_clear) if got is None or (keeps_open and not keeps_open(set(got))): return False plan.furniture.append((role, x, y, orient)) occupied.update(got) return True

nodes.name: furnish_classroom
nodes.signature: def furnish_classroom(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, keep_clear: set, keeps_open=None) -> tuple[list[str], bool]
nodes.body_text: def furnish_classroom(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, keep_clear: set, keeps_open=None) -> tuple[list[str], bool]: group = CLASS_DESK if (room.x1 - room.x0) < (room.y1 - room.y0): # A tall room faces its board on the west wall: the rows turn with it. group = [(role, dy, dx, _TURNED[o]) for role, dx, dy, o in group] rows, _measures = pack_stations(plan, idx, room, group, occupied, keep_clear, keeps_open, gap=1, aisle=1) if not rows: return ["whiteboard", "table", "chair", "chair", "desk", "bookshelf", "shelf"], False return ["whiteboard", "desk", "office_chair", "bookshelf", "bookshelf", "shelf"], True

nodes.name: furnish_salon
nodes.signature: def furnish_salon(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str]
nodes.body_text: def furnish_salon(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str]: """Hairdresser's chairs out in the floor, and wash basins along the back wall each with a commercial counter beside it. Returns what is left for the walls: mirrors and a plant, no bookcases.""" L = _layout() cells = _cells(plan, idx, room) front = _front_side(plan, idx, cells, None) frame = Frame(cells, front) back = OPPOSITE[front] # The back wall: a basin, then a counter, then a basin. A wall with doors # down it has room for one basin or none, so the side walls get a turn. basin = rng.choice([s for s in ("sink", "sink_cream") if s in C.FURNITURE] or ["sink"]) def wash_wall(frame, back) -> int: run = [basin if n % 2 == 0 else "shop_counter" for n in range(frame.length)] basins = 0 for a, role in enumerate(run): x, y = frame.xy(a, frame.depth - 1) orient = L._facing(role, back) got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, no_go | occupied) if got is None or (keeps_open and not keeps_open(set(got))): continue plan.furniture.append((role, x, y, orient)) occupied.update(got) basins += role == basin return basins washed = wash_wall(frame, back) for f in (f for f in ("N", "S", "E", "W") if f != front and f != OPPOSITE[front]): if washed >= 2: break washed += wash_wall(Frame(cells, f), OPPOSITE[f]) # Styling stations: a salon chair a step out from a mirror on the wall, # facing it, side by side along a north or west wall (the walls a # mirror hangs on). The chairs used to stand in rows in the open floor, # office chairs turned to the basins. chair = "salon_chair" if "salon_chair" in C.FURNITURE else "office_chair" want = max(2, room.area // SALON_TILES_PER_CHAIR) chairs = 0 for wall in ("W", "N"): if wall in (front, back): continue sx, sy = STEP[OPPOSITE[wall]] for i, (x, y) in enumerate(_against(plan, idx, cells, wall)[1:-1]): if chairs >= want: continue if (x, y) in occupied or (x + sx, y + sy) in occupied: continue if not _put(plan, idx, chair, x + sx, y + sy, OPPOSITE[wall], occupied, no_go, keeps_open): continue occupied.add((x, y)) # the station's own step to the mirror _hang(plan, idx, "mirror", x, y, wall) chairs += 1 # Where no side wall takes them: in rows across the floor, as before. for d in range(frame.depth - 3, 1, -3): for a in range(2, frame.length - 1, 3): if chairs >= want: break x, y = frame.xy(a, d) chairs += _put(plan, idx, chair, x, y, L._facing(chair, back), occupied, no_go, keeps_open) # A hood dryer for a big salon, against a wall. if chairs >= 3 and "hair_dryer" in C.FURNITURE: for side in (back, "W", "N", "E", "S"): if side != front and any( _put(plan, idx, "hair_dryer", x, y, side, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) for x, y in _against(plan, idx, cells, side)[1:-1]): break return ["mirror", "plant"]

nodes.name: wash_wall
nodes.body_text: def wash_wall(frame, back) -> int: run = [basin if n % 2 == 0 else "shop_counter" for n in range(frame.length)] basins = 0 for a, role in enumerate(run): x, y = frame.xy(a, frame.depth - 1) orient = L._facing(role, back) got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, no_go | occupied) if got is None or (keeps_open and not keeps_open(set(got))): continue plan.furniture.append((role, x, y, orient)) occupied.update(got) basins += role == basin return basins

nodes.name: palette
nodes.signature: def palette(rng: random.Random, profile=None) -> dict[str, str]
nodes.body_text: def palette(rng: random.Random, profile=None) -> dict[str, str]: """Role -> the role this home uses for it.""" def choose(options, weight): return rng.choices(options, weights=[weight(option) for option in options], k=1)[0] sofa_sets = [s for s in SOFA_SETS if s[0] in C.FURNITURE and s[1] in C.FURNITURE] if profile: sofa, armchair = choose(sofa_sets, lambda pair: ( profile.furniture_weight(pair[0]) + profile.furniture_weight(pair[1])) / 2) else: sofa, armchair = rng.choice(sofa_sets) out = {"sofa": sofa, "armchair": armchair} for role, options in CHOICES.items(): options = [o for o in options if o in C.FURNITURE] pick = choose(options, profile.furniture_weight) if profile else rng.choice(options) out[role] = pick # Both beds of a pair and both wardrobes follow the one choice. out["double_bed_alt"] = out["double_bed"] out["bed_alt"] = out["bed"] out["wardrobe2"] = out["wardrobe"] dressers = [o for o in CHOICES["dresser"] if o in C.FURNITURE] out["dresser_alt"] = (choose(dressers, profile.furniture_weight) if profile else rng.choice(dressers)) return out

nodes.name: choose
nodes.body_text: def choose(options, weight): return rng.choices(options, weights=[weight(option) for option in options], k=1)[0]

nodes.name: _in_tone
nodes.signature: def _in_tone(role: str, x: int, y: int, orient: str, tone: dict) -> tuple | None
nodes.body_text: def _in_tone(role: str, x: int, y: int, orient: str, tone: dict) -> tuple | None: """(role, orient) of the piece in this wood that fits on the old one's tiles, or None to leave it.""" kind = TONE_KIND.get(role) new = tone.get(kind) if not new or new == role or new not in C.FURNITURE: return None cells = _layout()._cells_for under = set(cells(role, x, y, orient)) sides = [orient] + ([o for o in C.FURNITURE[new] if o != orient] if kind in _TONE_ANY_SIDE else []) for side in sides: if side in C.FURNITURE[new] and set(cells(new, x, y, side)) == under: return new, side return None

nodes.name: one_wood
nodes.body_text: def one_wood(building, rng: random.Random) -> None: """Every home in `building` furnished in one wood: the whole building if it is a house, each flat of a block of flats.""" L = _layout() tones: dict = {} for lvl, plan in enumerate(building.storeys): if plan.kind not in L.HOME_KINDS: continue flats = plan.kind == "apartment" out = [] for role, x, y, orient in plan.furniture: room = plan.grid[y][x] if 0 <= y < plan.height and 0 <= x < plan.width else 0 unit = plan.rooms[room - 1].unit if room else 0 got = None # A bathroom keeps its shelves: the black wood has no bookcase and # turned a bathroom shelf into a chest of drawers. bathroom = room and plan.rooms[room - 1].kind == "bathroom" if role in TONE_KIND and not (flats and not unit) and not bathroom: key = (lvl, unit) if flats else None if key not in tones: tones[key] = TONES[rng.choices(list(TONE_WEIGHTS), weights=list(TONE_WEIGHTS.values()))[0]] got = _in_tone(role, x, y, orient, tones[key]) out.append((got[0], x, y, got[1]) if got else (role, x, y, orient)) plan.furniture = out

nodes.name: bed_against_wall
nodes.signature: def bed_against_wall(plan, idx: int, room, slots, occupied: set, door_tiles: set, bed: str, side_table: str | None, keeps_open=None) -> bool
nodes.body_text: def bed_against_wall(plan, idx: int, room, slots, occupied: set, door_tiles: set, bed: str, side_table: str | None, keeps_open=None) -> bool: """A bed with its head to a wall and a bedside table on each side, on the longest stretch of inside wall that takes it. A spot or a bedside table that keeps_open(tiles) refuses is skipped.""" L = _layout() by_side: dict[str, list] = {} for x, y, facing in slots: by_side.setdefault(facing, []).append((x, y)) order = sorted(by_side, key=lambda s: (any(not L._room_at(plan, x + STEP[s][0], y + STEP[s][1]) for x, y in by_side[s]), -len(by_side[s]))) has_tables = side_table and side_table in C.FURNITURE def table_fits(fx, fy, t_or, taken): tc = L._cells_for(side_table, fx, fy, t_or) return all(c not in taken and c not in door_tiles and L._room_at(plan, *c) == idx for c in tc) and (keeps_open is None or keeps_open(tc)) # Every spot that takes the bed, in order of preference, and then the # first with room for a table each side, else one, else none: the first # spot that took the bed was often in a corner with no room beside it, # and a bed with a table each side was one in five. spots = [] for side in order: orient = L._facing(bed, side) if orient != side: continue tiles = sorted(by_side[side]) for x, y in tiles[len(tiles) // 3:] + tiles[:len(tiles) // 3]: cells = L._cells_for(bed, 0, 0, orient) w = max(cx for cx, _ in cells) h = max(cy for _, cy in cells) ax = x - w if side == "E" else x ay = y - h if side == "S" else y got = L._cells_for(bed, ax, ay, orient) if any(c in occupied or c in door_tiles or L._room_at(plan, *c) != idx for c in got): continue # A row of floor at the foot of the bed, or it wall-to-walls a # narrow bedroom and the far side of the room cannot be reached. dx, dy = {"N": (0, 1), "S": (0, -1), "W": (1, 0), "E": (-1, 0)}[side] foot = {(cx + dx, cy + dy) for cx, cy in got} - set(got) if any(c in occupied or L._room_at(plan, *c) != idx for c in foot): continue if keeps_open and not keeps_open(got): continue if side in ("N", "S"): flank = [(ax - 1, y), (ax + w + 1, y)] else: flank = [(x, ay - 1), (x, ay + h + 1)] t_or = L._facing(side_table, side) if has_tables else None fits = 0 if has_tables and t_or == side: taken = occupied | set(got) | foot fits = sum(table_fits(fx, fy, t_or, taken) for fx, fy in flank) spots.append((fits, bed, ax, ay, orient, got, foot, flank, t_or)) if fits == 2: break if spots and spots[-1][0] == 2: break if not spots: return False best = max(range(len(spots)), key=lambda i: (spots[i][0], -i)) _fits_n, bed, ax, ay, orient, got, foot, flank, t_or = spots[best] plan.furniture.append((bed, ax, ay, orient)) occupied.update(got) occupied.update(foot) # A bedside table with no sprite for this wall is left out rather than # drawn facing its own back; the bed still gets its wall. if has_tables and t_or == orient: for fx, fy in flank: if table_fits(fx, fy, t_or, occupied): plan.furniture.append((side_table, fx, fy, t_or)) occupied.update(L._cells_for(side_table, fx, fy, t_or)) return True

nodes.name: table_fits
nodes.body_text: def table_fits(fx, fy, t_or, taken): tc = L._cells_for(side_table, fx, fy, t_or) return all(c not in taken and c not in door_tiles and L._room_at(plan, *c) == idx for c in tc) and (keeps_open is None or keeps_open(tc))

nodes.name: eatery_style
nodes.signature: def eatery_style(plan, idx: int, room) -> str
nodes.body_text: def eatery_style(plan, idx: int, room) -> str: """How a dining room is fitted: from the kitchen it serves.""" if room.kind in ("cafe", "bar", "icecream"): return room.kind L = _layout() near = {plan.rooms[j - 1].kind for j in L._neighbours(plan).get(idx, {})} if "pizzakitchen" in near: return "pizza" if near & {"dinerkitchen", "burgerkitchen"}: return "diner" return "tables"

nodes.name: _pack_sets
nodes.signature: def _pack_sets(plan, idx: int, frame, group, occupied: set, blocked: set, keeps_open=None) -> int
nodes.body_text: def _pack_sets(plan, idx: int, frame, group, occupied: set, blocked: set, keeps_open=None) -> int: """As many of a seating set as the floor holds, a tile of aisle between one set and the next but the aisle shared, so a dining room is rows of booths and not three sets with a ring of floor round each. Filled from the back of the room, so the way in stays open.""" L = _layout() pieces = [(role, dx, dy, L._facing(role, o)) for role, dx, dy, o in group] shape = [(dx + cx, dy + cy) for role, dx, dy, o in pieces for cx, cy in L._cells_for(role, 0, 0, o)] solid = [(dx + cx, dy + cy) for role, dx, dy, o in pieces if C.FURNITURE_LAYERS.get(role, "Furniture") == "Furniture" for cx, cy in L._cells_for(role, 0, 0, o)] ring = {(x + i, y + j) for x, y in shape for i in (-1, 0, 1) for j in (-1, 0, 1)} - set(shape) spot = {frame.xy(a, d): (a, d) for a in range(frame.length) for d in range(frame.depth)} origins = sorted(spot, key=lambda c: (-spot[c][1], abs(spot[c][0] - frame.length / 2), c)) aisle: set = set() n = 0 for ox, oy in origins: cells = [(ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in shape] if any(L._room_at(plan, *c) != idx or c in occupied or c in blocked or c in aisle for c in cells): continue if keeps_open and not keeps_open({(ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in solid}): continue for role, dx, dy, o in pieces: plan.furniture.append((role, ox + dx, oy + dy, o)) occupied.update(cells) aisle.update((ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in ring) n += 1 return n

nodes.name: _wall_sets
nodes.signature: def _wall_sets(plan, idx: int, room, group, placed_cells: set, blocked: set) -> int
nodes.body_text: def _wall_sets(plan, idx: int, room, group, placed_cells: set, blocked: set) -> int: """Sets stood against a long wall one after another, leaving the rest of a narrow room as the aisle.""" L = _layout() along_x = room.w >= room.h # Laid along x the set is turned so its length runs along the wall. pieces = group if not along_x else [(r, dy, dx, L._TURN[o]) for r, dx, dy, o in group] pieces = [(r, dx, dy, L._facing(r, o)) for r, dx, dy, o in pieces] cells_of = [(dx + cx, dy + cy) for r, dx, dy, o in pieces for cx, cy in L._cells_for(r, 0, 0, o)] span = max(x for x, _ in cells_of) + 1 if along_x else max(y for _, y in cells_of) + 1 n = 0 start = room.x0 if along_x else room.y0 end = room.x1 if along_x else room.y1 depth = max(y for _, y in cells_of) + 1 if along_x else max(x for x, _ in cells_of) + 1 # Against one long wall, then the other if the room is wide enough to # keep an aisle between them. across = room.h if along_x else room.w walls = [room.y0 if along_x else room.x0] if across >= 2 * depth + 2: walls.append((room.y1 if along_x else room.x1) - depth + 1) for wall in walls: t = start while t + span - 1 <= end: ox, oy = (t, wall) if along_x else (wall, t) cells = [(ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in cells_of] if all(L._room_at(plan, *c) == idx and c not in placed_cells and c not in blocked for c in cells): for r, dx, dy, o in pieces: plan.furniture.append((r, ox + dx, oy + dy, o)) placed_cells.update(cells) n += 1 t += WALL_SET_EVERY else: t += 1 return n

nodes.name: furnish_dining
nodes.signature: def furnish_dining(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, keep_clear: set, door_tiles: set, street: str | None, keeps_open=None) -> list[str]
nodes.body_text: def furnish_dining(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, keep_clear: set, door_tiles: set, street: str | None, keeps_open=None) -> list[str]: """Fit out a dining room, café or bar. Returns what is left for the walls.""" L = _layout() style = eatery_style(plan, idx, room) cells = _cells(plan, idx, room) # The doorways and the tile either side of each: a small café cannot give # a whole ring of floor to every door. blocked = set(keep_clear) | set(door_tiles) for x, y, d in plan.doors: blocked |= {(x - 1, y), (x + 1, y)} if d == "N" else {(x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)} # The counter across the back, away from the street door. front = _front_side(plan, idx, cells, street) frame = Frame(cells, front) counter = BACK_COUNTERS.get(style, BACK_COUNTERS["tables"]) counter = [c for c in counter if c in C.FURNITURE] def lay_counter(frame, back) -> bool: depth = frame.depth - 1 if not counter or frame.depth < 5: return False # An unbroken run: the back wall has doors to the kitchen and # storerooms, so the whole run goes where there is clear wall, nearest # the middle, and a shorter one when there is none that long. run = None shorter = [] for n in range(len(counter), 1, -1): for roles in (counter[:n], counter[-n:]): if roles not in shorter: shorter.append(roles) for roles in shorter: n = len(roles) for start in sorted(range(frame.length - n + 1), key=lambda s0: abs(s0 + n / 2 - frame.length / 2)): a, used, laid = start, set(), [] for role in roles: x, y = frame.xy(a, depth) orient = L._facing(role, back) got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, blocked | occupied | used) if got is None: laid = None break laid.append((role, x, y, orient)) used.update(got) a += len(got) if laid: run = (start, a, laid, used) break if run: break if not run: return False start, a, laid, used = run plan.furniture.extend(laid) occupied.update(used) # Room behind the counter to stand, and in front to queue. occupied.update(frame.xy(a2, depth - 1) for a2 in range(start - 1, a + 1)) return True # Across from the street door; failing that along a side wall, as a # back wall with doors all down it has no stretch long enough. sides = [front] + [f for f in ("N", "S", "E", "W") if f != front and f != OPPOSITE[front]] for f in sides: if lay_counter(frame if f == front else Frame(cells, f), OPPOSITE[f]): break # Seating: sets out in the floor where there is room for an aisle all # round, else against the long wall. if style in BOOTH_SETS: group = BOOTH_SETS[style] elif style in ("cafe", "icecream", "bar"): group = SMALL_TABLE_SET else: group = TABLE_SET group = [g for g in group if g[0] in C.FURNITURE] placed = 0 if min(room.w, room.h) >= MIN_PACK_SIDE: placed = _pack_sets(plan, idx, frame, group, occupied, blocked, keeps_open) if not placed: placed = _wall_sets(plan, idx, room, group, occupied, blocked) if not placed: # Too small even for that: one small table and its chairs. L._place_group(plan, idx, room, [g for g in SMALL_TABLE_SET if g[0] in C.FURNITURE], 1, occupied, set(door_tiles), keeps_open) return ["plant", "painting", "plant"]

nodes.name: lay_counter
nodes.body_text: def lay_counter(frame, back) -> bool: depth = frame.depth - 1 if not counter or frame.depth < 5: return False # An unbroken run: the back wall has doors to the kitchen and # storerooms, so the whole run goes where there is clear wall, nearest # the middle, and a shorter one when there is none that long. run = None shorter = [] for n in range(len(counter), 1, -1): for roles in (counter[:n], counter[-n:]): if roles not in shorter: shorter.append(roles) for roles in shorter: n = len(roles) for start in sorted(range(frame.length - n + 1), key=lambda s0: abs(s0 + n / 2 - frame.length / 2)): a, used, laid = start, set(), [] for role in roles: x, y = frame.xy(a, depth) orient = L._facing(role, back) got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, blocked | occupied | used) if got is None: laid = None break laid.append((role, x, y, orient)) used.update(got) a += len(got) if laid: run = (start, a, laid, used) break if run: break if not run: return False start, a, laid, used = run plan.furniture.extend(laid) occupied.update(used) # Room behind the counter to stand, and in front to queue. occupied.update(frame.xy(a2, depth - 1) for a2 in range(start - 1, a + 1)) return True

nodes.name: _against
nodes.signature: def _against(plan, idx: int, cells: set, side: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]
nodes.body_text: def _against(plan, idx: int, cells: set, side: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]: """This room's tiles with a wall on `side`, in order along that wall.""" L = _layout() dx, dy = STEP[side] tiles = [(x, y) for x, y in cells if L._room_at(plan, x + dx, y + dy) != idx] return sorted(tiles, key=lambda t: (t[0], t[1]) if side in ("N", "S") else (t[1], t[0]))

nodes.name: _put
nodes.signature: def _put(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> bool
nodes.body_text: def _put(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> bool: if role not in C.FURNITURE or orient not in C.FURNITURE[role]: return False got = _fits(plan, idx, role, x, y, orient, no_go | occupied) if got is None or (keeps_open and not keeps_open(set(got))): return False plan.furniture.append((role, x, y, orient)) occupied.update(got) return True

nodes.name: _hang
nodes.signature: def _hang(plan, idx, role, x, y, wall: str) -> bool
nodes.body_text: def _hang(plan, idx, role, x, y, wall: str) -> bool: """A wall piece on (x, y) against `wall`, unless something hangs there.""" L = _layout() if wall not in ("N", "W") and role in L.NORTH_WEST_ONLY: return False edge = L._wall_edge(x, y, wall) if edge in plan.wall_pieces or role not in C.FURNITURE: return False plan.furniture.append((role, x, y, L._facing(role, wall))) plan.wall_pieces.add(edge) return True

nodes.name: furnish_bar
nodes.signature: def furnish_bar(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None
nodes.body_text: def furnish_bar(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None: """The bar along the back: bottle shelves on the wall, a step for whoever serves, the counter open at both ends, and stools along its front. A pool table in the floor if there is room for it and the players, a jukebox and an arcade cabinet against the walls.""" cells = _cells(plan, idx, room) if len(cells) < BAR_MIN_TILES: return None front = _front_side(plan, idx, cells, None) frame = Frame(cells, front) back = OPPOSITE[front] if frame.depth < 6 or frame.length < 5: return None d_shelf, d_counter, d_stool = frame.depth - 1, frame.depth - 3, frame.depth - 4 counters = 0 for a in range(1, frame.length - 1): x, y = frame.xy(a, d_counter) counters += _put(plan, idx, "bar_counter", x, y, back, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) if counters < 2: return None for a in range(1, frame.length - 1): _put(plan, idx, "bar_shelf", *frame.xy(a, d_shelf), back, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) # The serving step stays floor. occupied.add(frame.xy(a, frame.depth - 2)) for a in range(1, frame.length - 1, 2): _put(plan, idx, "bar_stool", *frame.xy(a, d_stool), front, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) # A pool table needs a cue's length round it: a clear ring of two. if frame.depth >= 11 and frame.length >= 7: orient = "N" if frame.along_x else "W" for a in range(2, frame.length - 3): x, y = frame.xy(a, 3) ring = {(x + dx, y + dy) for dx in range(-2, 4) for dy in range(-2, 4)} if all(c in cells and c not in occupied and c not in no_go for c in ring) \ and _put(plan, idx, "pool_table", x, y, orient, occupied, no_go, keeps_open): occupied.update(ring) break for role in ("jukebox", "arcade"): done = False for side in ("N", "W", "E", "S"): if done or side == front or side not in C.FURNITURE.get(role, {}): continue done = any(_put(plan, idx, role, x, y, side, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) for x, y in _against(plan, idx, cells, side)[1:-1]) return ["plant", "painting"]

nodes.name: furnish_laundromat
nodes.signature: def furnish_laundromat(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None
nodes.body_text: def furnish_laundromat(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None: """Washers down one long wall and dryers down the other, a folding table in the middle, a chair or two to wait on.""" cells = _cells(plan, idx, room) if len(cells) < 20: return None long_a = max(STEP, key=lambda s: len(_against(plan, idx, cells, s))) placed = 0 for side, role in ((long_a, "coin_washer"), (OPPOSITE[long_a], "coin_dryer")): fx, fy = STEP[OPPOSITE[side]] for x, y in _against(plan, idx, cells, side): front = (x + fx, y + fy) if front in occupied or front not in cells: continue if _put(plan, idx, role, x, y, side, occupied, no_go, keeps_open): occupied.add(front) # its door opens onto the floor placed += 1 if placed < 3: return None return ["table", "chair", "chair", "plant", "shelf"]

nodes.name: furnish_gym
nodes.signature: def furnish_gym(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None
nodes.body_text: def furnish_gym(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None: """Treadmills in one unbroken row facing a mirrored wall, and the weights in evenly spaced rows behind them, every machine on the same line as the ones in the row in front of it.""" cells = _cells(plan, idx, room) if len(cells) < 30: return None # Mirrors on a north or west wall, the treadmills facing it. wall = max(("N", "W"), key=lambda s: len(_against(plan, idx, cells, s))) line = _against(plan, idx, cells, wall) for x, y in line[1:-1]: _hang(plan, idx, "mirror", x, y, wall) # A treadmill is drawn facing west or north only: it stands with its # back to the east or south, running towards the mirrors. run_orient = "E" if wall == "W" else "S" sx, sy = STEP[OPPOSITE[wall]] machines = 0 # One row with no gaps: a treadmill is a tile wide, so its neighbour stands # flush beside it as they do along a real gym wall. Dropping every other # one left a treadmill, a space, a treadmill - which is what reads as a # gym floor with machines stood about at random. for x, y in line[1:-1]: machines += _put(plan, idx, "treadmill", x + sx, y + sy, run_orient, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) # The weights behind them, in rows square to that line and evenly spaced, # one model to a row and each machine in line with the row in front. They # used to go down on a 3x3 lattice with a coin tossed for the model, which # is what scattered them: three machines in a whole gym, at odd angles to # each other. weights = [w for w in ("weight_machine", "weight_machine_alt") if w in C.FURNITURE] frame = Frame(cells, wall) for row, d in enumerate(range(4, frame.depth - 1, 3)): role = weights[row % len(weights)] for a in range(1, frame.length - 1, 2): x, y = frame.xy(a, d) machines += _put(plan, idx, role, x, y, wall, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) if machines < 2: return None return ["shelf", "plant", "water_cooler"]

nodes.name: furnish_church
nodes.signature: def furnish_church(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None
nodes.body_text: def furnish_church(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, occupied: set, no_go: set, keeps_open=None) -> list[str] | None: """The altar at the far end from the door, and pews in rows facing it either side of an aisle down the middle.""" cells = _cells(plan, idx, room) if len(cells) < 30: return None door = _front_side(plan, idx, cells, None) # The altar faces the door when it can; the game draws it facing south # or east only, so where the far wall is a south or east one it goes on # a north or west wall instead and the pews turn to face it. altars = C.FURNITURE.get("altar", {}) back = OPPOSITE[door] if back not in altars: back = next((w for w in ("N", "W") if w in altars and w != door), back) front = OPPOSITE[back] frame = Frame(cells, front) if frame.length < 9 or frame.depth < 7: return None mid = frame.length // 2 if back in altars: _put(plan, idx, "altar", *frame.xy(mid, frame.depth - 2), back, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) else: _put(plan, idx, "table", *frame.xy(mid, frame.depth - 2), "N" if frame.along_x else "W", occupied, no_go, keeps_open) # Pews have their backs to the door and face the altar: three seats each, # an aisle down the middle and along both walls. pews = 0 for d in range(2, frame.depth - 4, 2): for a0 in (mid - 4, mid + 2): if a0 < 1 or a0 + 2 > frame.length - 2: continue x, y = min(frame.xy(a0 + k, d) for k in range(3)) pews += _put(plan, idx, "pew", x, y, front, occupied, no_go, keeps_open) if pews < 2: return None return ["plant", "painting", "shelf"]

nodes.name: household
nodes.body_text: def household(rng: random.Random, plan) -> dict: """{"kind": "family" | "retired" | "adults", "teen": bool, "siblings": bool}.""" age = getattr(plan.profile, "age", 0) or 0 retired = RETIRED_SHARE + (RETIRED_OLD_BUILDING if age >= OLD_BUILDING_YEARS else 0) roll = rng.random() family = FAMILY_SHARE.get(plan.kind, 0.3) kind = "family" if roll < family else "retired" if roll < family + retired else "adults" return {"kind": kind, "teen": kind == "family" and rng.random() < TEEN_SHARE, "siblings": kind == "family" and rng.random() < SIBLINGS_SHARE, "baby": kind == "family" and rng.random() < BABY_SHARE}

nodes.name: for_household
nodes.signature: def for_household(base: list[str], room, home: dict, kid_rooms: dict, rng: random.Random) -> list[str]
nodes.body_text: def for_household(base: list[str], room, home: dict, kid_rooms: dict, rng: random.Random) -> list[str]: """The room's wishlist for who lives there.""" posters = list(getattr(C, "POSTERS", ())) kind = room.kind if home["kind"] == "retired": if kind == "livingroom": return base + ["armchair", "plant", "plant"] return base if home["kind"] != "family": return base child = kind == "kidsbedroom" or (kind == "bedroom" and room.area <= CHILD_ROOM_MAX_TILES) if not child: return base nth = kid_rooms.get(room.unit, 0) kid_rooms[room.unit] = nth + 1 out = list(base) if home["teen"] and nth == 0: # The eldest's room: a desk to work at, and posters on the walls. out = [r for r in out if r not in ("plant", "painting")] out += ["desk", "office_chair"] + ([rng.choice(posters), rng.choice(posters)] if posters else []) return out if home.get("baby") and not home.get("cot") and "crib" in C.FURNITURE: home["cot"] = True out = ["crib" if r in ("bed", "double_bed") else r for r in out] elif home["siblings"] and room.area >= BUNK_MIN_TILES and "bunk_bed" in C.FURNITURE: out = ["bunk_bed" if r in ("bed", "double_bed") else r for r in out] if posters: out = [rng.choice(posters) if r == "painting" else r for r in out] return out

nodes.name: extras
nodes.signature: def extras(base: list[str], room, rng: random.Random) -> list[str]
nodes.body_text: def extras(base: list[str], room, rng: random.Random) -> list[str]: """A home room's wishlist with its vanity.""" if room.kind == "bedroom" and rng.random() < VANITY: return ["vanity" if r == "dresser_alt" else r for r in base] return base

nodes.name: dress_room
nodes.signature: def dress_room(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, door_edges: set, no_go: set, keeps_open, walk: set) -> None
nodes.body_text: def dress_room(plan, idx: int, room, rng: random.Random, door_edges: set, no_go: set, keeps_open, walk: set) -> None: """Small things on what the room already has: a coffee maker and a toaster on the worktop and a clock on the wall above it, a mirror over the basin, a radio or a telephone in place of a spare lamp, a lamp on every bedside chest, a mat inside the front door. What does stand on the floor - a bin, a hamper, boxes, a coat rack, a shop's sale sign - goes only on a square against a wall that keeps_open allows: on the wishlist a bin took the wall an essential wanted, and the clear-up threw out six more sinks, stoves and counters.""" L = _layout() home = plan.kind in L.HOME_KINDS mine = [f for f in plan.furniture if L._room_at(plan, f[1], f[2]) == idx] topped = {(x, y) for role, x, y, _o in mine if L._needs_surface(role) and not L._is_wall_piece(role)} walls = set(door_edges) for role, x, y, o in plan.furniture: if L._is_wall_piece(role): walls |= {L._wall_edge(cx, cy, o) for cx, cy in L._cells_for(role, x, y, o)} cells = [(x, y) for y in range(room.y0, room.y1 + 1) for x in range(room.x0, room.x1 + 1) if plan.grid[y][x] == idx] entries = [] for x, y, d in plan.doors: a, b = ((x, y - 1), (x, y)) if d == "N" else ((x - 1, y), (x, y)) rooms = (L._room_at(plan, *a), L._room_at(plan, *b)) if idx in rooms: entries.append((a if rooms[0] == idx else b, d, 0 in rooms)) def free(starts): return [(x, y, o) for role, x, y, o in mine if role.startswith(starts) and (x, y) not in topped] def stand(item, spots) -> None: spots = [s for s in spots if s[2] in C.FURNITURE.get(item, {})] if spots: x, y, o = rng.choice(spots) plan.furniture.append((item, x, y, o)) topped.add((x, y)) def hang(item, spots) -> None: spots = [s for s in spots if s[2] in C.FURNITURE.get(item, {}) and L._wall_edge(*s) not in walls] if spots: x, y, o = rng.choice(spots) plan.furniture.append((item, x, y, o)) walls.add(L._wall_edge(x, y, o)) def on_walls(sides=tuple(STEP)) -> list: """Every square of this room against one of its walls, with the wall.""" return [(x, y, side) for x, y in cells for side in sides if L._room_at(plan, x + STEP[side][0], y + STEP[side][1]) != idx] def floor_spot(item, near=()) -> bool: """`item` on a free square against a wall, its back to the wall, nearest to `near` if given.""" if item not in C.FURNITURE: return False taken = {c for role, x, y, o in plan.furniture if L._blocks(role) and L._room_at(plan, x, y) == idx for c in L._cells_for(role, x, y, o)} # Nor in front of anything opened from the front: a cooler's door, a # fridge, a wardrobe - or of a toilet, sat on from there. taken |= {(cx + STEP[OPPOSITE[o]][0], cy + STEP[OPPOSITE[o]][1]) for role, x, y, o in plan.furniture if L._room_at(plan, x, y) == idx and (L._needs_front(role) or role == "toilet") for cx, cy in L._cells_for(role, x, y, o)} spots = [(x, y, side) for x, y, side in on_walls() if side in C.FURNITURE[item] and (x, y) not in taken and (x, y) not in no_go and not L._narrow(plan.grid, x, y)] rng.shuffle(spots) if near: spots.sort(key=lambda s: min(abs(s[0] - a) + abs(s[1] - b) for a, b in near)) for x, y, side in spots: if keeps_open is None or keeps_open([(x, y)]): plan.furniture.append((item, x, y, side)) return True return False def swap_lamp(item, keep: int = 1) -> None: """`item` in place of one of this room's lamps, leaving it `keep`.""" lamps = [n for n, f in enumerate(plan.furniture) if f[0] == "lamp" and L._room_at(plan, f[1], f[2]) == idx] if len(lamps) > keep and item in C.FURNITURE: n = rng.choice(lamps) _role, x, y, o = plan.furniture[n] plan.furniture[n] = (item, x, y, L._facing(item, o)) if not home: if room.kind in STORES and rng.random() < SALE_SIGN: floor_spot("sale_sign", near=[t for t, _d, _out in entries]) if room.kind.endswith("storage") and plan.kind in BOXED_KINDS: for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)): floor_spot(rng.choice(("box", "box_battered"))) return if room.kind in ("kitchen", "openplan"): if rng.random() < KITCHEN_BIN: floor_spot("bin") worktop = [(x, y, o) for role, x, y, o in mine if role.startswith(WORKTOPS)] if rng.random() < COFFEE_MAKER: stand("coffee_maker", free(WORKTOPS)) if rng.random() < TOASTER: stand("toaster", free(WORKTOPS)) if rng.random() < KITCHEN_CLOCK: hang("clock", worktop) elif room.kind == "bathroom": if rng.random() < BATHROOM_BIN: floor_spot("bin") if rng.random() < HAMPER: floor_spot("hamper") if rng.random() < BASIN_MIRROR and not any(f[0].startswith("mirror") for f in mine): hang("mirror_small", [(x, y, o) for role, x, y, o in mine if L._is_sink(role)]) elif room.kind == "laundry": if rng.random() < LAUNDRY_HAMPER: floor_spot("hamper") elif room.kind == "livingroom": # Every chest in a living room is there to hold a lamp or the # television, so the radio takes the place of a second lamp. if rng.random() < LIVING_RADIO: swap_lamp("radio") if rng.random() < LIVING_CLOCK: hang("clock", on_walls(("N", "W"))) if rng.random() < WALL_VENT: hang("wall_vent", on_walls(("N", "W"))) elif room.kind in ("b

nodes.name: free
nodes.body_text: def free(starts): return [(x, y, o) for role, x, y, o in mine if role.startswith(starts) and (x, y) not in topped]

nodes.name: stand
nodes.body_text: def stand(item, spots) -> None: spots = [s for s in spots if s[2] in C.FURNITURE.get(item, {})] if spots: x, y, o = rng.choice(spots) plan.furniture.append((item, x, y, o)) topped.add((x, y))
