nodes.signature: def keep(part: list[tuple[str, list]], found: list[list[str]]) -> None
nodes.body_text: def keep(part: list[tuple[str, list]], found: list[list[str]]) -> None: nonlocal done for (ref, seen), why in zip(part, found): out[ref] = why files[ref] = seen + [why] done += len(part) if on_progress: on_progress(done, total)

nodes.name: repair_project
nodes.signature: def repair_project(pzw: str | os.PathLike, check_buildings: bool = True, knoxlots: bool | None = None, should_stop=None, on_progress=None) -> dict
nodes.body_text:
def repair_project(pzw: str | os.PathLike, check_buildings: bool = True, knoxlots: bool | None = None, should_stop=None, on_progress=None) -> dict: """Repair the project in place. Returns what was done: {"moved": n, "dropped": [(what, why), ...], "changed": bool}. `should_stop` and `on_progress(done, total)` are for checking the building files, which is most of the time on a big map (check_lot_files).""" path = Path(pzw) with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as f: text = f.read() newline = "
" if "
" in text else "
" lines = text.splitlines() size = _WORLD.search(text) report = {"moved": 0, "dropped": [], "changed": False} if not size: return report width, height = int(size.group(1)), int(size.group(2)) head: list[str] = [] tail: list[str] = [] cells: dict[tuple[int, int], dict] = {} # (cx, cy) -> {"open": line, "entries": [...]} order: list[tuple[int, int]] = [] current = None seen_cell = False for line in lines: m = _CELL.match(line) if m: seen_cell = True key = (int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))) rest = m.group(4) empty = rest.rstrip().endswith("/") if empty: rest = rest.rstrip()[:-1].rstrip() if key not in cells: cells[key] = {"indent": m.group(1), "rest": rest, "entries": []} order.append(key) current = None if empty else key continue if current is not None: if line.strip() == "</cell>": current = None continue e = _ENTRY.match(line) if e: cells[current]["entries"].append((e.group(1), e.group(2), e.group(3))) continue cells[current]["entries"].append((None, None, line)) # anything else, kept continue (tail if seen_cell else head).append(line) base = path.parent checked: dict[str, list[str]] = {} if check_buildings: refs = list(dict.fromkeys( dict(_ATTR.findall(body)).get("map", "") for key in order for _ind, kind, body in cells[key]["entries"] if kind == "lot")) checked = check_lot_files(base, refs, knoxlots, should_stop, on_progress) placed: dict[tuple[int, int], list] = {k: [] for k in order} def on_map(cx, cy): return 0 <= cx < width and 0 <= cy < height for key in order: cx, cy = key for indent, kind, body in cells[key]["entries"]: if kind is None: if on_map(cx, cy): placed[key].append((indent, kind, body)) continue attrs = dict(_ATTR.findall(body)) label = attrs.get("map") or attrs.get("group") or kind try: x, y = int(attrs.get("x", 0)), int(attrs.get("y", 0)) w, h = int(attrs.get("width", 1)), int(attrs.get("height", 1)) except ValueError: report["dropped"].append((label, "coordinates are not numbers")) continue if w <= 0 or h <= 0: report["dropped"].append((label, f"size {w}x{h}")) continue # Where it really is, in tiles of the whole map. tx, ty = cx * CELL + x, cy * CELL + y if not (0 <= tx < width * CELL and 0 <= ty < height * CELL): report["dropped"].append((label, f"at tile {tx},{ty}, outside the " f"{width * CELL}x{height * CELL} map")) continue if kind == "lot": ref = attrs.get("map", "") if ref not in checked: # not checking the buildings target = (base / ref) if ref else None checked[ref] = [] if ref and target.is_file() else ["the file is missing"] if checked[ref]: report["dropped"].append((label, "; ".join(checked[ref][:2]))) continue ncx, ncy = tx // CELL, ty // CELL if (ncx, ncy) != key: report["moved"] += 1 body = re.sub(r' x="-?\d+"', f'x="{tx - ncx * CELL}"', body, count=1) body = re.sub(r' y="-?\d+"', f'y="{ty - ncy * CELL}"', body, count=1) placed.setdefault((ncx, ncy), []).append((indent, kind, body)) if not report["moved"] and not report["dropped"] and all(on_map(*k) for k in order): return report out = list(head) indent = cells[order[0]]["indent"] if order else " " for key in sorted({k for k in placed if on_map(*k)} | {k for k in order if on_map(*k)}): info = cells.get(key, {"indent": indent, "rest": ' map=""'}) out.append(f'{info["indent"]}<cell x="{key[0]}" y="{key[1]}"{info["rest"]}>') for ind, kind, body in placed.get(key, []): out.append(body if kind is None else f"{ind}<{kind}{body}/>") out.append(f'{info["indent"]}</cell>') out.extend(tail) shutil.copyfile(path, path.with_name(path.name + ".bak")) with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f: f.write(newline.join(out) + newline) report["changed"] = True return report

nodes.name: on_map
nodes.body_text: def on_map(cx, cy): return 0 <= cx < width and 0 <= cy < height

nodes.name: room_solver.py
nodes.body_text: """House rooms by constraint solver (OR-Tools CP-SAT): the room_solver setting. Off by default (Settings.room_solver = 0): every building is laid out as before. On, each house of up to four storeys is laid out as a whole by a constraint model and a building it cannot fit, or anything that is not a house, keeps Build's own layout. Without OR-Tools installed it does nothing. A house's programme (which rooms, at what sizes: room_solver.json) is chosen by its storeys and floor area. The programmes and room kinds came from English houses (KnoxMap UK, where the regional data also gives each house its age and type - the `uk_rooms` record the house_from_job path below reads when a map has one). A house's storeys are laid out together in one model: each room is a rectangle, or an L of two, of its kind's sizes (room_solver.json "kinds"); the rooms fill each storey's mask exactly; the stairs are a 1 x 5 strip in the same place on every storey, belonging to the hall below and the landing above. The hall and landing are the stairs plus as little passage as the doors need (their passage is the dearest square in the house). Windows are planned with the rooms: each outside wall has its window columns (every 3 squares front and back, 5 on the ends, from the outline), a room that needs a window must hold a column with its own wall either side of it, and a column kept on one storey is kept on the others where it can be, so windows stack. python -m knoxbuild.room_solver --demo [out_dir] writes plan pictures of a few made-up houses. Without OR-Tools, or when no variant of a programme fits, solve() returns None and Build keeps its own layout. """ from __future__ import annotations import hashlib import json import os import time from dataclasses import dataclass, field HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) with open(os.path.join(HERE, "room_solver.json"), encoding="utf-8") as _tables: TABLES = json.load(_tables) KINDS = TABLES["kinds"] RULES = TABLES["rules"] WEIGHTS = TABLES["weights"] PROGRAMMES = TABLES["programmes"] SHOPS = TABLES["shops"] STAIR_RUN = 5 # as layout.STAIR_RUN: the flight's squares, from Stairs::bounds ROOT_KINDS = ("hall", "landing") SHOP_ONLY = "shop_only" # a business with no homes: shop_only@class (room_solver.json "shops") _COMPOSED = {} STAIRS_OFF_STREET = False # True: no square of the flight on the street wall (too strict for terraces) OPPOSITE = {"N": "S", "S": "N", "E": "W", "W": "E"} STEP = {"N": (0, -1), "S": (0, 1), "E": (1, 0), "W": (-1, 0)} @dataclass @dataclass # ---- the model's pieces ------------------------------------------------------- # ---- solving ------------------------------------------------------------------ # Speed (2026-10-20, measured on Alton): small houses on one solver thread # (4 only from SMALL_FLOOR_M2), and a solve stops within REL_GAP of the best # possible rather than proving it (None: prove it, to the time limit). SMALL_FLOOR_M2 = None REL_GAP = None # Patience: a solve stops when it has found no better layout for this long # (seconds), rather than searching to its time limit (None: to the limit). TIMED_OUT = [False] # set when a solve ran out of time (solve_varied reads it) PATIENCE = 1.0 # measured on 30 Alton houses: 38% faster, the same houses laid out, objective 3% worse LAST_OBJECTIVE = [None] # the last solve's objective (for measuring) # Set by prepare, once it has tried every footprint: Build's workers (they # inherit it) then only read the cache. A footprint that ran out of time in # prepare is not cached, and a worker used to solve it again at the same budget, # so the same building came out the solver's way one run and Build's own the next # (a pub with 18 rooms: then 7). PREPARED = "KNOXMAP_ROOMS_PREPARED" SLACK = (1.0, 1.5, 2.5) # the room maxima tried as given, then stretched MAX_FLOOR_M2 = 260 # a storey bigger than this keeps Build's own layout (not one house: a row, a block) # ---- doors and windows from the solved rooms --------------------------------- # ---- blocks of flats: two stages -------------------------------------------- ZONE_TRIES = 3 # stage 1 zonings tried before a flat a floor fewer SHARED_HALL_M2 = 20 # a block's shared hall or landing: passage at most this (m2) # a flat's zone at least this share of its floor's fair share (the hall and # stores take the rest): the zoning attempts in turn, strict first ZONE_SHARE = (0.85, 0.85, 0.6) # ---- the cache: layouts kept by footprint, with variety ----------------------- # # Most houses on a map share their footprint with others (Alton: 2,784 houses, # 1,401 footprints; 1,689 plain rectangles in 337 sizes), so a house is solved # once for its footprint, street side, party walls and programme, a few ways # (VARIETY), and kept on disk. A house takes one of its footprint's layouts by # its own id, so a terrace of the same house is not all one plan. A layout # mirrored along the street fits the mirror-image house (a semi's pair), when # its stairs still climb a way the game has (N or W). VARIETY = 2 # layouts solved per footprint (its mirror image's add more) CACHE_VERSION = 3 # bump when the solver changes what it makes _PROG_HASH = {} # the rules a layout depends on (the rest only choose a programme) LAYOUT_RULES = ("behind", "behind_wanted", "larger", "no_door", "prefer_from", "pitch_front", "pitch_side", "habitable", "bedrooms_upstairs_from", "bedroom_kinds") BLOCK_RULES = ("flat_min_m2", "flats_per_floor_max", "flat_split_m2") SWAP_X = {"E": "W", "W": "E"} SWAP_Y = {"N": "S", "S": "N"} # ---- into Build --------------------------------------------------------------- # ---- checks ------------------------------------------------------------------- # ---- pictures ----------------------------------------------------------------- COLOURS = { "hall": (222, 210, 180), "landing": (222, 210, 180), "living": (164, 196, 140), "through": (150, 190, 130), "dining": (196, 214, 150), "kitchen": (240, 196, 120), "kitchen_diner": (240, 186, 110), "utility": (220, 180, 140), "wc": (150, 200, 225), "bathroom": (130, 186, 222), "ensuite": (150, 200, 230), "bed_double": (196, 160, 210), "bed_single": (214, 186, 222), "box": (226, 200, 230), "airing": (190, 190, 190), "garage": (170, 170, 170), "drawing_room": (140, 184, 120), "sitting_room": (176, 204, 150), "family_room": (170, 200, 140), "library": (186, 160, 120), "breakfast_room": (214, 222, 150), "kitchen_breakfast": (240, 190, 115), "scullery": (226, 196, 150), "pantry": (200, 180, 150), "dressing": (206, 180, 214), "bed_master": (180, 140, 200), "cupboard": (196, 196, 196), "study": (160, 190, 200), "shop_floor": (240, 220, 120), "stockroom": (200, 184, 140), "shop_kitchen": (240, 176, 100), "back_office": (170, 196, 210), "strongroom": (150, 150, 150), "waiting": (230, 216, 170), "consult": (176, 210, 200), "store_room": (200, 184, 140), "break_room": (214, 200, 160), "bar_room": (196, 150, 110), "cellar": (160, 140, 120), "function_room": (206, 166, 126), } LABEL = {"bed_master": "main bed", "kitchen_breakfast": "kitchen", "drawing_room": "drawing rm", "sitting_room": "sitting rm", "family_room": "family rm", "breakfast_room": "breakfast", "cupboard": "cpd", "bed_double": "double", "bed_single": "single", "kitchen_diner": "kit-diner", "living": "front room", "dining": "dining", "shop_floor": "shop", "shop_kitchen": "kitchen", "back_office": "office", "store_room": "store", "break_room": "break rm", "bar_room": "bar", "function_room": "function rm"} # ---- demo --------------------------------------------------------------------- HOME_BUILDS = {"livingroom", "bedroom", "kitchen", "openplan"} # a floor with these is a home's # ---- Build's hook: the room_solver setting ------------------------------------------ _CACHE = None ENV = "KNOXMAP_ROOM_SOLVER" # 1 / 0: on or off for every map, whatever its settings say OFF = ("0", "off", "no", "false") if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())

nodes.name: use_class
nodes.body_text: def use_class(use) -> str: """A business's class (room_solver.json shops.classes) by its rooms ("front|back": a guest house's lobby and office) or its front room: food, bank, surgery, office, pub, guest; anything else is retail.""" if not use: return "retail" classes = SHOPS["classes"] return classes.get(f"{use[0]}|{use[1]}", classes.get(use[0], "retail"))

nodes.name: conversion
nodes.signature: def conversion(info: dict, use) -> str | None
nodes.body_text: def conversion(info: dict, use) -> str | None: """A business in a house (option C, room_solver.json shops.converted): its class when it is an office, surgery or guest house and the building's look is a house's; None otherwise.""" cls = use_class(use) if cls not in SHOPS["converted"]["rename"]: return None look = (info or {}).get("look") or "" house = RULES["look_programmes"].get(look) is not None or look in SHOPS["converted"]["looks"] return cls if house else None

nodes.name: is_programme
nodes.body_text: def is_programme(name: str) -> bool: if name in PROGRAMMES: return True base, _, cls = (name or "").partition("@") return cls in SHOPS["grounds"] and (base == SHOP_ONLY or base in PROGRAMMES)

nodes.name: _composed
nodes.body_text: def _composed(name: str) -> dict: """base@class: a commercial programme. shop_only@class is a business with no homes - the class's ground floor, a stair hall behind it opening off the back rooms when there is an upper floor, and the class's upper floors (store rooms and a break room; a pub's function room); one variant for each of 1-4 storeys. Any other base (shop_house, shop_flats...) keeps its own variants, the homes' lobby on the ground floor and the floors above, with the shop's rooms swapped for the class's.""" if name in _COMPOSED: return _COMPOSED[name] base, _, cls = name.partition("@") ground = SHOPS["grounds"][cls] if base == SHOP_ONLY: upper = SHOPS["uppers"].get(cls, SHOPS["uppers"]["store"]) hall = dict(SHOPS["stair_hall"], **{"from": SHOPS["stair_from"]}) prog = {"weights": dict(SHOPS["weights"]), "variants": [[ground + ([hall] if n > 1 else [])] + [upper] * (n - 1) for n in range(1, 5)]} else: own = PROGRAMMES[base] prog = dict(own) if isinstance(own, dict) else {"variants": own} prog["weights"] = dict(prog.get("weights", {}), **SHOPS["weights"]) prog["variants"] = [[ground + [r for r in v[0] if r["kind"] in ("hall", "cupboard")]] + [floor + SHOPS["upper_extra"] for floor in v[1:]] for v in prog["variants"]] _COMPOSED[name] = prog return prog

nodes.name: programme_tables
nodes.body_text: def programme_tables(name: str): """A programme's variants, weights and room kinds: a programme is a list of variants, or {"variants": [...], "weights": {...}, "kinds": {kind: {...}}} whose weights and kind fields replace the shared ones for its houses (a large house's bigger rooms, and a hall and landing allowed to be corridors).""" prog = _composed(name) if "@" in name else PROGRAMMES[name] if isinstance(prog, list): return prog, WEIGHTS, KINDS wt = dict(WEIGHTS, **prog.get("weights", {})) kd = dict(KINDS) for kind, over in prog.get("kinds", {}).items(): kd[kind] = dict(KINDS[kind], **over) return prog["variants"], wt, kd

nodes.name: _from
nodes.body_text: def _from(spec: dict) -> list: """The rooms a programme room may open from: its own list, else its kind's.""" return spec.get("from", KINDS[spec["kind"]]["from"])

nodes.name: _is_root
nodes.body_text: def _is_root(spec: dict) -> bool: """Where a storey's doors start: the hall or landing, or a programme's own root (a cottage's front door straight into its living room). A hall with root false opens off another room (the stairs behind a shop with no homes).""" return bool(spec.get("root", spec["kind"] in ROOT_KINDS))

nodes.name: House
nodes.body_text: class House: """What the solver is given. masks[level][y][x] is True on the house's squares; party holds (x, y, side) for each square edge on a party wall; garage is a fixed (x0, y0, x1, y1) on the ground floor.""" width: int height: int masks: list street: str = "S" party: set = field(default_factory=set) garage: tuple | None = None epc_rooms: int | None = None # habitable rooms its EPCs say it has (a soft target) homes: int | None = None # a block of flats: how many (shops.py's knox_homes) entry: tuple | None = None # a flat: the square its front door opens onto inner: bool = False # a flat inside a block: no outside doors of its own def inside(self, lvl, x, y): return 0 <= x < self.width and 0 <= y < self.height and self.masks[lvl][y][x] def outside_edge(self, lvl, x, y, side): """Whether square (x, y)'s edge on `side` is an outside wall (not party).""" dx, dy = STEP[side] return (self.inside(lvl, x, y) and not self.inside(lvl, x + dx, y + dy) and (x, y, side) not in self.party)

nodes.name: inside
nodes.body_text: def inside(self, lvl, x, y): return 0 <= x < self.width and 0 <= y < self.height and self.masks[lvl][y][x]

nodes.name: outside_edge
nodes.signature: def outside_edge(self, lvl, x, y, side)
nodes.body_text: def outside_edge(self, lvl, x, y, side): """Whether square (x, y)'s edge on `side` is an outside wall (not party).""" dx, dy = STEP[side] return (self.inside(lvl, x, y) and not self.inside(lvl, x + dx, y + dy) and (x, y, side) not in self.party)

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.body_text: class Layout: """The answer, one entry per storey: rooms [{kind, build, rects, squares}], grid[y][x] (room number from 1, 0 = not house), doors and windows as Build's wall edges (x, y, "W"|"N"); stairs (x, y, "N"|"W") as Build's.""" house: House programme: str variant: int storeys: list stairs: tuple | None seconds: float front_door: tuple | None = None back_door: tuple | None = None

nodes.name: Rect
nodes.body_text: class Rect: """A rectangle of squares x0..x1, y0..y1 (inclusive), each a linear expression; `on` is its presence literal (True for a rectangle every layout has).""" def __init__(self, x0, y0, wx, hy, on=True, area=None): self.x0, self.y0, self.wx, self.hy, self.on, self.area = x0, y0, wx, hy, on, area self.x1 = x0 + wx - 1 self.y1 = y0 + hy - 1

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.signature: def __init__(self, x0, y0, wx, hy, on=True, area=None)
nodes.body_text: def __init__(self, x0, y0, wx, hy, on=True, area=None): self.x0, self.y0, self.wx, self.hy, self.on, self.area = x0, y0, wx, hy, on, area self.x1 = x0 + wx - 1 self.y1 = y0 + hy - 1

nodes.name: _iv
nodes.body_text: def _iv(m, start, size, hi, on=None): """An interval start..start+size (CP-SAT wants its end as one variable).""" end = m.new_int_var(0, hi, "") if on is None: return m.new_interval_var(start, size, end, "") return m.new_optional_interval_var(start, size, end, on, "")

nodes.name: _lits
nodes.body_text: def _lits(*bs): return [b for b in bs if b is not True]

nodes.name: _when
nodes.body_text: def _when(m, c, *conds): """Add constraint c only when every literal in conds holds.""" lits = _lits(*conds) ct = m.add(c) if lits: ct.only_enforce_if(lits)

nodes.name: _contact
nodes.signature: def _contact(m, a: Rect, b: Rect, k: int)
nodes.body_text: def _contact(m, a: Rect, b: Rect, k: int): """A literal that, when true, makes a and b share k or more squares of wall.""" c = m.new_bool_var("") dirs = [] for (lo, hi, p0, p1, q0, q1) in ( (a.x0, b.x1, a.y0, a.y1, b.y0, b.y1), # a east of b (b.x0, a.x1, a.y0, a.y1, b.y0, b.y1), # a west of b (a.y0, b.y1, a.x0, a.x1, b.x0, b.x1), # a south of b (b.y0, a.y1, a.x0, a.x1, b.x0, b.x1)): # a north of b d = m.new_bool_var("") dirs.append(d) _when(m, lo == hi + 1, d) _when(m, p1 >= q0 + k - 1, d) _when(m, q1 >= p0 + k - 1, d) _when(m, p1 >= p0 + k - 1, d) _when(m, q1 >= q0 + k - 1, d) m.add_bool_or(dirs).only_enforce_if(c) for lit in _lits(a.on, b.on): m.add_implication(c, lit) return c

nodes.name: _need
nodes.body_text: def _need(m, lits, pres) -> bool: """One of lits must hold when the room is there; False when a room that must be there never can (an optional one is then left out).""" if not lits: if pres is True: return False m.add(pres == 0) return True ct = m.add_bool_or(lits) if pres is not True: ct.only_enforce_if(pres) return True

nodes.name: _contains
nodes.body_text: def _contains(m, r: Rect, x, y): s = m.new_bool_var("") _when(m, r.x0 <= x, s) _when(m, r.x1 >= x, s) _when(m, r.y0 <= y, s) _when(m, r.y1 >= y, s) for lit in _lits(r.on): m.add_implication(s, lit) return s

nodes.name: _segments
nodes.signature: def _segments(house: House, lvl: int, side: str)
nodes.body_text: def _segments(house: House, lvl: int, side: str): """The storey's outside walls facing `side` as straight runs: (line, a, b) = squares a..b along the wall, at row/column `line`.""" w, h = house.width, house.height runs = [] horizontal = side in ("N", "S") for line in range(h if horizontal else w): run = [] for t in range(w if horizontal else h): x, y = (t, line) if horizontal else (line, t) if house.outside_edge(lvl, x, y, side): run.append(t) elif run: runs.append((line, run[0], run[-1])) run = [] if run: runs.append((line, run[0], run[-1])) return runs

nodes.name: _wall_of
nodes.signature: def _wall_of(house: House, lvl: int, side: str, k: int) -> list
nodes.body_text: def _wall_of(house: House, lvl: int, side: str, k: int) -> list: """The outside walls facing `side` at least k long, as (side, segment); when that side has none (all party wall: a terrace house whose street side was taken from a side road), the two walls at right angles stand in.""" segs = [(side, g) for g in _segments(house, lvl, side) if g[2] - g[1] + 1 >= k] if segs: return segs turn = ("E", "W") if side in ("N", "S") else ("N", "S") return [(sd, g) for sd in turn for g in _segments(house, lvl, sd) if g[2] - g[1] + 1 >= k]

nodes.name: _touch
nodes.signature: def _touch(m, rect: Rect, side: str, seg, k: int)
nodes.body_text: def _touch(m, rect: Rect, side: str, seg, k: int): """A literal that, when true, puts k or more squares of rect on segment seg.""" line, a, b = seg if b - a + 1 < k: return None t = m.new_bool_var("") edge = {"N": rect.y0, "S": rect.y1, "W": rect.x0, "E": rect.x1}[side] lo, hi = (rect.x0, rect.x1) if side in ("N", "S") else (rect.y0, rect.y1) _when(m, edge == line, t) _when(m, hi >= a + k - 1, t) _when(m, lo <= b - k + 1, t) _when(m, hi >= lo + k - 1, t) for lit in _lits(rect.on): m.add_implication(t, lit) return t

nodes.name: window_columns
nodes.body_text: def window_columns(house: House, lvl: int): """Each outside wall's window spots: (x, y, side). Every 3 squares on the front and back, 5 on the ends, never a run's end square.""" out = [] front = (house.street, OPPOSITE[house.street]) for side in "NSEW": pitch = RULES["pitch_front"] if side in front else RULES["pitch_side"] for line, a, b in _segments(house, lvl, side): n = b - a + 1 if n < 3: # a short wall (the back room's beside a back addition): the # square at its inside corner, the wall going on indoors dx, dy = _along(side) for t in range(a, b + 1): x, y = (t, line) if side in ("N", "S") else (line, t) if house.inside(lvl, x - dx, y - dy) and house.inside(lvl, x + dx, y + dy): out.append((x, y, side)) break continue count = max(1, (n + 1) // pitch) for k in range(count): i = min(max(1, int((k + .5) * n / count)), n - 2) t = a + i spot = (t, line, side) if side in ("N", "S") else (line, t, side) if spot not in out: out.append(spot) return out

nodes.name: _one_piece
nodes.body_text: def _one_piece(mask) -> bool: """Whether a storey's squares all join up, side to side.""" cells = {(x, y) for y, row in enumerate(mask) for x, v in enumerate(row) if v} if not cells: return True seen, todo = set(), [next(iter(cells))] while todo: x, y = todo.pop() if (x, y) in seen: continue seen.add((x, y)) todo += [q for q in ((x + 1, y), (x - 1, y), (x, y + 1), (x, y - 1)) if q in cells and q not in seen] return len(seen) == len(cells)

nodes.name: stair_places
nodes.body_text: def stair_places(house: House): """Every (x, y, vert) the stairs may take: the 5 squares in every storey, and one long side of the flight against the ground floor's outside or party wall (English stairs run along a wall, not across a room).""" out = [] levels = len(house.masks) for vert in (1, 0): for y in range(house.height): for x in range(house.width): sq = [(x + i * (1 - vert), y + i * vert) for i in range(STAIR_RUN)] if not all(house.inside(l, *q) for l in range(levels) for q in sq): continue if house.garage: gx0, gy0, gx1, gy1 = house.garage if any(gx0 <= qx <= gx1 and gy0 <= qy <= gy1 for qx, qy in sq): continue if STAIRS_OFF_STREET and any(house.outside_edge(0, qx, qy, house.street) for qx, qy in sq): continue # the flight keeps off the street wall sides = ("E", "W") if vert else ("N", "S") for side in sides: dx, dy = STEP[side] if all(not house.inside(0, qx + dx, qy + dy) for qx, qy in sq): out.append((x, y, vert)) break return out

nodes.name: _along
nodes.body_text: def _along(side): return (1, 0) if side in ("N", "S") else (0, 1)

nodes.name: _check_variant
nodes.body_text: def _check_variant(house: House, variant: list): """1990 rules a variant must keep before it is tried.""" if len(variant) != len(house.masks): return False if len(variant) >= RULES["bedrooms_upstairs_from"]: if any(r["kind"] in RULES["bedroom_kinds"] for r in variant[0]): return False for storey in variant: kinds = {r["kind"] for r in storey} for r in storey: frm = _from(r) if not _is_root(r) and frm and not (kinds & set(frm)): return False return True

nodes.name: solve
nodes.signature: def solve(house: House, programme: str, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, seed: int = 0)
nodes.body_text: def solve(house: House, programme: str, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, seed: int = 0): """The first variant of the programme that fits, as a Layout; None if none does. Every variant is tried with the rooms' maxima as given before any is tried with them stretched (a 1 m grid has no wall thickness to take up).""" try: from ortools.sat.python import cp_model # noqa: F401 except ImportError: return None start = time.time() if programme == "flats_block": return solve_flats(house, seconds, workers, seed) if any(sum(v for row in mk for v in row) > MAX_FLOOR_M2 for mk in house.masks): return None if not all(_one_piece(mk) for mk in house.masks): return None # a storey in pieces (an outbuilding in the outline): Build's layout # a big house's model is bigger: more time (3 s, and 1 s per 10 m2 of its # biggest floor past 60, at most 20 s) biggest = max(sum(v for row in mk for v in row) for mk in house.masks) seconds = min(20.0, seconds + max(0, biggest - 60) / 10) if SMALL_FLOOR_M2 and biggest < SMALL_FLOOR_M2: workers = 1 variants, wt, kd = programme_tables(programme) tries = [(slack, i, v) for slack in SLACK for i, v in enumerate(variants)] for slack, i, variant in tries: if not _check_variant(house, variant): continue got = _solve_variant(house, variant, seconds, workers, slack, seed, wt, kd) if got is not None: storeys, stairs = got lay = Layout(house, programme, i, storeys, stairs, time.time() - start) _place_openings(lay) return lay return None

nodes.name: _solve_patiently
nodes.body_text: def _solve_patiently(solver, model, patience: float): """Solve, stopping the search once no better layout has turned up for `patience` seconds after the first (a watcher thread; CP-SAT has no such setting). Until a first layout is found it searches to its time limit.""" import threading from ortools.sat.python import cp_model last = [None] class Better(cp_model.CpSolverSolutionCallback): def on_solution_callback(self): last[0] = time.time() done = threading.Event() def watch(): while not done.wait(0.1): if last[0] is not None and time.time() - last[0] > patience: solver.stop_search() return t = threading.Thread(target=watch, daemon=True) t.start() try: return solver.solve(model, Better()) finally: done.set()

nodes.name: Better
nodes.body_text: class Better(cp_model.CpSolverSolutionCallback): def on_solution_callback(self): last[0] = time.time()

nodes.name: on_solution_callback
nodes.body_text: def on_solution_callback(self): last[0] = time.time()

nodes.name: watch
nodes.body_text: def watch(): while not done.wait(0.1): if last[0] is not None and time.time() - last[0] > patience: solver.stop_search() return

nodes.name: _solve_variant
nodes.signature: def _solve_variant(house: House, variant: list, seconds: float, workers: int, slack: float = 1.0, seed: int = 0, wt: dict | None = None, kd: dict | None = None)
nodes.body_text: def _solve_variant(house: House, variant: list, seconds: float, workers: int, slack: float = 1.0, seed: int = 0, wt: dict | None = None, kd: dict | None = None): import random from ortools.sat.python import cp_model # seed > 0: another layout of the same house - each room's size aimed a # little off, and a small pull on where rooms and stairs sit jig = random.Random(seed) if seed else None wt, kd = wt or WEIGHTS, kd or KINDS m = cp_model.CpModel() W, H = house.width, house.height levels = len(house.masks) cost = [] # The stairs: one strip for every storey, its top at (sx, sy), running # down the page (Build's "N": foot at the bottom) when vert, else across. stairs = None if levels > 1: sx = m.new_int_var(0, W - 1, "sx") sy = m.new_int_var(0, H - 1, "sy") vert = m.new_bool_var("vert") m.add(sx + (STAIR_RUN - 1) * (1 - vert) <= W - 1) m.add(sy + (STAIR_RUN - 1) * vert <= H - 1) stairs = (sx, sy, vert) places = stair_places(house) if not places: return None m.add_allowed_assignments([sx, sy, vert], places) if jig: cost.append(jig.choice((-3, 3)) * sx + jig.choice((-3, 3)) * sy) def stair_square(i): return Rect(sx + i * (1 - vert), sy + i * vert, 1, 1) layouts = [] for lvl, storey in enumerate(variant): xs, ys, area_terms = [], [], [] mask_area = sum(sum(1 for v in row if v) for row in house.masks[lvl]) # squares not in this storey: fixed blocks, a row run at a time for y in range(H): x = 0 while x < W: if house.masks[lvl][y][x]: x += 1 continue x2 = x while x2 + 1 < W and not house.masks[lvl][y][x2 + 1]: x2 += 1 xs.append(m.new_fixed_size_interval_var(x, x2 - x + 1, "")) ys.append(m.new_fixed_size_interval_var(y, 1, "")) x = x2 + 1 walk_stair = [] if stairs: sx, sy, vert = stairs xs.append(_iv(m, sx, 1 + (STAIR_RUN - 1) * (1 - vert), W)) ys.append(_iv(m, sy, 1 + (STAIR_RUN - 1) * vert, H)) area_terms.append(STAIR_RUN) if lvl < levels - 1: walk_stair.append(stair_square(STAIR_RUN - 1)) # the foot if lvl > 0: walk_stair.append(stair_square(0)) # the head rooms = [] for spec in storey: kind = spec["kind"] k = kd[kind] rects = [] # an optional room (a third bedroom, a study) is there if it fits pres = m.new_bool_var("") if spec.get("optional") else True if pres is not True: cost.append(-spec.get("value", wt["optional_room"]) * pres) n_rects = 2 if k["l"] else 1 for j in range(n_rects): optional = j > 0 or kind in ROOT_KINDS or pres is not True if j == 0 and pres is not True: on = pres else: on = m.new_bool_var("") if optional else True if on is not True and pres is not True: m.add_implication(on, pres) side = k["side"] x0 = m.new_int_var(0, W - 1, "") y0 = m.new_int_var(0, H - 1, "") wx = m.new_int_var(side, W, "") hy = m.new_int_var(side, H, "") a = m.new_int_var(0, W * H, "") m.add_multiplication_equality(a, [wx, hy]) if optional: xs.append(_iv(m, x0, wx, 2 * W, on)) ys.append(_iv(m, y0, hy, 2 * H, on)) eff = m.new_int_var(0, W * H, "") m.add(eff == a).only_enforce_if(on) m.add(eff == 0).only_enforce_if(~on) m.add(x0 + wx <= W).only_enforce_if(on) m.add(y0 + hy <= H).only_enforce_if(on) per = m.new_int_var(0, W + H, "") m.add(per == wx + hy).only_enforce_if(on) m.add(per == 0).only_enforce_if(~on) else: xs.append(_iv(m, x0, wx, W)) ys.append(_iv(m, y0, hy, H)) eff, per = a, wx + hy if j == 0 and kind not in ROOT_KINDS: # aspect: long side at most `aspect` times the short asp = int(round(k["aspect"] * 10)) _when(m, 10 * wx <= asp * hy, on) _when(m, 10 * hy <= asp * wx, on) r = Rect(x0, y0, wx, hy, on, eff) rects.append(r) area_terms.append(eff) cost.append(wt["wall"] * per) # an L: the second rectangle against the first if len(rects) == 2: first = rects[0] if kind in ROOT_KINDS: # passage pieces are free-standing but must be used in order m.add_implication(rects[1].on, rects[0].on) else: m.add_implication(rects[1].on, _contact(m, first, rects[1], k["side"])) area = sum(r.area for r in rects) lo, hi = spec.get("area", k["area"]) if k.get("grow") and slack > 1: # stretched past its size: allowed, at a price per m2 over = m.new_int_var(0, W * H, "") m.add(over >= sum(r.area for r in rects) - hi) cost.append(wt["stretch"] * over) hi = int(hi * slack) _when(m, area >= lo, pres) _when(m, area <= hi, pres) if kind in ROOT_KINDS: cost.append(wt["stair_room"] * area) elif kind == "store": cost.append(wt["store"] * area) else: target = spec.get("target", k["target"]) + (jig.randint(-3, 3) if jig else 0) dev = m.new_int_var(0, W * H, "") _when(m, dev >= area - target, pres) _when(m, dev >= target - area, pres) cost.append(wt["size"] * dev) if jig: cost.append(jig.choice((-2, -1, 1, 2)) * rects[0].x0) cost.append(jig.choice((-2, -1, 1, 2)) * rects[0].y0) walk = list(rects) if kind in ROOT_KINDS and len(walk_stair) == 2: # a middle floor: the flight up starts where the flight from # below arrives only through the landing - its passage must # join the foot of the next flight to the head of this one foot, head = walk_stair ways = [] for a in rects: w = m.new_bool_var("") for c in (_contact(m, a, head, 1), _contact(m, a, foot, 1

nodes.name: stair_square
nodes.body_text: def stair_square(i): return Rect(sx + i * (1 - vert), sy + i * vert, 1, 1)

nodes.name: back_of
nodes.body_text: def back_of(r): """Twice the middle of r's first rectangle, counted from the street.""" a = r["rects"][0] return {"S": -(a.y0 + a.y1), "N": a.y0 + a.y1, "E": -(a.x0 + a.x1), "W": a.x0 + a.x1}[house.street]

nodes.name: one_home
nodes.body_text: def one_home(ra, rb): return ra["spec"].get("unit", 0) == rb["spec"].get("unit", 0)

nodes.name: _edge
nodes.body_text: def _edge(x, y, side): """Build's wall edge for square (x, y)'s edge on side.""" return {"N": (x, y, "N"), "W": (x, y, "W"), "S": (x, y + 1, "N"), "E": (x + 1, y, "W")}[side]

nodes.name: flats_per_floor
nodes.body_text: def flats_per_floor(house: House) -> int: """How many flats a floor: its homes over its storeys, at most rules.flats_per_floor_max, no flat under rules.flat_min_m2.""" levels = len(house.masks) homes = house.homes or levels n = max(1, min(RULES["flats_per_floor_max"], -(-homes // levels))) least = min(sum(v for row in mk for v in row) for mk in house.masks) while n > 1 and (least - 9) / n < RULES["flat_min_m2"]: n -= 1 return n

nodes.name: _zone_variant
nodes.signature: def _zone_variant(house: House, n: int, share: float = None) -> list
nodes.body_text: def _zone_variant(house: House, n: int, share: float = None) -> list: """Stage 1: each floor's shared hall (or landing) and n flat zones, stacked where the floors have the same outline.""" levels = len(house.masks) out = [] for lvl, mk in enumerate(house.masks): area = sum(v for row in mk for v in row) - (STAIR_RUN if levels > 1 else 0) - 4 # a smaller floor (the top, under the roof) takes fewer flats n_here = max(1, min(n, area // RULES["flat_split_m2"])) t = max(RULES["flat_min_m2"], area // n_here) # the shared hall may be a corridor to the street door (the stairs can # rise from the back): up to SHARED_HALL_M2 of passage, still priced floor = [{"kind": "hall" if lvl == 0 else "landing", "stack": True, "area": [0, SHARED_HALL_M2], **({"front": 1} if lvl == 0 else {})}] for i in range(n_here): floor.append({"kind": "flat_zone", "unit": lvl * n + i + 1, "target": t, "outside": 3, "area": [max(RULES["flat_min_m2"], int(t * (share or ZONE_SHARE[0]))), int(t * 1.5) + 2]}) # communal stores take the corners no flat can use (priced per m2) floor += [{"kind": "store", "optional": True, "value": 0}, {"kind": "store", "optional": True, "value": 0}] out.append(floor) return out

nodes.name: _zone_house
nodes.signature: def _zone_house(house: House, lvl: int, squares: set, entry) -> House
nodes.body_text: def _zone_house(house: House, lvl: int, squares: set, entry) -> House: """A flat's zone as a house of its own: its walls onto the stairwell or the next flat are party walls (no windows), its front door's square fixed.""" W, H = house.width, house.height mask = [[(x, y) in squares for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)] party = set() for (x, y) in squares: for side in "NSEW": dx, dy = STEP[side] if (x + dx, y + dy) in squares: continue if not house.outside_edge(lvl, x, y, side): party.add((x, y, side)) return House(W, H, [mask], house.street, party, None, None, None, entry, True)

nodes.name: solve_flats
nodes.signature: def solve_flats(house: House, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, seed: int = 0)
nodes.body_text: def solve_flats(house: House, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, seed: int = 0): """A block of flats in two stages: the floors' shared hall, stairs and a zone a flat (stage 1), then each zone as a flat (stage 2, flat_unit; a zone the same as one solved already is not solved again). Fewer flats a floor when they do not fit; None when not even one does.""" start = time.time() if not all(_one_piece(mk) for mk in house.masks): return None if any(sum(v for row in mk for v in row) > 2 * MAX_FLOOR_M2 for mk in house.masks): return None for n in range(flats_per_floor(house), 0, -1): # a zone can come out a shape no flat fits: zone the floors again, # nudged and less strictly (ZONE_SHARE), before taking a flat a floor away for attempt in range(ZONE_TRIES): variant = _zone_variant(house, n, ZONE_SHARE[min(attempt, len(ZONE_SHARE) - 1)]) got = None for slack in SLACK: got = _solve_variant(house, variant, seconds + 2, workers, slack, seed * 7 + attempt) if got: break if not got: continue # no zoning this strict: the next attempt is less so storeys, stairs = got block = Layout(house, "flats_block", n, storeys, stairs, 0.0) _place_openings(block) flats = _lay_flats(block, seconds, workers, seed) if flats is not None: flats.seconds = time.time() - start return flats return None

nodes.name: _lay_flats
nodes.body_text: def _lay_flats(block: Layout, seconds, workers, seed): house = block.house done = {} out_storeys = [] for lvl, st in enumerate(block.storeys): rooms, doors = [], [] number = {} # the shared rooms first: the hall or landing (with the stairs) for i, r in enumerate(st["rooms"]): if r["kind"] != "flat_zone": number[i] = len(rooms) rooms.append(dict(r, unit=0, parent=None if r["parent"] is None else number.get(r["parent"]))) windows = [w for w in st["windows"] if st["grid"][_inside_of(w, st["grid"])[1]][_inside_of(w, st["grid"])[0]] and st["rooms"][st["grid"][_inside_of(w, st["grid"])[1]][_inside_of(w, st["grid"])[0]] - 1][ "kind"] != "flat_zone"] grid = [[0] * house.width for _ in range(house.height)] for i, r in enumerate(st["rooms"]): if r["kind"] != "flat_zone": for (x, y) in r["squares"]: grid[y][x] = number[i] + 1 for d in st["doors"]: a, b = _door_squares(d) ra, rb = (_room_at(st["grid"], *a), _room_at(st["grid"], *b)) kinds = {st["rooms"][q - 1]["kind"] for q in (ra, rb) if q} if "flat_zone" not in kinds or len(kinds) == 1: doors.append(d) # the shared rooms' own doors (the street door) for i, r in enumerate(st["rooms"]): if r["kind"] != "flat_zone": continue # its front door: the door from the hall or landing into it entry, front = None, None for d in st["doors"]: a, b = _door_squares(d) if a in r["squares"] and b not in r["squares"]: entry, front = a, d elif b in r["squares"] and a not in r["squares"]: entry, front = b, d if entry is None: return None zone = _zone_house(house, lvl, r["squares"], entry) key = house_key(zone, "flat_unit") if key not in done: done[key] = solve(zone, "flat_unit", seconds, workers, seed) flat = done[key] if flat is None: return None unit = r.get("unit") or r["spec"].get("unit", 0) base = len(rooms) for fr in flat.storeys[0]["rooms"]: parent = fr["parent"] rooms.append(dict(fr, unit=unit, parent=(base + parent) if parent is not None else number.get(r["parent"]))) for y, row in enumerate(flat.storeys[0]["grid"]): for x, v in enumerate(row): if v: grid[y][x] = base + v doors += [front] + list(flat.storeys[0]["doors"]) windows += list(flat.storeys[0]["windows"]) out_storeys.append({"rooms": rooms, "grid": grid, "cols": [], "doors": doors, "windows": windows}) return Layout(house, "flats_block", block.variant, out_storeys, block.stairs, 0.0, block.front_door, block.back_door)

nodes.name: _door_squares
nodes.body_text: def _door_squares(edge): x, y, d = edge return ((x - 1, y), (x, y)) if d == "W" else ((x, y - 1), (x, y))

nodes.name: _room_at
nodes.body_text: def _room_at(grid, x, y): if 0 <= y < len(grid) and 0 <= x < len(grid[0]): return grid[y][x] return 0

nodes.name: _inside_of
nodes.body_text: def _inside_of(edge, grid): """The square of a window edge that is in the building.""" a, b = _door_squares(edge) return a if _room_at(grid, *a) else b

nodes.name: _place_openings
nodes.body_text: def _place_openings(lay: Layout): house = lay.house # the programme's own kinds (a studio's open-plan room may have a small window) kd = programme_tables(lay.programme)[2] if is_programme(lay.programme) and lay.programme != "flats_block" else KINDS stair = set() walk_stair = {} if lay.stairs: x, y, d = lay.stairs dx, dy = (0, 1) if d == "N" else (1, 0) stair = [(x + dx * i, y + dy * i) for i in range(STAIR_RUN)] levels = len(lay.storeys) for lvl, st in enumerate(lay.storeys): grid, rooms = st["grid"], st["rooms"] blocked = set(stair) if stair: if lvl < levels - 1: blocked.discard(stair[-1]) if lvl > 0: blocked.discard(stair[0]) walk_stair[lvl] = blocked def room_at(x, y): if 0 <= x < house.width and 0 <= y < house.height: return grid[y][x] return 0 # windows: the spots the solver gave each room per_room = {} for r, spot in st.get("owned", []): per_room.setdefault(r, []).append(tuple(spot)) for r, spots in per_room.items(): rooms[r - 1]["windows"] = spots st["windows"] += [_edge(*sp) for sp in spots] window_squares = {(x, y) for r in per_room.values() for (x, y, _) in r} # inside doors: across the middle of each room's wall with its parent for i, room in enumerate(rooms): p = room["parent"] if p is None: continue pairs = [] for (x, y) in sorted(room["squares"]): if (x, y) in blocked: continue for side in "NSEW": dx, dy = STEP[side] q = (x + dx, y + dy) if room_at(*q) == p + 1 and q not in blocked: pairs.append(_edge(x, y, side)) if pairs: st["doors"].append(pairs[len(pairs) // 2]) if lvl == 0 and not house.inner: # the stair hall behind a shop with no homes has no street door entries = [r for r in rooms if r["spec"].get("root", True) is not False] lay.front_door = _outside_door(house, lvl, entries, house.street, ROOT_KINDS + ("living",), set(stair), window_squares, near=stair[-1] if stair else None) if lay.front_door is None: # the hall's only front square is a window: the door wins lay.front_door = _outside_door(house, lvl, entries, house.street, ROOT_KINDS + ("living",), set(stair), set()) if lay.front_door in st["windows"]: st["windows"].remove(lay.front_door) for room in rooms: room["windows"] = [w for w in room.get("windows", []) if _edge(*w) != lay.front_door] if lay.front_door: st["doors"].append(lay.front_door) # a shop (each bar of a pub): its own door in the middle of its # frontage, the frontage glass business = [] # the street wall, else (all party wall) the walls at right angles (_wall_of) faces = [house.street] + [sd for sd in ("E", "W", "N", "S") if sd not in (house.street, OPPOSITE[house.street]) and not _segments(house, lvl, house.street)] for room in rooms: if not kd[room["kind"]].get("frontage"): continue face, spots = next(((sd, s) for sd in faces if (s := [(x, y) for (x, y) in sorted(room["squares"]) if house.outside_edge(lvl, x, y, sd)])), (None, [])) if not spots: continue front = [_edge(x, y, face) for (x, y) in spots] door = front[len(front) // 2] st["doors"].append(door) business.append(door) st["shop_front"] = st.get("shop_front", []) + front st["windows"] = [w for w in st["windows"] if w not in front] + \ [e for e in front if e != door] room["windows"] = [w for w in room.get("windows", []) if _edge(*w) not in front] # a surgery's waiting room: a door from the street in an ordinary wall for room in rooms: if not kd[room["kind"]].get("street_door"): continue door = (_outside_door(house, lvl, [room], house.street, (room["kind"],), blocked, window_squares) or _outside_door(house, lvl, [room], house.street, (room["kind"],), blocked, set())) if door: st["doors"].append(door) business.append(door) st["windows"] = [w for w in st["windows"] if w != door] room["windows"] = [w for w in room.get("windows", []) if _edge(*w) != door] if lay.front_door is None and business: lay.front_door = business[0] # a business with no homes: its own door lay.back_door = _outside_door(house, lvl, rooms, OPPOSITE[house.street], ("kitchen", "kitchen_diner", "kitchen_breakfast", "utility", "scullery", "cellar", "stockroom", "shop_kitchen", "back_office", "family_room", "hall", "shop_floor"), blocked, window_squares) if lay.back_door: st["doors"].append(lay.back_door)

nodes.name: room_at
nodes.body_text: def room_at(x, y): if 0 <= x < house.width and 0 <= y < house.height: return grid[y][x] return 0

nodes.name: _outside_door
nodes.signature: def _outside_door(house, lvl, rooms, side, kinds, blocked, windows, near=None)
nodes.body_text: def _outside_door(house, lvl, rooms, side, kinds, blocked, windows, near=None): if not _segments(house, lvl, side): # all party wall that way: the walls at right angles (_wall_of) for sd in (("E", "W") if side in ("N", "S") else ("N", "S")): got = _outside_door(house, lvl, rooms, sd, kinds, blocked, windows, near) if _segments(house, lvl, sd) else None if got: return got return None for kind in kinds: for room in rooms: if room["kind"] != kind: continue spots = [(x, y) for (x, y) in sorted(room["squares"]) if house.outside_edge(lvl, x, y, side) and (x, y) not in blocked and (x, y) not in windows] if not spots: continue if near: spots.sort(key=lambda s: abs(s[0] - near[0]) + abs(s[1] - near[1])) x, y = spots[0] else: x, y = spots[len(spots) // 2] return _edge(x, y, side) return None

nodes.name: _rules_for
nodes.body_text: def _rules_for(keys) -> dict: return {k: RULES.get(k) for k in keys}

nodes.name: programme_hash
nodes.body_text: def programme_hash(name: str) -> str: """What a programme's layouts depend on: its variants, weights and the kinds it names, the rules and the solver's version. Editing one kind re-solves only the programmes using it.""" if name == "flats_block" and name not in _PROG_HASH: _PROG_HASH[name] = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps( [CACHE_VERSION, programme_hash("flat_unit"), KINDS["flat_zone"], KINDS["hall"], KINDS["landing"], _rules_for(LAYOUT_RULES + BLOCK_RULES), WEIGHTS, ZONE_TRIES, SHARED_HALL_M2, ZONE_SHARE], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12] if name not in _PROG_HASH: variants, wt, kd = programme_tables(name) # the kinds it names (their from lists are in them): a kind it never # has cannot change its layouts used = {r["kind"] for v in variants for st in v for r in st} | set(ROOT_KINDS) | {"garage"} text = json.dumps([CACHE_VERSION, variants, wt, {k: kd[k] for k in sorted(used) if k in kd}, _rules_for(LAYOUT_RULES)], sort_keys=True) _PROG_HASH[name] = hashlib.sha1(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] return _PROG_HASH[name]

nodes.name: house_key
nodes.signature: def house_key(house: House, programme: str) -> str
nodes.body_text: def house_key(house: House, programme: str) -> str: masks = ["/".join("".join("1" if v else "0" for v in row) for row in m) for m in house.masks] text = json.dumps([programme, programme_hash(programme), house.width, house.height, masks, house.street, sorted(house.party), house.garage, house.epc_rooms, house.homes, house.entry, house.inner]) return hashlib.sha1(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:20]

nodes.name: _flips_x
nodes.body_text: def _flips_x(house: House) -> bool: """A mirror along the street flips x for a street N or S, else y.""" return house.street in ("N", "S")

nodes.name: mirror_house
nodes.body_text: def mirror_house(house: House) -> House: W, H = house.width, house.height g = house.garage if _flips_x(house): masks = [[list(row[::-1]) for row in m] for m in house.masks] party = {(W - 1 - x, y, SWAP_X.get(s, s)) for (x, y, s) in house.party} g = g and (W - 1 - g[2], g[1], W - 1 - g[0], g[3]) else: masks = [[list(row) for row in m[::-1]] for m in house.masks] party = {(x, H - 1 - y, SWAP_Y.get(s, s)) for (x, y, s) in house.party} g = g and (g[0], H - 1 - g[3], g[2], H - 1 - g[1]) return House(W, H, masks, house.street, party, tuple(g) if g else None, house.epc_rooms, house.homes, None, house.inner)

nodes.name: mirror
nodes.signature: def mirror(lay: Layout, house: House) -> Layout | None
nodes.body_text: def mirror(lay: Layout, house: House) -> Layout | None: """lay (solved for house's mirror image) mirrored onto house; None when its stairs would climb a way the game has no stairs for.""" W, H = house.width, house.height fx = _flips_x(house) stairs = None if lay.stairs: x, y, d = lay.stairs # a flight along the flip would come out climbing E or S: no such stairs if (fx and d == "W") or (not fx and d == "N"): return None stairs = (W - 1 - x, y, d) if fx else (x, H - 1 - y, d) def sq(p): return (W - 1 - p[0], p[1]) if fx else (p[0], H - 1 - p[1]) def edge(e): x, y, d = e if fx: return (W - x, y, "W") if d == "W" else (W - 1 - x, y, "N") return (x, H - 1 - y, "W") if d == "W" else (x, H - y, "N") def rect(r): x0, y0, x1, y1 = r return (W - 1 - x1, y0, W - 1 - x0, y1) if fx else (x0, H - 1 - y1, x1, H - 1 - y0) def spot(w): x, y, s = w return (*sq((x, y)), (SWAP_X if fx else SWAP_Y).get(s, s)) storeys = [] for st in lay.storeys: grid = [list(row[::-1]) for row in st["grid"]] if fx else [list(r) for r in st["grid"][::-1]] rooms = [dict(r, rects=[rect(t) for t in r["rects"]], squares={sq(p) for p in r["squares"]}, windows=[spot(w) for w in r.get("windows", [])]) for r in st["rooms"]] storeys.append({"rooms": rooms, "grid": grid, "cols": [], "doors": [edge(e) for e in st["doors"]], "windows": [edge(e) for e in st["windows"]], "shop_front": [edge(e) for e in st.get("shop_front", [])]}) return Layout(house, lay.programme, lay.variant, storeys, stairs, lay.seconds, lay.front_door and edge(lay.front_door), lay.back_door and edge(lay.back_door))

nodes.name: sq
nodes.body_text: def sq(p): return (W - 1 - p[0], p[1]) if fx else (p[0], H - 1 - p[1])

nodes.name: edge
nodes.body_text: def edge(e): x, y, d = e if fx: return (W - x, y, "W") if d == "W" else (W - 1 - x, y, "N") return (x, H - 1 - y, "W") if d == "W" else (x, H - y, "N")

nodes.name: rect
nodes.body_text: def rect(r): x0, y0, x1, y1 = r return (W - 1 - x1, y0, W - 1 - x0, y1) if fx else (x0, H - 1 - y1, x1, H - 1 - y0)

nodes.name: spot
nodes.body_text: def spot(w): x, y, s = w return (*sq((x, y)), (SWAP_X if fx else SWAP_Y).get(s, s))

nodes.name: _to_json

nodes.body_text: def solve_varied(house: House, programme: str, n: int = VARIETY, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4) -> list: """Up to n different layouts of one house (seed 0 is solve()'s own). TIMED_OUT[0] says afterwards whether a solve ran out of time: then an empty answer is not "no layout" (it is not cached as one).""" TIMED_OUT[0] = False out, seen = [], set() for seed in range(n + 1): lay = solve(house, programme, seconds, workers, seed) if lay is None: break # no layout at all: another seed will not find one sig = json.dumps([st["grid"] for st in lay.storeys]) if sig not in seen: seen.add(sig) out.append(lay) if len(out) >= n: break return out

nodes.name: LayoutCache
nodes.body_text: class LayoutCache: """Layouts by house_key, on disk as JSON. The key holds its programme's hash, so a change to the tables or the solver leaves the old entries unused (`prune` drops them) and re-solves only what it touched.""" def __init__(self, folder: str | None = None): self.folder = folder or os.path.join(HERE, "..", "cache", "room_solver") self.path = os.path.join(self.folder, "layouts.json") self.data = {} if os.path.exists(self.path): with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as f: self.data = json.load(f) self.dirty = False def options(self, house: House, programme: str) -> list: """Every cached layout that fits house: its own, and its mirror image's mirrored.""" own = [_from_json(d, house) for d in self._layouts(house_key(house, programme))] twin = mirror_house(house) flipped = [mirror(_from_json(d, twin), house) for d in self._layouts(house_key(twin, programme))] return own + [m for m in flipped if m is not None] def known(self, house: House, programme: str) -> bool: """Whether this footprint has been solved (layouts or none), or its mirror image has layouts that mirror onto it (stairs the game has).""" return house_key(house, programme) in self.data or bool(self.options(house, programme)) def _layouts(self, key: str) -> list: return self.data.get(key, {}).get("layouts", []) def put(self, house: House, programme: str, lays: list) -> None: self.store(house_key(house, programme), programme, [_to_json(lay) for lay in lays]) def store(self, key: str, programme: str, lays: list) -> None: self.data[key] = {"programme": programme, "hash": programme_hash(programme), "layouts": lays} self.dirty = True def prune(self) -> int: """Drop entries an older version of their programme made.""" stale = [k for k, v in self.data.items() if not is_programme(v.get("programme")) or v.get("hash") != programme_hash(v["programme"])] for k in stale: del self.data[k] self.dirty = self.dirty or bool(stale) return len(stale) def save(self, tries: int = 10) -> None: """Write the cache, merged with what is on disk now (another Build run may have saved since this one read it), through a file of this process's own; a moment's lock on Windows is waited out.""" if not self.dirty: return os.makedirs(self.folder, exist_ok=True) tmp = f"{self.path}.{os.getpid()}.tmp" for i in range(tries): try: if os.path.exists(self.path): with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as f: disk = json.load(f) disk.update(self.data) self.data = disk with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(self.data, f, separators=(",", ":")) os.replace(tmp, self.path) self.dirty = False return except (OSError, ValueError): if i == tries - 1: raise time.sleep(0.5 * (i + 1))

nodes.body_text: def pick(options: list, building_id) -> Layout: """One of a footprint's layouts, the same one for a building every run.""" h = int(hashlib.sha1(str(building_id).encode()).hexdigest(), 16) return options[h % len(options)]

nodes.name: layout_for
nodes.signature: def layout_for(house: House, programme: str, building_id, cache: LayoutCache, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, solve_missing: bool = True) -> Layout | None
nodes.body_text: def layout_for(house: House, programme: str, building_id, cache: LayoutCache, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, solve_missing: bool = True) -> Layout | None: """A layout for this house from the cache, solving its footprint first when the cache has none - unless solve_missing is False (Build's workers after prepare, which has tried every footprint: what it could not solve keeps Build's own layout, the same every run).""" options = cache.options(house, programme) if not options: if cache.known(house, programme) or not solve_missing: return None # solved before: no layout fits (Build's own layout) lays = solve_varied(house, programme, seconds=seconds, workers=workers) if not lays: if not TIMED_OUT[0]: cache.put(house, programme, lays) # proven: no layout return None cache.put(house, programme, lays) options = cache.options(house, programme) return pick(options, building_id)

nodes.name: _prewarm_one
nodes.body_text: def _prewarm_one(job): """Solve one footprint. None in place of the layouts: nothing to store (it ran out of time, or the solver failed - that house keeps Build's own).""" house, programme, seconds, workers, n = job t = time.time() try: lays = solve_varied(house, programme, n=n, seconds=seconds, workers=workers) except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - one house is not worth the Build run return house_key(house, programme), programme, None, time.time() - t if not lays and TIMED_OUT[0]: return house_key(house, programme), programme, None, time.time() - t return house_key(house, programme), programme, [_to_json(x) for x in lays], time.time() - t

nodes.name: prewarm
nodes.signature: def prewarm(jobs, cache: LayoutCache, processes: int = 2, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, progress=None) -> dict
nodes.body_text: def prewarm(jobs, cache: LayoutCache, processes: int = 2, seconds: float = 3.0, workers: int = 4, progress=None) -> dict: """Solve every footprint in jobs [(house, programme)] the cache lacks, in parallel. First each footprint once, a mirror image left to its twin; then any house whose twin's layouts do not mirror onto it (stairs that would climb a way the game has none) is solved itself. A solve that ran out of time or failed stores nothing: the next run tries it again.""" from collections import Counter from multiprocessing import Pool # a footprint only one house has needs one layout; variety is for repeats uses = Counter() for house, programme in jobs: k, tk = house_key(house, programme), house_key(mirror_house(house), programme) uses[min(k, tk)] += 1 start = time.time() got = {"solved": 0, "no_layout": 0, "not_stored": 0, "solve_seconds": 0.0} def run(todo): if not todo: return with Pool(processes) as pool: for i, (k, prog, lays, took) in enumerate(pool.imap_unordered(_prewarm_one, todo)): got["solved"] += 1 got["solve_seconds"] += took if lays is None: got["not_stored"] += 1 else: cache.store(k, prog, lays) got["no_layout"] += not lays if progress and (i + 1) % 25 == 0: progress(i + 1, len(todo), time.time() - start) cache.save() cache.save() todo, keys = [], set() for house, programme in jobs: k = house_key(house, programme) tk = house_key(mirror_house(house), programme) if k in keys or tk in keys or cache.known(house, programme): continue keys.add(k) todo.append((house, programme, seconds, workers, VARIETY if uses[min(k, tk)] > 1 else 1)) run(todo) again, keys = [], set() for house, programme in jobs: k = house_key(house, programme) if k not in keys and not cache.known(house, programme): keys.add(k) again.append((house, programme, seconds, workers, 1)) run(again) got["solve_seconds"] = round(got["solve_seconds"], 1) return dict(got, jobs=len(jobs), seconds=round(time.time() - start, 1))

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: def run(todo): if not todo: return with Pool(processes) as pool: for i, (k, prog, lays, took) in enumerate(pool.imap_unordered(_prewarm_one, todo)): got["solved"] += 1 got["solve_seconds"] += took if lays is None: got["not_stored"] += 1 else: cache.store(k, prog, lays) got["no_layout"] += not lays if progress and (i + 1) % 25 == 0: progress(i + 1, len(todo), time.time() - start) cache.save() cache.save()

nodes.name: to_building
nodes.signature: def to_building(lay: Layout, seed: int = 0, profile=None, party: dict | None = None, uses: list | None = None, converted: str | None = None, homes: bool = False)
nodes.body_text: def to_building(lay: Layout, seed: int = 0, profile=None, party: dict | None = None, uses: list | None = None, converted: str | None = None, homes: bool = False): """The layout as Build's own Building: its rooms, doors and windows as solved, then Build's furnishing and walkways, as designer.stack does for a hand-drawn plan. converted: a house's layout for an office, surgery or guest house (conversion), its rooms renamed by that class - only the ground floor's when homes are over it.""" import random from . import layout as L house = lay.house block = lay.programme == "flats_block" kd = KINDS if block else programme_tables(lay.programme)[2] shop = any(kd[r["kind"]].get("frontage") or kd[r["kind"]].get("street_door") for r in lay.storeys[0]["rooms"]) use = shop_use_of(uses) if shop or converted else None conv = SHOPS["converted"] storeys = [] for lvl, st in enumerate(lay.storeys): rooms = [] # (with homes on its one storey a house stays a home: someone working from it) renamed = converted and (not homes or converted in conv["all_floors"] or (lvl == 0 and len(lay.storeys) > 1)) for room in st["rooms"]: xs = [x for x, _ in room["squares"]] ys = [y for _, y in room["squares"]] # named after the business's own use (the pizza place's kitchen), # where the room's kind or the programme says so; in a converted # house, by its class's table (the front room the office's reception) which = room.get("spec", {}).get("use", kd[room["kind"]].get("use")) if renamed: which = conv["rename"][converted].get(room["kind"]) if which in ("front", "back"): kind = use[0 if which == "front" else 1] if use else room["build"] else: kind = which or room["build"] else: kind = use[0 if which == "front" else 1] if use and which else room["build"] # a shop's lobby and stair hall: nothing standing in them (_furnish) rooms.append(L.Room(min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys), kind=kind, fixed=True, unit=room.get("unit", 0), is_core=shop and lvl == 0 and room["kind"] in ROOT_KINDS)) # a wall is a party wall on this storey where the neighbour is as tall # (Build's party: {edge: the neighbour's storeys}), else every storey walls = ({e for e, n in party.items() if n > lvl} if party is not None else {_edge(*e) for e in house.party}) plan = L.Plan(width=house.width, height=house.height, rooms=rooms, grid=[row[:] for row in st["grid"]], drawn=True, profile=profile, mask=[row[:] for row in house.masks[lvl]], party=walls) plan.doors = list(st["doors"]) plan.windows = list(st["windows"]) if block: plan.kind = "apartment" if shop: # a floor of homes over the business is a flat's; its store rooms are the shop's home = any(kd[r["kind"]]["build"] in HOME_BUILDS for r in st["rooms"]) plan.kind = "shop" if lvl == 0 or not home else "apartment" plan.shop_front = set(st.get("shop_front", ())) if lvl == 0 else set() elif renamed and converted != "guest": plan.kind = "shop" # furnished as a business (an office's desks, a public WC) storeys.append(plan) building = L.Building(width=house.width, height=house.height, storeys=storeys, profile=profile) for lvl, plan in enumerate(storeys): L._furnish(plan, random.Random(seed + 977 * lvl), lay.stairs, house.street) pubs = _pubs() if lay.programme.endswith("@pub") else None if pubs: for plan in storeys: pubs.fit_bars(plan, house.street) # the counter, the back bar, the tables if lay.stairs: for lvl in range(len(storeys) - 1): building.stairs.append(lay.stairs) L._clear_for_stairs(storeys[lvl], *lay.stairs) L._clear_for_stairs(storeys[lvl + 1], *lay.stairs) L._clear_the_way(building) from . import interiors interiors.one_wood(building, random.Random(f"{seed}:wood")) return building

nodes.name: check
nodes.body_text: def check(lay: Layout) -> list[str]: """Rule breaks in a solved layout (empty when it keeps them all).""" out = [] levels = len(lay.storeys) for lvl, st in enumerate(lay.storeys): for i, room in enumerate(st["rooms"]): k = room["kind"] flat = lay.programme == "flats_block" and room.get("unit") if levels >= RULES["bedrooms_upstairs_from"] and lvl == 0 and k in RULES["bedroom_kinds"] and not flat: out.append(f"L{lvl} {k}: a bedroom downstairs") need = programme_tables("flat_unit")[2][k]["window"] if flat else KINDS[k]["window"] if need == "need" and not room.get("windows"): out.append(f"L{lvl} {k}: no window") if not _is_root(room["spec"]) and k != "garage" and room["parent"] is None: out.append(f"L{lvl} {k}: no door") if room["parent"] is not None: pk = st["rooms"][room["parent"]]["kind"] if [k, pk] in RULES["no_door"] or [pk, k] in RULES["no_door"]: out.append(f"L{lvl} {k}: door from {pk}") if lay.stairs and 0 < lvl < levels - 1: x, y, d = lay.stairs dx, dy = (0, 1) if d == "N" else (1, 0) flight = [(x + dx * i, y + dy * i) for i in range(STAIR_RUN)] hall = st["grid"][flight[0][1]][flight[0][0]] open_sq = {(cx, cy) for cy, row in enumerate(st["grid"]) for cx, v in enumerate(row) if v == hall} - set(flight[1:-1]) seen, todo = set(), [flight[0]] while todo: q = todo.pop() if q in seen or q not in open_sq: continue seen.add(q) todo += [(q[0] + 1, q[1]), (q[0] - 1, q[1]), (q[0], q[1] + 1), (q[0], q[1] - 1)] if flight[-1] not in seen: out.append(f"L{lvl}: the landing does not join the stairs up to the stairs down") cells = sum(1 for row in st["grid"] for c in row if c) need = sum(1 for row in lay.house.masks[lvl] for c in row if c) if cells != need: out.append(f"L{lvl}: {need - cells} squares in no room") if lay.front_door is None and not lay.house.inner: out.append("no front door") pubs = _pubs() if lay.programme.endswith("@pub") else None if pubs: out += pubs.check(lay) return out

nodes.name: render
nodes.signature: def render(lay: Layout, path: str, title: str = "", px: int = 28)
nodes.body_text: def render(lay: Layout, path: str, title: str = "", px: int = 28): from PIL import Image, ImageDraw house = lay.house W, H = house.width, house.height pad = 30 fw, fh = W * px + 2 * pad, H * px + 2 * pad + 20 img = Image.new("RGB", (fw * len(lay.storeys), fh + 24), (250, 250, 247)) d = ImageDraw.Draw(img) d.text((6, 4), f"{title} [{lay.programme} v{lay.variant}, {lay.seconds:.1f}s]", fill=(0, 0, 0)) stair = [] if lay.stairs: x, y, dd = lay.stairs dx, dy = (0, 1) if dd == "N" else (1, 0) stair = [(x + dx * i, y + dy * i) for i in range(STAIR_RUN)] for lvl, st in enumerate(lay.storeys): ox, oy = lvl * fw + pad, pad + 24 grid = st["grid"] d.text((ox, oy - 16), ["Ground", "First", "Second", "Third"][lvl] + f" (street {house.street})", fill=(60, 60, 60)) def P(x, y): return ox + x * px, oy + y * px for y in range(H): for x in range(W): r = grid[y][x] if not r: continue c = COLOURS.get(st["rooms"][r - 1]["kind"], (200, 200, 200)) d.rectangle([*P(x, y), P(x + 1, y + 1)[0] - 1, P(x + 1, y + 1)[1] - 1], fill=c) d.rectangle([*P(x, y), P(x + 1, y + 1)[0] - 1, P(x + 1, y + 1)[1] - 1], outline=(0, 0, 0, 30)) # stairs: hatched, arrow up the flight for i, (x, y) in enumerate(stair): x0, y0 = P(x, y) for t in range(0, px, 5): if lay.stairs[2] == "N": d.line([x0 + 3, y0 + t, x0 + px - 3, y0 + t], fill=(120, 100, 70)) else: d.line([x0 + t, y0 + 3, x0 + t, y0 + px - 3], fill=(120, 100, 70)) if stair: a, b = P(*stair[-1]), P(*stair[0]) d.line([a[0] + px // 2, a[1] + px // 2, b[0] + px // 2, b[1] + px // 2], fill=(200, 0, 0), width=2) d.text((b[0] + 4, b[1] + 2), "UP" if lvl < len(lay.storeys) - 1 else "dn", fill=(200, 0, 0)) # walls for y in range(H + 1): for x in range(W + 1): here = grid[y][x] if y < H and x < W else 0 west = grid[y][x - 1] if 0 < x <= W and y < H else 0 north = grid[y - 1][x] if 0 < y <= H and x < W else 0 if y < H and here != west: party = (x, y, "W") in house.party or (x - 1, y, "E") in house.party d.line([*P(x, y), *P(x, y + 1)], fill=(170, 30, 30) if party else (20, 20, 20), width=4 if (here == 0 or west == 0) else 2) if x < W and here != north: party = (x, y, "N") in house.party or (x, y - 1, "S") in house.party d.line([*P(x, y), *P(x + 1, y)], fill=(170, 30, 30) if party else (20, 20, 20), width=4 if (here == 0 or north == 0) else 2) for (x, y, s) in st["windows"]: a = P(x, y) if s == "W": d.line([a[0], a[1] + 5, a[0], a[1] + px - 5], fill=(40, 170, 240), width=5) else: d.line([a[0] + 5, a[1], a[0] + px - 5, a[1]], fill=(40, 170, 240), width=5) for (x, y, s) in st["doors"]: a = P(x, y) if s == "W": d.line([a[0], a[1] + 4, a[0], a[1] + px - 4], fill=(250, 250, 247), width=5) d.line([a[0] - 3, a[1] + 4, a[0] + 3, a[1] + 4], fill=(140, 80, 30), width=2) else: d.line([a[0] + 4, a[1], a[0] + px - 4, a[1]], fill=(250, 250, 247), width=5) d.line([a[0] + 4, a[1] - 3, a[0] + 4, a[1] + 3], fill=(140, 80, 30), width=2) for room in st["rooms"]: if not room["rects"]: continue x0, y0, x1, y1 = max(room["rects"], key=lambda r: (r[2] - r[0] + 1) * (r[3] - r[1] + 1)) cx, cy = P((x0 + x1 + 1) / 2, (y0 + y1 + 1) / 2) name = LABEL.get(room["kind"], room["kind"]) if room.get("unit"): name = f"{room['unit']}: {name}" # which flat area = len(room["squares"]) d.text((cx - 3 * len(name), cy - 10), name, fill=(0, 0, 0)) d.text((cx - 8, cy + 1), f"{area}m2", fill=(60, 60, 60)) _save(img, path)

nodes.name: _save
nodes.signature: def _save(img, path: str, tries: int = 5) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _save(img, path: str, tries: int = 5) -> None: """Save through a temporary file: on Windows an open preview of the old picture can refuse the write for a moment.""" path = os.path.normpath(path) tmp = path + ".tmp.png" img.save(tmp) for i in range(tries): try: os.replace(tmp, path) return except OSError: time.sleep(0.3 * (i + 1)) os.replace(tmp, path)

nodes.name: _box
nodes.body_text: def _box(w, h, cut=()): """A w x h mask with (x0, y0, x1, y1) rectangles cut out.""" m = [[True] * w for _ in range(h)] for (x0, y0, x1, y1) in cut: for y in range(y0, y1 + 1): for x in range(x0, x1 + 1): m[y][x] = False return m

nodes.name: _party
nodes.body_text: def _party(w, h, sides, mask=None): out = set() for side in sides: if side == "E": out |= {(w - 1, y, "E") for y in range(h)} if side == "W": out |= {(0, y, "W") for y in range(h)} return out
