nodes.name: parse_chunk
nodes.body_text: fn parse_chunk(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Rec>, String> { let mut r = Reader::new(bytes); let mut recs = Vec::new(); while r.left() > 0 { let n = r.u32()?; if n == SKIP { recs.push(Rec::Skip(r.u32()?)); } else { let n = n as usize; if n * 4 > r.left() { return Err("a square runs past its chunk".into()); } let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(n); for _ in 0..n { v.push(r.u32()?); } recs.push(Rec::Square(v)); } } Ok(recs) }

nodes.name: write_chunk
nodes.body_text: fn write_chunk(recs: &[Rec], out: &mut Vec<u8>) { for rec in recs { match rec { Rec::Skip(c) => { put_u32(out, SKIP); put_u32(out, *c); } Rec::Square(v) => { put_u32(out, v.len() as u32); v.iter().for_each(|&x| put_u32(out, x)); } } } }

nodes.name: parse
nodes.body_text: pub fn parse(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Pack, String> { let mut r = Reader::new(data); if r.bytes(4)? != MAGIC { return Err("not a lot pack".into()); } let version = r.u32()?; let count = r.u32()? as usize; let mut offs = Vec::with_capacity(count + 1); for _ in 0..count { offs.push(r.u64()? as usize); } offs.push(data.len()); let mut chunks = Vec::with_capacity(count); for i in 0..count { let (a, b) = (offs[i], offs[i + 1]); if a > b || b > data.len() { return Err(format!("chunk {i} has offsets {a}..{b}")); } chunks.push(parse_chunk(&data[a..b]).map_err(|e| format!("chunk {i}: {e}"))?); } Ok(Pack { version, chunks }) }

nodes.name: write
nodes.body_text: pub fn write(&self) -> Vec<u8> { let mut body = Vec::new(); let mut offs = Vec::with_capacity(self.chunks.len()); let start = 12 + 8 * self.chunks.len(); for c in &self.chunks { offs.push((start + body.len()) as u64); write_chunk(c, &mut body); } let mut o = Vec::with_capacity(start + body.len()); o.extend_from_slice(MAGIC); put_u32(&mut o, self.version); put_u32(&mut o, self.chunks.len() as u32); for off in offs { o.extend_from_slice(&off.to_le_bytes()); } o.extend_from_slice(&body); o }

nodes.name: expand
nodes.body_text: pub fn expand(recs: &[Rec]) -> Vec<Option<Vec<u32>>> { let mut grid = Vec::new(); for rec in recs { match rec { Rec::Skip(c) => grid.extend((0..*c).map(|_| None)), Rec::Square(v) => grid.push(Some(v.clone())), } } grid }

nodes.name: encode
nodes.body_text: pub fn encode(grid: &[Option<Vec<u32>>]) -> Vec<Rec> { let mut recs = Vec::new(); let mut run = 0u32; for sq in grid { match sq { None => run += 1, Some(v) => { if run > 0 { recs.push(Rec::Skip(run)); run = 0; } recs.push(Rec::Square(v.clone())); } } } if run > 0 { recs.push(Rec::Skip(run)); } recs }

nodes.name: source_round_trips
nodes.body_text: fn source_round_trips() { let k = sample(); let bytes = k.write().unwrap(); let back = KCell::parse(&bytes).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, k); assert_eq!(back.write().unwrap(), bytes); let mut with_zombie = k.clone(); with_zombie.zombie = Some(vec![3; 1024]); assert_eq!(KCell::parse(&with_zombie.write().unwrap()).unwrap(), with_zombie); }

nodes.name: compiled_files_read_back_as_the_same_cell
nodes.body_text: fn compiled_files_read_back_as_the_same_cell() { let k = sample(); let files = compile_cell(&k, &Manifest::default(), None); let h = Header::parse(&files.header).unwrap(); let p = Pack::parse(&files.pack).unwrap(); // The table holds the used tiles once each, sorted by name. assert_eq!(h.tiles, vec!["blends_natural_01_0", "floors_interior_tilesandwood_01_0", "walls_exterior_house_01_0"]); assert_eq!((h.min_z, h.max_z), (0, 1)); let cell = Cell::from_pack(&h.tiles, &p, 2).unwrap(); let sq = cell.get(0, 10, 20).unwrap(); assert_eq!(sq.room, 0); assert_eq!(sq.tiles.iter().map(|&t| cell.names[t as usize].as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), ["floors_interior_tilesandwood_01_0", "walls_exterior_house_01_0"]); assert!(cell.get(1, 255, 255).is_some() && cell.get(1, 0, 0).is_none()); // No spawn map and no stored bytes: no zombies. assert!(h.chunk_values.iter().all(|&b| b == 0)); assert_eq!(files.chunkdata.len(), 1026); }

nodes.name: damaged_sources_are_errors_not_panics
nodes.body_text: fn damaged_sources_are_errors_not_panics() { let bytes = sample().write().unwrap(); for len in (0..bytes.len()).step_by(997) { let _ = KCell::parse(&bytes[..len]); } let mut bad = bytes.clone(); bad[4..8].copy_from_slice(&9u32.to_le_bytes()); assert!(KCell::parse(&bad).is_err(), "unknown version"); assert!(KCell::parse(b"KCEL").is_err()); let mut over = bytes.clone(); over.extend_from_slice(&[1, 2, 3]); assert!(KCell::parse(&over).is_err(), "bytes after the squares"); let mut huge_levels = bytes; huge_levels[20..24].copy_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes()); assert!(KCell::parse(&huge_levels).is_err()); }

nodes.body_text: fn take(&mut self, n: usize) -> Vec<u8> { let mut buf = vec![0u8; n]; if let Err(e) = self.inner.read_exact(&mut buf) { die(&format!("short read ({n} bytes): {e}")); } buf }

nodes.body_text: struct Tables { step_x: [i32; N], step_y: [i32; N], span: [i32; N], angle: [f64; N], length: [f64; N], slope: [usize; N], slope_cost: [f64; N], dir_penalty: [f64; N], /// A notch of turn costs beta x this: the search's own beta times it. share: f64, reverse: f64, bounds: Vec<f64>, swing: Vec<[u8; N]>, }

nodes.name: Moves
nodes.body_text: struct Moves { sharp: Vec<Vec<Move>>, curved_small: Vec<Vec<Move>>, curved_wide: Vec<Vec<Move>>, }

nodes.name: State
nodes.body_text: struct State { x: i32, y: i32, hd: i32, run: i32, last: i32, }

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.body_text: struct Entry { f: f64, neg: f64, tick: u64, st: State, }

nodes.name: eq
nodes.body_text: fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self.f == other.f && self.neg == other.neg && self.tick == other.tick }

nodes.name: cmp_f
nodes.signature: fn cmp_f(a: f64, b: f64) -> Ordering
nodes.body_text: fn cmp_f(a: f64, b: f64) -> Ordering { if a < b { Ordering::Less } else if b < a { Ordering::Greater } else { Ordering::Equal } }

nodes.name: cmp
nodes.body_text: fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering { cmp_f(self.f, other.f) .then_with(|| cmp_f(self.neg, other.neg)) .then_with(|| self.tick.cmp(&other.tick)) }

nodes.name: sift_up
nodes.signature: fn sift_up(h: &mut [Entry], start: usize, mut pos: usize)
nodes.body_text: fn sift_up(h: &mut [Entry], start: usize, mut pos: usize) { let item = h[pos].clone(); while pos > start { let parent = (pos - 1) >> 1; if item < h[parent] { h[pos] = h[parent].clone(); pos = parent; } else { break; } } h[pos] = item; }

nodes.name: sift_down
nodes.body_text: fn sift_down(h: &mut [Entry], pos: usize) { let end = h.len(); let start = pos; let item = h[pos].clone(); let mut pos = pos; let mut child = 2 * pos + 1; while child < end { let right = child + 1; if right < end && !(h[child] < h[right]) { child = right; } h[pos] = h[child].clone(); pos = child; child = 2 * pos + 1; } h[pos] = item; sift_up(h, start, pos); }

nodes.name: push
nodes.body_text: fn push(h: &mut Vec<Entry>, e: Entry) { h.push(e); let n = h.len(); sift_up(h, 0, n - 1); }

nodes.name: pop
nodes.body_text: fn pop(h: &mut Vec<Entry>) -> Option<Entry> { let last = h.pop()?; if h.is_empty() { return Some(last); } let first = std::mem::replace(&mut h[0], last); sift_down(h, 0); Some(first) }

nodes.name: partial_cmp
nodes.body_text: fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> { Some(self.cmp(other)) }

nodes.name: Search
nodes.body_text: struct Search { w: i32, h: i32, x0: i32, y0: i32, weight: Vec<f64>, way: Vec<f64>, dens: Option<Vec<f64>>, occ: Option<Vec<f64>>, turnable: Vec<u8>, taken: HashMap<u32, i32>, run_here: Vec<i32>, s: (i32, i32), g: (i32, i32), me: i32, reach: f64, run_min: i32, cap: i32, end_run: i32, end_r: i32, road_w: f64, jog_end: f64, stops: Vec<(i32, i32)>, end_short: f64, h_start: i32, h_arrive: i32, lean: f64, limit: i64, }

nodes.name: idx
nodes.signature: fn idx(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> usize
nodes.body_text: fn idx(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> usize { ((y - self.y0) as usize) * (self.w as usize) + ((x - self.x0) as usize) }

nodes.name: inside
nodes.signature: fn inside(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> bool
nodes.body_text: fn inside(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> bool { x >= self.x0 && y >= self.y0 && x < self.x0 + self.w && y < self.y0 + self.h }

nodes.name: key
nodes.signature: fn key(&self, x: i32, y: i32, hd: i32) -> u64
nodes.body_text: fn key(&self, x: i32, y: i32, hd: i32) -> u64 { let cx = (x - self.x0) as u64; let cy = (y - self.y0) as u64; (cx << 32) | (cy << 16) | ((hd + 1) as u64) }

nodes.name: bearing
nodes.signature: fn bearing(dx: f64, dy: f64) -> f64
nodes.body_text: fn bearing(dx: f64, dy: f64) -> f64 { let a = dy.atan2(dx).to_degrees() % 360.0; if a < 0.0 { a + 360.0 } else { a } }

nodes.name: adiff
nodes.signature: fn adiff(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64
nodes.body_text: fn adiff(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { let d = (a - b).abs() % 360.0; d.min(360.0 - d) }

nodes.name: notches
nodes.signature: fn notches(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32
nodes.body_text: fn notches(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { let n = N as i32; (a - b).rem_euclid(n).min((b - a).rem_euclid(n)) }

nodes.name: Ctx
nodes.body_text: struct Ctx<'a> { t: &'a Tables, s: &'a Search, reach_short: f64, reach_near: f64, hcache: HashMap<u64, f64>, notch: f64, }

nodes.name: h
nodes.signature: fn h(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, hd: i32) -> f64
nodes.body_text: fn h(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, hd: i32) -> f64 { let key = self.s.key(x, y, hd); if let Some(v) = self.hcache.get(&key) { return *v; } let dx = (self.s.g.0 - x) as f64; let dy = (self.s.g.1 - y) as f64; let mut dist = dx.hypot(dy) - self.reach_short; if dist < 0.0 { dist = 0.0; } let out = if hd == DONE { dist } else { let mut turns = 0i32; if dx.abs().max(dy.abs()) > self.reach_near { let a = bearing(dx, dy); let on_boundary = self.t.bounds.iter().any(|b| *b == a); turns = if on_boundary { (0..N as i32) .filter(|b| adiff(self.t.angle[*b as usize], a) < 90.0) .map(|b| notches(hd, b)) .min() .unwrap_or(0) } else { let k = self.t.bounds.partition_point(|b| *b <= a); let row = if k == 0 { self.t.bounds.len() - 1 } else { k - 1 }; self.t.swing[row][hd as usize] as i32 }; } if self.s.h_arrive != NO_HEADING { turns = turns.max(notches(hd, self.s.h_arrive)); } self.s.lean * (dist + self.notch * turns as f64) }; self.hcache.insert(key, out); out }

nodes.name: may_turn
nodes.signature: fn may_turn(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> bool
nodes.body_text: fn may_turn(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> bool { if self.s.turnable[self.s.idx(x, y)] != 0 { return true; } let reach = self.s.jog_end.max(self.s.road_w); for q in std::iter::once(&self.s.s) .chain(std::iter::once(&self.s.g)) .chain(self.s.stops.iter()) { let d = ((x - q.0) as f64).hypot((y - q.1) as f64); if d <= reach { return true; } } false }

nodes.name: Trace
nodes.signature: type Trace = (f64, f64, i32, i32, i32, i32, i32);
nodes.body_text: type Trace = (f64, f64, i32, i32, i32, i32, i32);

nodes.name: run
nodes.signature: fn run(ctx: &mut Ctx, mv: &Moves, trace: &mut Vec<Trace>, trace_n: i32) -> (Option<Vec<(i32, i32)>>, u64)
nodes.body_text: fn run(ctx: &mut Ctx, mv: &Moves, trace: &mut Vec<Trace>, trace_n: i32) -> (Option<Vec<(i32, i32)>>, u64) { let (t, s) = (ctx.t, ctx.s); let heads: Vec<i32> = if s.h_start == NO_HEADING { (0..N as i32).collect() } else { vec![s.h_start] }; let starts: Vec<State> = heads .into_iter() .map(|hd| State { x: s.s.0, y: s.s.1, hd, run: s.run_min - s.end_run, last: 0 }) .collect(); let mut best: HashMap<State, f64> = HashMap::new(); let mut came: HashMap<State, State> = HashMap::new(); let mut via: HashMap<State, Vec<(i32, i32)>> = HashMap::new(); let mut heap: Vec<Entry> = Vec::new(); let mut tick = 0u64; for st in &starts { best.insert(*st, 0.0); let f = ctx.h(st.x, st.y, st.hd); heap.push(Entry { f, neg: -0.0, tick, st: *st }); tick += 1; } // Python heapifies its starts (snap._search does the same): a list is not a heap, // and one that is never heapified pops whatever happens to sit at the front. for i in (0..heap.len() / 2).rev() { sift_down(&mut heap, i); } let mut seen: i64 = 0; while let Some(e) = pop(&mut heap) { let cost = -e.neg; if cost > *best.get(&e.st).unwrap_or(&INF) { continue; } let st = e.st; let (x, y, hd, run_n, last) = (st.x, st.y, st.hd, st.run, st.last); if trace_n > 0 { trace.push((e.f, cost, x, y, hd, run_n, last)); if trace.len() as i32 >= trace_n { return (None, seen as u64); } } if hd == DONE { // The same walk Python makes: the corners of a curved move come // before the corner the move started from. let mut out: Vec<(i32, i32)> = vec![(x, y)]; let mut node = *came.get(&st).unwrap_or(&st); while let Some(prev) = came.get(&node) { if let Some(v) = via.get(&node) { for p in v.iter().rev() { out.push(*p); } } node = *prev; out.push((node.x, node.y)); } out.reverse(); return (Some(out), seen as u64); } let near_goal = (x - s.g.0).abs().max((y - s.g.1).abs()) as f64 <= s.reach; if near_goal && (s.h_arrive == NO_HEADING || s.h_arrive == hd) && run_n >= s.end_run && (x, y) != s.s { let done = State { x, y, hd: DONE, run: 0, last: 0 }; let dc = cost + s.end_short * ((x - s.g.0) as f64).hypot((y - s.g.1) as f64); if dc < *best.get(&done).unwrap_or(&INF) { best.insert(done, dc); came.insert(done, st); push(&mut heap, Entry { f: dc, neg: -dc, tick, st: done }); tick += 1; } } seen += 1; if s.limit >= 0 && seen > s.limit { return (None, seen as u64); } let need = s.run_here[s.idx(x, y)]; let mut nrun = run_n + t.span[hd as usize]; if nrun > s.cap { nrun = s.cap; } let mut moves: Vec<Move> = Vec::with_capacity(12); moves.push(Move { pieces: vec![(hd, 1)], nh: hd, nr: nrun, sign: if nrun >= s.cap { 0 } else { last }, cost: 0.0, }); if run_n >= need && ctx.may_turn(x, y) { let short = run_n < 2 * need; for m in &mv.sharp[hd as usize] { let back = if short && last * m.sign < 0 { t.reverse } else { 0.0 }; moves.push(Move { cost: m.cost + back, ..m.clone() }); } let curved = if need <= s.run_min { &mv.curved_small } else { &mv.curved_wide }; for m in &curved[hd as usize] { let back = if short && last * m.sign < 0 { t.reverse } else { 0.0 }; moves.push(Move { cost: m.cost + back, ..m.clone() }); } } for m in &moves { let (mut cx, mut cy) = (x, y); let mut nc = cost + m.cost; let mut corners: Vec<(i32, i32)> = Vec::new(); let mut ok = true; 'pieces: for (sh, count) in &m.pieces { let (dx, dy) = (t.step_x[*sh as usize], t.step_y[*sh as usize]); let ang = t.angle[*sh as usize]; let slope = t.slope[*sh as usize]; for _ in 0..*count { cx += dx; cy += dy; if !s.inside(cx, cy) { ok = false; break 'pieces; } let i = s.idx(cx, cy); let wgt = s.weight[i]; if wgt == INF { ok = false; break 'pieces; } let mut d = (ang - s.way[i]) % 360.0; if d < 0.0 { d += 360.0; } if d > 101.25 && 360.0 - d > 101.25 { ok = false; break 'pieces; } if let Some(owner) = s.taken.get(&(i as u32)) { let ends = ((cx - s.s.0).abs() + (cy - s.s.1).abs()) .min((cx - s.g.0).abs() + (cy - s.g.1).abs()); if *owner != s.me && ends > s.end_r { ok = false; break 'pieces; } } nc += t.length[*sh as usize] * t.slope_cost[slope] * wgt; if let Some(dens) = &s.dens { nc += t.length[*sh as usize] * dens[i] * t.dir_penalty[slope]; } if let Some(occ) = &s.occ { nc += t.length[*sh as usize] * occ[i]; } corners.push((cx, cy)); } } if !ok { continue; } let ns = State { x: cx, y: cy, hd: m.nh, run: m.nr, last: m.sign }; if nc < *best.get(&ns).unwrap_or(&INF) { best.insert(ns, nc); came.insert(ns, st); if corners.len() > 1 { let mut keep = corners; keep.pop(); via.insert(ns, keep); } else { via.remove(&ns); } let f = nc + ctx.h(cx, cy, m.nh); push(&mut heap, Entry { f, neg: -nc, tick, st: ns }); tick += 1; } } } (None, seen as u64) }

nodes.name: read_moves
nodes.body_text: fn read_moves(r: &mut Reader<impl Read>) -> Vec<Move> { let n = r.i32().max(0); let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n as usize); for _ in 0..n { let np = r.i32().max(0); let mut pieces = Vec::with_capacity(np as usize); for _ in 0..np { pieces.push((r.i32(), r.i32())); } out.push(Move { pieces, nh: r.i32(), nr: r.i32(), sign: r.i32(), cost: r.f64() }); } out }

nodes.name: read_tables
nodes.body_text: fn read_tables(r: &mut Reader<impl Read>) -> Tables { let mut step_x = [0i32; N]; let mut step_y = [0i32; N]; let mut angle = [0f64; N]; let mut length = [0f64; N]; let mut slope = [0usize; N]; let mut slope_cost = [0f64; N]; let mut dir_penalty = [0f64; N]; let mut span = [0i32; N]; for k in 0..N { step_x[k] = r.i32(); step_y[k] = r.i32(); span[k] = step_x[k].abs().max(step_y[k].abs()); angle[k] = r.f64(); length[k] = r.f64(); // The client sends a slope's numbers once per heading; keep them by slope id, which // is how the step loop looks them up (several headings share a slope). let sl = r.i32().max(0) as usize; slope[k] = sl; slope_cost[sl] = r.f64(); dir_penalty[sl] = r.f64(); } let share = r.f64(); let reverse = r.f64(); let nb = r.i32().max(0) as usize; let bounds: Vec<f64> = r.f64s(nb); let mut swing = Vec::with_capacity(nb); for _ in 0..nb { swing.push(r.u8s(N).try_into().unwrap()); } Tables { step_x, step_y, span, angle, length, slope, slope_cost, dir_penalty, share, reverse, bounds, swing, } }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: fn main() { if std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() == Some("--woodland") { woodland::run(); return; } if std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() == Some("--rails") { rails::run(); return; } let mut r = Reader { inner: io::stdin() }; if r.take(4) != b"KRTE" { die("not a knoxroute stream"); } if r.i32() != VERSION { die("protocol version mismatch"); } let tables = read_tables(&mut r); let stdout = io::stdout(); let mut out = BufWriter::new(stdout.lock()); loop { let mut head = [0u8; 4]; if r.inner.read_exact(&mut head).is_err() { break; // Python closed the pipe } let w = r.i32(); let h = r.i32(); let (x0, y0) = (r.i32(), r.i32()); let (sx, sy, gx, gy) = (r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32()); let h_start = r.i32(); let h_arrive = r.i32(); let (reach, run_min, cap, end_run, end_r) = (r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32()); let (road_w, jog_end, me) = (r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32()); // The junctions the road is routed through: may_turn counts them as places to // turn, as the interpreter's does. let n_stops = r.i32().max(0) as usize; let mut stops: Vec<(i32, i32)> = Vec::with_capacity(n_stops); for _ in 0..n_stops { stops.push((r.i32(), r.i32())); } let end_short = r.f64(); let lean = r.f64(); let beta = r.f64(); let limit = r.i64(); let trace_n = r.i32(); let mut mv = Moves { sharp: Vec::with_capacity(N), curved_small: Vec::with_capacity(N), curved_wide: Vec::with_capacity(N), }; for _ in 0..N { mv.sharp.push(read_moves(&mut r)); mv.curved_small.push(read_moves(&mut r)); mv.curved_wide.push(read_moves(&mut r)); } let has_dens = r.i32() != 0; let has_occ = r.i32() != 0; let ncells = r.i32().max(0) as usize; let idx = r.i32s(ncells); let weight_v = r.f64s(ncells); let way_v = r.f64s(ncells); let dens_v = if has_dens { r.f64s(ncells) } else { Vec::new() }; let occ_v = if has_occ { r.f64s(ncells) } else { Vec::new() }; let turn_v = r.u8s(ncells); let run_v = r.i32s(ncells); let ntaken = r.i32().max(0) as usize; let taken_idx = r.i32s(ntaken); let taken_owner = r.i32s(ntaken); let win = (w * h) as usize; let mut weight = vec![INF; win]; let mut way = vec![0f64; win]; let mut dens = if has_dens { Some(vec![0f64; win]) } else { None }; let mut occ = if has_occ { Some(vec![0f64; win]) } else { None }; let mut turnable = vec![0u8; win]; let mut run_here = vec![run_min; win]; for k in 0..ncells { let i = idx[k] as usize; weight[i] = weight_v[k]; way[i] = way_v[k]; run_here[i] = run_v[k]; turnable[i] = turn_v[k]; if let Some(d) = dens.as_mut() { d[i] = dens_v[k]; } if let Some(o) = occ.as_mut() { o[i] = occ_v[k]; } } let mut taken: HashMap<u32, i32> = HashMap::with_capacity(ntaken); for k in 0..ntaken { taken.insert(taken_idx[k] as u32, taken_owner[k]); } let s = Search { w, h, x0, y0, weight, way, dens, occ, turnable, taken, run_here, s: (sx, sy), g: (gx, gy), me, reach: reach as f64, run_min, cap, end_run, end_r, road_w: road_w as f64, jog_end: jog_end as f64, stops, end_short, h_start, h_arrive, lean, limit, }; let mut ctx = Ctx { t: &tables, s: &s, reach_short: (reach as f64) * std::f64::consts::SQRT_2, reach_near: reach as f64 + 2.0, hcache: HashMap::new(), notch: tables.share * beta, }; let mut trace: Vec<Trace> = Vec::new(); let (path, states) = run(&mut ctx, &mv, &mut trace, trace_n); let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new(); if trace_n > 0 { buf.extend_from_slice(&2i32.to_le_bytes()); buf.extend_from_slice(&states.to_le_bytes()); buf.extend_from_slice(&(trace.len() as i32).to_le_bytes()); for (f, cost, x, y, hd, run_n, last) in &trace { buf.extend_from_slice(&f.to_le_bytes()); buf.extend_from_slice(&cost.to_le_bytes()); for v in [x, y, hd, run_n, last] { buf.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes()); } } } else { buf.extend_from_slice(&(if path.is_some() { 1i32 } else { 0i32 }).to_le_bytes()); buf.extend_from_slice(&states.to_le_bytes()); let n = path.as_ref().map(|p| p.len()).unwrap_or(0) as i32; buf.extend_from_slice(&n.to_le_bytes()); if let Some(p) = &path { for (x, y) in p { buf.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes()); buf.extend_from_slice(&y.to_le_bytes()); } } } if out.write_all(&buf).and_then(|_| out.flush()).is_err() { break; } } }

nodes.body_text: struct State(i32, i32, i32, i32);

nodes.name: Action
nodes.body_text: struct Action { index: i32, entry: [i32; 2], delta: [i32; 2], heading: [i32; 2], }

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.body_text: struct Entry { priority: f64, cost: f64, state: State, }

nodes.name: eq
nodes.body_text: fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self.priority == other.priority && self.cost == other.cost && self.state == other.state }

nodes.name: partial_cmp
nodes.body_text: fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> { Some(self.cmp(other)) }

nodes.name: cmp
nodes.body_text: fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering { // BinaryHeap is a max heap; Python pops the smallest (f, cost, state). cmp_f(other.priority, self.priority) .then_with(|| cmp_f(other.cost, self.cost)) .then_with(|| other.state.cmp(&self.state)) }

nodes.name: Guide
nodes.body_text: struct Guide { x0: i32, y0: i32, width: usize, height: usize, pixels: Vec<u8>, }

nodes.name: deviation
nodes.signature: fn deviation(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> u8
nodes.body_text: fn deviation(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> u8 { let px = (x / 2.0).round_ties_even() as i64 - i64::from(self.x0); let py = (y / 2.0).round_ties_even() as i64 - i64::from(self.y0); if px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= self.width as i64 || py >= self.height as i64 { return 255; } self.pixels[py as usize * self.width + px as usize] }

nodes.name: Parent
nodes.body_text: type Parent = (State, i32, [i32; 2]);

nodes.name: Section
nodes.body_text: type Section = (i32, i32, i32);

nodes.name: search
nodes.body_text: fn search( guide: &Guide, actions: &HashMap<[i32; 2], Vec<Action>>, start: State, target: [f64; 2], last: [i32; 2], end_radius: f64, ) -> Option<Vec<Section>> { let remaining = |s: State| (f64::from(s.0) - target[0]).hypot(f64::from(s.1) - target[1]) / 2.0; let mut queue = BinaryHeap::from([Entry { priority: remaining(start) * 1.15, cost: 0.0, state: start, }]); let mut best: HashMap<State, (f64, Option<Parent>)> = HashMap::from([(start, (0.0, None))]); let mut final_state = None; while let Some(Entry { cost, state, .. }) = queue.pop() { if cost != best[&state].0 { continue; } if state != start && remaining(state) <= end_radius && [state.2, state.3] == last { final_state = Some(state); break; } for action in actions.get(&[state.2, state.3]).into_iter().flatten() { let (Some(nx), Some(ny)) = ( state.0.checked_add(action.delta[0]), state.1.checked_add(action.delta[1]), ) else { continue; }; let mut samples = [0u8; 4]; for (i, t) in [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0].iter().enumerate() { samples[i] = guide.deviation( f64::from(state.0) + f64::from(action.delta[0]) * t, f64::from(state.1) + f64::from(action.delta[1]) * t, ); } if samples.contains(&255) { continue; } let step = f64::from(action.delta[0]).hypot(f64::from(action.delta[1])) / 2.0; let mut candidate = cost + step * (1.0 + f64::from(samples.iter().map(|v| u32::from(*v)).sum::<u32>()) / 4.0 * 0.08); if action.index >= 4 { candidate += 2.0; } let next = State(nx, ny, action.heading[0], action.heading[1]); if candidate >= best.get(&next).map_or(f64::INFINITY, |v| v.0) { continue; } best.insert(next, (candidate, Some((state, action.index, action.entry)))); queue.push(Entry { priority: candidate + remaining(next) * 1.15, cost: candidate, state: next, }); } } let mut state = final_state?; let mut path = Vec::new(); while state != start { let (previous, index, entry) = best[&state].1?; // Python // rounds negative tile origins towards minus infinity. let x = (i64::from(previous.0) - i64::from(entry[0])).div_euclid(2); let y = (i64::from(previous.1) - i64::from(entry[1])).div_euclid(2); path.push((i32::try_from(x).ok()?, i32::try_from(y).ok()?, index)); state = previous; } path.reverse(); Some(path) }

nodes.name: heading
nodes.body_text: fn heading(value: [i32; 2]) -> bool { value.iter().all(|v| (-1..=1).contains(v)) && value != [0, 0] }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: pub fn run() { let mut r = Reader { inner: io::stdin() }; if r.take(4) != b"KRL2" { die("not a version 2 rail stream"); } let (x0, y0, width, height) = (r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32()); let size = usize::try_from(width) .ok() .zip(usize::try_from(height).ok()) .and_then(|(w, h)| w.checked_mul(h)); let Some(size) = size.filter(|n| *n > 0 && *n <= 512 * 1024 * 1024) else { die("invalid rail raster size"); }; let start = State(r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32(), r.i32()); let target = [r.f64(), r.f64()]; let end_radius = r.f64(); let last = [r.i32(), r.i32()]; if !heading([start.2, start.3]) || !heading(last) || target.iter().any(|v| !v.is_finite()) || !end_radius.is_finite() || end_radius <= 0.0 || end_radius > 2.0 { die("invalid rail endpoint"); } let count = r.i32(); if !(1..=1024).contains(&count) { die("invalid rail assembly count"); } let mut actions: HashMap<[i32; 2], Vec<Action>> = HashMap::new(); for index in 0..count { let entry = [r.i32(), r.i32()]; let exit = [r.i32(), r.i32()]; let incoming = [r.i32(), r.i32()]; let outgoing = [r.i32(), r.i32()]; if !heading(incoming) || !heading(outgoing) || entry .iter() .chain(&exit) .any(|v| !(-4096..=4096).contains(v)) || entry == exit { die("invalid rail assembly"); } let delta = [exit[0] - entry[0], exit[1] - entry[1]]; actions.entry(incoming).or_default().push(Action { index, entry, delta, heading: outgoing, }); actions .entry([-outgoing[0], -outgoing[1]]) .or_default() .push(Action { index, entry: exit, delta: [-delta[0], -delta[1]], heading: [-incoming[0], -incoming[1]], }); } let guide = Guide { x0, y0, width: width as usize, height: height as usize, pixels: r.u8s(size), }; let path = search(&guide, &actions, start, target, last, end_radius); let stdout = io::stdout(); let mut out = io::BufWriter::new(stdout.lock()); out.write_all(b"KRL2").unwrap(); out.write_all(&path.as_ref().map_or(-1, |p| p.len() as i32).to_le_bytes()) .unwrap(); if let Some(path) = path { for (x, y, index) in path { for v in [x, y, index] { out.write_all(&v.to_le_bytes()).unwrap(); } } } out.flush().unwrap(); }

nodes.body_text: mod tests { use super::*; #[test] fn heap_matches_python_tuple_order() { let a = Entry { priority: 3.0, cost: 2.0, state: State(1, 2, 1, 0), }; let b = Entry { priority: 3.0, cost: 2.0, state: State(2, 2, 1, 0), }; let c = Entry { priority: 3.0, cost: 1.0, ..a }; let mut heap = BinaryHeap::from([b, a, c]); assert_eq!(heap.pop().unwrap().cost, 1.0); assert_eq!(heap.pop().unwrap().state, a.state); assert_eq!(heap.pop().unwrap().state, b.state); } #[test] fn samples_round_half_to_even_including_negative_coordinates() { let guide = Guide { x0: -2, y0: 0, width: 5, height: 1, pixels: vec![10, 20, 30, 40, 50], }; assert_eq!(guide.deviation(-1.0, 0.0), 30); assert_eq!(guide.deviation(-3.0, 0.0), 10); assert_eq!(guide.deviation(3.0, 0.0), 50); assert_eq!(guide.deviation(20.0, 0.0), 255); } #[test] fn no_path_and_negative_tile_origin() { let start = State(-1, 2, 1, 0); let actions = HashMap::from([( [1, 0], vec![Action { index: 0, entry: [-1, 2], delta: [6, 0], heading: [1, 0], }], )]); let mut guide = Guide { x0: -2, y0: 0, width: 9, height: 4, pixels: vec![0; 36], }; assert_eq!( search(&guide, &actions, start, [11.0, 2.0], [1, 0], 1.5), Some(vec![(0, 0, 0), (3, 0, 0)]) ); guide.pixels.fill(255); assert!(search(&guide, &actions, start, [11.0, 2.0], [1, 0], 1.5).is_none()); } #[test] fn fractional_endpoints_need_the_port_rounding_radius() { let guide = Guide { x0: -2, y0: 0, width: 9, height: 4, pixels: vec![0; 36], }; let actions = HashMap::from([( [1, 0], vec![Action { index: 0, entry: [-1, 2], delta: [6, 0], heading: [1, 0], }], )]); let start = State(-1, 0, 1, 0); assert!(search(&guide, &actions, start, [8.0, 0.2], [1, 0], 1.5).is_none()); assert_eq!( search( &guide, &actions, start, [8.0, 0.2], [1, 0], 2.5_f64.sqrt() + 1e-9 ), Some(vec![(0, -1, 0)]) ); } }

nodes.name: heap_matches_python_tuple_order

nodes.name: paint
nodes.body_text: fn paint(veg: &mut [u8], land: &mut [u8], masks: &[u8], colours: &[[u8; 3]; 8]) { let n = veg.len() / 3; let [water, medium, light, dark, scrub, edge, inside, nothing] = *colours; for i in 0..n { let v = &mut veg[3 * i..3 * i + 3]; let g = &mut land[3 * i..3 * i + 3]; if masks[2 * n + i] != 0 { v.copy_from_slice(&scrub); } if masks[i] == 0 || g == water { continue; } let shade = if masks[n + i] != 0 { inside } else { edge }; if shade == nothing { continue; } v.copy_from_slice(&shade); if g == medium || g == light { g.copy_from_slice(&dark); } } }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: pub fn run() { let mut r = Reader { inner: io::stdin() }; if r.take(4) != b"KWD1" { die("not a version 1 woodland stream"); } let strips = r.i32(); if !(1..=1_048_576).contains(&strips) { die("invalid woodland strip count"); } let mut out = io::BufWriter::new(io::stdout()); for _ in 0..strips { let (width, height) = (r.i32(), r.i32()); let n = usize::try_from(width) .ok() .zip(usize::try_from(height).ok()) .and_then(|(w, h)| w.checked_mul(h)); let Some(n) = n.filter(|n| *n > 0 && *n <= 1_048_576) else { die("invalid woodland strip size"); }; let mut colours = [[0u8; 3]; 8]; for c in &mut colours { c.copy_from_slice(&r.take(3)); } let mut veg = r.take(3 * n); let mut land = r.take(3 * n); let masks = r.take(3 * n); paint(&mut veg, &mut land, &masks, &colours); out.write_all(b"KWD1").unwrap(); out.write_all(&veg).unwrap(); out.write_all(&land).unwrap(); out.flush().unwrap(); } }

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.body_text: // Knoxify — frontend. // // - Leaflet map with leaflet-draw for selecting the bbox. // - Area stats update live as the rectangle is drawn/edited. // - POSTs to /api/generate and renders results. // Mirrors the server. Big areas are fetched as a grid of Overpass queries, so // the cap is render memory and patience rather than one API call's limit. // Where a map stops being an easy one. None of these stops anything: the // window says what you are in for and the button stays lit. A limit that says // no is worth having only when the thing behind it cannot be done, and a big // map can be done - it costs memory and patience, which are the mapper's to // spend. const BIG_AREA_KM2 = 1000.0; const BIG_TILES_PER_SIDE = 20000; // Peak memory of Generate buildings, as in BUILD_BYTES_PER_TILE in app.py. const BUILD_BYTES_PER_TILE = 24; const BUILD_BASE_BYTES = 300e6; const BIG_LANDMARK_KM2 = 40.0; const OVERPASS_TILE_KM2 = 30.0; const SLOW_ABOVE_KM2 = 60.0; // ---- errors ------------------------------------------------------------- // Every failure the server answers with carries an id (E-7F3A2C) that is also // in logs/knoxmap.log beside the full error; the page shows it, so a bug // report can point straight at the line. See knoxlog.py. let lastErrorId = null; // Errors in this page's own code, which otherwise vanish inside the app // window where there is no console to see them. window.addEventListener('error', e => sendPageError(e.message, `${e.filename}:${e.lineno}:${e.colno}`, e.error && e.error.stack)); window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', e => sendPageError((e.reason && e.reason.message) || e.reason, 'unhandled promise', e.reason && e.reason.stack)); const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: true }).setView([38.0406, -84.5037], 14); // Tiles through KnoxMap's own server, which follows the OSM tile policy - // see the /tiles route in app.py. L.tileLayer('/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 19, attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors', }).addTo(map); const drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup().addTo(map); const SEL_STYLE = { color: '#3d8bfd', weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.1, className: 'sel-rect' }; const drawControl = new L.Control.Draw({ draw: { polyline: false, marker: false, circlemarker: false, rectangle: { shapeOptions: SEL_STYLE }, // Any outline, clicked point by point: a neighbourhood, a stretch of // coast, the blocks either side of a high street. polygon: { allowIntersection: false, showArea: true, shapeOptions: SEL_STYLE }, circle: { shapeOptions: SEL_STYLE, showRadius: true, metric: true }, }, edit: { featureGroup: drawnItems, remove: true }, }); map.addControl(drawControl); let currentRect = null; let rotateHandleMarker = null; let rotateHandleStem = null; let isRotatingSelection = false; // ---- rotate the selection (Photoshop style) ------------------------------------ map.on('zoomend', updateRotateHandle); // ---- drag the selection -------------------------------------------------------- // Press on the chosen area and drag it to somewhere else; the size and shape // stay as they are. leaflet-draw only reshapes by the corners, so moving a // whole rectangle, polygon, circle or a place's outline is done here. It stands // aside while any drawing tool or the corner editor is in use. let selDrawing = false; map.on(L.Draw.Event.DRAWSTART, () => { selDrawing = true; }); map.on(L.Draw.Event.DRAWSTOP, () => { selDrawing = false; }); map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, (e) => { // The area selection and the drawing palette both finish a shape the same // way; which of them it belongs to is which of them armed the handler. if (zoneEd.claim(e.layer)) return; if (sketchEd.claim(e.layer)) return; setSelection(e.layer); }); // One draw handler at a time on the world map: the area toolbar, the sketch // palette and the zone tool each arm one, and two armed at once would both // answer the same clicks. Whichever started last wins. map.on(L.Draw.Event.DRAWSTART, () => { const mine = [sketchEd, zoneEd].find(e => e.kind); for (const e of [sketchEd, zoneEd]) if (e !== mine) e.stop(); }); // ---- freehand lasso --------------------------------------------------------------- // Drag round what you want. The traced line is thinned to a polygon, so the // server receives a few dozen points rather than every mouse move. const LassoControl = L.Control.extend({ options: { position: 'topleft' }, }); map.addControl(new LassoControl()); // Douglas-Peucker on screen pixels, so "a few metres" means the same at every zoom. // The selection as GeoJSON for the server, or null for a plain rectangle. // Area inside the selection in km², on a local flat projection: plenty for // town-sized shapes. map.on(L.Draw.Event.EDITED, () => { updateBboxFields(); updateRotateHandle(); }); map.on(L.Draw.Event.DELETED, () => { currentRect = null; clearBboxFields(); updateRotateHandle(); }); // Leaflet reports coordinates *unwrapped* once the map has been panned across // a world copy, so a rectangle drawn after dragging east twice comes back at // longitude 747 rather than 27. The server folds these back too, but doing it // here as well keeps the boxes on screen showing where the user actually is. // The box at the current scale, rounded out to whole 300-tile cells. // ---- an area typed rather than drawn ----------------------------------------- // The four corner boxes are filled in by whatever is drawn on the map, and // they also work the other way round: somebody who knows where their map ends // - a county line, a coordinate out of another tool - types the degrees and // gets the box, instead of nudging a rectangle until the numbers look right. document.getElementById('coordsApply').addEventListener('click', areaFromCoords); for (const id of ['south', 'west', 'north', 'east']) { document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('keydown', ev => { if (ev.key === 'Enter') { ev.preventDefault(); areaFromCoords(); } }); } // The scale is typed, so it can be empty, half-typed or out of range. Whole // metres only, 1 to 100 (MIN/MAX_METERS_PER_TILE in app.py); anything else // becomes the nearest valid number, or 1, and the field is corrected so what // is shown is what is used. document.getElementById('metersPerTile').addEventListener('input', updateBboxFields); document.getElementById('metersPerTile').addEventListener('change', fixScaleField); // The smallest whole metres-per-tile, no finer than the one in use, at which // the map is back inside the tiles-a-side warning and its bitmaps (3 bytes a // tile, twice over) come to under 1.5 GB. Null when the scale // is already as coarse as the window allows or nothing in range fits. document.getElementById('area-stats').addEventListener('click', ev => { const btn = ev.target.closest('.use-scale'); if (!btn) return; document.getElementById('metersPerTile').value = btn.dataset.scale; fixScaleField(); }); // Landscape and vegetation, 3 bytes a tile each, held at full size while the // map is drawn. It is the number that decides whether a big map finishes. // How long Generate map takes, as a range in seconds. Fitted to the timings in // logs/knoxmap.log (Oct 2026): the OpenStreetMap download ran 3 to 45 s a km² // depending on the server, and drawing ran 3 to 8 s per million tiles. nodes.name: apiError

nodes.name: sendPageError
nodes.body_text: function sendPageError(message, where, stack) { try { fetch('/api/client-error', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ message: String(message).slice(0, 500), where: String(where || '').slice(0, 300), stack: String(stack || '').slice(0, 4000) }), }).catch(() => {}); } catch (_) { /* nothing more to do */ } }

nodes.name: calculatePivot
nodes.body_text: function calculatePivot(layer) { const crs = map.options.crs || L.CRS.EPSG3857; if (layer instanceof L.Circle) { return layer.getLatLng(); } const pts = flattenLatLngs(getShapeLatLngs(layer)); if (!pts.length) return layer.getBounds().getCenter(); let sumX = 0, sumY = 0; for (const pt of pts) { const p = crs.project(pt); sumX += p.x; sumY += p.y; } return crs.unproject(L.point(sumX / pts.length, sumY / pts.length)); }

nodes.name: setSelection
nodes.body_text: function setSelection(layer) { drawnItems.clearLayers(); currentRect = layer; currentRect._rotationAngle = 0; currentRect._pivot = calculatePivot(layer); currentRect._origPoints = getShapeLatLngs(currentRect); makeSelectionDraggable(layer); drawnItems.addLayer(currentRect); updateBboxFields(); updateRotateHandle(); }

nodes.name: rotateSingleLatLng
nodes.body_text: function rotateSingleLatLng(ll, pivot, rad) { const crs = map.options.crs || L.CRS.EPSG3857; const pPivot = crs.project(pivot); const p = crs.project(ll); const dx = p.x - pPivot.x; const dy = p.y - pPivot.y; // Pure rigid clockwise rotation in projected Web Mercator coordinates: // Zero distortion, zero drift, center point is 100% frozen in place. const rx = dx * Math.cos(rad) + dy * Math.sin(rad); const ry = -dx * Math.sin(rad) + dy * Math.cos(rad); return crs.unproject(L.point(pPivot.x + rx, pPivot.y + ry)); }

nodes.name: rotateShapeCoords
nodes.body_text: function rotateShapeCoords(item, pivot, rad) { if (Array.isArray(item)) { return item.map(child => rotateShapeCoords(child, pivot, rad)); } return rotateSingleLatLng(item, pivot, rad); }

nodes.name: flattenLatLngs
nodes.body_text: function flattenLatLngs(items) { const out = []; function walk(x) { if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const item of x) walk(item); } else if (x && typeof x.lat === 'number') { out.push(x); } } walk(items); return out; }

nodes.name: walk
nodes.body_text: function walk(x) { if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const item of x) walk(item); } else if (x && typeof x.lat === 'number') { out.push(x); } }

nodes.name: getShapeLatLngs
nodes.body_text: function getShapeLatLngs(layer) { if (layer instanceof L.Rectangle) { const b = layer.getBounds(); return [ L.latLng(b.getNorth(), b.getWest()), L.latLng(b.getNorth(), b.getEast()), L.latLng(b.getSouth(), b.getEast()), L.latLng(b.getSouth(), b.getWest()), ]; } if (layer instanceof L.Circle) { const c = layer.getLatLng(); const r = layer.getRadius(); const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) { const a = (i / 64) * 2 * Math.PI; const dLat = (r * Math.cos(a)) / 111320; const dLon = (r * Math.sin(a)) / (111320 * Math.cos(c.lat * Math.PI / 180)); pts.push(L.latLng(c.lat + dLat, wrapLon(c.lng + dLon))); } return pts; } if (layer instanceof L.Polygon) { const raw = layer.getLatLngs(); return Array.isArray(raw[0]) ? raw[0] : raw; } return []; }

nodes.name: getShapeTopExtentPx
nodes.body_text: function getShapeTopExtentPx(origPoints, pivot) { const cPt = map.latLngToLayerPoint(pivot); let maxUpPx = 25; for (const pt of flattenLatLngs(origPoints)) { const p = map.latLngToLayerPoint(pt); const up = cPt.y - p.y; if (up > maxUpPx) maxUpPx = up; } return maxUpPx; }

nodes.name: calcRotateHandlePositions
nodes.body_text: function calcRotateHandlePositions(pivot, origPoints, angle) { const cPt = map.latLngToLayerPoint(pivot); const maxUpPx = getShapeTopExtentPx(origPoints, pivot); const stemLen = 24; const handleRadius = maxUpPx + stemLen; const alpha = -Math.PI / 2 + angle; const dx = Math.cos(alpha); const dy = Math.sin(alpha); const hPt = L.point(cPt.x + handleRadius * dx, cPt.y + handleRadius * dy); const sPt = L.point(cPt.x + maxUpPx * dx, cPt.y + maxUpPx * dy); return { handleLatLng: map.layerPointToLatLng(hPt), stemStartLatLng: map.layerPointToLatLng(sPt), cPt, maxUpPx, stemLen, handleRadius }; }

nodes.name: removeRotateHandle
nodes.body_text: function removeRotateHandle() { if (rotateHandleMarker) { map.removeLayer(rotateHandleMarker); rotateHandleMarker = null; } if (rotateHandleStem) { map.removeLayer(rotateHandleStem); rotateHandleStem = null; } }

nodes.name: updateRotateHandle
nodes.body_text: function updateRotateHandle() { if (!currentRect || !drawnItems.hasLayer(currentRect)) { removeRotateHandle(); return; } if (!currentRect._pivot) { currentRect._pivot = calculatePivot(currentRect); currentRect._origPoints = getShapeLatLngs(currentRect); currentRect._rotationAngle = 0; } const pos = calcRotateHandlePositions( currentRect._pivot, currentRect._origPoints, currentRect._rotationAngle || 0 ); if (!rotateHandleStem) { rotateHandleStem = L.polyline([pos.stemStartLatLng, pos.handleLatLng], { color: '#3d8bfd', weight: 2, opacity: 0.9, interactive: false, zIndexOffset: 1900, }).addTo(map); } else { rotateHandleStem.setLatLngs([pos.stemStartLatLng, pos.handleLatLng]); } if (!rotateHandleMarker) { createRotateHandle(pos.handleLatLng); } else { rotateHandleMarker.setLatLng(pos.handleLatLng); attachRotateHandleEvents(rotateHandleMarker); } }

function createRotateHandle(latlng) { if (rotateHandleMarker) { map.removeLayer(rotateHandleMarker); rotateHandleMarker = null; } const icon = L.divIcon({ className: 'rotate-handle-icon-container', html: `

nodes.name: rotateSelectionBy
nodes.body_text: function rotateSelectionBy(deg) { if (!currentRect) return; if (!currentRect._pivot) { currentRect._pivot = calculatePivot(currentRect); currentRect._origPoints = getShapeLatLngs(currentRect); currentRect._rotationAngle = 0; } const angle = (currentRect._rotationAngle || 0) + (deg * Math.PI / 180); currentRect._rotationAngle = angle; const rotated = rotateShapeCoords(currentRect._origPoints, currentRect._pivot, angle); if (currentRect instanceof L.Rectangle || currentRect instanceof L.Circle) { const pivot = currentRect._pivot; const origPoints = currentRect._origPoints; drawnItems.removeLayer(currentRect); currentRect = L.polygon(rotated, SEL_STYLE); currentRect._pivot = pivot; currentRect._origPoints = origPoints; currentRect._rotationAngle = angle; makeSelectionDraggable(currentRect); drawnItems.addLayer(currentRect); } else { currentRect.setLatLngs(rotated); } updateBboxFields(); updateRotateHandle(); }

nodes.name: shiftLatLngs
nodes.body_text: function shiftLatLngs(ll, dLat, dLng) { return Array.isArray(ll) ? ll.map(x => shiftLatLngs(x, dLat, dLng)) : L.latLng(ll.lat + dLat, ll.lng + dLng); }

nodes.name: makeSelectionDraggable
nodes.body_text: function makeSelectionDraggable(layer) { layer.on('mousedown', (ev) => { const oe = ev.originalEvent; if (oe && oe.button !== undefined && oe.button !== 0) return; if (isRotatingSelection) return; if (selDrawing || map.getContainer().classList.contains('lasso-armed')) return; if (layer.editing && layer.editing.enabled && layer.editing.enabled()) return; if (!drawnItems.hasLayer(layer)) return; L.DomEvent.stop(ev); // not a map pan, not a click if (oe) L.DomEvent.preventDefault(oe); // and no text selection while dragging const isCircle = layer instanceof L.Circle; const startLL = ev.latlng; const start = isCircle ? layer.getLatLng() : layer.getLatLngs(); const startPivot = currentRect && currentRect._pivot ? nodes.name: onAdd
nodes.body_text: onAdd() { const bar = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar leaflet-control lasso-control'); const a = L.DomUtil.create('a', 'lasso-btn', bar); a.href = '#'; a.title = 'Draw freehand: drag round the area you want'; a.innerHTML = '✎'; L.DomEvent.on(a, 'click', (ev) => { L.DomEvent.stop(ev); startLasso(a); }); return bar; }

nodes.name: startLasso
nodes.body_text: function startLasso(button) { const box = map.getContainer(); button.classList.add('is-active'); box.classList.add('lasso-armed'); map.dragging.disable(); let points = []; let trail = null; const down = (e) => { points = [e.latlng]; trail = L.polyline(points, { color: '#3d8bfd', weight: 2, dashArray: '4 4' }).addTo(map); map.on('mousemove', move); }; const move = (e) => { points.push(e.latlng); trail.setLatLngs(points); }; const up = () => { map.off('mousedown', down); map.off('mousemove', move); map.off('mouseup', up); map.dragging.enable(); button.classList.remove('is-active'); box.classList.remove('lasso-armed'); if (trail) map.removeLayer(trail); const thin = simplifyLatLngs(points, 8); if (thin.length >= 3) { setSelection(L.polygon(thin, SEL_STYLE)); map.fire(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, { layer: currentRect, layerType: 'polygon', lasso: true }); } }; map.on('mousedown', down); map.on('mouseup', up); }

nodes.body_text: move = (e) => { points.push(e.latlng); trail.setLatLngs(points); }

nodes.name: up
nodes.body_text: up = () => { map.off('mousedown', down); map.off('mousemove', move); map.off('mouseup', up); map.dragging.enable(); button.classList.remove('is-active'); box.classList.remove('lasso-armed'); if (trail) map.removeLayer(trail); const thin = simplifyLatLngs(points, 8); if (thin.length >= 3) { setSelection(L.polygon(thin, SEL_STYLE)); map.fire(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, { layer: currentRect, layerType: 'polygon', lasso: true }); } }

nodes.name: simplifyLatLngs
nodes.body_text: function simplifyLatLngs(latlngs, tolerancePx) { if (latlngs.length < 3) return latlngs; const pts = latlngs.map(ll => map.latLngToLayerPoint(ll)); const keep = new Array(pts.length).fill(false); keep[0] = keep[pts.length - 1] = true; const stack = [[0, pts.length - 1]]; while (stack.length) { const [a, b] = stack.pop(); let best = -1, bestD = tolerancePx; for (let i = a + 1; i < b; i++) { const d = L.LineUtil.pointToSegmentDistance(pts[i], pts[a], pts[b]); if (d > bestD) { best = i; bestD = d; } } if (best >= 0) { keep[best] = true; stack.push([a, best], [best, b]); } } return latlngs.filter((_, i) => keep[i]); }

nodes.name: selectionShape
nodes.body_text: function selectionShape() { if (!currentRect || currentRect instanceof L.Rectangle) return null; if (currentRect instanceof L.Circle) { const c = currentRect.getLatLng(); const r = currentRect.getRadius(); const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) { const a = (i / 64) * 2 * Math.PI; const dLat = (r * Math.cos(a)) / 111320; const dLon = (r * Math.sin(a)) / (111320 * Math.cos(c.lat * Math.PI / 180)); ring.push([wrapLon(c.lng + dLon), c.lat + dLat]); } ring.push(ring[0]); return { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [ring] }; } const geo = currentRect.toGeoJSON().geometry; const fold = coords => coords.map(ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [wrapLon(lon), lat])); if (geo.type === 'Polygon') return { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: fold(geo.coordinates) }; if (geo.type === 'MultiPolygon') return { type: 'MultiPolygon', coordinates: geo.coordinates.map(fold) }; return null; }

nodes.name: fold
nodes.body_text: fold = coords => coords.map(ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [wrapLon(lon), lat]))

nodes.name: selectionAreaKm2
nodes.body_text: function selectionAreaKm2() { if (!currentRect) return null; if (currentRect instanceof L.Rectangle) { const b = currentRect.getBounds(); const s = b.getSouth(), n = b.getNorth(); const w = b.getWest(), e = b.getEast(); return haversineKm(s, w, s, e) * haversineKm(s, w, n, w); } const shape = selectionShape(); if (!shape) return null; const polys = shape.type === 'Polygon' ? [shape.coordinates] : shape.coordinates; let total = 0; for (const rings of polys) { rings.forEach((ring, idx) => { const lat0 = ring[0][1] * Math.PI / 180; let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < ring.length - 1; i++) { const [x1, y1] = [ring[i][0] * 111.32 * Math.cos(lat0), ring[i][1] * 111.32]; const [x2, y2] = [ring[i + 1][0] * 111.32 * Math.cos(lat0), ring[i + 1][1] * 111.32]; sum += x1 * y2 - x2 * y1; } total += (idx === 0 ? 1 : -1) * Math.abs(sum) / 2; }); } return total; }

nodes.name: wrapLon
nodes.body_text: function wrapLon(lon) { return ((lon + 180) % 360 + 360) % 360 - 180; }

nodes.name: rectBounds
nodes.body_text: function rectBounds(rect) { const b = rect.getBounds(); return { s: b.getSouth(), n: b.getNorth(), w: wrapLon(b.getWest()), e: wrapLon(b.getEast()), }; }

nodes.name: boxSize
nodes.body_text: function boxSize(s, w, n, e) { const mpt = readScale(); const widthM = haversineKm(s, w, s, e) * 1000; const heightM = haversineKm(s, w, n, w) * 1000; return { area: bboxAreaKm2(s, w, n, e), widthM, heightM, tilesX: Math.ceil(widthM / mpt / 300) * 300, tilesY: Math.ceil(heightM / mpt / 300) * 300, }; }

nodes.name: updateBboxFields
nodes.body_text:
function updateBboxFields() { if (!currentRect) return clearBboxFields(); const { s, w, n, e } = rectBounds(currentRect); document.getElementById('south').value = s.toFixed(6); document.getElementById('west').value = w.toFixed(6); document.getElementById('north').value = n.toFixed(6); document.getElementById('east').value = e.toFixed(6); const mpt = readScale(); const { area, widthM, heightM, tilesX, tilesY } = boxSize(s, w, n, e); const cellsX = tilesX / 300; const cellsY = tilesY / 300; const queries = area > OVERPASS_TILE_KM2 ? Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(area / OVERPASS_TILE_KM2)) ** 2 : 1; // Landscape and vegetation images, 3 bytes a tile each. const pixelsMB = (tilesX * tilesY * 3 * 2) / 1e6; const stats = document.getElementById('area-stats'); const btn = document.getElementById('generateBtn'); const side = Math.max(tilesX, tilesY); const heavy = []; if (area > BIG_AREA_KM2) { heavy.push(`${Math.round(area)} km² is bigger than maps usually are ` + `(${BIG_AREA_KM2} km²).`); } if (side > BIG_TILES_PER_SIDE) { heavy.push(`${side} tiles a side is past what is comfortable ` + `(${BIG_TILES_PER_SIDE}) — about ${bitmapFor(tilesX, tilesY)} of ` + 'ground and greenery held in memory at once. Raising metres per ' + 'tile is the cheapest fix: 2 m is a quarter of the memory of 1 m.'); } const slow = !heavy.length && area > SLOW_ABOVE_KM2; const fitScale = heavy.length ? scaleThatFits(widthM, heightM, mpt) : null; const bitmap = bitmapFor(tilesX, tilesY); const buildGB = ((tilesX * tilesY * BUILD_BYTES_PER_TILE + BUILD_BASE_BYTES) / 1e9).toFixed(1); const fill = Math.min(100, (area / BIG_AREA_KM2) * 100); const takes = durationText(generateSeconds(area, tilesX * tilesY)); const shapeKm2 = selectionAreaKm2(); const shapeVal = shapeKm2 !== null ? shapeKm2 : area; stats.className = heavy.length ? 'warn' : (slow ? 'warn' : 'ok'); stats.innerHTML = `
${fx.tile(shapeVal, 'km²', 'Shape area', shapeVal < 10 ? 2 : 1)} ${fx.tile(area, 'km²', 'Map area', area < 10 ? 2 : 1)}
0×0
Cells
${fx.tile(tilesX * tilesY / 1e6, 'M', 'Tiles', 2)} ${fx.tile(queries, '', queries === 1 ? 'OSM query' : 'OSM queries')} ${fx.tile(Math.round(pixelsMB), 'MB', 'Bitmap', 0)}
~${Math.round(widthM)} × ${Math.round(heightM)} m · ${bitmap} of bitmap · ~${buildGB} GB to add buildings · ${takes} to generate ${fill < 1 ? '<1' : Math.round(fill)}% of limit
${selectionShape() !== null && shapeKm2 !== null ? `
Only the drawn shape is built: ${shapeKm2.toFixed(2)} km² (bounding box: ${area.toFixed(1)} km², ${cellsX}×${cellsY} cells). Outside it the land turns back to countryside, with the main roads and rivers running on.
` : ''} ${heavy.length ? `
${heavy.join(' ')} You can still build it — this is a heads-up, not a wall. ${fitScale ? `` : ''}
` : ''} ${slow ? `
A big map — Generate map will take ${takes}, mostly OpenStreetMap downloads.
` : ''} `; fx.countUp(stats); btn.disabled = false; fx.step('area', 'done'); const lm = document.getElementById('landmarksBtn'); lm.disabled = false; lm.title = area > BIG_LANDMARK_KM2 ? `${Math.round(area)} km² is a lot to search for landmarks — it will take a while.` : ''; }

nodes.name: coordsNote
nodes.body_text: function coordsNote(text, bad) { const box = document.getElementById('coordsNote'); box.textContent = text || ''; box.classList.toggle('bad', !!bad); }

nodes.name: areaFromCoords
nodes.body_text: function areaFromCoords() { const read = id => parseFloat(String(document.getElementById(id).value) .replace(',', '.')); const [s, w, n, e] = ['south', 'west', 'north', 'east'].map(read); if ([s, w, n, e].some(v => !Number.isFinite(v))) { coordsNote('Fill in all four corners first.', true); return; } // Said plainly rather than quietly swapped: a map built upside down from a // typo is worse than being told the typo. if (s >= n || w >= e) { coordsNote('South must be below north, and west left of east.', true); return; } if (Math.abs(s) > 85.05 || Math.abs(n) > 85.05 || Math.abs(w) > 180 || Math.abs(e) > 180) { coordsNote('Those are outside the map: 85 degrees north and south, 180 east and west.', true); return; } const layer = L.rectangle([[s, w], [n, e]], SEL_STYLE); setSelection(layer); map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds()); coordsNote('Area taken from the corners you typed.'); }

nodes.name: read
nodes.body_text: read = id => parseFloat(String(document.getElementById(id).value) .replace(',', '.'))

nodes.name: clearBboxFields
nodes.body_text:
function clearBboxFields() { ['south', 'west', 'north', 'east'].forEach(id => { document.getElementById(id).value = ''; }); const stats = document.getElementById('area-stats'); stats.className = 'empty'; stats.innerHTML = `
Draw an area on the map - rectangle, polygon, circle or freehand - to see what you'll get.
`; document.getElementById('generateBtn').disabled = true; document.getElementById('landmarksBtn').disabled = true; document.getElementById('landmark-results').innerHTML = ''; fx.resetFrom('area'); updateRotateHandle(); }

nodes.name: readScale
nodes.body_text: function readScale() { const el = document.getElementById('metersPerTile'); let v = parseFloat(String(el.value).replace(',', '.')); if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return 1; // Quarter metres. Between 1 and 2 is where a scale earns its keep - a town // at full size, or everything in it half that - so the steps in between // are worth having. app.py settles it the same way (tidy_scale). return Math.min(100, Math.max(0.5, Math.round(v / 0.25) * 0.25)); }

nodes.name: fixScaleField
nodes.body_text: function fixScaleField() { const el = document.getElementById('metersPerTile'); el.value = String(readScale()); updateBboxFields(); }

nodes.name: scaleThatFits
nodes.body_text: function scaleThatFits(widthM, heightM, current) { const MAX_BITMAP_MB = 1500; for (let s = Math.max(1, Math.floor(current) + 1); s <= 100; s++) { const tx = Math.ceil(widthM / s / 300) * 300; const ty = Math.ceil(heightM / s / 300) * 300; if (Math.max(tx, ty) <= BIG_TILES_PER_SIDE && tx * ty * 6 / 1e6 <= MAX_BITMAP_MB) { return { mpt: s, side: Math.max(tx, ty), bitmap: bitmapFor(tx, ty) }; } } return null; }

nodes.name: bitmapFor
nodes.body_text: function bitmapFor(tilesX, tilesY) { const mb = (tilesX * tilesY * 3 * 2) / 1e6; return mb < 1000 ? `${Math.round(mb)} MB` : `${(mb / 1000).toFixed(1)} GB`; }

nodes.name: generateSeconds
nodes.body_text: function generateSeconds(areaKm2, tiles) { const mTiles = tiles / 1e6; return [20 + areaKm2 * 3 + mTiles * 3, 20 + areaKm2 * 45 + mTiles * 8]; }

nodes.name: durationText
nodes.body_text: function durationText([lo, hi]) { const say = s => s < 90 ? `${Math.max(1, Math.round(s / 60))} min` : s < 5400 ? `${Math.round(s / 60)} min` : `${(s / 3600).toFixed(1)} h`; return say(lo) === say(hi) ? `about ${say(hi)}` : `${say(lo)} to ${say(hi)}`; }

nodes.name: say
nodes.body_text: say = s => s < 90 ? `${Math.max(1, Math.round(s / 60))} min` : s < 5400 ? `${Math.round(s / 60)} min` : `${(s / 3600).toFixed(1)} h`

nodes.name: bboxAreaKm2
nodes.body_text: function bboxAreaKm2(s, w, n, e) { const hKm = (n - s) * 111.32; const wKm = (e - w) * 111.32 * Math.cos((s + n) / 2 * Math.PI / 180); return Math.abs(hKm * wKm); }

nodes.name: haversineKm
nodes.body_text: function haversineKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) { const R = 6371; const toRad = d => d * Math.PI / 180; const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1); const dLon = toRad(lon2 - lon1); const a = Math.sin(dLat/2)**2 + Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLon/2)**2; return 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a)); }

nodes.name: toRad
nodes.body_text: toRad = d => d * Math.PI / 180

nodes.name: loadSettings
nodes.body_text: async function loadSettings() { const res = await fetch('/api/settings'); settingsMeta = await res.json(); buildSettingsForm(settingsMeta.current); }

nodes.name: buildSettingsForm
nodes.body_text:
function buildSettingsForm(values) { const body = document.getElementById('advanced-body'); body.innerHTML = ''; for (const [key, [label, hint]] of Object.entries(SETTING_LABELS)) { if (!(key in settingsMeta.defaults)) continue; // knob has been removed const [lo, hi] = settingsMeta.limits[key]; const isInt = settingsMeta.types ? settingsMeta.types[key] === 'int' : Number.isInteger(settingsMeta.defaults[key]); const choices = settingsMeta.options?.[key]; const isChoice = Array.isArray(choices); // A setting that is only ever 0 or 1 is a switch, not a quantity. As a // slider it was two positions wide, read "1" or "0" rather than on or // off, and could be left halfway on a touchscreen. const isSwitch = !isChoice && isInt && lo === 0 && hi === 1; const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = isSwitch ? 'setting setting-switch' : 'setting'; // A seed is an identifier, not a quantity: nobody wants to drag a slider // across two billion values to find one, so it gets a box and a dice. const control = key === 'seed' ? `
` : isChoice ? `` : isSwitch ? '' : ``; // The switch sits in the heading, where the number used to be: the name // on the left, what it is set to on the right, the hint underneath. const head = isSwitch ? `` : key === 'seed' || isChoice ? '' : `${values[key]}`; wrap.innerHTML = `
${label} ${head}
${control} ${hint}`; body.appendChild(wrap); } fx.wireSettings(body); runListSearch('advanced-body'); }

nodes.name: readSettings
nodes.body_text: function readSettings() { const out = { preset: document.getElementById('preset').value }; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('#advanced-body [data-key]')) { // A switch is on or off, and sends the 1 or 0 the generator reads. if (el.type === 'checkbox') { out[el.dataset.key] = el.checked ? 1 : 0; continue; } // Blank means "whatever the preset says" rather than zero. if (el.value.trim() !== '') { out[el.dataset.key] = el.tagName === 'SELECT' ? el.value : parseFloat(el.value); } } return out; }

nodes.name: rememberMap
nodes.body_text: function rememberMap(map) { importedSettings = null; openedMap = map; if (map && map.settings) { openedMap.settings = { ...map.settings }; delete openedMap.settings.preset; } // What the panel reads back once it has been filled in, which is not always // what was saved: the sliders step in hundredths, so a style_oddity of 0.18 // comes back as 0.20 and would be reported as a change nobody made. The // knobs are measured against what they were showing, and only the ones that // really move are sent, so the rest keep the value the map was made with. openedMap.shown = readSettings(); showReapply(); // Editing is about a map that exists, so it waits for one to be open. The // shapes of whichever map was open before are cleared rather than left to // be edited into a map they do not belong to. if (typeof editReady === 'function') { editReady(map && openedMap ? openedMap.mapName : null); editLayer.clearLayers(); pickEdit(null); mapEdits = { removed: [], moved: {}, tags: {} }; document.getElementById('editShape').disabled = true; showEditCount(); noteEdit(''); } }

nodes.name: changedSettings
nodes.body_text: function changedSettings() { if (!openedMap || !openedMap.shown) return []; return changedFrom(openedMap.shown, readSettings()); }

nodes.name: changedFrom
nodes.body_text: function changedFrom(was, now) { const out = []; for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(now)) { if (key === 'preset' || !(key in was)) continue; const before = was[key]; const same = typeof value === 'number' && typeof before === 'number' ? Math.abs(value - before) < 1e-9 : String(value) === String(before); if (!same) out.push(key); } return out; }

nodes.name: settingsForRequest
nodes.body_text: function settingsForRequest() { const now = readSettings(); const saved = importedSettings || openedMap; if (!saved || !saved.shown || !saved.settings) return now; const out = { ...saved.settings, preset: now.preset }; for (const key of changedFrom(saved.shown, now)) out[key] = now[key]; return out; }

nodes.name: settingsToApply
nodes.body_text: function settingsToApply(changed) { const now = readSettings(); const out = { ...(openedMap.settings || {}) }; for (const key of changed) out[key] = now[key]; return out; }

nodes.name: stepsFor
nodes.body_text: function stepsFor(changed) { if (!changed.length) return []; const redraw = (settingsMeta && settingsMeta.renderKeys) || []; return changed.some(k => redraw.includes(k)) ? ['generate', 'build'] : ['build']; }

nodes.name: showReapply
nodes.body_text: function showReapply() { const box = document.getElementById('reapply'); if (!box) return; if (!openedMap) { box.hidden = true; box.innerHTML = ''; return; } const changed = changedSettings(); const steps = stepsFor(changed); box.hidden = false; if (!steps.length) { box.innerHTML = `${escapeHtml(openedMap.mapName)} already has these settings.`; return; } const names = changed.map(k => (SETTING_LABELS[k] || [k])[0]); const what = steps.length === 2 ? 'draws the map again and lays the buildings out again' : 'lays the buildings out again, on the ground already drawn'; box.innerHTML = `Changed since ${escapeHtml(openedMap.mapName)} was made: ${escapeHtml(names.join(', '))}. Applying it ${what} - the area, the scale and the name stay as they are. `; document.getElementById('reapplyBtn').addEventListener('click', reapply); }

nodes.name: reapply
nodes.body_text: async function reapply() { const box = document.getElementById('reapply'); const btn = document.getElementById('reapplyBtn'); const changed = changedSettings(); const steps = stepsFor(changed); if (!steps.length || !openedMap) return; const settings = settingsToApply(changed); const say = text => { const line = box.querySelector('.hint'); if (line) line.textContent = text; }; const post = async (url, body) => { const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), }); const out = await res.json(); if (wasStopped(out, res)) return null; if (!res.ok) throw apiError(out, res); return out; }; btn.disabled = true; showStop(openedMap.mapName); try { if (steps.includes('generate')) { say(`Drawing ${openedMap.mapName} again - the town is not downloaded twice.`); startProgress(openedMap.mapName); const b = openedMap.bbox || {}; const drawn = await post('/api/generate', { south: b.south, west: b.west, north: b.north, east: b.east, metersPerTile: openedMap.metersPerTile, mapName: openedMap.mapName, settings, shape: openedMap.shape, }); if (!drawn) { say('Stopped. Nothing was thrown away.'); return; } renderResults(drawn); } say('Laying the buildings out again...'); const built = await post('/api/buildings', { mapName: openedMap.mapName, settings }); if (!built) { say('Stopped. Nothing was thrown away.'); return; } renderCensus(built.population); document.getElementById('worldedBtn').disabled = false; document.getElementById('compileBtn').disabled = false; note('compileNote', 'Ready - compile to put the change in the game.'); rememberMap({ ...openedMap, settings }); fx.toast('ok', 'Settings applied', `${openedMap.mapName}: ${built.count} buildings. Compile it to put the change in the game.`); } catch (err) { say(err.message); } finally { btn.disabled = false; showStop(null); } }

nodes.name: say
nodes.body_text: say = text => { const line = box.querySelector('.hint'); if (line) line.textContent = text; }

nodes.name: post
nodes.body_text: post = async (url, body) => { const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), }); const out = await res.json(); if (wasStopped(out, res)) return null; if (!res.ok) throw apiError(out, res); return out; }

nodes.name: currentPortablePreset
nodes.body_text: function currentPortablePreset() { if (!currentRect) throw new Error('Draw an area first.'); const b = rectBounds(currentRect); return { format: 'knoxmap-preset', version: 1, name: document.getElementById('presetName').value.trim() || document.getElementById('mapName').value.trim() || 'Shared area', south: b.s, west: b.w, north: b.n, east: b.e, shape: selectionShape(), metersPerTile: readScale(), settings: settingsForRequest(), }; }

nodes.name: validatePortablePreset
nodes.body_text: async function validatePortablePreset(p) { const res = await fetch('/api/presets/validate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(p), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); return data.preset; }

nodes.name: applyPortablePreset
nodes.body_text: function applyPortablePreset(p) { let layer; if (p.shape) { const polys = p.shape.type === 'Polygon' ? [p.shape.coordinates] : p.shape.coordinates; layer = L.polygon(polys.map(rings => rings.map(ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon]))), SEL_STYLE); } else { layer = L.rectangle([[p.south, p.west], [p.north, p.east]], SEL_STYLE); } setSelection(layer); map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds()); document.getElementById('metersPerTile').value = p.metersPerTile; document.getElementById('presetName').value = p.name; if (settingsMeta) { const kinds = document.getElementById('preset'); kinds.value = [...kinds.options].some(option => option.value === p.preset) ? p.preset : 'town'; buildSettingsForm({ ...settingsMeta.defaults, ...p.settings }); } openedMap = null; importedSettings = { settings: p.settings, shown: readSettings() }; showReapply(); fixScaleField(); presetNote(`Loaded "${p.name}".`); }

nodes.name: importPortablePreset
nodes.body_text: async function importPortablePreset(raw) { if (!await settingsReady) throw new Error('Could not load the settings list.'); const preset = await validatePortablePreset(raw); applyPortablePreset(preset); document.getElementById('presetsPanel').open = true; }

nodes.name: presetFromLink
nodes.body_text: function presetFromLink(link) { const url = new URL(link, location.href); const encoded = url.searchParams.get('preset'); if (!encoded || encoded.length > 1000000) throw new Error('This link has no valid KnoxMap preset.'); try { return JSON.parse(encoded); } catch (_) { throw new Error('This link has an unreadable KnoxMap preset.'); } }

nodes.name: loadPresets
nodes.body_text: async function loadPresets() { try { savedAreas = (await (await fetch('/api/presets')).json()).presets || []; } catch (_) { savedAreas = []; } const list = document.getElementById('presetList'); list.innerHTML = savedAreas.length ? savedAreas.map(p => `<option value="${escapeHtml(p.name)}">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</option>`).join('') : '<option value="">(none saved yet)</option>'; document.getElementById('presetsCount').textContent = savedAreas.length ? `(${savedAreas.length})` : ''; for (const id of ['presetLoad', 'presetDelete']) { document.getElementById(id).disabled = !savedAreas.length; } }

nodes.name: presetNote
nodes.body_text: function presetNote(text, kind) { const el = document.getElementById('presetNote'); el.textContent = text; el.className = kind === 'bad' ? 'hint bad' : 'hint'; }

nodes.name: checkSetup
nodes.body_text:
async function checkSetup() { if (setupChecking) return; setupChecking = true; try { const res = await fetch('/api/setup-status'); const data = await res.json(); const card = document.getElementById('setupCard'); // Named after the script this PC actually has: Setup.bat on Windows, // ./setup.sh on Linux and macOS. const script = document.getElementById('setupScript'); if (script && data.setupCommand) script.textContent = data.setupCommand; if (data.ready) { card.hidden = true; return; } document.getElementById('setupList').innerHTML = data.checks.map(c => `
  • ${c.ok ? '✓' : '✗'} ${escapeHtml(c.label)}${c.ok ? '' : ` — ${escapeHtml(c.fix)}`}
    • `).join(''); card.hidden = false; } catch (_) { /* the page still works without the check */ } finally { setupChecking = false; } }

nodes.name: row
nodes.body_text:
row = (ok, label, extra) => `
  • ${ok ? '✓' : '✗'} ${escapeHtml(label)}${extra ? ` — ${escapeHtml(extra)}` : ''}
    • `

nodes.name: setOsmSourceUI
nodes.body_text:
function setOsmSourceUI(source, saveToServer = true) { if (!OSM_SOURCE_DESCS[source]) source = 'overpass'; currentOsmSource = source; const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.osm-source-card'); cards.forEach(card => { const isThis = card.dataset.source === source; card.classList.toggle('is-on', isThis); card.setAttribute('aria-checked', isThis ? 'true' : 'false'); }); const info = OSM_SOURCE_DESCS[source]; const descEl = document.getElementById('osmSourceDesc'); if (descEl) { descEl.innerHTML = `${escapeHtml(info.title)}
${escapeHtml(info.description)}`; } if (saveToServer) { fetch('/api/overpass', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ osm_source: source }), }).then(async r => { const data = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) throw apiError(data, r); }).then(() => { const name = { overpass: 'Overpass API', auto: 'Auto', extract: 'Geofabrik' }[source]; note('overpassNote', `Map data source set to ${name}`, 'ok'); }).catch(err => { note('overpassNote', err.message, 'bad'); }); } }

nodes.name: savePbfFile
nodes.body_text: async function savePbfFile(path) { const res = await fetch('/api/overpass', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pbf_file: path }), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); return data; }

nodes.name: localCall
nodes.body_text: async function localCall(action, extra) { const res = await fetch('/api/local-overpass', extra === undefined && !action ? undefined : { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ action, ...extra }) }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); return data; }

nodes.name: showLocal
nodes.body_text: function showLocal(d) { const text = !d.docker ? 'Docker was not found. Install Docker Desktop and start it.' : { none: 'Not set up.', stopped: 'Stopped.', ready: 'Running and ready.', loading: 'Loading the region' + (d.log ? ` — ${d.log}` : '…') }[d.state]; note('localNote', text, d.state === 'ready' ? 'ok' : ''); const show = (id, on) => { document.getElementById(id).hidden = !on; }; document.getElementById('localExtract').hidden = d.state !== 'none'; show('localStart', d.docker && d.state !== 'loading' && d.state !== 'ready'); show('localUse', d.state === 'ready'); show('localStop', d.state === 'ready' || d.state === 'loading'); show('localRemove', d.docker && d.state !== 'none'); clearTimeout(localTimer); if (d.state === 'loading') localTimer = setTimeout(refreshLocal, 15000); }

nodes.name: showSteamLibraries

  • ✗No Steam library found
    • '; const field = document.getElementById('steamFolders'); if (document.activeElement !== field) field.value = (data.chosen || []).join('; '); document.getElementById('steamNote').className = 'hint'; document.getElementById('steamNote').textContent = data.game ? `Project Zomboid: ${data.game}` : 'Project Zomboid was not found in these.'; }
