nodes.name: loadMaps
nodes.body_text: async function loadMaps() { let data; try { data = await (await fetch('/api/maps')).json(); } catch (_) { return; } const list = document.getElementById('mapList'); const card = document.getElementById('mapsCard'); if (!data.maps || !data.maps.length) { card.hidden = true; return; } card.hidden = false; document.getElementById('mapsCount').textContent = `(${data.maps.length})`; list.innerHTML = ''; for (const m of data.maps) { const li = document.createElement('li'); const name = document.createElement('span'); name.className = 'name'; name.textContent = m.mapName; const size = document.createElement('span'); size.className = 'size'; size.textContent = `${m.cellsX}×${m.cellsY} cells`; li.append(name, size); if (m.needs.length) { const tag = document.createElement('span'); tag.className = 'old'; tag.textContent = m.madeWith === 'an early release' ? 'older release' : `made with ${m.madeWith}`; li.append(tag); } const install = document.createElement('span'); if (!m.installed) { install.className = 'size'; install.textContent = 'not installed'; } else { install.className = m.installed.upToDate ? 'size' : 'old'; install.textContent = m.installed.upToDate ? 'installed' : 'installed before last compile'; install.title = m.installed.modRoot; } li.append(install); const open = document.createElement('button'); open.type = 'button'; open.textContent = 'Open'; open.addEventListener('click', () => openMap(m.mapName)); li.append(open); if (m.installed) { const remove = document.createElement('button'); remove.type = 'button'; remove.textContent = 'Uninstall'; remove.addEventListener('click', () => uninstallMap(m.mapName)); const update = document.createElement('button'); update.type = 'button'; update.textContent = 'Update'; update.title = 'Install the latest compile over the installed copy'; if (!m.installed.upToDate) update.className = 'btn-primary'; update.addEventListener('click', () => updateMap(m.mapName, update)); li.append(update, remove); } const del = document.createElement('button'); del.type = 'button'; del.className = 'btn-danger'; del.textContent = 'Delete'; del.title = 'Delete this map and all its files'; del.addEventListener('click', () => deleteMap(m.mapName)); li.append(del); list.append(li); } }

nodes.name: watchInstall
nodes.body_text: function watchInstall(mapName, tick) { let over = false; const timer = setInterval(async () => { try { const p = await (await fetch(`/api/progress?map=${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`)).json(); // An answer still on its way when the install ended must not write // "copying" over what the end said. if (!over && p.stage === 'install' && p.total) tick(p.done || 0, p.total); } catch (_) { /* the install call is the source of truth */ } }, 700); return () => { over = true; clearInterval(timer); }; }

nodes.name: installSaid
nodes.body_text: function installSaid(done, total) { return `${done.toLocaleString()} of ${total.toLocaleString()} files ` + `(${Math.floor(100 * done / total)}%)`; }

nodes.name: updateMap
nodes.body_text:
async function updateMap(mapName, btn) { // The same install as the Install button, into the same mod folder under the // same name; the copy already there is replaced. btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Updating…'; // Under the map's own row, so it is clear which map is being copied. const shown = document.createElement('li'); shown.className = 'map-progress'; shown.innerHTML = '
' + ''; const bar = shown.querySelector('.bar'); const said = shown.querySelector('span'); said.textContent = 'Starting…'; btn.closest('li').after(shown); fx.toast('ok', 'Updating in the game', `Copying ${mapName} into your mods folder…`); const stop = watchInstall(mapName, (done, total) => { bar.classList.remove('is-indeterminate'); bar.firstChild.style.width = `${Math.floor(100 * done / total)}%`; said.textContent = `Copying ${installSaid(done, total)}`; }); try { const res = await fetch('/api/install', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ mapName }), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); fx.toast('ok', 'Updated in the game', `${mapName}: ${data.cells} cells`, 6000); loadMaps(); } catch (err) { fx.toast('bad', 'Could not update that map', err.message, 8000); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Update'; } finally { stop(); shown.remove(); } }

nodes.name: uninstallMap
nodes.body_text: async function uninstallMap(mapName) { // Only the copy in the game's mods folder goes; the map's own files stay, and // so do the player's saves. if (!window.confirm(`Remove ${mapName} from the game's mods folder? Its files in ` + 'KnoxMap stay, and your saves are not touched.')) return; try { const res = await fetch('/api/uninstall', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ mapName }), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); fx.toast('ok', 'Removed from the game', mapName, 6000); loadMaps(); } catch (err) { fx.toast('bad', 'Could not remove that map', err.message, 8000); } }

nodes.name: deleteMap
nodes.body_text: async function deleteMap(mapName) { if (!mapName) return; const prompt = `Delete ${mapName} and all its files? This cannot be undone.`; if (!window.confirm(prompt)) return; try { const res = await fetch(`/api/maps/${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`, { method: 'DELETE', }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); fx.toast('ok', 'Map deleted', mapName, 6000); if (typeof closeTab === 'function') { closeTab(mapName); } else { const results = document.getElementById('results'); if (results) results.hidden = true; } loadMaps(); if (typeof refreshMyMaps === 'function') refreshMyMaps(); } catch (err) { fx.toast('bad', 'Could not delete that map', err.message, 8000); } }

nodes.name: openMap
nodes.body_text: async function openMap(mapName) { let data; try { const res = await fetch(`/api/maps/${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`); data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); } catch (err) { fx.toast('bad', 'Could not open that map', err.message, 8000); return; } renderResults(data); showUpgrade(data); // The settings this map was made with, back in the panel, so one of them can // be changed and put into it without setting all the others again. if (data.settings && settingsMeta) buildSettingsForm(data.settings); // Whatever was drawn for this map, back on the map to be added to or changed. loadZones(data.mapName); fetch(`/api/sketch/${encodeURIComponent(data.mapName)}`) .then(r => r.json()) .then(loadSketchGeoJSON) .catch(() => { /* a map with nothing drawn simply has none */ }); rememberMap({ mapName: data.mapName, bbox: data.bbox, metersPerTile: data.metersPerTile, shape: data.shape, settings: data.settings }); }

nodes.name: showUpgrade
nodes.body_text: function showUpgrade(data) { const box = document.getElementById('upgradeNote'); if (!box) return; if (!data.needs || !data.needs.length) { box.hidden = true; box.innerHTML = ''; return; } const steps = data.needsLabels.join(' → '); box.hidden = false; box.innerHTML = ''; // A map this KnoxMap made itself is not "from an earlier release": it is // simply a step short, usually the install it has never had. box.querySelector('span').textContent = data.madeWith === data.current ? `This map still needs: ${steps}.` : `This map was made with ${data.madeWith === 'an early release' ? 'an earlier release' : 'KnoxMap ' + data.madeWith}. ` + `Do you want to upgrade it to ${data.current}? It needs: ${steps}.`; const go = document.createElement('button'); go.type = 'button'; go.textContent = 'Upgrade'; go.addEventListener('click', () => upgradeMap(data, go)); const later = document.createElement('button'); later.type = 'button'; later.className = 'later'; later.textContent = 'Not now'; later.addEventListener('click', () => { box.hidden = true; }); box.append(go, later); }

nodes.name: wirePictures
nodes.body_text: function wirePictures(mapName) { const button = document.getElementById('makePictures'); const note = document.getElementById('pictureNote'); const shots = document.getElementById('pictureShots'); if (!button) return; button.hidden = false; note.textContent = ''; shots.hidden = true; shots.innerHTML = ''; const show = files => { shots.innerHTML = ''; const names = { 'town.png': 'The whole map', 'close.png': 'Close up', 'inside.png': 'With the roofs off' }; for (const url of files) { const file = url.split('/').pop(); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = url; link.target = '_blank'; link.title = names[file] || file; const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = `${url}?t=${Date.now()}`; // a redraw replaces the same file img.alt = link.title; link.append(img); shots.append(link); } shots.hidden = files.length === 0; }; button.onclick = async () => { button.disabled = true; note.className = 'hint'; note.textContent = 'Drawing the map — this takes a minute…'; try { const res = await fetch('/api/pictures', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ mapName }), }); const started = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(started, res); for (;;) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const st = await (await fetch( `/api/pictures-status?map=${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`)).json(); if (st.state === 'running') continue; if (st.error) throw new Error(st.error); show(st.files || []); note.textContent = 'Click one to see it full size.'; break; } } catch (err) { note.className = 'hint error'; note.textContent = err.message || String(err); } finally { button.disabled = false; button.textContent = 'Draw it again'; } }; }

nodes.name: show
nodes.body_text: show = files => { shots.innerHTML = ''; const names = { 'town.png': 'The whole map', 'close.png': 'Close up', 'inside.png': 'With the roofs off' }; for (const url of files) { const file = url.split('/').pop(); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = url; link.target = '_blank'; link.title = names[file] || file; const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = `${url}?t=${Date.now()}`; // a redraw replaces the same file img.alt = link.title; link.append(img); shots.append(link); } shots.hidden = files.length === 0; }

nodes.name: upgradeMap
nodes.body_text: async function upgradeMap(data, button) { const box = document.getElementById('upgradeNote'); const say = text => { box.querySelector('span').textContent = text; }; for (const b of box.querySelectorAll('button')) b.disabled = true; fx.toast('ok', 'Upgrading', `${data.mapName}: ${data.needsLabels.join(' → ')}`); const post = async (url, body) => { const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), }); const out = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(out, res); return out; }; try { for (const step of data.needs) { if (step === 'generate') { say(`Drawing ${data.mapName} again…`); const b = data.bbox || {}; await post('/api/generate', { south: b.south, west: b.west, north: b.north, east: b.east, metersPerTile: data.metersPerTile, mapName: data.mapName, settings: data.settings, shape: data.shape, }); } else if (step === 'build') { say('Building the buildings again…'); let over = false; const watch = setInterval(async () => { try { const p = await (await fetch( `/api/progress?map=${encodeURIComponent(data.mapName)}`)).json(); if (!over && p.stage === 'buildings' && p.note) { const pct = p.fraction != null ? ` (${Math.round(100 * p.fraction)}%)` : ''; say(`${p.note}${pct}…`); } } catch (_) { /* the next tick will do */ } }, 1500); try { await post('/api/buildings', { mapName: data.mapName, settings: data.settings }); } finally { over = true; clearInterval(watch); } } else if (step === 'compile') { say('Compiling…'); await post('/api/compile', { mapName: data.mapName }); for (;;) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const st = await (await fetch( `/api/compile-status?map=${encodeURIComponent(data.mapName)}`)).json(); if (st.state === 'running' || st.state === 'stopping') { // The knoxlots compile names its step; the cells already in lots/ // are the old ones, and read as done on a map compiled before. say(st.phase ? `Compiling — ${st.phase} (${Math.round(100 * st.fraction)}%)…` : `Compiling… ${st.cells || 0} of ${st.expected || '?'} cells`); continue; } if (st.error) throw new Error(st.error); // Stopped is not finished: going on would install the old lots. if (st.state === 'stopped') throw new Error('the compile was stopped.'); break; } } else if (step === 'install') { say('Installing…'); const stopWatching = watchInstall(data.mapName, (done, total) => say(`Installing — ${installSaid(done, total)}…`)); try { await post('/api/install', { mapName: data.mapName, title: data.mapName, modId: data.mapName }); } finally { stopWatching(); } } } box.innerHTML = ''; box.querySelector('span').textContent = `${data.mapName} is up to date with KnoxMap ${data.current}.`; fx.toast('ok', 'Map upgraded', `${data.needsLabels.join(', ')} ran again.`); loadMaps(); } catch (err) { say(`Could not upgrade it: ${err.message}`); for (const b of box.querySelectorAll('button')) b.disabled = false; if (button) button.textContent = 'Try again'; } }

nodes.name: say

nodes.body_text: post = async (url, body) => { const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), }); const out = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(out, res); return out; }

nodes.name: showStop
nodes.body_text: function showStop(mapName) { stoppingMap = null; document.querySelectorAll('[data-stop]').forEach(b => { b.hidden = !mapName; b.disabled = false; b.textContent = 'Stop'; }); runningMap = mapName; }

nodes.name: requestStop
nodes.body_text: async function requestStop() { if (!runningMap || stoppingMap === runningMap) return; stoppingMap = runningMap; document.querySelectorAll('[data-stop]').forEach(b => { b.disabled = true; b.textContent = 'Stopping…'; }); try { await fetch('/api/stop', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ mapName: runningMap }), }); } catch (_) { /* the step's own reply is the source of truth */ } }

nodes.name: wasStopped
nodes.body_text: function wasStopped(data, res) { return res.status === 409 && data && data.stopped; }

nodes.name: startProgress
nodes.body_text: function startProgress(mapName) { clearInterval(progressTimer); progressTimer = setInterval(async () => { try { const res = await fetch(`/api/progress?map=${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`); const p = await res.json(); fx.overlay.update(p); const status = document.getElementById('status'); if (p.stage === 'osm') { const total = p.total || 1; // A retry waits a minute or two with nothing moving; say so, or it // reads as a hang and gets killed just before the pass that works. status.textContent = p.note ? p.note : (total > 1 ? `Querying OpenStreetMap — area ${(p.done || 0) + 1} of ${total}…` : 'Querying OpenStreetMap…'); } else if (p.stage === 'overture') { // A few minutes, nearly all of it Overture's own files being sifted // for the handful that cover this box. Saying so beats a dead bar. status.textContent = 'Looking up the buildings OpenStreetMap has not got ' + '— this takes a few minutes the first time…'; } else if (p.stage === 'roads') { status.textContent = `Routing the roads — ${(p.done || 0).toLocaleString()} of ` + `${(p.total || 0).toLocaleString()} stretches…` + (p.slowRoads ? ' Slowly: the fast road router (knoxroute) is ' + 'missing. Stop, and pick another Road layout, or update KnoxMap.' : ''); } else if (p.stage === 'render') { status.textContent = `Rendering ${p.features.toLocaleString()} features ` + 'into bitmaps…'; } } catch (_) { /* the generate call is the source of truth */ } }, 1500); }

nodes.name: stopProgress
nodes.body_text: function stopProgress() { clearInterval(progressTimer); progressTimer = null; }

nodes.name: saveFile
nodes.body_text: async function saveFile(name, label) { const note = document.getElementById('saveNote'); if (note) { note.className = 'hint'; note.textContent = `Saving ${label}…`; } try { const res = await fetch('/api/save', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ mapName: currentMap, name }), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); if (note) note.textContent = `Saved ${data.name} in ${data.folder} (shown in Explorer).`; } catch (err) { if (note) { note.className = 'hint bad'; note.textContent = err.message; } fx.toast('bad', 'Could not save that file', err.message, 8000); } }

nodes.name: wireDownload
nodes.body_text: function wireDownload(link, name, label) { if (!IN_WINDOW) return; link.removeAttribute('download'); link.href = '#'; link.addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); saveFile(name, label); }); }

nodes.name: getActiveMapName
nodes.body_text: function getActiveMapName() { const badge = document.querySelector('.map-badge'); const name = badge ? badge.textContent.trim() : ''; if (name && name !== '—') return name; return typeof currentMap !== 'undefined' && currentMap ? currentMap : ''; }

nodes.name: renderResults
nodes.body_text:
function renderResults(data) { const section = document.getElementById('results'); section.hidden = false; document.getElementById('previewImg').src = data.files.preview + '?t=' + Date.now(); document.getElementById('previewLink').href = data.files.preview; const info = document.getElementById('results-info'); info.innerHTML = `
${fx.tile(data.width, '', 'tiles wide')} ${fx.tile(data.height, '', 'tiles tall')}
0×0
cells
${fx.tile(data.featureCount, '', 'osm features')}
`; fx.countUp(info); // One click gets the lot; the individual files stay available but folded away. const all = document.getElementById('downloadAll'); all.href = data.files.zip; all.setAttribute('download', `${data.mapName}.zip`); all.textContent = IN_WINDOW ? 'Save everything as a .zip' : 'Download everything (.zip)'; wireDownload(all, 'zip', 'the zip'); const note = document.getElementById('saveNote'); if (note) { note.className = 'hint'; note.textContent = ''; } wirePictures(data.mapName); document.querySelectorAll('#results .ph').forEach(el => { el.textContent = data.mapName; }); const entries = [ ['Landscape BMP', data.files.landscape], ['Vegetation BMP', data.files.vegetation], ['Zombie spawn BMP', data.files.spawn], ['Preview PNG', data.files.preview], ['Building footprints (GeoJSON)', data.files.buildings], ['Meta (JSON)', data.files.meta], ['README', data.files.readme], ]; const ul = document.getElementById('downloads'); ul.innerHTML = entries.map(([label, href]) => `
  • → ${label}
    • ` ).join(''); ul.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link, i) => { const href = entries[i][1]; wireDownload(link, href.split('/').pop(), entries[i][0]); }); setupPipeline(data); section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }

nodes.name: setRectFromBounds
nodes.body_text: function setRectFromBounds(bounds) { setSelection(L.rectangle(bounds, SEL_STYLE)); }

nodes.name: setOutline
nodes.body_text: function setOutline(geojson) { const flip = rings => rings.map(ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon])); const latlngs = geojson.type === 'Polygon' ? flip(geojson.coordinates) : geojson.coordinates.map(flip); setSelection(L.polygon(latlngs, SEL_STYLE)); return currentRect.getBounds(); }

nodes.name: flip
nodes.body_text: flip = rings => rings.map(ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon]))

nodes.name: boundsAround
nodes.body_text: function boundsAround(lat, lon, km) { const dLat = km / 111.32 / 2; const dLon = km / (111.32 * Math.cos(lat * Math.PI / 180)) / 2; return L.latLngBounds([lat - dLat, lon - dLon], [lat + dLat, lon + dLon]); }

nodes.name: boundsForResult
nodes.body_text: function boundsForResult(r) { const [s, w, n, e] = r.bbox; const km2 = bboxAreaKm2(s, w, n, e); const widthKm = haversineKm(s, w, s, e); const heightKm = haversineKm(s, w, n, w); if (km2 <= BIG_AREA_KM2 && widthKm >= MIN_BOX_KM && heightKm >= MIN_BOX_KM) { return L.latLngBounds([s, w], [n, e]); } return boundsAround(r.lat, r.lon, DEFAULT_BOX_KM); }

nodes.name: hideSearchResults
nodes.body_text: function hideSearchResults() { searchResults.hidden = true; searchResults.innerHTML = ''; }

nodes.name: renderSearchResults
nodes.body_text:
function renderSearchResults(results) { if (!results.length) { searchResults.innerHTML = '
  • No matches.
    • '; searchResults.hidden = false; return; } searchResults.innerHTML = results.map((r, i) => { const kind = [r.type, r.category].filter(Boolean)[0] || ''; const rest = r.display_name.split(',').slice(1).join(',').trim(); return `
  • ${escapeHtml(r.name)} ${kind ? `${escapeHtml(kind.replace(/_/g, ' '))}` : ''} ${r.outline ? `` : ''} ${escapeHtml(rest)}
    • `; }).join(''); searchResults.hidden = false; searchResults.querySelectorAll('button[data-outline]').forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); const r = results[parseInt(btn.dataset.outline, 10)]; const bounds = setOutline(r.outline); map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30] }); hideSearchResults(); searchInput.value = r.name; }); }); searchResults.querySelectorAll('li[data-i]').forEach(li => { li.addEventListener('click', () => { const r = results[parseInt(li.dataset.i, 10)]; const bounds = boundsForResult(r); map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30] }); setRectFromBounds(bounds); if (searchMarker) map.removeLayer(searchMarker); searchMarker = L.marker([r.lat, r.lon]).addTo(map) .bindPopup(escapeHtml(r.name)).openPopup(); hideSearchResults(); searchInput.value = r.name; }); }); }

nodes.name: runSearch
nodes.body_text:
async function runSearch(q) { if (!q.trim()) return hideSearchResults(); searchResults.innerHTML = '
  • Searching…
    • '; searchResults.hidden = false; const params = new URLSearchParams({ q }); if (searchHere.checked) { const b = map.getBounds(); // Zoomed far enough out, the viewport spans more than a whole world and // wrapping it would describe a sliver instead. Search globally then. if (b.getEast() - b.getWest() < 360) { params.set('south', b.getSouth()); params.set('west', wrapLon(b.getWest())); params.set('north', b.getNorth()); params.set('east', wrapLon(b.getEast())); params.set('bounded', '1'); } } try { const res = await fetch('/api/search?' + params.toString()); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); renderSearchResults(data.results); } catch (err) { searchResults.innerHTML = `
  • ${escapeHtml(err.message)}
    • `; } }

nodes.name: renderLandmarks
