function renderLandmarks(items) { const out = document.getElementById('landmark-results'); landmarkMarkers.clearLayers(); if (!items.length) { out.innerHTML = '
Nothing named in this area.
'; return; } const groups = {}; items.forEach(it => { (groups[it.value] ||= []).push(it); }); const order = Object.keys(groups).sort((a, b) => groups[b].length - groups[a].length || a.localeCompare(b)); out.innerHTML = `
${items.length} named landmarks
` + order.map(k => `
${escapeHtml(k.replace(/_/g, ' '))} ${groups[k].length}
    ${groups[k].map(it => `
  • ${escapeHtml(it.name)}
    • ` ).join('')}
`).join(''); out.querySelectorAll('li[data-lat]').forEach(li => { li.addEventListener('click', () => { const lat = parseFloat(li.dataset.lat), lon = parseFloat(li.dataset.lon); map.setView([lat, lon], Math.max(map.getZoom(), 17)); landmarkMarkers.clearLayers(); L.circleMarker([lat, lon], { radius: 8, color: '#ffd23c', weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.4, }).addTo(landmarkMarkers).bindPopup(li.textContent).openPopup(); }); }); }

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.body_text: function escapeHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''', }[c])); }

nodes.name: searchableList
nodes.signature: function searchableList(inputId, boxId, item, group, least = 8)
nodes.body_text: function searchableList(inputId, boxId, item, group, least = 8) { const input = document.getElementById(inputId); if (!input || !document.getElementById(boxId)) return; LIST_SEARCHES[boxId] = { input, item, group, least, query: '' }; input.addEventListener('input', () => { LIST_SEARCHES[boxId].query = input.value; runListSearch(boxId); }); input.addEventListener('keydown', ev => { // Escape empties it, as it does in any search box. if (ev.key === 'Escape' && input.value) { ev.stopPropagation(); input.value = ''; LIST_SEARCHES[boxId].query = ''; runListSearch(boxId); } }); runListSearch(boxId); }

nodes.name: listHaystack
nodes.body_text: function listHaystack(el) { return (`${el.textContent} ${el.getAttribute('title') || ''} ` + `${el.dataset.find || ''}`).toLowerCase(); }

nodes.name: runListSearch
nodes.body_text: function runListSearch(boxId) { const found = LIST_SEARCHES[boxId]; const box = document.getElementById(boxId); if (!found || !box) return; const items = [...box.querySelectorAll(found.item)]; // A list short enough to read at a glance is one nobody needs to search. found.input.hidden = items.length < found.least; if (found.input.hidden && found.query) { found.input.value = ''; found.query = ''; } const words = found.query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); let shown = 0; for (const el of items) { const hay = listHaystack(el); const hit = words.every(word => hay.includes(word)); el.classList.toggle('out-of-search', !hit); shown += hit ? 1 : 0; } if (found.group) { // A heading with nothing left under it goes with its things. for (const head of box.querySelectorAll(found.group)) { head.classList.toggle('out-of-search', !head.querySelector(`${found.item}:not(.out-of-search)`)); } } found.input.classList.toggle('found-nothing', Boolean(words.length) && !shown); }

nodes.name: note
nodes.body_text: function note(id, text, cls) { const el = document.getElementById(id); el.textContent = text; el.className = 'step-note' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : ''); fx.noted(id, text, cls); if (cls === 'bad') { const what = { buildingsNote: 'Building failed', compileNote: 'Compile failed', worldedNote: 'WorldEd failed', installNote: 'Install failed', censusNote: 'Recount failed' }[id] || 'Something went wrong'; fx.problem(what, text, lastErrorId); lastErrorId = null; } }

nodes.name: setupPipeline
nodes.body_text: function setupPipeline(data) { currentMap = data.mapName; const upgrade = document.getElementById('upgradeNote'); if (upgrade) { upgrade.hidden = true; upgrade.innerHTML = ''; } document.getElementById('mapTitle').value = data.mapName; document.getElementById('modId').value = data.mapName; document.getElementById('buildingsBtn').disabled = false; document.getElementById('worldedBtn').disabled = true; document.getElementById('compileBtn').disabled = true; document.getElementById('installBtn').disabled = true; ['buildings', 'compile', 'install'].forEach(k => fx.card(k, null)); fx.card('buildings', 'ready'); fx.resetFrom('buildings'); document.getElementById('compileBar').style.width = '0%'; note('buildingsNote', 'Turns every OSM footprint into a furnished building.'); // Reset with the rest of them: opening another map used to leave whatever // the last compile said sitting under the new one's Compile button. note('compileNote', "Turns the map into the game's files. " + 'Takes a few minutes.'); note('worldedNote', 'Generate the buildings first.'); note('installNote', 'Copies the compiled map into ~/Zomboid/mods.'); renderCensus(null); document.getElementById('retryCellsBtn').hidden = true; // Where this one stands in the world, and whether it has been moved since // it was compiled. loadPlacement(data.mapName); checkLots(); // A map opened with its buildings already built can be compiled as it // stands; the button used to wake only after a build in this same window. if (data.buildingsReady) { const when = (data.builtAt || '').replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16); showBuilt(`Built${when ? ' ' + when : ''} → ${data.mapName}.pzw. Build again to lay them out afresh.`); } // Whatever the last compile of this map left behind, said again now: the // window has been closed and reopened since, and "done" would be a lie. // A compile still running is followed again rather than offered twice. fetch(`/api/compile-status?map=${encodeURIComponent(data.mapName)}`) .then(r => r.json()) .then(p => { if (p.state === 'running' || p.state === 'stopping') { document.getElementById('compileBtn').disabled = true; showStop(data.mapName); pollCompile(); return; } showFailedCells(p.failed, p.cells); }) .catch(() => { /* nothing to add if it cannot be asked */ }); }

nodes.name: showBuilt
nodes.body_text: function showBuilt(text) { note('buildingsNote', text, 'ok'); document.getElementById('worldedBtn').disabled = false; document.getElementById('compileBtn').disabled = false; note('compileNote', 'Ready — runs BMP to TMX and Generate Lots for you.'); note('worldedNote', 'Then File → BMP To TMX → All Cells… and ' + 'File → Generate Lots 8x8 → All Cells…'); }

nodes.name: startLotsPoll
nodes.body_text: function startLotsPoll() { clearInterval(lotsPoll); lotsPoll = setInterval(checkLots, 4000); }

nodes.name: checkLots
nodes.body_text: async function checkLots() { if (!currentMap) return; try { const res = await fetch(`/api/lots?map=${encodeURIComponent(currentMap)}`); const data = await res.json(); if (data.compiled) { clearInterval(lotsPoll); note('worldedNote', `${data.cells} cells compiled.`, 'ok'); document.getElementById('installBtn').disabled = false; sayIfInstallable(); } } catch (_) { /* keep polling quietly */ } }

nodes.name: refreshLayoutPreview
nodes.body_text: function refreshLayoutPreview() { const box = document.getElementById('layoutPreview'); if (!currentMap) { box.hidden = true; return; } const layer = document.getElementById('layoutLayer').value; const url = `/api/layout-preview?map=${encodeURIComponent(currentMap)}` + `&layer=${layer}&t=${Date.now()}`; const img = document.getElementById('layoutImg'); img.onerror = () => { box.hidden = true; }; img.onload = () => { box.hidden = false; }; img.src = url; document.getElementById('layoutLink').href = url; }

nodes.name: renderCensus
nodes.body_text: function renderCensus(pop) { const box = document.getElementById('census'); if (!pop) { box.hidden = true; document.getElementById('layoutPreview').hidden = true; return; } refreshLayoutPreview(); box.hidden = false; const tiles = document.getElementById('censusTiles'); tiles.innerHTML = ` ${fx.tile(pop.residents, '', 'residents')} ${fx.tile(pop.daytime_occupants, '', 'at work or school')} ${fx.tile(pop.on_the_street || 0, '', 'out on the street')} ${fx.tile(pop.zombie_estimate, '', 'zombies, roughly')} ${fx.tile(pop.share_with_zombies * 100, '%', 'of the map has zombies', 0)}`; fx.countUp(tiles); const official = document.getElementById('censusOfficial'); official.innerHTML = (pop.official || []).length ? 'OpenStreetMap lists ' + pop.official.map(p => `${escapeHtml(p.name || p.place)} at ${p.population.toLocaleString()} people` ).join(', ') + ' — official figures can cover a whole district, not just what is on the map.' : ''; }

nodes.name: startCompile
nodes.body_text: async function startCompile(onlyFailed) { const btn = document.getElementById('compileBtn'); const retry = document.getElementById('retryCellsBtn'); btn.disabled = true; retry.hidden = true; note('compileNote', 'Starting…'); showStop(currentMap); try { const res = await fetch('/api/compile', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ mapName: currentMap, onlyFailed: !!onlyFailed }), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); pollCompile(); } catch (err) { note('compileNote', err.message, 'bad'); showStop(null); btn.disabled = false; } }

nodes.name: showFailedCells
nodes.body_text: function showFailedCells(failed, cells) { const retry = document.getElementById('retryCellsBtn'); failed = failed || []; retry.hidden = !failed.length; if (!failed.length) return false; const where = failed.map(f => `${f.cells[0]},${f.cells[1]}`).join(' '); const many = failed.length === 1 ? 'batch' : 'batches'; note('compileNote', `${cells} cells compiled, but ${failed.length} ${many} would not compile ` + `after 3 tries (at ${where}). The map has a hole in it until those are done.`, 'warn'); note('installNote', 'You can install it, but those cells will be missing.'); return true; }

nodes.name: formatLeft
nodes.body_text: function formatLeft(seconds) { const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds / 60)); if (mins < 60) return `${mins} min`; return `${Math.floor(mins / 60)} h ${mins % 60} min`; }

nodes.name: pollCompile
nodes.body_text: function pollCompile() { clearInterval(compileTimer); compileTimer = setInterval(async () => { try { const res = await fetch( `/api/compile-status?map=${encodeURIComponent(currentMap)}`); const p = await res.json(); if (p.state === 'stopping') { note('compileNote', 'Stopping — waiting for WorldEd to close…'); return; } if (p.state === 'running' && p.phase) { // The Rust compile: no batches, so it says where it is. fx.progress('compile', Math.round(100 * p.fraction)); note('compileNote', `Compiling — ${p.phase} (${Math.round(100 * p.fraction)}%)…`); return; } if (p.state === 'running') { const pct = p.expected ? Math.floor(100 * p.cells / p.expected) : 0; // The batch counter is the honest one on a big map: cell files land in // bursts and stay flat for minutes inside a batch, which reads as a // hang. Batches tick over steadily. const batch = p.batches ? ` — batch ${p.batch}/${p.batches}` : ''; fx.progress('compile', p.batches ? Math.max(pct, 100 * (p.batch - 1) / p.batches) : pct); // Time left, once a few batches have set the pace; and the number // running at once when WorldEd made the compile ease off. const left = p.etaSeconds ? ` — about ${formatLeft(p.etaSeconds)} left` : ''; const eased = p.workers && p.workersStart && p.workers < p.workersStart ? ` — ${p.workers} at a time, down from ${p.workersStart} after WorldEd errors` : ''; // A map compiled before only redoes what has changed since. const inc = p.incremental && p.incremental.batches < p.incremental.of ? ` (only the ${p.incremental.changed} changed cell${p.incremental.changed === 1 ? '' : 's'}` + ` and what touches them: ${p.incremental.batches} of ${p.incremental.of} batches)` : ''; note('compileNote', `Compiling${batch}${inc}${left} — ${p.tmx} cells converted, ` + `${p.cells}/${p.expected || '?'} compiled (${pct}%)${eased}…`); return; } clearInterval(compileTimer); showStop(null); document.getElementById('compileBtn').disabled = false; if (p.state === 'stopped') { fx.progress('compile', 0); note('compileNote', 'Stopped. The cells already compiled are kept — ' + 'press Compile to carry on from there.'); fx.toast('ok', 'Stopped', 'Compiling picks up where it left off.'); return; } if (p.state === 'error') { lastErrorId = p.errorId || null; note('compileNote', p.error || 'Compile failed.', 'bad'); return; } if (p.state === 'done') { fx.progress('compile', 100); document.getElementById('installBtn').disabled = false; if (showFailedCells(p.failed, p.cells)) return; note('compileNote', `${p.cells} cells compiled.`, 'ok'); note('installNote', 'Ready to install.'); } } catch (_) { /* keep watching */ } }, 2000); }

nodes.name: disarmAreaToolbar
nodes.body_text: function disarmAreaToolbar() { try { drawControl._toolbars.draw.disable(); } catch { /* nothing armed */ } }

nodes.name: refreshSketchTools
nodes.body_text: refreshSketchTools = () => {}

nodes.name: sketchStyle
nodes.body_text: function sketchStyle(kind) { const cat = (sketchPalette.find(e => e.id === kind) || {}).category; const colour = SKETCH_COLOURS[cat] || '#3d8bfd'; return { color: colour, weight: 3, fillColor: colour, fillOpacity: 0.3 }; }

nodes.name: sketchLabel
nodes.body_text: function sketchLabel(kind) { return (sketchPalette.find(e => e.id === kind) || {}).label || kind; }

nodes.name: paletteMarkup
nodes.body_text:
function paletteMarkup() { const groups = []; for (const entry of sketchPalette) { const name = entry.group || 'Other'; const last = groups[groups.length - 1]; if (!last || last.name !== name) groups.push({ name, items: [entry] }); else last.items.push(entry); } return groups.map(g => `
${escapeHtml(g.name)} ${g.items.map(e => ``).join('')}
`).join(''); }

nodes.name: loadSketchPalette
nodes.body_text: async function loadSketchPalette() { let data; try { data = await (await fetch('/api/sketch')).json(); } catch { return; // the panel simply stays empty } sketchPalette = (data.palette || []).map( e => ({ ...e, category: (data.categories || {})[e.id] })); const box = document.getElementById('sketchPalette'); if (!box) return; box.innerHTML = paletteMarkup(); runListSearch('sketchPalette'); }

nodes.name: noteSketch
nodes.body_text: function noteSketch(text) { const box = document.getElementById('sketchNote'); if (box) box.textContent = text || ''; }

nodes.name: sketchCount
nodes.body_text: function sketchCount() { return sketchEd.count; }

nodes.name: showSketchCount
nodes.body_text: function showSketchCount() { const badge = document.getElementById('sketchCount'); const n = sketchCount(); if (badge) badge.textContent = n ? `(${n})` : ''; const only = document.getElementById('drawnOnly'); if (only && !n) only.checked = false; }

nodes.name: sketchGeoJSON
nodes.body_text: function sketchGeoJSON() { const features = []; sketchEd.each((layer, kind) => { features.push({ type: 'Feature', properties: { kind }, geometry: layer.toGeoJSON().geometry }); }); return { type: 'FeatureCollection', features }; }

nodes.name: loadSketchGeoJSON
nodes.body_text: function loadSketchGeoJSON(drawn) { const items = []; for (const f of (drawn && drawn.features) || []) { const kind = (f.properties || {}).kind; const geo = f.geometry || {}; if (!kind || !geo.type) continue; let layer = null; if (geo.type === 'LineString') { layer = L.polyline(geo.coordinates.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon])); } else if (geo.type === 'Polygon') { layer = L.polygon((geo.coordinates[0] || []).map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon])); } else if (geo.type === 'Point') { layer = L.marker([geo.coordinates[1], geo.coordinates[0]]); } if (layer) items.push({ kind, layer }); } sketchEd.replace(items); }

nodes.name: editCountNow
nodes.body_text: function editCountNow() { return mapEdits.removed.length + Object.keys(mapEdits.moved).length + Object.keys(mapEdits.tags).length; }

nodes.name: showEditCount
nodes.body_text: function showEditCount() { const badge = document.getElementById('editCount'); const n = editCountNow(); if (badge) badge.textContent = n ? `(${n})` : ''; document.getElementById('editSave').disabled = !n; document.getElementById('editReset').disabled = !n; }

nodes.name: noteEdit
nodes.body_text: function noteEdit(text) { const box = document.getElementById('editNote'); if (box) box.textContent = text || ''; }

nodes.name: editReady
nodes.body_text: function editReady(mapName) { document.getElementById('editLoad').disabled = !mapName; }

nodes.name: describeTags
nodes.body_text: function describeTags(tags) { for (const entry of sketchPalette) { if (Object.entries(entry.tags).every(([k, v]) => tags[k] === v)) return entry.label; } const first = Object.entries(tags || {})[0]; return first ? `${first[0]}=${first[1]}` : 'something'; }

nodes.name: pickEdit
nodes.body_text: function pickEdit(layer) { if (editSelected && editSelected.setStyle) editSelected.setStyle(EDIT_STYLE); editSelected = layer; const box = document.getElementById('editSelected'); if (!layer) { box.hidden = true; box.innerHTML = ''; return; } layer.setStyle(EDIT_PICKED); const tags = mapEdits.tags[layer.osmId] || layer.osmTags || {}; box.hidden = false; box.innerHTML = `${escapeHtml(describeTags(tags))} #${layer.osmId} `; document.getElementById('editDelete').addEventListener('click', () => { mapEdits.removed.push(layer.osmId); delete mapEdits.moved[layer.osmId]; delete mapEdits.tags[layer.osmId]; editLayer.removeLayer(layer); pickEdit(null); showEditCount(); noteEdit('Removed. It will be gone the next time the map is generated.'); }); document.getElementById('editRetag').addEventListener('change', ev => { const entry = sketchPalette.find(e => e.id === ev.target.value); if (!entry) return; mapEdits.tags[layer.osmId] = { ...entry.tags }; layer.osmTags = { ...entry.tags }; showEditCount(); pickEdit(layer); noteEdit(`Now a ${entry.label.toLowerCase()}.`); }); }

nodes.name: addEditable
nodes.body_text: function addEditable(feature) { const geo = feature.geometry || {}; const flip = ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon]); let layer = null; if (geo.type === 'Polygon') layer = L.polygon(flip(geo.coordinates[0] || []), EDIT_STYLE); else if (geo.type === 'LineString') layer = L.polyline(flip(geo.coordinates), EDIT_STYLE); if (!layer) return; layer.osmId = feature.id; layer.osmTags = (feature.properties || {}).tags || {}; // What it looked like when it arrived, so only a shape that really moved is // recorded as moved. layer.wasAt = JSON.stringify(layer.toGeoJSON().geometry.coordinates); layer.on('click', ev => { L.DomEvent.stop(ev); pickEdit(layer); }); editLayer.addLayer(layer); }

nodes.name: flip
nodes.body_text: flip = ring => ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon])

nodes.name: loadEditable
nodes.body_text: async function loadEditable() { if (!openedMap) return; const b = map.getBounds(); const q = new URLSearchParams({ south: b.getSouth(), west: b.getWest(), north: b.getNorth(), east: b.getEast(), }); noteEdit('Reading what this map was built from...'); let data; try { const res = await fetch(`/api/features/${encodeURIComponent(openedMap.mapName)}?${q}`); data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); } catch (err) { noteEdit(err.message); return; } editLayer.clearLayers(); pickEdit(null); mapEdits = { removed: [], moved: {}, tags: {}, ...(data.edits || {}) }; mapEdits.removed = mapEdits.removed || []; const gone = new Set(mapEdits.removed); for (const f of data.features || []) { if (!gone.has(f.id)) addEditable(f); } document.getElementById('editShape').disabled = !editLayer.getLayers().length; showEditCount(); // Say what is on the map, not what came down: the two differ by whatever // has already been taken out, and "5 features" over four shapes reads as a // bug in the counting. const hidden = (data.features || []).length - editLayer.getLayers().length; const capped = data.shown < data.total ? `${data.shown} of ${data.total} here - the biggest. Zoom in for the rest. ` : ''; const already = hidden ? ` ${hidden} already removed.` : ''; noteEdit(`${capped}${editLayer.getLayers().length} to edit.${already}` + ' Click one to remove it or say what it is.'); }

nodes.name: toggleShaping
nodes.body_text: function toggleShaping() { const btn = document.getElementById('editShape'); if (editShaper) { editShaper.save(); editShaper.disable(); editShaper = null; btn.textContent = 'Move and reshape'; // Only what really moved counts as moved. editLayer.eachLayer(layer => { const now = JSON.stringify(layer.toGeoJSON().geometry.coordinates); if (now !== layer.wasAt) { const geo = layer.toGeoJSON().geometry; const ring = geo.type === 'Polygon' ? geo.coordinates[0] : geo.coordinates; mapEdits.moved[layer.osmId] = ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon]); } }); showEditCount(); noteEdit('Shapes saved. Press Save changes to keep them.'); return; } pickEdit(null); editShaper = new L.EditToolbar.Edit(map, { featureGroup: editLayer }); editShaper.enable(); btn.textContent = 'Done moving'; noteEdit('Drag the corners. Press Done moving when finished.'); }

nodes.name: boardSize
nodes.body_text: function boardSize() { const w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('boardWidth').value) || 900; const h = parseFloat(document.getElementById('boardHeight').value) || 900; return { w: Math.min(Math.max(w, 100), 40000), h: Math.min(Math.max(h, 100), 40000) }; }

nodes.name: boardNote
nodes.body_text: function boardNote(text) { const box = document.getElementById('boardNote'); if (box) box.textContent = text || ''; }

nodes.name: boardCellMetres
nodes.body_text: function boardCellMetres() { return BOARD_CELL_TILES * readScale(); }

nodes.name: boardCells
nodes.body_text: function boardCells() { const { w, h } = boardSize(); const cell = boardCellMetres(); const across = w / cell; const down = h / cell; return { x: Math.ceil(across - 1e-6), y: Math.ceil(down - 1e-6), exact: Math.abs(across - Math.round(across)) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(down - Math.round(down)) < 1e-6 }; }

nodes.name: boardShowCount
nodes.body_text: function boardShowCount() { const n = boardEd ? boardEd.count : 0; const badge = document.getElementById('boardCount'); const { w, h } = boardSize(); const cells = boardCells(); const fit = document.getElementById('boardFitCells'); if (fit) fit.hidden = cells.exact; if (badge) { badge.textContent = `${w} × ${h} m · ${n} thing${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ` + (cells.exact ? `${cells.x} × ${cells.y} cells` : `built as ${cells.x} × ${cells.y} cells with empty ` + 'ground round it'); } }

nodes.name: boardDrawSheet
nodes.body_text: function boardDrawSheet() { const { w, h } = boardSize(); if (boardSheet) boardMap.removeLayer(boardSheet); if (boardGrid) boardMap.removeLayer(boardGrid); // Both go in the pane under the drawing rather than being shuffled there // afterwards: bringToBack() reaches for the renderer's container, which on // a map that has only just been given a size does not exist yet, and it // threw before a single line of the sheet was drawn. boardSheet = L.rectangle([[0, 0], [h, w]], { pane: 'tilePane', color: '#3d8bfd', weight: 2, fill: true, fillColor: '#0b0d0b', fillOpacity: 1, interactive: false }).addTo(boardMap); const lines = []; for (let x = BOARD_GRID_M; x < w; x += BOARD_GRID_M) lines.push([[0, x], [h, x]]); for (let y = BOARD_GRID_M; y < h; y += BOARD_GRID_M) lines.push([[y, 0], [y, w]]); boardGrid = L.polyline(lines, { pane: 'boardGridPane', color: '#2b3326', weight: 1, interactive: false }).addTo(boardMap); // The picture being traced covers the sheet, so it is stretched to it // whenever the sheet changes size. if (boardTrace) boardTrace.setBounds([[0, 0], [h, w]]); boardMap.setMaxBounds([[-h * 0.1, -w * 0.1], [h * 1.1, w * 1.1]]); boardShowCount(); }

nodes.name: boardFit
nodes.body_text: function boardFit() { const { w, h } = boardSize(); // Not on the next animation frame: those do not come at all while the // window is behind another one, and the board would open unfitted - a map // the browser still thinks is nothing wide fits at the closest zoom there // is, leaving the sheet thousands of pixels off every edge. A timeout runs // either way, and the resize below catches the case where the panel is laid // out later still. setTimeout(() => { boardMap.invalidateSize(); if (boardMap.getSize().x > 0) { boardMap.fitBounds([[0, 0], [h, w]], { padding: [24, 24] }); } }, 0); }

nodes.name: boardJoinSide
nodes.body_text: function boardJoinSide() { return document.getElementById('boardJoinSide').value || 'E'; }

nodes.name: boardNeighbourBounds
nodes.body_text: function boardNeighbourBounds(data) { const { w, h } = boardSize(); const side = boardJoinSide(); const nw = data.widthM || 0; const nh = data.heightM || 0; if (side === 'E') return [[h - nh, -nw], [h, 0]]; if (side === 'W') return [[h - nh, w], [h, w + nw]]; if (side === 'N') return [[-nh, 0], [0, nw]]; return [[h, 0], [h + nh, nw]]; // this sheet is south of it }

nodes.name: boardClearJoin
nodes.body_text: function boardClearJoin() { if (boardJoinLayers) boardMap.removeLayer(boardJoinLayers); boardJoinLayers = null; }

nodes.name: boardDrawJoin
nodes.body_text: function boardDrawJoin() { boardClearJoin(); if (!boardJoin) return; const group = L.layerGroup().addTo(boardMap); const bounds = boardNeighbourBounds(boardJoin); if (boardJoin.preview) { L.imageOverlay(boardJoin.preview, bounds, { pane: 'boardTracePane', opacity: 0.75, interactive: false }) .addTo(group); } L.rectangle(bounds, { color: '#6fa8dc', weight: 1, dashArray: '6,4', fill: !boardJoin.preview, fillColor: '#16202a', fillOpacity: 0.5, interactive: false }).addTo(group); for (const join of boardJoin.joins || []) { L.circleMarker([join.y, join.x], { radius: 5, color: '#ffd37a', weight: 2, fillColor: '#ffd37a', fillOpacity: 0.9, interactive: false, }).addTo(group).bindTooltip(`a street of ${escapeHtml(boardJoin.name)} ` + `arrives here, ${join.width} m wide`, { sticky: true }); } boardJoinLayers = group; }

nodes.name: boardLoadJoin
nodes.body_text: async function boardLoadJoin() { const name = document.getElementById('boardJoin').value; const note = document.getElementById('boardJoinNote'); document.getElementById('boardMatchEdge').disabled = !name; if (!name) { boardJoin = null; boardClearJoin(); note.textContent = 'A map of its own, with nothing beside it.'; return; } const { w, h } = boardSize(); try { const res = await fetch(`/api/board/join/${encodeURIComponent(name)}` + `?side=${boardJoinSide()}&w=${w}&h=${h}`); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(data, res); boardJoin = data; boardDrawJoin(); // A sheet that is not whole cells is built with empty ground round it and // the drawing centred in that, so every street it marks here ends up // short of the border - the one thing a joined sheet must not do. const padded = !boardCells().exact ? ' This sheet is not whole cells, so it is built with empty ground ' + 'round it and its streets stop short of the border: use Fit to ' + 'cells before building.' : ''; const n = (data.joins || []).length; // A map made before KnoxMap kept a picture of its roads cannot say where // its streets reach the border, which is not the same as having none // there - saying so sent people looking for a street that was drawn. note.textContent = (n ? `${n} street${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} of ${name} reach${n === 1 ? 'es' : ''} ` + 'this sheet. Draw a road to one and it joins up.' : data.roadsKnown === false ? `${name} was made before KnoxMap kept a picture of a map's roads, so ` + 'it cannot say where its streets reach this sheet. Generate that ' + 'map again to put them on the edge. The sheet still goes beside it.' : `${name} has no street on that side. The sheet still goes beside it.`) + padded; } catch (err) { boardJoin = null; boardClearJoin(); note.textContent = err.message; } }

nodes.name: boardJoinPoints
nodes.body_text: function boardJoinPoints() { return ((boardJoin && boardJoin.joins) || []).map(j => [j.y, j.x]); }

nodes.name: boardPaletteInto
nodes.body_text: function boardPaletteInto(box) { box.innerHTML = paletteMarkup(); runListSearch(box.id); }

nodes.name: boardDesign
nodes.body_text: function boardDesign() { const { w, h } = boardSize(); const features = []; boardEd.each((layer, kind) => { const geo = layer.toGeoJSON().geometry; let ring; if (geo.type === 'Polygon') ring = geo.coordinates[0]; else if (geo.type === 'LineString') ring = geo.coordinates; else if (geo.type === 'Point') ring = [geo.coordinates]; else return; // GeoJSON from a CRS.Simple map is [lng, lat] = [x, y] already. Kept on // the sheet: it can be drawn past the edge, and a road at x = 1342 on a // 900 m sheet is simply off the map, which is not what somebody dragging // a street to the edge of the page meant. const clamp = (v, hi) => Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), hi); features.push({ kind, points: ring.map(([x, y]) => [clamp(x, w), clamp(y, h)]) }); }); return { width_m: w, height_m: h, anchor: { lat: 0.0, lon: 0.0 }, features }; }

nodes.name: clamp
nodes.body_text: clamp = (v, hi) => Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), hi)

nodes.name: boardLoadDesign
nodes.body_text: function boardLoadDesign(design) { if (!design) { boardEd.replace([]); boardShowCount(); return; } document.getElementById('boardWidth').value = design.width_m || 900; document.getElementById('boardHeight').value = design.height_m || 900; boardDrawSheet(); const items = []; for (const f of design.features || []) { const entry = sketchPalette.find(e => e.id === f.kind); if (!entry) continue; const pts = (f.points || []).map(([x, y]) => [y, x]); // back to (lat, lng) let layer = null; if (entry.geometry === 'area' && pts.length >= 3) layer = L.polygon(pts); else if (entry.geometry === 'line' && pts.length >= 2) layer = L.polyline(pts); else if (entry.geometry === 'point' && pts.length) layer = L.marker(pts[0]); if (layer) items.push({ kind: f.kind, layer }); } boardEd.replace(items); boardFit(); boardShowCount(); }

nodes.name: boardOpen
nodes.body_text: function boardOpen(mapName) { const panel = document.getElementById('board'); panel.hidden = false; if (!boardMap) { boardMap = L.map('boardMap', { crs: L.CRS.Simple, minZoom: -6, maxZoom: 4, zoomControl: true, attributionControl: false }); // Three layers under the drawing: the sheet, then the picture being // traced, then the grid over both so its hundred-metre squares are still // readable against the picture. boardMap.createPane('boardTracePane').style.zIndex = 210; boardMap.createPane('boardGridPane').style.zIndex = 220; for (const name of ['boardTracePane', 'boardGridPane']) { boardMap.getPane(name).style.pointerEvents = 'none'; } // A Leaflet map needs somewhere to be looking before anything can be put // on it or measured against it; fitting the sheet refines this a moment // later, once the panel it lives in has a size. boardMap.setView([450, 450], 0); let refreshBoardTools = () => {}; boardEd = KnoxDraw.create(boardMap, { style: kind => sketchStyle(kind), label: kind => sketchLabel(kind), note: boardNote, pickedBox: document.getElementById('boardPicked'), palette: document.getElementById('boardPalette'), active: () => !document.getElementById('board').hidden, snapOn: () => document.getElementById('boardSnap').checked, snapDist: BOARD_SNAP_M, snapExtra: boardJoinPoints, onChange: () => { boardShowCount(); refreshBoardTools(); }, }); refreshBoardTools = KnoxDraw.toolbar(document.getElementById('boardTools'), boardEd); // The first size the map gets may arrive after it was opened, if the // window was behind another one at the time. boardMap.on('resize', () => { if (!boardFitted && boardMap.getSize().x > 0) { boardFitted = true; boardFit(); } }); boardPaletteInto(document.getElementById('boardPalette')); for (const id of ['boardWidth', 'boardHeight']) { document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', () => { boardDrawSheet(); boardFit(); boardLoadJoin(); // the sheet moved under its neighbour }); } // Which map this sheet is drawn against, and which way round. for (const id of ['boardJoin', 'boardJoinSide']) { document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', boardLoadJoin); } } boardMap.invalidateSize(); // it was created inside a hidden panel boardDrawSheet(); boardFitted = boardMap.getSize().x > 0; boardFit(); if (mapName) document.getElementById('boardName').value = mapName; boardFillJoins(mapName); boardNote('Pick a tool and draw. Nothing is downloaded: this is your own map.'); }

nodes.name: refreshBoardTools
nodes.body_text: refreshBoardTools = () => {}

nodes.name: boardFillJoins
nodes.body_text: async function boardFillJoins(mine) { const box = document.getElementById('boardJoin'); const was = box.value; try { const data = await (await fetch('/api/maps')).json(); const names = (data.maps || []).map(m => m.mapName || m.name) .filter(n => n && n !== mine); box.innerHTML = ['<option value="">nothing - a map of its own</option>'] .concat(names.map(n => `<option value="${escapeHtml(n)}">${escapeHtml(n)}</option>`)).join(''); if (names.includes(was)) box.value = was; } catch { /* no maps to join: the sheet is simply a map of its own */ } boardLoadJoin(); }

nodes.name: boardTraceShow
nodes.body_text: function boardTraceShow(on) { document.getElementById('boardTraceFade').hidden = !on; document.getElementById('boardTraceOff').hidden = !on; }

nodes.name: boardMapName
nodes.body_text: function boardMapName() { const typed = document.getElementById('boardName').value.trim(); const clean = typed.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, ''); return clean || `drawn_${Date.now()}`; }

nodes.name: zoneDress
nodes.body_text: function zoneDress(zone, hover) { if (!zone || !zone.layer) return; zone.layer.setStyle(hover ? ZONE_HOVER : zoneList[zonePicked] === zone ? ZONE_PICKED : ZONE_STYLE); }

nodes.name: zoneTip
nodes.body_text:
function zoneTip(zone, i) { return `${escapeHtml(zone.name || 'Zone ' + (i + 1))}` + `
${escapeHtml(zoneSummary(zone))}`; }

nodes.name: loadZoneMeta
nodes.body_text: async function loadZoneMeta() { if (zoneMeta) return zoneMeta; try { zoneMeta = await (await fetch('/api/zones')).json(); } catch { zoneMeta = { settings: [], styles: [] }; } try { zonePresets = (await (await fetch('/api/presets/buildings')).json()).presets || []; } catch { zonePresets = []; } return zoneMeta; }

nodes.name: zoneNote
nodes.body_text: function zoneNote(text) { const box = document.getElementById('zoneNote'); if (box) box.textContent = text || ''; }

nodes.name: zoneDirty
nodes.body_text: function zoneDirty(on) { document.getElementById('zoneSave').disabled = !on; // A name or a setting changed: that is an undoable step too, but only once // the typing stops rather than once a keystroke. if (on) { clearTimeout(zoneCommitTimer); zoneCommitTimer = setTimeout(() => zoneEd.commit(), 600); } }

nodes.name: showZoneCount
nodes.body_text: function showZoneCount() { const badge = document.getElementById('zoneCount'); if (badge) badge.textContent = zoneList.length ? `(${zoneList.length})` : ''; }

nodes.name: zoneSummary
nodes.body_text: function zoneSummary(zone) { const n = Object.keys(zone.settings || {}).length; const bits = []; if (zone.presets && zone.presets.length) { bits.push(`${zone.presets.length} hand-built`); } if (zone.wall_style) bits.push(zone.wall_style); bits.push(n ? `${n} setting${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'nothing set yet'); return bits.join(' · '); }

nodes.name: drawZoneList
nodes.body_text:
function drawZoneList() { const box = document.getElementById('zoneList'); box.innerHTML = zoneList.map((z, i) => `
  • ${escapeHtml(z.name || 'Zone ' + (i + 1))} ${escapeHtml(zoneSummary(z))}
    • `).join(''); runListSearch('zoneList'); // The list is redrawn for every change a zone has in it, so this is where // what the map says about it is kept up to date. zoneList.forEach((z, i) => { if (z.layer) z.layer.setTooltipContent(zoneTip(z, i)); }); showZoneCount(); }

nodes.name: zonePick
nodes.body_text: function zonePick(i) { zonePicked = i; for (const z of zoneList) if (z.layer) z.layer.setStyle(ZONE_STYLE); const zone = zoneList[i]; if (zone && zone.layer) zone.layer.setStyle(ZONE_PICKED); const layer = zone && zone.layer ? zone.layer : null; if (zoneEd.picked !== layer) zoneEd.pick(layer); drawZoneList(); drawZoneEditor(); }

nodes.name: zoneSwitchable
nodes.body_text: function zoneSwitchable(setting) { return setting.int && setting.min === 0 && setting.max === 1; }

nodes.name: drawZoneEditor
nodes.body_text:
function drawZoneEditor() { const box = document.getElementById('zoneEditor'); const zone = zoneList[zonePicked]; if (!zone || !zoneMeta) { box.hidden = true; box.innerHTML = ''; runListSearch('zoneEditor'); // and its search box goes with it return; } box.hidden = false; const styles = [''].concat( zoneMeta.styles.map(s => ``)); // Hand-built buildings this zone stamps instead of generated ones. A plot // nothing fits still gets a generated building, so ticking one is never a // way to end up with a hole in the town. const chosen = new Set(zone.presets || []); const presetBox = zonePresets.length ? `

Hand-built buildings to use here. A plot none of them fits gets a generated building as usual.

${zonePresets.map(p => ``).join('')}` : `

No hand-built buildings yet. Put a BuildingEd .tbx in presets/buildings beside KnoxMap and it can be used here.

`; box.innerHTML = ` ${presetBox}

Leave a box empty and the map's own setting is used there.

${zoneMeta.settings.map(s => ``).join('')}`; document.getElementById('zoneName').addEventListener('input', ev => { zone.name = ev.target.value; zoneDirty(true); drawZoneList(); }); document.getElementById('zoneStyle').addEventListener('change', ev => { zone.wall_style = ev.target.value || undefined; zoneDirty(true); drawZoneList(); }); for (const tick of box.querySelectorAll('[data-building-preset]')) { tick.addEventListener('change', ev => { const name = ev.target.dataset.buildingPreset; const have = new Set(zone.presets || []); if (ev.target.checked) have.add(name); else have.delete(name); zone.presets = [...have]; if (!zone.presets.length) delete zone.presets; zoneDirty(true); drawZoneList(); }); } runListSearch('zoneEditor'); for (const input of box.querySelectorAll('[data-zone-key]')) { input.addEventListener(input.tagName === 'SELECT' ? 'change' : 'input', ev => { const key = ev.target.dataset.zoneKey; if (ev.target.value.trim() === '') delete zone.settings[key]; else zone.settings[key] = parseFloat(ev.target.value); ev.target.classList.toggle('zone-set', zone.settings[key] !== undefined); zoneDirty(true); drawZoneList(); }); } }

nodes.name: refreshZoneTools
nodes.body_text: refreshZoneTools = () => {}

nodes.name: zonesSync
nodes.body_text: function zonesSync() { const was = zoneList[zonePicked]; zoneList = []; zoneEd.each(layer => { const zone = layer.kdMeta; Object.defineProperty(zone, 'layer', { value: layer, writable: true, configurable: true, enumerable: false }); // Off the enumerable data too: the editor snapshots it for undo, and the // outline is already there. Object.defineProperty(zone, 'ring', { value: layer.toGeoJSON().geometry.coordinates[0], writable: true, configurable: true, enumerable: false }); zoneList.push(zone); }); zonePicked = zoneList.indexOf(was); drawZoneList(); drawZoneEditor(); }

nodes.name: loadZones
nodes.body_text: async function loadZones(mapName) { await loadZoneMeta(); const items = []; if (mapName) { try { const data = await (await fetch(`/api/zones/${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`)).json(); for (const z of data.zones || []) { items.push({ kind: 'zone', layer: L.polygon(z.ring.map(([lon, lat]) => [lat, lon])), meta: { name: z.name, settings: z.settings || {}, wall_style: z.wall_style, presets: z.presets }, }); } } catch { /* a map with no zones simply has none */ } } zoneLoading = true; zoneEd.replace(items); zoneLoading = false; zoneDirty(false); }

nodes.name: bdNote
nodes.body_text: function bdNote(text) { const box = document.getElementById('bdNote'); if (box) box.textContent = text || ''; }

nodes.name: bdApiError
nodes.body_text: function bdApiError(data, res) { return apiError(data, res); }

nodes.name: bdLoad
nodes.body_text: async function bdLoad(kind) { const key = kind || ''; if (!bdMetaFor[key]) { const res = await fetch(`/api/builder?kind=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`); bdMetaFor[key] = await res.json(); } bdMeta = bdMetaFor[key]; return bdMeta; }

nodes.name: bdPresetKind
nodes.body_text: function bdPresetKind(entry) { const kinds = (bdMeta && bdMeta.kinds) || []; const found = kinds.find(k => k.id === entry.kind); return found ? found.label : 'Any building'; }

nodes.name: drawBuiltList
nodes.body_text:
function drawBuiltList() { const box = document.getElementById('builtList'); if (!box || !bdMeta) return; const presets = bdMeta.presets || []; box.innerHTML = presets.map(p => `
  • ${escapeHtml(p.name)} ${p.width}×${p.height}, ${p.storeys} storey${p.storeys === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${escapeHtml(bdPresetKind(p))}${p.shared ? ` · shipped with KnoxMap${p.author ? `, by ${escapeHtml(p.author)}` : ''}` : ''} ${p.editable ? `` : ''} ${p.shared ? '' : ``}
    • `).join(''); runListSearch('builtList'); const badge = document.getElementById('builtCount'); if (badge) badge.textContent = presets.length ? `(${presets.length})` : ''; }

nodes.name: drawBuiltKinds
nodes.body_text: function drawBuiltKinds() { const box = document.getElementById('builtKinds'); if (!box || !bdMeta) return; const on = new Set(bdMeta.use || []); const have = {}; for (const p of bdMeta.presets || []) { have[p.kind || ''] = (have[p.kind || ''] || 0) + 1; } box.innerHTML = (bdMeta.kinds || []).map(k => `<button type="button" class="sketch-pick ${on.has(k.id) ? 'on' : ''}" data-use-kind="${k.id}" title="${have[k.id] ? have[k.id] + ' hand-built' : 'nothing hand-built for this yet'}"> ${escapeHtml(k.label)}${have[k.id] ? ` (${have[k.id]})` : ''}</button>`).join(''); }

nodes.name: refreshBuilt
nodes.body_text: async function refreshBuilt() { try { bdMetaFor[''] = await (await fetch('/api/builder?kind=')).json(); bdMeta = bdMetaFor['']; } catch { return; // the panel simply stays as it was } drawBuiltKinds(); drawBuiltList(); }

nodes.name: builtNote
nodes.body_text: function builtNote(text, kind) { const el = document.getElementById('builtNote'); el.textContent = text; el.className = kind === 'bad' ? 'hint bad' : 'hint'; }

nodes.name: bdShare
nodes.body_text: async function bdShare(name) { try { const res = await fetch(`/api/presets/buildings/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/share`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({}) }); if (!res.ok) throw bdApiError(await res.json(), res); if (IN_WINDOW) { const data = await res.json(); builtNote(`Wrote ${data.name} to ${data.folder}. Send that file to anyone ` + 'with KnoxMap, or to the KnoxMap Discord to have it shipped.'); } else { const blob = await res.blob(); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = url; link.download = `${name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '_') || 'building'}.knoxbuilding.json`; document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000); builtNote(`Shared "${name}".`); } } catch (err) { builtNote(err.message, 'bad'); } }

nodes.name: bdRoomAt
nodes.body_text: function bdRoomAt(x, y) { const rooms = (bdDesign && bdDesign.rooms) || []; for (let i = rooms.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) { const r = rooms[i]; if (r.level === bdLevel && x >= r.x && x < r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y < r.y + r.h) return { i, r }; } return null; }

nodes.name: bdGrip
nodes.body_text: function bdGrip(r, x, y) { const near = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, Math.floor(Math.min(r.w, r.h) / 4))); let edge = ''; if (y - r.y < near) edge += 'n'; else if (r.y + r.h - 1 - y < near) edge += 's'; if (x - r.x < near) edge += 'w'; else if (r.x + r.w - 1 - x < near) edge += 'e'; return edge; }

nodes.name: bdResized
nodes.body_text: function bdResized(r, edge, dx, dy) { let { x, y, w, h } = r; if (!edge) { x += dx; y += dy; } if (edge.includes('w')) { const by = Math.min(dx, w - 1); x += by; w -= by; } if (edge.includes('e')) { w = Math.max(1, w + dx); } if (edge.includes('n')) { const by = Math.min(dy, h - 1); y += by; h -= by; } if (edge.includes('s')) { h = Math.max(1, h + dy); } x = Math.min(Math.max(x, 0), bdDesign.width - 1); y = Math.min(Math.max(y, 0), bdDesign.height - 1); return { x, y, w: Math.min(w, bdDesign.width - x), h: Math.min(h, bdDesign.height - y) }; }

nodes.name: bdApplyEdit
nodes.body_text: function bdApplyEdit(idx, rect) { if (!bdDesign || bdBusy) return; bdRemember(); const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); const room = next.rooms[idx]; if (!room) return; next.rooms.splice(idx, 1); next.rooms.push({ level: room.level, x: rect.x, y: rect.y, w: rect.w, h: rect.h, kind: room.kind }); bdSel = { level: room.level, x: rect.x, y: rect.y, w: rect.w, h: rect.h }; bdRefresh(next); }

nodes.name: bdSelIndex
nodes.body_text: function bdSelIndex() { if (!bdSel || !bdDesign) return -1; const rooms = bdDesign.rooms || []; for (let i = rooms.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) { const r = rooms[i]; if (r.level === bdSel.level && r.x === bdSel.x && r.y === bdSel.y && r.w === bdSel.w && r.h === bdSel.h) return i; } return -1; }

nodes.name: bdRoomLabel
nodes.body_text: function bdRoomLabel(id) { const found = ((bdMeta && bdMeta.rooms) || []).find(r => r.id === id); return found ? found.label : (id || 'Cut away'); }

nodes.name: bdPlaceBox
nodes.signature: function bdPlaceBox(el, x0, y0, w, h)
nodes.body_text: function bdPlaceBox(el, x0, y0, w, h) { const plan = document.getElementById('bdPlan'); const img = document.getElementById('bdImage'); const box = img.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!bdDesign || !box.width) { el.hidden = true; return; } const plot = plan.getBoundingClientRect(); const tw = box.width / bdDesign.width; const th = box.height / bdDesign.height; el.hidden = false; el.style.left = `${box.left - plot.left + x0 * tw}px`; el.style.top = `${box.top - plot.top + y0 * th}px`; el.style.width = `${w * tw}px`; el.style.height = `${h * th}px`; }

nodes.name: bdShowSel
nodes.body_text: function bdShowSel() { const el = document.getElementById('bdSelBox'); const i = bdSelIndex(); if (i < 0 || bdSel.level !== bdLevel) { if (i < 0) bdSel = null; el.hidden = true; return; } bdPlaceBox(el, bdSel.x, bdSel.y, bdSel.w, bdSel.h); }

nodes.name: bdSelect
nodes.body_text: function bdSelect(room) { bdSel = room ? { level: room.level, x: room.x, y: room.y, w: room.w, h: room.h } : null; bdShowSel(); if (room) { bdNote(`${bdRoomLabel(room.kind)}, ${room.w}×${room.h} tiles. Arrow keys move it ` + '(Shift for five tiles), Delete removes it, Ctrl+D copies it, Escape lets go.'); } }

nodes.name: bdDeleteSel
nodes.body_text: function bdDeleteSel() { const i = bdSelIndex(); if (i < 0 || bdBusy) return; bdRemember(); const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); next.rooms.splice(i, 1); bdSel = null; bdRefresh(next); }

nodes.name: bdDuplicateSel
nodes.body_text: function bdDuplicateSel() { const i = bdSelIndex(); if (i < 0 || bdBusy) return; bdRemember(); const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); const r = next.rooms[i]; const at = bdResized(r, '', 2, 2); next.rooms.push({ level: r.level, x: at.x, y: at.y, w: at.w, h: at.h, kind: r.kind }); bdSel = { level: r.level, ...at }; bdRefresh(next); }

nodes.name: bdNudgeSel
nodes.body_text: function bdNudgeSel(dx, dy) { const i = bdSelIndex(); if (i < 0 || bdBusy) return; const r = bdDesign.rooms[i]; const to = bdResized(r, '', dx, dy); if (to.x === r.x && to.y === r.y) return; bdApplyEdit(i, to); }

nodes.name: bdCopyFloorUp
nodes.body_text: function bdCopyFloorUp() { if (!bdDesign || bdBusy) return; const to = bdLevel + 1; if (to >= 8) { bdNote('That is the top: a building has up to eight storeys.'); return; } bdRemember(); const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); if (to >= next.storeys) next.storeys = to + 1; const copy = next.rooms.filter(r => r.level === bdLevel) .map(r => ({ ...r, level: to })); next.rooms = next.rooms.filter(r => r.level !== to).concat(copy); bdSel = null; bdRefresh(next, to); bdNote(`This floor copied up to ${to === 0 ? 'the ground floor' : 'floor ' + to}.`); }

nodes.name: bdRoomsMarkup
nodes.body_text:
function bdRoomsMarkup() { const groups = []; for (const entry of (bdMeta && bdMeta.rooms) || []) { const last = groups[groups.length - 1]; if (!last || last.name !== entry.group) { groups.push({ name: entry.group, items: [entry] }); } else { last.items.push(entry); } } const adjust = `
Change what is drawn
`; const eraser = `
The eraser
`; return adjust + eraser + groups.map(g => `
${escapeHtml(g.name)} ${g.items.map(e => ``).join('')}
`).join(''); }

nodes.name: drawBdRooms
nodes.body_text: function drawBdRooms() { const box = document.getElementById('bdRooms'); if (!box) return; box.innerHTML = bdRoomsMarkup(); runListSearch('bdRooms'); }

nodes.name: drawBdStoreys
nodes.body_text: function drawBdStoreys() { const box = document.getElementById('bdStoreyTabs'); if (!box || !bdDesign) return; const names = []; for (let i = 0; i < bdDesign.storeys; i += 1) { names.push(`<button type="button" class="sketch-pick ${i === bdLevel ? 'on' : ''}" data-storey="${i}">${i === 0 ? 'Ground floor' : 'Floor ' + i}</button>`); } box.innerHTML = names.join(''); }

nodes.name: bdFields
nodes.body_text: function bdFields() { if (!bdDesign) return; document.getElementById('bdName').value = bdDesign.name || ''; document.getElementById('bdWidth').value = bdDesign.width; document.getElementById('bdHeight').value = bdDesign.height; document.getElementById('bdStoreys').value = bdDesign.storeys; const kinds = (bdMeta && bdMeta.kinds) || []; document.getElementById('bdKind').innerHTML = ['<option value="">Any building</option>'].concat(kinds.map(k => `<option value="${k.id}"${k.id === bdDesign.kind ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(k.label)}</option>`)).join(''); const styles = (bdMeta && bdMeta.styles) || []; document.getElementById('bdStyle').innerHTML = ['<option value="">Whatever suits it</option>'].concat(styles.map(s => `<option value="${s}"${s === bdDesign.style ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(s)}</option>`)).join(''); }

nodes.name: bdTileAt
nodes.body_text: function bdTileAt(ev) { const img = document.getElementById('bdImage'); const box = img.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!box.width || !box.height || !bdDesign) return null; const x = Math.floor((ev.clientX - box.left) / box.width * bdDesign.width); const y = Math.floor((ev.clientY - box.top) / box.height * bdDesign.height); return { x: Math.min(Math.max(x, 0), bdDesign.width - 1), y: Math.min(Math.max(y, 0), bdDesign.height - 1) }; }

nodes.name: bdShow
nodes.body_text:
function bdShow(data) { bdDesign = data.design; bdLevel = data.level; const img = document.getElementById('bdImage'); img.hidden = !data.image; if (data.image) img.src = data.image; document.getElementById('bdEmpty').hidden = data.painted > 0; document.getElementById('bdUndo').disabled = !bdHistory.length; document.getElementById('bdRedo').disabled = !bdFuture.length; drawBdStoreys(); bdShowSel(); bdFields(); const tally = document.getElementById('bdTally'); tally.innerHTML = (data.tally || []).map(t => `
  • ${escapeHtml(t.label)}${t.tiles} tiles
    • `).join('') || '
  • Nothing drawn on this floor yet.
    • '; const tiles = document.getElementById('bdTiles'); tiles.innerHTML = (data.tiles || []).map(t => `
  • ${escapeHtml(t.what)} ${t.tiles && t.tiles.length ? `
    ${escapeHtml(t.tiles.join(', '))}` : ''} ${t.fittings && t.fittings.length ? `
    ${escapeHtml(t.fittings.join(', '))}` : ''}
    • `).join(''); const b = data.built || {}; bdNote(`${b.rooms || 0} rooms, ${b.doors || 0} doorways, ${b.windows || 0} windows, ` + `${b.furniture || 0} things in them - as it will be built.` + (data.oneStoreyAtATime ? ' A building this big is drawn a floor at a time; the rest are built when it is saved.' : '')); }

nodes.name: bdRefresh
nodes.body_text: async function bdRefresh(design, level) { if (bdBusy) return; bdBusy = true; document.getElementById('bdPlan').style.opacity = '0.6'; try { const res = await fetch('/api/builder/preview', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ design: design || bdDesign, level: level === undefined ? bdLevel : level }) }); const out = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw bdApiError(out, res); bdShow(out); } catch (err) { bdNote(err.message); } finally { bdBusy = false; document.getElementById('bdPlan').style.opacity = ''; } }

nodes.name: bdRemember
nodes.body_text: function bdRemember() { bdHistory.push(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); if (bdHistory.length > 40) bdHistory.shift(); bdFuture = []; // a new change ends the road forward }

nodes.name: bdUndo
nodes.body_text: function bdUndo() { const was = bdHistory.pop(); if (!was || bdBusy) { if (was) bdHistory.push(was); return; } bdFuture.push(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); bdRefresh(JSON.parse(was)); }

nodes.name: bdRedo
nodes.body_text: function bdRedo() { const next = bdFuture.pop(); if (!next || bdBusy) { if (next) bdFuture.push(next); return; } bdHistory.push(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); bdRefresh(JSON.parse(next)); }

nodes.name: bdDraw
nodes.body_text: function bdDraw(x0, y0, x1, y1) { if (!bdDesign) return; bdRemember(); const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bdDesign)); next.rooms.push({ level: bdLevel, x: Math.min(x0, x1), y: Math.min(y0, y1), w: Math.abs(x1 - x0) + 1, h: Math.abs(y1 - y0) + 1, kind: bdRoom }); bdRefresh(next); }

nodes.name: builderOpen
nodes.body_text: function builderOpen() { document.getElementById('builder').hidden = false; }

nodes.name: bdStart
nodes.body_text: async function bdStart() { await bdLoad(''); if (!bdDesign) { bdDesign = { name: '', kind: '', style: '', width: 20, height: 16, storeys: 1, rooms: [] }; bdHistory = []; bdFuture = []; } bdSel = null; drawBdRooms(); await bdRefresh(bdDesign, 0); bdNote('Pick a room, then drag a rectangle on the plan. Adjust rooms moves the walls of one already drawn.'); }

nodes.name: bdOpenSaved
nodes.body_text: async function bdOpenSaved(name) { try { const res = await fetch(`/api/builder/design/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`); const out = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw bdApiError(out, res); bdHistory = []; bdFuture = []; bdSel = null; bdShow(out); await bdLoad(out.design.kind || ''); drawBdRooms(); bdFields(); bdNote(`"${name}" as it was drawn. Change it and save it again.`); } catch (err) { bdNote(err.message); } }

nodes.name: placeBox
nodes.body_text: function placeBox(x0, y0, w, h) { bdPlaceBox(ghost, x0, y0, w, h); // How big it is, as it is dragged: tiles are what the sheet is measured in. ghost.dataset.size = `${w} × ${h}`; }

nodes.name: place
nodes.body_text: function place(a, b) { placeBox(Math.min(a.x, b.x), Math.min(a.y, b.y), Math.abs(b.x - a.x) + 1, Math.abs(b.y - a.y) + 1); }

nodes.name: dragged
nodes.body_text: function dragged(now) { return bdResized(grab.r, grab.edge, now.x - grab.at.x, now.y - grab.at.y); }

nodes.name: placeNote
nodes.body_text: function placeNote(text, bad) { const box = document.getElementById('placeNote'); if (!box) return; box.textContent = text || ''; box.classList.toggle('bad', !!bad); }

nodes.name: placeTiles
nodes.body_text: function placeTiles() { return (placeWorld && placeWorld.cellTiles) || 300; }

nodes.name: placeMine
nodes.body_text: function placeMine() { if (!placeWorld) return null; const at = placePicked || placeWorld.map; const k = placeTiles(); return { x: at.x * k, y: at.y * k, w: placeWorld.map.w * k, h: placeWorld.map.h * k }; }

nodes.name: placeWorldMaps
nodes.body_text: function placeWorldMaps() { if (!placeWorld || placeWorld.standalone) return []; return placeWorld.maps || []; }

nodes.name: placeOtherRects
nodes.body_text: function placeOtherRects() { if (!placeWorld) return []; const k = placeWorld.compiledCell || 256; const out = []; for (const map of placeWorldMaps()) { for (const [row, first, last] of map.runs) { out.push({ x: first * k, y: row * k, w: (last - first + 1) * k, h: k, kind: map.kind, name: map.name }); } } return out; }

nodes.name: placeSpan
nodes.body_text: function placeSpan() { // Enough of the world to show everything on it, with room to move into. const k = placeTiles(); const boxes = placeOtherRects().concat(placeMine() || []); const right = Math.max(PLACE_MIN_SPAN * k, ...boxes.map(b => b.x + b.w)); const down = Math.max(PLACE_MIN_SPAN * 0.62 * k, ...boxes.map(b => b.y + b.h)); return { w: right + PLACE_PAD * k, h: down + PLACE_PAD * k }; }

nodes.name: placeFitScale
nodes.body_text: function placeFitScale() { const canvas = document.getElementById('placeCanvas'); const span = placeSpan(); return Math.min(canvas.width / span.w, canvas.height / span.h); }

nodes.name: placeScale
nodes.body_text: function placeScale() { return placeFitScale() * placeView.zoom; }

nodes.name: placeClampView
nodes.body_text: function placeClampView() { const canvas = document.getElementById('placeCanvas'); const span = placeSpan(); const k = placeScale(); placeView.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(placeView.x, span.w - canvas.width / k)); placeView.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(placeView.y, span.h - canvas.height / k)); if (placeView.zoom <= 1) { placeView.x = 0; placeView.y = 0; } }

nodes.name: placeZoomBy
nodes.body_text: function placeZoomBy(factor, px, py) { const canvas = document.getElementById('placeCanvas'); if (px === undefined) { px = canvas.width / 2; py = canvas.height / 2; } const before = placeScale(); const tx = px / before + placeView.x; const ty = py / before + placeView.y; placeView.zoom = Math.max(1, Math.min(PLACE_MAX_ZOOM, placeView.zoom * factor)); const after = placeScale(); placeView.x = tx - px / after; placeView.y = ty - py / after; placeClampView(); drawWorld(); }

nodes.name: hits
nodes.body_text: function hits(a, b) { return a.x < b.x + b.w && b.x < a.x + a.w && a.y < b.y + b.h && b.y < a.y + a.h; }

nodes.name: placeClashes
nodes.body_text: function placeClashes(corner) { if (!placeWorld || placeWorld.standalone) return []; const k = placeTiles(); const mine = { x: corner.x * k, y: corner.y * k, w: placeWorld.map.w * k, h: placeWorld.map.h * k }; const names = new Set(); for (const rect of placeOtherRects()) { // Knox County under the map is not a clash: it is what the map replaces. if (rect.kind === 'vanilla') continue; if (hits(mine, rect)) names.add(rect.name); } return [...names]; }

nodes.name: placeReplaces
nodes.body_text: function placeReplaces(corner) { if (!placeWorld || placeWorld.standalone) return []; const k = placeTiles(); const mine = { x: corner.x * k, y: corner.y * k, w: placeWorld.map.w * k, h: placeWorld.map.h * k }; return placeOtherRects().some(r => r.kind === 'vanilla' && hits(mine, r)) ? [placeWorld.vanilla.name] : []; }

nodes.name: drawWorld
nodes.body_text: function drawWorld() { const canvas = document.getElementById('placeCanvas'); if (!canvas || !placeWorld) return; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const k = placeScale(); const cell = placeTiles(); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); ctx.fillStyle = '#0d100c'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); placeClampView(); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-placeView.x * k, -placeView.y * k); // The grid, every ten cells, so distances are readable. const span = placeSpan(); ctx.strokeStyle = '#1b211a'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = 0; x <= span.w; x += cell * 10) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x * k, 0); ctx.lineTo(x * k, span.h * k); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = 0; y <= span.h; y += cell * 10) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y * k); ctx.lineTo(span.w * k, y * k); ctx.stroke(); } // Every map on this PC: the game's own picture of it where there is one - // Knox County as it really looks, down to the fields and the river - and // the shape of its cells where there is not. const mineNow = placeMine(); const drawn = new Set(); for (const map of placeWorldMaps()) { const shot = placePictures[map.name]; if (map.pictureBox && shot && shot.complete && shot.naturalWidth) { const b = map.pictureBox; ctx.drawImage(shot, b.x * k, b.y * k, b.w * k, b.h * k); drawn.add(map.name); } } for (const rect of placeOtherRects()) { if (drawn.has(rect.name)) continue; ctx.fillStyle = rect.kind === 'vanilla' ? 'rgba(150,160,135,0.42)' : 'rgba(120,140,170,0.42)'; ctx.fillRect(rect.x * k, rect.y * k, Math.max(1, rect.w * k), Math.max(1, rect.h * k)); } // ...labelled once each, under what they cover. ctx.font = '13px system-ui, sans-serif'; for (const map of placeWorldMaps()) { const c = placeWorld.compiledCell || 256; ctx.fillStyle = map.kind === 'vanilla' ? '#d6dcc8' : '#92a8c4'; ctx.fillText(map.name, map.x * c * k + 3, (map.y * c + map.h * c) * k + 14); } if (mineNow) { const clash = placeClashes(placePicked || placeWorld.map); const edge = clash.length ? '#dc5046' : '#3d8bfd'; if (placePreview && placePreview.complete && placePreview.naturalWidth) { ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95; ctx.drawImage(placePreview, mineNow.x * k, mineNow.y * k, mineNow.w * k, mineNow.h * k); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; } else { ctx.fillStyle = clash.length ? 'rgba(220,80,70,0.35)' : 'rgba(61,139,253,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(mineNow.x * k, mineNow.y * k, mineNow.w * k, mineNow.h * k); } ctx.strokeStyle = edge; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeRect(mineNow.x * k, mineNow.y * k, mineNow.w * k, mineNow.h * k); ctx.fillStyle = edge; ctx.fillText('this map', mineNow.x * k + 3, (mineNow.y + mineNow.h) * k + 14); } // The road being drawn across the gap. if (placeRoad.length) { ctx.strokeStyle = '#f0b429'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); placeRoad.forEach(([x, y], i) => { if (i) ctx.lineTo(x * k, y * k); else ctx.moveTo(x * k, y * k); }); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = '#f0b429'; for (const [x, y] of placeRoad) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x * k, y * k, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); } } ctx.restore(); }

nodes.name: placeSummary
nodes.body_text: function placeSummary() { const badge = document.getElementById('placeWhere'); if (!badge || !placeWorld) return; const mine = placePicked || placeWorld.map; badge.textContent = `(cell ${mine.x},${mine.y})`; }

nodes.name: placeFields
nodes.body_text: function placeFields() { const mine = placePicked || (placeWorld && placeWorld.map); if (!mine) return; const box = document.getElementById('placeStandalone'); if (box && placeWorld) box.checked = !!placeWorld.standalone; document.getElementById('placeX').value = mine.x; document.getElementById('placeY').value = mine.y; placeSummary(); }

nodes.name: placeState
nodes.body_text: function placeState() { if (!placeWorld) return; const mine = placePicked || placeWorld.map; const clash = placeClashes(mine); const tiles = placeTiles(); const where = `Cell ${mine.x},${mine.y} - world tile ` + `${mine.x * tiles},${mine.y * tiles}.`; const replaces = placeReplaces(mine); if (clash.length) { placeNote(`${where} It would sit on top of ${clash.join(' and ')}, and the ` + 'game would read one map’s cells for the other.', true); } else if (!placeWorld.lotsMatch) { placeNote(`${where} The map has moved since it was compiled - compile it ` + 'again before installing.', true); } else if (placeWorld.standalone) { placeNote(`${where} Standalone: the whole world is this map.`); } else if (replaces.length) { placeNote(`${where} This replaces the ${replaces[0]} cells under it. Load the ` + 'map ahead of Muldraugh, KY: SERVER SETUP.txt has the lines.'); } else { placeNote(where); } }

nodes.name: placeFetchPictures
nodes.body_text: function placeFetchPictures() { for (const map of placeWorld.maps || []) { if (!map.picture || placePictures[map.name]) continue; const shot = new Image(); shot.onload = drawWorld; shot.onerror = () => { delete placePictures[map.name]; }; shot.src = `/api/world-picture/${encodeURIComponent(map.name)}`; placePictures[map.name] = shot; } }

nodes.name: loadPlacement
nodes.body_text: async function loadPlacement(mapName) { const panel = document.getElementById('placePanel'); if (!panel || !mapName) return; try { placeWorld = await (await fetch(`/api/placement/${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}`)).json(); } catch { return; // the step simply shows nothing about place } if (placeWorld.error) { placeWorld = null; return; } placePicked = null; placeRoad = []; placeDrawingRoad = false; placeLinkState(); placeFetchPictures(); // The map as it came out, drawn in its place in the world. placePreview = new Image(); placePreview.onload = drawWorld; placePreview.onerror = () => { placePreview = null; }; placePreview.src = `/output/${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}/` + `${encodeURIComponent(mapName)}_preview.png`; drawWorld(); placeFields(); placeState(); sayIfInstallable(); }

nodes.name: placeAt
nodes.body_text: function placeAt(ev) { const canvas = document.getElementById('placeCanvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const k = placeScale(); const scale = canvas.width / rect.width; // drawn at its own size, shown scaled return [(ev.clientX - rect.left) * scale / k + placeView.x, (ev.clientY - rect.top) * scale / k + placeView.y]; }

nodes.name: placeFromEvent
nodes.body_text: function placeFromEvent(ev) { const [tx, ty] = placeAt(ev); const cell = placeTiles(); // Picked by the middle of the map rather than its corner: the pointer is // where you want the town, not where its north-west cell happens to be. return { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(placeWorld.maxCell, Math.round(tx / cell - placeWorld.map.w / 2))), y: Math.max(0, Math.min(placeWorld.maxCell, Math.round(ty / cell - placeWorld.map.h / 2))), }; }

nodes.name: pick
nodes.body_text: pick = ev => { if (!placeWorld) return; placePicked = placeFromEvent(ev); drawWorld(); placeFields(); placeState(); }

nodes.name: canvasPx
nodes.body_text: canvasPx = ev => { const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const f = canvas.width / box.width; return [(ev.clientX - box.left) * f, (ev.clientY - box.top) * f]; }

nodes.name: release
nodes.body_text: release = () => { placeDragging = false; panning = null; }

nodes.name: sayIfInstallable
nodes.body_text: function sayIfInstallable() { const btn = document.getElementById('installBtn'); if (placeWorld && placeWorld.compiled && !placeWorld.lotsMatch) { note('installNote', 'This map was moved after it was compiled. ' + 'Compile it again (step 5), then install.', 'bad'); note('compileNote', 'The map was moved on the world map since the last ' + 'compile. Compile it again.', 'warn'); btn.disabled = true; return false; } if (!btn.disabled) note('installNote', 'Ready to install.'); return true; }

nodes.name: putMapAt
nodes.body_text: async function putMapAt(body) { if (!currentMap) { placeNote('Open or generate a map first.', true); return; } try { const res = await fetch(`/api/placement/${encodeURIComponent(currentMap)}`, body); const out = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw apiError(out, res); placeWorld = out; placePicked = null; placeFetchPictures(); drawWorld(); placeFields(); const moved = out.moved || {}; sayIfInstallable(); if (moved.needsCompile) { placeNote(`Moved to cell ${out.map.x},${out.map.y}. ` + `${(moved.rewrote || []).length} files re-pointed - compile the map ` + 'again, then install.', true); fx.toast('ok', 'Map moved', 'Compile it again before installing.'); } else { placeState(); fx.toast('ok', 'Map placed', `It will be built at cell ${out.map.x},${out.map.y}.`); } } catch (err) { placeFields(); // a refused change leaves the checkbox as it really is placeNote(err.message, true); } }

nodes.name: linkBox
nodes.body_text: function linkBox() { if (placeRoad.length < 2) return null; const cell = placeTiles(); const xs = placeRoad.map(p => p[0]), ys = placeRoad.map(p => p[1]); const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.min(...xs) / cell) - LINK_MARGIN_CELLS); const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.min(...ys) / cell) - LINK_MARGIN_CELLS); const x1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...xs) / cell) + LINK_MARGIN_CELLS; const y1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...ys) / cell) + LINK_MARGIN_CELLS; return trimLink({ x: x0, y: y0, w: Math.max(1, x1 - x0), h: Math.max(1, y1 - y0) }); }

nodes.name: placeMapBoxes
nodes.body_text: function placeMapBoxes() { // Whole maps rather than their runs of cells: a strip of road is trimmed // out of a map, not threaded through the bites out of its edge. if (!placeWorld) return []; const c = placeWorld.compiledCell || 256; return (placeWorld.maps || []).map(m => ({ x: m.x * c, y: m.y * c, w: m.w * c, h: m.h * c, name: m.name })); }

nodes.name: trimLink
nodes.body_text: function trimLink(box) { const cell = placeTiles(); const others = placeMapBoxes().concat(placeMine() || []); let { x, y, w, h } = box; for (let pass = 0; pass < 8 && w > 0 && h > 0; pass += 1) { const me = { x: x * cell, y: y * cell, w: w * cell, h: h * cell }; const hit = others.find(r => hits(me, r)); if (!hit) break; // Trimmed on whichever side it pokes in least far, so a road laid along a // map keeps its length and one laid at its edge keeps its width. const sides = [ ['left', Math.ceil((hit.x + hit.w - me.x) / cell)], ['right', Math.ceil((me.x + me.w - hit.x) / cell)], ['top', Math.ceil((hit.y + hit.h - me.y) / cell)], ['bottom', Math.ceil((me.y + me.h - hit.y) / cell)], ].filter(([, by]) => by > 0).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]); if (!sides.length) break; const [side, by] = sides[0]; if (side === 'left') { x += by; w -= by; } else if (side === 'right') { w -= by; } else if (side === 'top') { y += by; h -= by; } else { h -= by; } } if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return null; return { x, y, w, h, trimmed: x !== box.x || y !== box.y || w !== box.w || h !== box.h }; }

nodes.name: placeLinkState
nodes.body_text: function placeLinkState() { const draw = document.getElementById('placeRoad'); const make = document.getElementById('placeLink'); const undo = document.getElementById('placeRoadUndo'); if (!draw) return; draw.textContent = placeDrawingRoad ? 'Finish the road' : 'Draw a road'; draw.classList.toggle('is-on', placeDrawingRoad); const box = linkBox(); make.disabled = !box; undo.disabled = !placeRoad.length; if (!placeRoad.length) return; if (!box) { placeNote('Click once more: a road needs at least two points.'); return; } const cells = box.w * box.h; const trimmed = box.trimmed ? ' Trimmed back out of the maps it crossed - two maps cannot share a cell.' : ''; placeNote(`A road of ${placeRoad.length} points across ${box.w}×${box.h} ` + `cells (${cells} in all)${cells > LINK_MAX_CELLS ? ' - that is a map, not a road. Draw a straighter one.' : '.'}${trimmed}`, cells > LINK_MAX_CELLS); }

nodes.name: stopRoad
nodes.body_text: function stopRoad() { placeDrawingRoad = false; placeLinkState(); }

nodes.name: draw.js
nodes.body_text: // The one drawing editor behind every place KnoxMap lets you draw shapes by // hand: the sketch palette over the world map and the drawing board. It owns // what used to be copied into each of them - arming a Leaflet draw handler, // picking, removing, duplicating, dragging corners, snapping - and adds what // neither had: undo and redo of anything (not just the last shape added), // a rectangle tool, nudging with the arrow keys, and one toolbar. // // const ed = KnoxDraw.create(map, { group, style, label, ... }); // KnoxDraw.toolbar(container, ed); // ed.start('house', 'area'); // // Every shape carries `layer.kdKind`, the palette id the server knows it by. // Undo works by snapshot: the whole set of shapes is cheap to copy (a drawn // map is hundreds of shapes, not millions), and one mechanism covers adding, // removing, reshaping, nudging, duplicating and clearing alike. (function () { const PICKED = { color: '#ff5f5f', weight: 4 }; const NUDGE_PX = 4; // The same row of buttons everywhere. They follow the editor's state, so // Undo is dimmed when there is nothing to undo and Duplicate when nothing is // picked, wherever the row happens to be. window.KnoxDraw = { create, toolbar }; })();

nodes.name: ringOf
nodes.body_text: ringOf = layer => { const ll = layer.getLatLngs(); return Array.isArray(ll[0]) ? ll[0] : ll; }

nodes.name: typeOf
nodes.body_text: typeOf = layer => (layer instanceof L.Polygon ? 'area' : layer instanceof L.Polyline ? 'line' : 'point')

nodes.name: create
nodes.body_text: function create(map, opts) { const o = Object.assign({ group: null, // the FeatureGroup shapes live in style: () => ({}), // kind -> Leaflet path style label: k => k, // kind -> words note: () => {}, // status line onChange: () => {}, // called with {count, canUndo, canRedo, picked, editing} onPick: null, // called with the picked layer or null pickedBox: null, // element the picked shape's details go in active: () => true, // whether the keyboard belongs to this editor now snapOn: () => false, // whether finished shapes snap snapDist: 14, // in map units (metres on the drawing board) snapExtra: () => [], // more points to snap to: [[lat, lng], ...] listen: true, // false when the owner forwards CREATED to claim() palette: null, // element whose .sketch-pick buttons start tools pickedStyle: PICKED, // how the picked shape looks tooltip: null, // layer -> tooltip html; default is the label tooltipOptions: { sticky: true }, newMeta: null, // kind -> data a new shape carries (kept by undo) cloneMeta: m => m, // data -> the data a duplicate carries onAttach: null, // called with each shape put on the map onClaimed: null, // called with a shape the user has just drawn onStart: null, // called when a tool is armed }, opts); const group = o.group || new L.FeatureGroup().addTo(map); const crsSimple = map.options.crs === L.CRS.Simple; let kind = null, handler = null, picked = null, editing = false; let rect = false, geometry = null; let history = [], at = -1, rev = 0; // ---- measuring --------------------------------------------------------- const dist = (a, b) => (crsSimple ? Math.hypot(a.lat - b.lat, a.lng - b.lng) : map.distance(a, b)); function measure(layer) { if (layer.getLatLng) return ''; const ring = ringOf(layer); if (ring.length < 2) return ''; if (layer instanceof L.Polygon) { // Local flat projection: exact on the sheet, close enough on the world // map for shapes of a town's size. const lat0 = ring[0].lat; const kx = crsSimple ? 1 : 111320 * Math.cos(lat0 * Math.PI / 180); const ky = crsSimple ? 1 : 110540; let twice = 0; for (let i = 0; i < ring.length; i += 1) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % ring.length]; twice += (a.lng * kx) * (b.lat * ky) - (b.lng * kx) * (a.lat * ky); } const area = Math.abs(twice) / 2; return area >= 10000 ? `${(area / 10000).toFixed(2)} ha` : `${Math.round(area)} m²`; } let run = 0; for (let i = 1; i < ring.length; i += 1) run += dist(ring[i], ring[i - 1]); return `${Math.round(run)} m long`; } // ---- history ----------------------------------------------------------- const snapshot = () => { const out = []; group.eachLayer(l => { if (!l.kdKind) return; const type = typeOf(l); out.push({ kind: l.kdKind, type, meta: l.kdMeta, pts: type === 'point' ? [[l.getLatLng().lat, l.getLatLng().lng]] : ringOf(l).map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]) }); }); return JSON.stringify(out); }; function state() { return { count: group.getLayers().length, rev, canUndo: at > 0, canRedo: at < history.length - 1, picked, editing }; } const changed = () => o.onChange(state()); function commit() { const snap = snapshot(); if (snap === history[at]) return; rev += 1; history = history.slice(0, at + 1); history.push(snap); if (history.length > 200) history.shift(); at = history.length - 1; changed(); } function build(item) { const pts = item.pts; if (item.type === 'area' && pts.length >= 3) return L.polygon(pts); if (item.type === 'line' && pts.length >= 2) return L.polyline(pts); if (item.type === 'point' && pts.length) return L.marker(pts[0]); return null; } function restore(snap) { pick(null); group.clearLayers(); for (const item of JSON.parse(snap)) { const layer = build(item); if (layer) attach(item.kind, layer, item.meta); } rev += 1; changed(); } function undo() { if (at <= 0) return; at -= 1; restore(history[at]); o.note('Undone.'); } function redo() { if (at >= history.length - 1) return; at += 1; restore(history[at]); o.note('Redone.'); } // ---- shapes ------------------------------------------------------------ function drag(layer, on) { const h = layer.editing || layer.dragging; if (!h) return; if (on) h.enable(); else h.disable(); } function snapPoints(skip) { const out = o.snapExtra().slice(); group.eachLayer(l => { if (l === skip || !l.kdKind) return; if (l.getLatLng) { const p = l.getLatLng(); out.push([p.lat, p.lng]); } else for (const p of ringOf(l)) out.push([p.lat, p.lng]); }); return out; } // Move the ends of a shape onto whatever they were aimed at. function snap(layer) { if (!o.snapOn() || layer.getLatLng) return 0; const targets = snapPoints(layer); if (!targets.length) return 0; const lls = layer.getLatLngs(); const ring = Array.isArray(lls[0]) ? lls[0] : lls; let moved = 0; for (const p of ring) { let best = null, far = o.snapDist; for (const [lat, lng] of targets) { const d = Math.hypot(p.lat - lat, p.lng - lng); if (d > 0 && d <= far) { far = d; best = [lat, lng]; } } if (best) { p.lat = best[0]; p.lng = best[1]; moved += 1; } } if (moved) layer.setLatLngs(lls); return moved; }
