nodes.body_text: function measure(layer) { if (layer.getLatLng) return ''; const ring = ringOf(layer); if (ring.length < 2) return ''; if (layer instanceof L.Polygon) { // Local flat projection: exact on the sheet, close enough on the world // map for shapes of a town's size. const lat0 = ring[0].lat; const kx = crsSimple ? 1 : 111320 * Math.cos(lat0 * Math.PI / 180); const ky = crsSimple ? 1 : 110540; let twice = 0; for (let i = 0; i < ring.length; i += 1) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % ring.length]; twice += (a.lng * kx) * (b.lat * ky) - (b.lng * kx) * (a.lat * ky); } const area = Math.abs(twice) / 2; return area >= 10000 ? `${(area / 10000).toFixed(2)} ha` : `${Math.round(area)} m²`; } let run = 0; for (let i = 1; i < ring.length; i += 1) run += dist(ring[i], ring[i - 1]); return `${Math.round(run)} m long`; }

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.body_text: snapshot = () => { const out = []; group.eachLayer(l => { if (!l.kdKind) return; const type = typeOf(l); out.push({ kind: l.kdKind, type, meta: l.kdMeta, pts: type === 'point' ? [[l.getLatLng().lat, l.getLatLng().lng]] : ringOf(l).map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]) }); }); return JSON.stringify(out); }

nodes.name: state
nodes.body_text: function state() { return { count: group.getLayers().length, rev, canUndo: at > 0, canRedo: at < history.length - 1, picked, editing }; }

nodes.name: changed
nodes.body_text: changed = () => o.onChange(state())

nodes.name: commit
nodes.body_text: function commit() { const snap = snapshot(); if (snap === history[at]) return; rev += 1; history = history.slice(0, at + 1); history.push(snap); if (history.length > 200) history.shift(); at = history.length - 1; changed(); }

nodes.name: build
nodes.body_text: function build(item) { const pts = item.pts; if (item.type === 'area' && pts.length >= 3) return L.polygon(pts); if (item.type === 'line' && pts.length >= 2) return L.polyline(pts); if (item.type === 'point' && pts.length) return L.marker(pts[0]); return null; }

nodes.name: restore
nodes.body_text: function restore(snap) { pick(null); group.clearLayers(); for (const item of JSON.parse(snap)) { const layer = build(item); if (layer) attach(item.kind, layer, item.meta); } rev += 1; changed(); }

nodes.name: undo
nodes.body_text: function undo() { if (at <= 0) return; at -= 1; restore(history[at]); o.note('Undone.'); }

nodes.name: redo
nodes.body_text: function redo() { if (at >= history.length - 1) return; at += 1; restore(history[at]); o.note('Redone.'); }

nodes.name: drag
nodes.body_text: function drag(layer, on) { const h = layer.editing || layer.dragging; if (!h) return; if (on) h.enable(); else h.disable(); }

nodes.name: snapPoints
nodes.body_text: function snapPoints(skip) { const out = o.snapExtra().slice(); group.eachLayer(l => { if (l === skip || !l.kdKind) return; if (l.getLatLng) { const p = l.getLatLng(); out.push([p.lat, p.lng]); } else for (const p of ringOf(l)) out.push([p.lat, p.lng]); }); return out; }

nodes.name: snap
nodes.body_text: function snap(layer) { if (!o.snapOn() || layer.getLatLng) return 0; const targets = snapPoints(layer); if (!targets.length) return 0; const lls = layer.getLatLngs(); const ring = Array.isArray(lls[0]) ? lls[0] : lls; let moved = 0; for (const p of ring) { let best = null, far = o.snapDist; for (const [lat, lng] of targets) { const d = Math.hypot(p.lat - lat, p.lng - lng); if (d > 0 && d <= far) { far = d; best = [lat, lng]; } } if (best) { p.lat = best[0]; p.lng = best[1]; moved += 1; } } if (moved) layer.setLatLngs(lls); return moved; }

nodes.name: attach
nodes.body_text: function attach(k, layer, meta) { layer.kdKind = k; if (meta !== undefined) layer.kdMeta = meta; if (layer.setStyle) layer.setStyle(o.style(k)); layer.bindTooltip(o.tooltip ? o.tooltip(layer) : o.label(k), o.tooltipOptions); layer.on('click', ev => { if (handler) return; // a click while drawing is a vertex L.DomEvent.stop(ev); pick(layer); }); // Corner dragged, or a marker let go: that is one undoable step, and // snapping applies to it as it does to a new shape. layer.on('edit dragend', () => { if (editing && layer.editing && o.snapOn()) { layer.editing.disable(); snap(layer); layer.editing.enable(); } commit(); }); group.addLayer(layer); if (editing) drag(layer, true); if (o.onAttach) o.onAttach(layer); return layer; }

nodes.name: add
nodes.body_text: function add(k, layer, silent, meta) { attach(k, layer, meta); commit(); if (!silent) o.note(`${o.label(k)} added.`); return layer; }

nodes.name: remove
nodes.body_text: function remove(layer) { if (!layer) return; if (picked === layer) pick(null); group.removeLayer(layer); commit(); o.note('Removed.'); }

nodes.name: clear
nodes.body_text: function clear() { if (!group.getLayers().length) return; pick(null); group.clearLayers(); commit(); o.note('Cleared. Undo brings it back.'); }

nodes.name: replace
nodes.body_text: function replace(items) { pick(null); group.clearLayers(); for (const { kind: k, layer, meta } of items) attach(k, layer, meta); history = [snapshot()]; at = 0; rev += 1; changed(); }

nodes.name: each
nodes.body_text: function each(fn) { group.eachLayer(l => { if (l.kdKind) fn(l, l.kdKind); }); }

nodes.name: duplicate
nodes.body_text: function duplicate() { if (!picked) return; const k = picked.kdKind; const off = ([lat, lng]) => { // A fixed few pixels, so it lands visibly beside the original at any // zoom, in the world's degrees or the sheet's metres alike. const pt = map.latLngToLayerPoint([lat, lng]).add([20, 20]); const q = map.layerPointToLatLng(pt); return [q.lat, q.lng]; }; const item = { type: typeOf(picked), pts: (picked.getLatLng ? [picked.getLatLng()] : ringOf(picked)) .map(p => off([p.lat, p.lng])) }; const copy = build(item); if (!copy) return; add(k, copy, true, picked.kdMeta === undefined ? undefined : o.cloneMeta(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(picked.kdMeta)))); pick(copy); o.note(`${o.label(k)} copied. Drag it by its corners, or nudge with the arrow keys.`); }

nodes.name: off
nodes.body_text: off = ([lat, lng]) => { // A fixed few pixels, so it lands visibly beside the original at any // zoom, in the world's degrees or the sheet's metres alike. const pt = map.latLngToLayerPoint([lat, lng]).add([20, 20]); const q = map.layerPointToLatLng(pt); return [q.lat, q.lng]; }

nodes.name: renderPicked
nodes.body_text: function renderPicked() { const box = o.pickedBox; if (!box) return; if (!picked) { box.hidden = true; box.innerHTML = ''; return; } const size = measure(picked); box.hidden = false; box.innerHTML = ''; const text = document.createElement('span'); text.className = 'hint'; text.textContent = o.label(picked.kdKind) + (size ? ` · ${size}` : ''); const del = document.createElement('button'); del.type = 'button'; del.className = 'btn'; del.textContent = 'Remove'; del.addEventListener('click', () => remove(picked)); box.append(text, del); }

nodes.name: pick
nodes.body_text: function pick(layer) { if (picked && picked.setStyle && picked.kdKind) picked.setStyle(o.style(picked.kdKind)); picked = layer || null; if (picked && picked.setStyle) picked.setStyle(o.pickedStyle); renderPicked(); if (o.onPick) o.onPick(picked); changed(); }

nodes.name: stop
nodes.body_text: function stop() { if (handler) { handler.disable(); handler = null; } kind = null; if (o.palette) { for (const b of o.palette.querySelectorAll('.sketch-pick')) b.classList.remove('on'); } changed(); }

nodes.name: start
nodes.body_text: function start(k, geom) { if (o.onStart) o.onStart(); stop(); pick(null); if (editing) setEditing(false); kind = k; geometry = geom; const shapeOptions = o.style(k); if (geom === 'line') handler = new L.Draw.Polyline(map, { shapeOptions }); else if (geom === 'area' && rect) handler = new L.Draw.Rectangle(map, { shapeOptions }); else if (geom === 'area') { handler = new L.Draw.Polygon(map, { allowIntersection: false, shapeOptions }); } else handler = new L.Draw.Marker(map, {}); handler.enable(); if (o.palette) { for (const b of o.palette.querySelectorAll('.sketch-pick')) { b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.kind === k); } } o.note(`Drawing ${o.label(k)}. ${geom === 'point' ? 'Click to place it.' : rect && geom === 'area' ? 'Drag a rectangle.' : 'Click each corner; double-click or click the last point to finish.'}`); changed(); }

nodes.name: setRect
nodes.body_text: function setRect(on) { rect = !!on; if (kind && geometry === 'area') start(kind, geometry); changed(); }

nodes.name: claim
nodes.body_text: function claim(layer) { if (!kind) return false; const k = kind; const geom = geometry; stop(); // A rectangle comes back as L.Rectangle; the server wants plain corners. const shape = layer instanceof L.Rectangle ? L.polygon(layer.getLatLngs()[0]) : layer; const joined = snap(shape); add(k, shape, true, o.newMeta ? o.newMeta(k) : undefined); o.note(`${o.label(k)} added${joined ? `, ${joined} end${joined === 1 ? '' : 's'} joined up` : ''}.` + (geom ? ' Pick another tool to keep going.' : '')); if (o.onClaimed) o.onClaimed(shape); return true; }

nodes.name: setEditing
nodes.body_text: function setEditing(on) { editing = !!on; if (on) { stop(); pick(null); } group.eachLayer(l => drag(l, on)); o.note(on ? 'Drag a corner to move it, or the middle of a line to add one. ' + 'Press Move and reshape again to stop.' : 'Back to drawing.'); changed(); }

nodes.name: nudge
nodes.body_text: function nudge(dx, dy) { if (!picked) return; const shift = p => { const q = map.layerPointToLatLng(map.latLngToLayerPoint(p).add([dx, dy])); return q; }; const wasEditing = editing && picked.editing; if (wasEditing) picked.editing.disable(); if (picked.getLatLng) picked.setLatLng(shift(picked.getLatLng())); else { const lls = picked.getLatLngs(); const ring = Array.isArray(lls[0]) ? lls[0] : lls; picked.setLatLngs(Array.isArray(lls[0]) ? [ring.map(shift)] : ring.map(shift)); } if (wasEditing) picked.editing.enable(); renderPicked(); }

nodes.name: shift
nodes.body_text: shift = p => { const q = map.layerPointToLatLng(map.latLngToLayerPoint(p).add([dx, dy])); return q; }

nodes.name: kind
nodes.body_text: get kind() { return kind; }

nodes.name: picked
nodes.body_text: get picked() { return picked; }

nodes.name: editing
nodes.body_text: get editing() { return editing; }

nodes.name: rect
nodes.body_text: get rect() { return rect; }

nodes.name: count
nodes.body_text: get count() { return group.getLayers().length; }

nodes.name: toolbar
nodes.body_text: function toolbar(container, ed) { const defs = [ ['undo', 'Undo', 'Ctrl+Z', () => ed.undo()], ['redo', 'Redo', 'Ctrl+Shift+Z', () => ed.redo()], ['rect', 'Rectangle', 'Draw areas as a rectangle by dragging', () => ed.setRect(!ed.rect)], ['edit', 'Move and reshape', 'Drag corners; arrow keys nudge a picked shape', () => ed.setEditing(!ed.editing)], ['dupe', 'Duplicate', 'Copy the picked shape', () => ed.duplicate()], ['clear', 'Clear', 'Remove everything (Undo brings it back)', () => ed.clear()], ]; container.classList.add('kd-bar'); const buttons = {}; for (const [id, text, title, run] of defs) { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'btn kd-' + id; b.textContent = text; b.title = title; b.addEventListener('click', run); container.appendChild(b); buttons[id] = b; } function refresh() { const s = ed.state(); buttons.undo.disabled = !s.canUndo; buttons.redo.disabled = !s.canRedo; buttons.dupe.disabled = !s.picked; buttons.clear.disabled = !s.count; buttons.edit.classList.toggle('on', s.editing); buttons.rect.classList.toggle('on', ed.rect); } return refresh; }

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.body_text: function refresh() { const s = ed.state(); buttons.undo.disabled = !s.canUndo; buttons.redo.disabled = !s.canRedo; buttons.dupe.disabled = !s.picked; buttons.clear.disabled = !s.count; buttons.edit.classList.toggle('on', s.editing); buttons.rect.classList.toggle('on', ed.rect); }

nodes.name: fx.js
nodes.body_text: // KnoxMap - the small bits of UI glue app.js calls into. // // It never talks to the server or decides anything: app.js calls `fx` when an // area is chosen, a step starts or finishes, and this shows it. If this file // failed to load, the app would still work. /* exported fx */ // Called from app.js and the windows. A linter checking one script cannot see // that anybody uses it, so the line above says so. const fx = (() => { // Steps used to light up in a header bar; the panels now say it themselves. // ---- messages ----------------------------------------------------------- // An error worth reporting: the message, its id in the log, and two ways to // pass it on - the details copied for a Discord message, or the whole // report zip saved into the logs folder and shown in Explorer. // ---- numbers ------------------------------------------------------------ // ---- terrain progress --------------------------------------------------- let clockTimer = null; let started = 0; const overlay = { }; // ---- the build / compile / install steps -------------------------------- const NOTE_STEP = { buildingsNote: 'buildings', compileNote: 'compile', worldedNote: 'compile', installNote: 'install', }; const BUSY = /generating|starting|installing|compiling|waiting|opened/i; // ---- basemaps ------------------------------------------------------------- // ---- kind of place ---------------------------------------------------------- // ---- settings form ------------------------------------------------------------ // ---- updates ------------------------------------------------------------ // updater.py downloads a newer release in the background; once it is // ready the header offers a restart, which installs it. // A dot beside the version in the top bar: green when a newer release // exists, amber once it has downloaded and only a restart is left. The // menu is behind a click, so without this nothing on screen said an // update was waiting. // ---- version menu --------------------------------------------------------------- // Click the version at the top for every release on GitHub. The one chosen // downloads now (updater.py checks it against GitHub's fingerprint) and goes // in on restart - older ones too, for when a new release breaks something. const VERSION_MENU_SINCE = [1, 3, 5]; // the first release with this menu document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { versionMenu(); setTimeout(watchUpdates, 8000); presetCards(); $('.hint-close')?.addEventListener('click', () => $('#map-hint')?.remove()); $('#reportLink')?.addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); saveReport(); }); }); window.addEventListener('load', mapExtras); return { step, resetFrom, toast, problem, saveReport, countUp, tile, overlay, noted, card, progress, })();
$ = (sel, root = document) => root.querySelector(sel)

nodes.name: step
nodes.body_text: function step(key, state) { if (key === 'area' && state === 'done') $('#map-hint')?.remove(); }

nodes.name: resetFrom
nodes.body_text: function resetFrom() {}

nodes.name: toast
nodes.body_text: function toast(kind, title, msg, ms = 5000) { const box = $('#toasts'); if (!box) return; const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = `toast ${kind}`; el.innerHTML = ' '; el.querySelector('b').textContent = title; el.querySelector('span').textContent = msg || ''; box.appendChild(el); const kill = () => el.remove(); el.addEventListener('click', kill); setTimeout(kill, ms); }

nodes.name: kill
nodes.body_text: kill = () => el.remove()

nodes.name: problem
nodes.body_text:
function problem(title, msg, errorId) { const box = $('#toasts'); if (!box) return; const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'toast bad problem'; el.innerHTML = '
' + '
' + '' + '
'; el.querySelector('b').textContent = title; el.querySelector('.msg').textContent = msg || ''; el.querySelector('.eid').textContent = errorId ? `Error ${errorId}` : ''; el.querySelector('.dismiss').addEventListener('click', () => el.remove()); el.querySelector('.copy').addEventListener('click', async (e) => { const version = $('#appVersion')?.textContent || ''; const text = [`KnoxMap ${version}: ${title}`, msg || '', errorId || ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n'); try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); e.target.textContent = 'Copied'; } catch (_) { e.target.textContent = 'Could not copy'; } }); el.querySelector('.report').addEventListener('click', saveReport); box.appendChild(el); }

nodes.name: saveReport
nodes.body_text: async function saveReport() { try { const res = await fetch('/api/report-save', { method: 'POST' }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`); toast('ok', 'Report saved', `${data.name} is in KnoxMap's logs folder. Post it in #bug-reports on the Discord.`, 15000); } catch (_) { // In a plain browser rather than the app window: download it instead. window.location.href = '/api/report'; } }

nodes.name: countUp
nodes.body_text: function countUp(root = document) { root.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => { const value = parseFloat(el.dataset.count); const decimals = parseInt(el.dataset.decimals || '0', 10); el.textContent = isFinite(value) ? value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals, }) : ''; }); }

nodes.name: tile
nodes.body_text:
function tile(value, unit, label, decimals = 0) { return `
0${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ''}
${label}
`; }

nodes.name: show
nodes.body_text: show() { const el = $('#gen-overlay'); el.hidden = false; $('.gen-kicker', el).textContent = 'Generating terrain'; $('#gen-stage').textContent = 'Contacting OpenStreetMap…'; $('#gen-detail').textContent = ''; $('#gen-bar').parentElement.classList.remove('is-indeterminate'); $('#gen-bar').style.width = '4%'; started = Date.now(); clearInterval(clockTimer); clockTimer = setInterval(() => { const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - started) / 1000); $('#gen-clock').textContent = `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`; }, 500); }

nodes.name: update
nodes.body_text: update(p) { $('#gen-bar').parentElement.classList.toggle('is-indeterminate', p.stage === 'osm' && p.total === 0); if (p.stage === 'osm') { const total = p.total || 1; const done = p.done || 0; $('#gen-stage').textContent = 'Downloading map data'; $('#gen-detail').textContent = p.note || (total > 1 ? `Part ${done + 1} of ${total}` : ''); $('#gen-bar').style.width = p.total === 0 ? '35%' : `${Math.max(6, Math.round(8 + 62 * done / total))}%`; } else if (p.stage === 'roads') { $('#gen-stage').textContent = 'Routing the roads'; $('#gen-detail').textContent = `${(p.done || 0).toLocaleString()} of ${(p.total || 0).toLocaleString()} stretches` + (p.slowRoads ? ' · slow: the fast road router is missing' : ''); $('#gen-bar').style.width = `${Math.round(70 + 12 * (p.done || 0) / Math.max(1, p.total || 1))}%`; } else if (p.stage === 'render') { $('#gen-stage').textContent = 'Drawing the terrain'; $('#gen-detail').textContent = `${(p.features || 0).toLocaleString()} features`; $('#gen-bar').style.width = '82%'; } }

nodes.name: done
nodes.body_text: done(summary) { $('#gen-bar').parentElement.classList.remove('is-indeterminate'); $('.gen-kicker').textContent = 'Done'; $('#gen-stage').textContent = summary || ''; $('#gen-detail').textContent = ''; $('#gen-bar').style.width = '100%'; this.hide(600); }

nodes.name: fail
nodes.body_text: fail(message) { $('#gen-bar').parentElement.classList.remove('is-indeterminate'); $('.gen-kicker').textContent = 'Failed'; const shown = i18n.t(message); $('#gen-stage').textContent = shown.length > 160 ? shown.slice(0, 157) + '…' : shown; $('#gen-detail').textContent = ''; this.hide(2500); }

nodes.name: hide
nodes.body_text: hide(delay = 0) { setTimeout(() => { $('#gen-overlay').hidden = true; clearInterval(clockTimer); }, delay); }

nodes.name: card
nodes.body_text: function card(key, state) { const el = $(`.pipe-card[data-step="${key}"]`); if (!el) return; el.classList.remove('is-running', 'is-done', 'is-error', 'is-ready'); if (state) el.classList.add(`is-${state}`); }

nodes.name: noted
nodes.body_text: function noted(id, text, cls) { const key = NOTE_STEP[id]; if (!key) return; if (cls === 'ok') card(key, 'done'); // 'warn' is a step that finished and still needs attention - a compile // that stepped over a batch of cells. It has stopped, so the card must // not go on saying it is running. else if (cls === 'bad' || cls === 'warn') card(key, 'error'); else if (BUSY.test(text)) card(key, 'running'); else if (/^ready/i.test(text)) card(key, 'ready'); }

nodes.name: progress
nodes.body_text: function progress(key, pct) { const bar = key === 'compile' ? $('#compileBar') : null; if (!bar) return; bar.parentElement.classList.toggle('is-indeterminate', !(pct > 0)); if (pct > 0) bar.style.width = `${Math.min(100, pct)}%`; }

nodes.name: mapExtras
nodes.body_text: function mapExtras() { if (typeof map === 'undefined') return; const attribution = '© OpenStreetMap contributors'; const layers = { streets: L.tileLayer('/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 19, attribution }), // The same tiles, darkened in CSS. dark: L.tileLayer('/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 19, className: 'tiles-dark', attribution }), }; const existing = []; map.eachLayer(l => { if (l instanceof L.TileLayer) existing.push(l); }); existing.forEach(l => map.removeLayer(l)); let saved = 'dark'; try { saved = localStorage.getItem('knoxmap.base') || 'dark'; } catch (_) {} if (!layers[saved]) saved = 'dark'; layers[saved].addTo(map); document.querySelectorAll('#basemaps button').forEach(btn => { btn.classList.toggle('is-on', btn.dataset.base === saved); btn.addEventListener('click', () => { Object.values(layers).forEach(l => map.removeLayer(l)); layers[btn.dataset.base].addTo(map); document.querySelectorAll('#basemaps button') .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('is-on', b === btn)); try { localStorage.setItem('knoxmap.base', btn.dataset.base); } catch (_) {} }); }); map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, () => $('#map-hint')?.remove()); }

nodes.name: presetCards
nodes.body_text: function presetCards() { const select = $('#preset'); document.querySelectorAll('.preset-card').forEach(card => { card.addEventListener('click', () => { document.querySelectorAll('.preset-card').forEach(c => { const on = c === card; c.classList.toggle('is-on', on); c.setAttribute('aria-checked', on ? 'true' : 'false'); }); select.value = card.dataset.preset; // app.js listens on the real select; it stays the single source of truth. select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }); }); }

nodes.name: paintRange
nodes.body_text: function paintRange(input) { const v = parseFloat(input.value); const out = input.closest('.setting')?.querySelector('.setting-val'); if (out) out.textContent = input.step && parseFloat(input.step) < 1 ? v.toFixed(2) : String(v); }

nodes.name: wireSettings
nodes.body_text: function wireSettings(root) { root.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(r => { paintRange(r); r.addEventListener('input', () => paintRange(r)); }); root.querySelectorAll('.dice').forEach(d => { d.addEventListener('click', () => { d.parentElement.querySelector('input').value = Math.floor(Math.random() * 999999) + 1; }); }); }

nodes.name: versionDot
nodes.body_text: function versionDot(state, version) { const dot = $('#versionDot'); if (!dot) return; dot.hidden = !state; dot.classList.toggle('ready', state === 'ready'); dot.title = state === 'ready' ? `KnoxMap ${version} is downloaded - restart to use it` : `KnoxMap ${version} is out`; }

nodes.name: watchUpdates
nodes.body_text: async function watchUpdates(round = 0) { const box = $('#updateNote'); if (!box) return; let st; try { st = await (await fetch('/api/update')).json(); } catch (_) { return; } versionDot(st.state === 'ready' ? 'ready' : (st.latest && st.latest !== st.current ? 'new' : ''), st.latest); if (st.state === 'ready') { box.hidden = false; box.innerHTML = ' '; box.querySelector('span').textContent = `KnoxMap ${st.latest} is ready.`; box.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', async (e) => { e.target.disabled = true; e.target.textContent = 'Restarting...'; try { const res = await fetch('/api/update/restart', { method: 'POST' }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`); } catch (err) { e.target.disabled = false; e.target.textContent = 'Restart to update'; toast('bad', 'Could not restart', err.message, 8000); } }); return; } if (st.state === 'downloading') { box.hidden = false; box.textContent = `Downloading KnoxMap ${st.latest}...`; } // The first check runs a few seconds after the window opens and the // download takes a moment, so ask often to begin with and settle down // afterwards: one poll every ten minutes meant the banner could be ten // minutes late on a window somebody only had open for five. const gap = st.state === 'downloading' || round < 12 ? 5000 : round < 20 ? 30 * 1000 : 10 * 60 * 1000; setTimeout(() => watchUpdates(round + 1), gap); }

nodes.name: versionParts
nodes.body_text: versionParts = v => (String(v).match(/\d+/g) || []).map(Number)

nodes.name: versionBefore
nodes.body_text: function versionBefore(a, b) { for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(a.length, b.length); i++) { if ((a[i] || 0) !== (b[i] || 0)) return (a[i] || 0) < (b[i] || 0); } return false; }

nodes.name: versionNote
nodes.body_text: function versionNote(text, cls) { const note = $('#versionNote'); note.className = 'hint' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : ''); note.textContent = text; }

nodes.name: waitForVersion
nodes.body_text: async function waitForVersion(version) { let st; for (;;) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); try { st = await (await fetch('/api/update')).json(); } catch (_) { continue; } if (st.state === 'downloading') continue; break; } if (st.state !== 'ready' || st.latest !== version) { throw new Error(st.error || `KnoxMap ${version} could not be downloaded.`); } const note = $('#versionNote'); note.className = 'hint'; note.innerHTML = ' '; note.querySelector('span').textContent = `KnoxMap ${version} is ready.`; note.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', async (e) => { e.target.disabled = true; e.target.textContent = 'Restarting...'; try { const res = await fetch('/api/update/restart', { method: 'POST' }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`); } catch (err) { e.target.disabled = false; e.target.textContent = 'Restart now'; versionNote(err.message, 'bad'); } }); watchUpdates(); }

nodes.name: chooseVersion
nodes.body_text: async function chooseVersion(item, button, current) { const older = versionBefore(versionParts(item.version), versionParts(current)); if (older && versionBefore(versionParts(item.version), VERSION_MENU_SINCE)) { const ok = window.confirm( `KnoxMap ${item.version} has no version menu. To come back, download the newest ` + 'KnoxMap from GitHub, or set "auto_update" to true in knoxmap_config.json. ' + `Go back to ${item.version}?`); if (!ok) return; } for (const b of document.querySelectorAll('#versionList button')) b.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Downloading...'; versionNote(`Downloading KnoxMap ${item.version} from GitHub...`); try { const res = await fetch('/api/versions/install', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ version: item.version }), }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`); await waitForVersion(item.version); button.textContent = 'Downloaded'; } catch (err) { versionNote(err.message, 'bad'); openVersions(true); } }

nodes.name: openVersions
nodes.body_text:
async function openVersions(keepNote) { const list = $('#versionList'); list.innerHTML = '
  • Asking GitHub…
    • '; if (!keepNote) versionNote(''); let data; try { const res = await fetch('/api/versions'); data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`); } catch (err) { list.innerHTML = ''; versionNote(err.message, 'bad'); return; } list.innerHTML = ''; const newest = data.releases.find(r => r.latest); if (data.managed && newest && !newest.current && !keepNote) { // The one thing most people opened this menu to do, before the list of // every release there has ever been. versionNote(''); const note = $('#versionNote'); note.className = 'hint update-ready'; note.innerHTML = ' '; note.querySelector('span').textContent = `KnoxMap ${newest.version} is out.`; const go = document.createElement('button'); go.type = 'button'; go.textContent = 'Update'; go.addEventListener('click', () => chooseVersion(newest, go, data.current)); note.append(go); } else if (!data.managed) { versionNote('This copy of KnoxMap is a git checkout: switch versions with git.'); } else if (!data.auto_update && !keepNote) { versionNote('Automatic updates are off while you are on an older version. ' + 'Choose the newest to turn them back on.'); } for (const item of data.releases) { const li = document.createElement('li'); const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'version-row'; const v = document.createElement('span'); v.className = 'v'; v.textContent = `v${item.version}`; const date = document.createElement('span'); date.className = 'date'; date.textContent = item.date; row.append(v, date); if (item.current) { const tag = document.createElement('span'); tag.className = 'tag now'; tag.textContent = 'this one'; row.append(tag); } else if (item.latest) { const tag = document.createElement('span'); tag.className = 'tag'; tag.textContent = 'newest'; row.append(tag); } if (!item.current) { const older = versionBefore(versionParts(item.version), versionParts(data.current)); const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.textContent = older ? 'Go back' : 'Update'; if (older) button.classList.add('older'); button.disabled = !data.managed; button.addEventListener('click', () => chooseVersion(item, button, data.current)); row.append(button); } li.append(row); if (item.notes) { const details = document.createElement('details'); const summary = document.createElement('summary'); summary.textContent = "What's in it"; const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.textContent = item.notes; details.append(summary, pre); li.append(details); } list.append(li); } }

nodes.name: versionMenu
nodes.body_text: function versionMenu() { const badge = $('#appVersion'); const menu = $('#versionMenu'); if (!badge || !menu) return; const close = () => { menu.hidden = true; badge.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }; badge.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!menu.hidden) { close(); return; } menu.hidden = false; badge.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); openVersions(); }); menu.querySelector('.version-menu-close').addEventListener('click', close); document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); }); document.addEventListener('click', e => { if (!menu.hidden && !menu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== badge) close(); }); }

nodes.name: close
nodes.body_text: close = () => { menu.hidden = true; badge.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }

nodes.name: confetti
nodes.body_text: confetti() {}

nodes.name: i18n.js
nodes.body_text: // KnoxMap in another language, from a plain text file. // // lang/english.txt lists every line the window says, as "English = English". // Copy it to lang/<language>.txt, translate the right-hand side, and the // language is in the menu at the top - no code, no rebuild. Anything left in // English stays English, so a half-translated file is fine. // // The page itself is written in English, so translating means swapping the // text as it is shown: every text node and every placeholder, title and label // now, and anything the app writes later - a note under a button, a toast, the // settings it builds from the server - through a MutationObserver. Matching is // on the whole string, which is what the translator sees in the file. /* exported i18n */ // Read by app.js and shell.js. A linter checking one script cannot see that // anybody uses it, so the line above says so. const i18n = (() => { let strings = {}; // English -> translated let templates = []; // compiled once when a language is loaded let watching = null; document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); return { use, translateAll, t: text => say(text) ?? text }; })();

nodes.name: clean
nodes.body_text: clean = s => s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()

nodes.name: compileTemplates
nodes.body_text: function compileTemplates() { templates = []; for (const [english, translated] of Object.entries(strings)) { const names = []; const pieces = english.split(/(\{[A-Za-z_]\w*\})/g); if (pieces.length === 1) continue; const escape = s => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); const pattern = pieces.map(piece => { if (!/^\{[A-Za-z_]\w*\}$/.test(piece)) return escape(piece); names.push(piece.slice(1, -1)); return '(.+?)'; }).join(''); templates.push({ regex: new RegExp(`^${pattern}$`), names, translated, specificity: pieces.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0).join('').length }); } templates.sort((a, b) => b.specificity - a.specificity); }

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.body_text: function lookup(text, depth = 0) { const source = clean(text); if (Object.hasOwn(strings, source)) return strings[source]; if (depth >= 4) return null; for (const { regex, names, translated } of templates) { const match = regex.exec(source); if (!match) continue; const values = Object.create(null); names.forEach((name, i) => { const value = match[i + 1]; values[name] = lookup(value, depth + 1) ?? value; }); // Callback replacement keeps URLs, dollar signs and markup as literal // text. The result still goes through text nodes or attributes only. return translated.replace(/\{([A-Za-z_]\w*)\}/g, (token, name) => values[name] ?? token); } return null; }

nodes.name: say
nodes.body_text: function say(text) { if (!text) return null; const hit = lookup(text); if (hit === null) return null; // Keep the spacing around it: the page lays text out with it. const [, before, , after] = text.match(/^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/); return before + hit + after; }

nodes.name: translateNode
nodes.body_text: function translateNode(node) { if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) { const next = say(node.nodeValue); if (next !== null && next !== node.nodeValue) node.nodeValue = next; return; } if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return; if (node.closest && node.closest('[data-no-translate]')) return; for (const attr of ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label']) { const value = node.getAttribute && node.getAttribute(attr); const next = value && say(value); if (next && next !== value) node.setAttribute(attr, next); } for (const child of node.childNodes) translateNode(child); }

nodes.name: translateAll
nodes.body_text: function translateAll() { translateNode(document.body); }

nodes.name: watch
nodes.body_text: function watch() { if (watching) return; watching = new MutationObserver(records => { watching.disconnect(); // our own changes must not re-trigger it for (const record of records) { if (record.type === 'characterData') translateNode(record.target); for (const node of record.addedNodes) translateNode(node); if (record.type === 'attributes' && record.target) translateNode(record.target); } observe(); }); observe(); }

nodes.name: observe
nodes.body_text: function observe() { watching.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true, attributeFilter: ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label'], }); }

nodes.name: use
nodes.body_text: async function use(file, remember) { try { const res = await fetch(`/api/language/${encodeURIComponent(file)}`, { method: remember ? 'POST' : 'GET' }); const data = await res.json(); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`); strings = data.strings || {}; } catch (_) { strings = {}; // no file, no harm: English it is } compileTemplates(); if (Object.keys(strings).length) { translateAll(); watch(); } else if (remember) { window.location.reload(); // back to English: the simplest way back } }

nodes.name: start
nodes.body_text: async function start() { const menu = document.getElementById('language'); if (!menu) return; let data; try { data = await (await fetch('/api/languages')).json(); } catch (_) { return; } const languages = data.languages || []; // With nothing to choose from, the menu only gets in the way; the file // that explains how to add one is named in its tooltip. if (languages.length < 2) { menu.hidden = true; return; } menu.hidden = false; menu.innerHTML = ''; for (const language of languages) { const option = document.createElement('option'); option.value = language.file; option.textContent = language.name; option.selected = language.file === data.current; menu.append(option); } menu.addEventListener('change', () => use(menu.value, true)); if (data.current && data.current !== 'english') use(data.current, false); }

nodes.name: iso_view.js
nodes.body_text: // Isometric 2.5D game view for KnoxMap. // Displays the dimetric in-game rendering of Project Zomboid maps with pan, // zoom, interiors/roofs toggling, interactive box selection, and on-demand 1:1 HD sector rendering. (() => { let activeMap = null; let mapInfo = null; let currentMode = 'town'; // 'town' | 'close' | 'inside' | 'sector' let scale = 1.0; let panX = 0; let panY = 0; let isDragging = false; let startX = 0; let startY = 0; let touchStartDist = 0; let touchStartScale = 1.0; let el = null; let stage = null; let img = null; let badge = null; let emptyBox = null; let titleEl = null; let sectorBar = null; let loadHdHereBtn = null; let backOverviewBtn = null; let cellSelect = null; let drawBoxBtn = null; // Interactive selection marquee & popover let selectionLayer = null; let selectionMarquee = null; let selectionBadge = null; let selectionPopover = null; let popoverDim = null; let popoverCoords = null; let isDrawModeActive = false; let isBoxSelecting = false; let boxStartX = 0; let boxStartY = 0; let currentSelection = null; // { x, y, w, h } let currentSector = null; // { x, y, w, h, roofs } // Progress overlay elements and state let overlay = null; let progressKicker = null; let progressTitle = null; let progressSub = null; let progressBar = null; let progressPercent = null; let progressClock = null; let cancelBtn = null; let progressTimer = null; let progressStartTime = 0; let activeImageLoader = null; let isCancelled = false; // Determine current image bounding box in tile coordinates // Convert current screen coordinates to map tile coordinates (X, Y) // Box selection marquee logic window.showIsoView = showIsoView; window.closeIsoView = closeIsoView; })();

nodes.name: ensureElements
nodes.body_text:
function ensureElements() { const root = document.getElementById('wsIso'); if (!root) return; if (el) return; root.innerHTML = `
100%
60 × 60
🔲 Selected area
60 × 60 tiles
X: 1200 · Y: 1050
Project Zomboid 2.5D View

nodes.name: startProgress
nodes.body_text: function startProgress(title, sub, estimatedSecs = 4) { ensureElements(); isCancelled = false; if (progressTimer) clearInterval(progressTimer); if (progressTitle) progressTitle.textContent = title || 'Loading isometric view…'; if (progressSub) progressSub.textContent = sub || 'Reading map data…'; if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = '0%'; if (progressPercent) progressPercent.textContent = '0%'; if (progressClock) progressClock.textContent = '⏱️ 0:00'; if (overlay) { overlay.hidden = false; overlay.style.display = 'flex'; } progressStartTime = Date.now(); const durationMs = Math.max(1000, estimatedSecs * 1000); progressTimer = setInterval(() => { const elapsed = Date.now() - progressStartTime; const sec = Math.floor(elapsed / 1000); const min = Math.floor(sec / 60); const remSec = String(sec % 60).padStart(2, '0'); if (progressClock) progressClock.textContent = `⏱️ ${min}:${remSec}`; let p = 0; if (elapsed < durationMs * 0.4) { p = Math.round((elapsed / (durationMs * 0.4)) * 50); } else if (elapsed < durationMs) { const t = (elapsed - durationMs * 0.4) / (durationMs * 0.6); p = Math.round(50 + t * 40); } else { const extra = (elapsed - durationMs) / 1000; p = Math.min(98, Math.round(90 + (1 - Math.exp(-extra / 4)) * 8)); } if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = `${p}%`; if (progressPercent) progressPercent.textContent = `${p}%`; if (progressSub) { if (p < 25) { progressSub.textContent = 'Loading building data…'; } else if (p < 60) { progressSub.textContent = 'Rendering tiles and isometric projection…'; } else if (p < 85) { progressSub.textContent = 'Compositing furniture, walls and layers…'; } else { progressSub.textContent = 'Finalizing image…'; } } }, 120); }

nodes.name: finishProgress
nodes.body_text: function finishProgress(isError = false) { if (progressTimer) { clearInterval(progressTimer); progressTimer = null; } if (isError) { if (overlay) { overlay.hidden = true; overlay.style.display = 'none'; } return; } if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = '100%'; if (progressPercent) progressPercent.textContent = '100%'; if (progressSub) progressSub.textContent = 'Done!'; setTimeout(() => { if (overlay) { overlay.hidden = true; overlay.style.display = 'none'; } }, 180); }

nodes.name: cancelProgress
nodes.body_text: function cancelProgress() { isCancelled = true; if (activeImageLoader) { activeImageLoader.src = ''; activeImageLoader = null; } finishProgress(true); if (window.fx?.toast) { window.fx.toast('bad', 'Cancelled', 'Loading cancelled.', 3000); } }

nodes.name: getCurrentImageBox
nodes.body_text: function getCurrentImageBox() { const W = mapInfo?.width_tiles || 2400; const H = mapInfo?.height_tiles || 2100; if (currentMode === 'sector' && currentSector) { return { x: currentSector.x, y: currentSector.y, w: currentSector.w, h: currentSector.h }; } if (currentMode === 'close') { const close = Math.min(320, Math.max(120, Math.floor(Math.min(W, H) / 3))); return { x: Math.max(0, Math.floor(W / 2 - close / 2)), y: Math.max(0, Math.floor(H / 2 - close / 2)), w: close, h: close, }; } // 'town' and 'inside' (inside_town.png) return { x: 0, y: 0, w: W, h: H }; }

nodes.name: screenPointToTile
nodes.body_text: function screenPointToTile(clientX, clientY) { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport || !img || !img.naturalWidth || !mapInfo) { return { x: 1000, y: 1000 }; } const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect(); const vcx = clientX - rect.left; const vcy = clientY - rect.top; const imgX = (vcx - panX) / scale; const imgY = (vcy - panY) / scale; const box = getCurrentImageBox(); const iw = img.naturalWidth; const ih = img.naturalHeight; const cx = iw / 2; const cy = ih / 2; const half = iw / (box.w + box.h); const quarter = half / 2; const dx = imgX - cx; const dy = imgY - cy; const t_dx = (dx / half + dy / quarter) / 2; const t_dy = (dy / quarter - dx / half) / 2; const mapW = mapInfo.width_tiles || 2400; const mapH = mapInfo.height_tiles || 2100; const tileX = Math.max(0, Math.min(mapW, Math.round(box.x + box.w / 2 + t_dx))); const tileY = Math.max(0, Math.min(mapH, Math.round(box.y + box.h / 2 + t_dy))); return { x: tileX, y: tileY }; }

nodes.name: getViewportCenterTile
nodes.body_text: function getViewportCenterTile() { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport) return { x: 1000, y: 1000 }; const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect(); return screenPointToTile(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2); }

nodes.name: startBoxSelect
nodes.body_text: function startBoxSelect(clientX, clientY) { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport || !selectionLayer || !selectionMarquee) return; isBoxSelecting = true; boxStartX = clientX; boxStartY = clientY; currentSelection = null; if (selectionPopover) { selectionPopover.hidden = true; selectionPopover.style.display = 'none'; } selectionLayer.hidden = false; selectionLayer.style.display = 'block'; const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect(); const vx = clientX - rect.left; const vy = clientY - rect.top; selectionMarquee.style.display = 'block'; selectionMarquee.style.left = `${vx}px`; selectionMarquee.style.top = `${vy}px`; selectionMarquee.style.width = '0px'; selectionMarquee.style.height = '0px'; }

nodes.name: updateBoxSelect
nodes.body_text: function updateBoxSelect(clientX, clientY) { if (!isBoxSelecting) return; const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport || !selectionMarquee) return; const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect(); const minScreenX = Math.min(boxStartX, clientX); const maxScreenX = Math.max(boxStartX, clientX); const minScreenY = Math.min(boxStartY, clientY); const maxScreenY = Math.max(boxStartY, clientY); const vx = minScreenX - rect.left; const vy = minScreenY - rect.top; const vw = maxScreenX - minScreenX; const vh = maxScreenY - minScreenY; selectionMarquee.style.left = `${vx}px`; selectionMarquee.style.top = `${vy}px`; selectionMarquee.style.width = `${vw}px`; selectionMarquee.style.height = `${vh}px`; // Convert 4 screen corners to tile coordinates const p1 = screenPointToTile(minScreenX, minScreenY); const p2 = screenPointToTile(maxScreenX, minScreenY); const p3 = screenPointToTile(minScreenX, maxScreenY); const p4 = screenPointToTile(maxScreenX, maxScreenY); const mapW = mapInfo?.width_tiles || 2400; const mapH = mapInfo?.height_tiles || 2100; const minTx = Math.max(0, Math.min(p1.x, p2.x, p3.x, p4.x)); const maxTx = Math.min(mapW, Math.max(p1.x, p2.x, p3.x, p4.x)); const minTy = Math.max(0, Math.min(p1.y, p2.y, p3.y, p4.y)); const maxTy = Math.min(mapH, Math.max(p1.y, p2.y, p3.y, p4.y)); // Boxes bigger than 200 tiles are allowed: the renderer draws the whole // rectangle at a smaller scale rather than cropping it (see web/maps.py). const selW = Math.max(10, Math.min(1000, maxTx - minTx)); const selH = Math.max(10, Math.min(1000, maxTy - minTy)); currentSelection = { x: minTx, y: minTy, w: selW, h: selH }; if (selectionBadge) { selectionBadge.textContent = `${selW} × ${selH} tiles`; } }

nodes.name: finishBoxSelect
nodes.body_text: function finishBoxSelect(clientX, clientY) { if (!isBoxSelecting) return; isBoxSelecting = false; const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); const dist = Math.hypot(clientX - boxStartX, clientY - boxStartY); if (dist < 15 || !currentSelection) { clearBoxSelection(); return; } // Position action popover next to marquee if (viewport && selectionPopover) { const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect(); const minScreenX = Math.min(boxStartX, clientX); const maxScreenX = Math.max(boxStartX, clientX); const minScreenY = Math.min(boxStartY, clientY); const maxScreenY = Math.max(boxStartY, clientY); const vx = minScreenX - rect.left; const vy = minScreenY - rect.top; const vw = maxScreenX - minScreenX; const vh = maxScreenY - minScreenY; const popWidth = 270; const popLeft = Math.max(12, Math.min(rect.width - popWidth - 16, vx + (vw - popWidth) / 2)); const popTop = (vy > 140) ? (vy - 110) : (vy + vh + 12); selectionPopover.style.left = `${Math.round(popLeft)}px`; selectionPopover.style.top = `${Math.round(popTop)}px`; if (popoverDim) { popoverDim.textContent = `${currentSelection.w} × ${currentSelection.h} tiles (${(currentSelection.w * currentSelection.h).toLocaleString()} tiles)`; } if (popoverCoords) { popoverCoords.textContent = `X: ${currentSelection.x} · Y: ${currentSelection.y}`; } selectionPopover.hidden = false; selectionPopover.style.display = 'flex'; } // Update sector toolbar inputs updateSectorInputs(currentSelection.x, currentSelection.y, currentSelection.w, currentSelection.h); if (isDrawModeActive) { toggleDrawMode(false, true); } }

nodes.name: clearBoxSelection
nodes.body_text: function clearBoxSelection() { isBoxSelecting = false; currentSelection = null; if (selectionMarquee) selectionMarquee.style.display = 'none'; if (selectionPopover) { selectionPopover.hidden = true; selectionPopover.style.display = 'none'; } if (selectionLayer) { selectionLayer.hidden = true; selectionLayer.style.display = 'none'; } }

nodes.name: toggleDrawMode
nodes.body_text: function toggleDrawMode(forceState, keepSelection = false) { isDrawModeActive = typeof forceState === 'boolean' ? forceState : !isDrawModeActive; const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (drawBoxBtn) { drawBoxBtn.classList.toggle('is-on', isDrawModeActive); drawBoxBtn.textContent = isDrawModeActive ? '✕ Cancel draw' : '🔲 Draw area'; } if (viewport) { viewport.classList.toggle('is-drawing-tool', isDrawModeActive); } if (!isDrawModeActive && !keepSelection) { clearBoxSelection(); } }

nodes.name: updateSectorInputs
nodes.body_text: function updateSectorInputs(x, y, w, h) { const inX = document.getElementById('isoSectorX'); const inY = document.getElementById('isoSectorY'); const inW = document.getElementById('isoSectorW'); const inH = document.getElementById('isoSectorH'); if (inX) inX.value = x; if (inY) inY.value = y; if (inW) inW.value = w; if (inH) inH.value = h; }

nodes.name: updateSectorToggle
nodes.body_text: function updateSectorToggle(roofs) { const btnRoofs = document.getElementById('isoSectorRoofsBtn'); const btnInteriors = document.getElementById('isoSectorInteriorsBtn'); if (btnRoofs) btnRoofs.classList.toggle('is-on', roofs === 1); if (btnInteriors) btnInteriors.classList.toggle('is-on', roofs === 0); }

nodes.name: bindEvents
nodes.body_text: function bindEvents() { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); // Pan with mouse or start drawing box if draw tool active / Shift held viewport.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { if (e.target.closest('button, input, select, label, .iso-empty, .iso-overlay, .iso-selection-popover')) return; if (isDrawModeActive || e.shiftKey) { startBoxSelect(e.clientX, e.clientY); return; } isDragging = true; startX = e.clientX - panX; startY = e.clientY - panY; viewport.classList.add('is-dragging'); }); window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if (isBoxSelecting) { updateBoxSelect(e.clientX, e.clientY); return; } if (!isDragging) return; panX = e.clientX - startX; panY = e.clientY - startY; applyTransform(); }); window.addEventListener('mouseup', e => { if (isBoxSelecting) { finishBoxSelect(e.clientX, e.clientY); return; } if (!isDragging) return; isDragging = false; viewport.classList.remove('is-dragging'); }); // Zoom with mouse wheel centered on cursor viewport.addEventListener('wheel', e => { e.preventDefault(); const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = e.clientX - rect.left; const cy = e.clientY - rect.top; const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : (1 / 1.15); const newScale = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(8.0, scale * factor)); if (newScale === scale) return; panX = cx - (cx - panX) * (newScale / scale); panY = cy - (cy - panY) * (newScale / scale); scale = newScale; applyTransform(); }, { passive: false }); // Double-click on any building/street renders that sector in HD 1:1 viewport.addEventListener('dblclick', e => { if (e.target.closest('button, input, select, label, .iso-overlay, .iso-selection-popover')) return; const { x, y } = screenPointToTile(e.clientX, e.clientY); const w = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorW')?.value || '60', 10); const h = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorH')?.value || '60', 10); const roofs = currentMode === 'inside' ? 0 : (currentSector?.roofs ?? 1); const startX = Math.max(0, x - Math.round(w / 2)); const startY = Math.max(0, y - Math.round(h / 2)); renderSectorBox(startX, startY, w, h, roofs); }); // Touch support (pinch-to-zoom and pan) viewport.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { if (e.touches.length === 1) { isDragging = true; startX = e.touches[0].clientX - panX; startY = e.touches[0].clientY - panY; } else if (e.touches.length === 2) { isDragging = false; const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX; const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY; touchStartDist = Math.hypot(dx, dy); touchStartScale = scale; } }, { passive: true }); viewport.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { if (e.touches.length === 1 && isDragging) { panX = e.touches[0].clientX - startX; panY = e.touches[0].clientY - startY; applyTransform(); } else if (e.touches.length === 2 && touchStartDist > 0) { const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX; const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY; const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy); const factor = dist / touchStartDist; scale = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(8.0, touchStartScale * factor)); applyTransform(); } }, { passive: true }); viewport.addEventListener('touchend', () => { isDragging = false; touchStartDist = 0; }); // Zoom buttons document.getElementById('isoZoomIn')?.addEventListener('click', () => zoomBy(1.25)); document.getElementById('isoZoomOut')?.addEventListener('click', () => zoomBy(1 / 1.25)); document.getElementById('isoZoomFit')?.addEventListener('click', () => fitToScreen()); document.getElementById('isoZoom100')?.addEventListener('click', () => zoomTo(1.0)); // Draw box selection button toggle drawBoxBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => toggleDrawMode()); // Popover actions document.getElementById('isoPopoverClose')?.addEventListener('click', () => clearBoxSelection()); document.getElementById('isoPopoverRoofs')?.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!currentSelection) return; renderSectorBox(currentSelection.x, currentSelection.y, currentSelection.w, currentSelection.h, 1); }); document.getElementById('isoPopoverInteriors')?.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!currentSelection) return; renderSectorBox(currentSelection.x, currentSelection.y, currentSelection.w, currentSelection.h, 0); }); // Sector HD toggle buttons: Roofs vs Interiors document.getElementById('isoSectorRoofsBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!currentSector) return; renderSectorBox(currentSector.x, currentSector.y, currentSector.w, currentSector.h, 1); }); document.getElementById('isoSectorInteriorsBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!currentSector) return; renderSectorBox(currentSector.x, currentSector.y, currentSector.w, currentSector.h, 0); }); // Load HD Here button loadHdHereBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => { const { x, y } = getViewportCenterTile(); const w = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorW')?.value || '60', 10); const h = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorH')?.value || '60', 10); const roofs = currentMode === 'inside' ? 0 : (currentSector?.roofs ?? 1)

nodes.name: applyTransform
nodes.body_text: function applyTransform() { if (!stage) return; stage.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(panX)}px, ${Math.round(panY)}px) scale(${scale.toFixed(4)})`; if (badge) badge.textContent = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`; }

nodes.name: zoomBy
nodes.body_text: function zoomBy(factor) { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport) return; const cx = viewport.clientWidth / 2; const cy = viewport.clientHeight / 2; const newScale = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(8.0, scale * factor)); panX = cx - (cx - panX) * (newScale / scale); panY = cy - (cy - panY) * (newScale / scale); scale = newScale; applyTransform(); }

nodes.name: zoomTo
nodes.body_text: function zoomTo(targetScale) { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport) return; const cx = viewport.clientWidth / 2; const cy = viewport.clientHeight / 2; const newScale = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(8.0, targetScale)); panX = cx - (cx - panX) * (newScale / scale); panY = cy - (cy - panY) * (newScale / scale); scale = newScale; applyTransform(); }

nodes.name: fitToScreen
nodes.body_text: function fitToScreen() { const viewport = document.getElementById('isoViewport'); if (!viewport || !img || !img.naturalWidth) return; const vw = viewport.clientWidth; const vh = viewport.clientHeight; const iw = img.naturalWidth; const ih = img.naturalHeight; const fitScale = Math.min((vw - 32) / iw, (vh - 32) / ih, 1.0); scale = Math.max(0.08, fitScale); panX = (vw - iw * scale) / 2; panY = (vh - ih * scale) / 2; applyTransform(); }

nodes.name: loadImage
nodes.body_text: function loadImage(src, title, sub, estimatedSecs = 3) { startProgress(title, sub, estimatedSecs); const loader = new Image(); activeImageLoader = loader; loader.onload = () => { if (isCancelled || activeImageLoader !== loader) return; img.src = src; activeImageLoader = null; finishProgress(); fitToScreen(); }; loader.onerror = () => { if (isCancelled || activeImageLoader !== loader) return; activeImageLoader = null; finishProgress(true); if (window.fx?.toast) { window.fx.toast('bad', 'Error', 'Could not load isometric view.', 5000); } }; loader.src = src; if (loader.complete && loader.naturalWidth > 0) { img.src = src; activeImageLoader = null; finishProgress(); fitToScreen(); } }

nodes.name: setMode
nodes.body_text: function setMode(mode) { currentMode = mode; clearBoxSelection(); el.querySelectorAll('[data-iso-mode]').forEach(b => { b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.isoMode === mode); }); const isSector = mode === 'sector'; if (sectorBar) { sectorBar.hidden = !isSector; sectorBar.style.display = isSector ? 'flex' : 'none'; } if (loadHdHereBtn) { loadHdHereBtn.hidden = isSector; loadHdHereBtn.style.display = isSector ? 'none' : 'inline-flex'; } if (mode === 'sector') { const x = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorX')?.value || '1200', 10); const y = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorY')?.value || '1050', 10); const w = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorW')?.value || '60', 10); const h = parseInt(document.getElementById('isoSectorH')?.value || '60', 10); const roofs = currentSector ? currentSector.roofs : 1; renderSectorBox(x, y, w, h, roofs); return; } if (!mapInfo || !mapInfo.pictures) return; let src = mapInfo.pictures[mode]; const modeLabels = { town: 'Town overview', close: 'Town center', inside: 'Interiors (All)', }; const title = `Loading ${modeLabels[mode] || mode}…`; if (src) { loadImage(src, title, 'Reading generated town picture', 2); } else { const roofs = mode !== 'inside'; const fallbackUrl = `/api/iso-render/${encodeURIComponent(activeMap)}?roofs=${roofs ? 1 : 0}&scale=0.5`; loadImage(fallbackUrl, title, 'Rendering preview on demand…', 5); } }

nodes.name: renderSectorBox
nodes.signature: function renderSectorBox(x, y, w, h, roofs = 1, bustCache = false)
nodes.body_text: function renderSectorBox(x, y, w, h, roofs = 1, bustCache = false) { if (!activeMap) return; clearBoxSelection(); currentSector = { x, y, w, h, roofs: roofs ? 1 : 0 }; updateSectorInputs(x, y, w, h); updateSectorToggle(roofs ? 1 : 0); currentMode = 'sector'; el.querySelectorAll('[data-iso-mode]').forEach(b => { b.classList.toggle('is-on', b.dataset.isoMode === 'sector'); }); if (sectorBar) { sectorBar.hidden = false; sectorBar.style.display = 'flex'; } if (loadHdHereBtn) { loadHdHereBtn.hidden = true; loadHdHereBtn.style.display = 'none'; } // 1:1 is 128x256 px a tile, so the picture grows with the square of the // box. 412 tiles corner to corner is where 200x200 at 1:1 sits (~85 Mpx); // past that the same area is drawn whole at a smaller scale, which is the // server's rule too. const scale = Math.min(1, 412 / Math.max(10, w + h)); let url = `/api/iso-render/${encodeURIComponent(activeMap)}?box=${x},${y},${w},${h}` + `&scale=${scale.toFixed(2)}&roofs=${roofs ? 1 : 0}`; if (bustCache) { url += `&t=${Date.now()}`; } const roofText = roofs ? 'with roofs' : 'furnished interiors'; const at = scale < 0.99 ? ` at ${Math.round(scale * 100)}% to fit` : ''; loadImage(url, `Rendering HD sector ${x},${y} (${w}×${h} tiles, ${roofText}${at})…`, roofs ? 'Compositing in-game sprites' : 'Compositing furnished rooms, walls and partitions', scale < 0.99 ? 6 : 3); }

nodes.name: showIsoView
nodes.body_text: async function showIsoView(name) { ensureElements(); if (!name) return; // Re-ask when the last answer was "not compiled": compiling happens in the // pipeline behind this panel, and coming back to it must not keep saying // the map has no compiled cells. if (activeMap === name && mapInfo && mapInfo.compiled) { fitToScreen(); return; } activeMap = name; startProgress('Loading map data…', 'Fetching compiled isometric details', 2); try { const res = await fetch(`/api/iso-info/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`); mapInfo = await res.json(); } catch (err) { finishProgress(true); if (window.fx?.toast) { window.fx.toast('bad', 'Error', `Could not load isometric info: ${err.message}`, 5000); } return; } if (!mapInfo.compiled) { finishProgress(true); if (emptyBox) { emptyBox.hidden = false; emptyBox.style.display = 'flex'; } if (stage) { stage.hidden = true; stage.style.display = 'none'; } if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = `${name} · Uncompiled`; return; } if (emptyBox) { emptyBox.hidden = true; emptyBox.style.display = 'none'; } if (stage) { stage.hidden = false; stage.style.display = 'block'; } // Set map title details const bldCount = mapInfo.building_count ? ` · ${mapInfo.building_count} buildings` : ''; const dims = mapInfo.width_tiles && mapInfo.height_tiles ? ` · ${mapInfo.width_tiles} × ${mapInfo.height_tiles} tiles (${mapInfo.cells_x}×${mapInfo.cells_y} cells)` : ''; if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = `${name}${dims}${bldCount}`; // Populate cell dropdown if available if (cellSelect && Array.isArray(mapInfo.cells)) { cellSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">(Select cell)</option>' + mapInfo.cells.map(([cx, cy]) => `<option value="${cx}_${cy}">Cell ${cx}, ${cy}</option>`).join(''); } // Update sector default coordinates: prefer actual building focus or center const midX = Math.round((mapInfo.width_tiles || 1000) / 2); const midY = Math.round((mapInfo.height_tiles || 1000) / 2); const initX = (typeof mapInfo.focus_x === 'number') ? mapInfo.focus_x : midX; const initY = (typeof mapInfo.focus_y === 'number') ? mapInfo.focus_y : midY; updateSectorInputs(initX, initY, 60, 60); // Pick initial mode: 'town' if available, otherwise 'close', 'inside', or 'sector' let initialMode = 'town'; if (!mapInfo.pictures?.town) { if (mapInfo.pictures?.inside) initialMode = 'inside'; else if (mapInfo.pictures?.close) initialMode = 'close'; else initialMode = 'sector'; } setMode(initialMode); }

nodes.name: closeIsoView
nodes.body_text: function closeIsoView() { activeMap = null; mapInfo = null; currentSector = null; clearBoxSelection(); if (isDrawModeActive) toggleDrawMode(false); finishProgress(true); }

So everything app.js // already does - progress, Stop, errors, the census, retries - works unchanged. (() => { 'use strict'; const ws = { home: true, // Home is showing draft: false, // a new map is being drawn, not yet generated tabs: [], // maps open in this window, by name popped: [], // maps popped out into their own windows tool: 'move', view: 'place', // 'place' (the real map) or 'world' (the game's) pop: null, // the step whose card is open }; // =========================== the frame =========================== const body = document.body; const top = document.querySelector('header.topbar'); const main = document.querySelector('main'); const pane = $('map-pane'); const controls = $('controls'); const results = $('results'); // Anything moved out of sight is kept here, never thrown away: its handlers // stay wired, and it comes back when it is wanted. const holder = make('div', 'ws-holder'); holder.id = 'wsHolder'; body.appendChild(holder); holder.appendChild(results); // Menu bar: the logo and name, the menus, the search, the credit, the rest. const menuSlot = make('nav', 'ws-menus'); menuSlot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Menus'); menuSlot.style.display = 'flex'; top.querySelector('h1').after(menuSlot); menuSlot.after($('search-box')); // The window's language: a small menu by the version, in each language's own // name. world.hidden = true; pane.appendChild(world); // The 2.5D isometric in-game view over the map. const isoView = make('div', 'ws-iso'); isoView.id = 'wsIso'; isoView.hidden = true; pane.appendChild(isoView); nodes.body_text: """A small town for the basement tests: two streets of houses, built and compiled. `extra` adds OpenStreetMap features (a military base, a school) to the same ground. `digest` is what a build put in the game's files: the buildings and the compiled lots, which carry no paths, so two folders can be compared. nodes.name: digest
nodes.body_text: def digest(out: str) -> dict[str, str]: """SHA-1 of every .tbx and every lot file, by name.""" files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(out, "buildings", "*.tbx")) + glob.glob(os.path.join(out, "lots", "*.lot*")) + glob.glob(os.path.join(out, "lots", "chunkdata_*.bin"))) return {os.path.relpath(f, out).replace("\\", "/"): _sha1(f) for f in files}

nodes.body_text: // The pieces of the language matcher that the browser test cannot reach: a // placeholder filled from the text it replaced, and a value that is itself // translated. Both are the difference between a translation that reads right // and one that echoes "Map area" inside a half-translated sentence. // // Run with: node --test tests/js // No packages: the page's own i18n.js is loaded into a Node VM, as // tests/test_i18n_templates.js already does, with only the browser pieces it // touches at load time stubbed out. const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const test = require('node:test'); const vm = require('node:vm'); const root = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..'); test('a placeholder is filled from the sentence it matched', async () => { const language = load({ 'Shape area: {area} km²': 'Fläche: {area} km²' }); await language.translate(); assert.equal(language.t('Shape area: 12 km²'), 'Fläche: 12 km²'); }); test('a value that is itself translated is translated too', async () => { const language = load({ 'Map area': 'Kartenfläche', 'Shape area: {name}': 'Fläche: {name}', }); await language.translate(); assert.equal(language.t('Shape area: Map area'), 'Fläche: Kartenfläche'); assert.equal(language.t('Shape area: km'), 'Fläche: km'); }); test('the spacing around a sentence is kept', async () => { const language = load({ 'Map area': 'Kartenfläche' }); await language.translate(); assert.equal(language.t(' Map area '), ' Kartenfläche '); }); test('text with no translation comes back untouched', async () => { const language = load({ 'Map area': 'Kartenfläche' }); await language.translate(); assert.equal(language.t('Nothing matches this'), 'Nothing matches this'); assert.equal(language.t(''), ''); });

nodes.name: test_api_junk.py
nodes.body_text: """Nothing the window can post should come back as a server error. Every one of these endpoints reads JSON the page sent, and the page is not the only thing that can post to it: an older release's script, a half-finished request, somebody's own tooling. Several of them answered a list where a table was expected with a 500 and a Python message - "'int' object has no attribute 'get'" - which tells the person nothing and reads as KnoxMap falling over. A refusal is fine; 400 and "Expected a sheet." is the right answer to rubbish. A 500 is not. """ import unittest import app as A # Left out on purpose: the ones that write to the config or start work - # saving an area, the Steam libraries, generate, compile, install, update. SAFE_POSTS = [ "/api/client-error", "/api/landmarks", "/api/stop", "/api/presets/validate", "/api/presets/export", "/api/builder/kind", "/api/builder/use", "/api/builder/save", "/api/builder/preview", "/api/builder/autofill", "/api/presets/buildings/probe", "/api/placement/no_such_map", "/api/placement/no_such_map/link", "/api/board/place-beside", "/api/zones/no_such_map", "/api/edits/no_such_map", "/api/design/no_such_map", "/api/sketch/no_such_map", "/api/overpass", ] # A value of the wrong shape at every level: not a dict, not a list, not a # number, and the two strings float() takes and nothing else does. JUNK = [None, "", "x", 5, -1, 1.5, True, [], {}, [1, 2], {"a": 1}, "NaN", "inf", [[1, 2], [3]], [[None]], {"features": 7}, {"name": 5}, {"design": 5}, {"design": {"rooms": "x"}}, {"points": 1.5}, {"cells": "x"}, {"zones": 5}, {"folders": 5}, {"ring": 7}] KEYS = ["name", "map", "neighbour", "side", "cells", "zones", "design", "rooms", "kind", "tbx", "preset", "points", "features", "width", "height", "settings", "scenery"] if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

nodes.name: NoServerErrors
nodes.body_text: class NoServerErrors(unittest.TestCase): def setUp(self): A.app.config["TESTING"] = True self.client = A.app.test_client() def test_every_editor_endpoint_refuses_rubbish_without_falling_over(self): # Each key paired with a different piece of junk, rather than every # pairing: the same lines of code read them, and the suite is run on # every change. bodies = list(JUNK) + [{key: JUNK[i % len(JUNK)]} for i, key in enumerate(KEYS)] bodies += [{key: JUNK[(i + 7) % len(JUNK)]} for i, key in enumerate(KEYS)] for path in SAFE_POSTS: for body in bodies: reply = self.client.post(path, json=body) if reply.status_code >= 500: self.fail(f"{path} answered {reply.status_code} to " f"{body!r}: {reply.get_json()}") def test_and_says_something_rather_than_nothing(self): # A refusal carries a message the window can show. reply = self.client.post("/api/design/no_such_map", json=5) self.assertEqual(reply.status_code, 400) self.assertTrue((reply.get_json() or {}).get("error"))

nodes.name: test_api_mutations.py
nodes.body_text: """What the window can change, and what it must refuse. The endpoints that change something - a place, a version, a restart - were the untested half of the web layer: 73 routes and two test files, and those two only sent rubbish to the ones that read JSON. Two things are worth knowing about every one of them without opening the app: another website cannot reach it, and a request that makes no sense is a refusal rather than a crash. The map's own bookkeeping (knoxbuild/mapstate.py) is here too. It decides what a newer KnoxMap asks to be redone, so getting it wrong means either a map that is silently out of date or a whole rebuild nobody needed. """ import os import tempfile import unittest from unittest import mock import app as A MUTATING = {"POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH"} if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

nodes.name: mutations
nodes.body_text: def mutations() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]: """(rule, a concrete path, a method it accepts) for every route that does more than read. The method matters: a route that only deletes answers a POST with 405 during routing, before the cross-site guard ever runs, so asking every one of them with the same verb would prove nothing about it. """ found = [] for rule in A.app.url_map.iter_rules(): allowed = sorted((rule.methods or set()) & MUTATING) if not allowed: continue path = rule.rule for part in [p for p in path.split("/") if p.startswith("<")]: path = path.replace(part, "no_such_thing") found.append((rule.rule, path, allowed[0])) return sorted(found)

nodes.name: NoOtherWebsiteCanChangeAnything
nodes.body_text: class NoOtherWebsiteCanChangeAnything(unittest.TestCase): """A page in the player's browser can post to 127.0.0.1 - and every one of these used to take it. The port is random, which is not a defence.""" def setUp(self): self.client = A.app.test_client() def test_a_page_on_another_site_is_refused(self): routes = mutations() self.assertGreater(len(routes), 15, f"only found {routes}") for rule, path, method in routes: with self.subTest(route=rule): answer = self.client.open(path, method=method, headers={"Origin": "https://example.invalid"}) self.assertEqual(answer.status_code, 403, f"{rule} answered a request from another site") def test_a_cross_site_request_without_an_origin_is_refused(self): for rule, path, method in mutations(): with self.subTest(route=rule): answer = self.client.open(path, method=method, headers={"Sec-Fetch-Site": "cross-site"}) self.assertEqual(answer.status_code, 403, rule) def test_this_computer_is_let_through_to_the_one_route_that_answers_every_time(self): # The guard must not be a wall: a real page here has to still work. answer = self.client.post("/api/stop", headers={"Origin": "http://127.0.0.1"}) self.assertNotEqual(answer.status_code, 403)

nodes.body_text: """Levels below ground through the .pzw, the cell sources and knoxlots.""" import glob import os import re import shutil import struct import tempfile import unittest import numpy as np from knoxbuild.kcell import SIDE, cell_source from knoxbuild.layout import build_plan from knoxbuild.settings import Settings from knoxbuild.tbx import render_tbx from knoxbuild.world import Placement, render_pzw from tools.building_stats import read_header from tools.compile_map import compile_rust, knoxlots_exe from tools.map_source import project_origin, read_lots from tests.basement_town import build_town SOURCE_CELL = 300 # the .pzw's cells; the game's are 256 (SIDE) @unittest.skipIf(knoxlots_exe() is None, "knoxlots is not built") if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

nodes.name: _add_lot
nodes.signature: def _add_lot(project: str, name: str, tx: int, ty: int, w: int, h: int, level: int) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _add_lot(project: str, name: str, tx: int, ty: int, w: int, h: int, level: int) -> None: """Put a lot into the project's .pzw by hand, in the source cell of its corner.""" stem = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(project)) pzw = os.path.join(project, f"{stem}.pzw") with open(pzw, encoding="utf-8") as f: text = f.read() cx, cy = tx // SOURCE_CELL, ty // SOURCE_CELL line = (f' <lot x="{tx % SOURCE_CELL}" y="{ty % SOURCE_CELL}" level="{level}"' f' width="{w}" height="{h}" map="buildings/{name}"/>\n') m = re.search(rf'<cell x="{cx}" y="{cy}"[^>]*>\n', text) with open(pzw, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(text[:m.end()] + line + text[m.end():])

nodes.name: _levels
nodes.body_text: def _levels(project: str) -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]: return {os.path.basename(p): read_header(p)[1:3] for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(project, "lots", "*.lotheader"))}

nodes.body_text: class SignedLevels(unittest.TestCase): def test_a_lot_at_level_minus_2_is_read_back(self): with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work: project = os.path.join(work, "t") os.makedirs(project) text = render_pzw(1, 1, "t.bmp", [Placement("buildings/a.tbx", 5, 6, 3, 3, base_level=-2)], "t", project) self.assertIn('level="-2"', text) with open(os.path.join(project, "t.pzw"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(text) self.assertEqual(read_lots(project), [("a", 5, 6, -2, 3, 3)]) def test_cell_source_below_ground_is_version_2_and_signed(self): layer = np.zeros((SIDE, SIDE), np.int64) layer[1, 1] = 1 data = cell_source(0, 0, ["floors_a_01_0"], [[layer], [layer]], min_z=-1, rooms=[("storage", -1, [(1, 1, 2, 2)], [])]) version, _cx, _cy, min_z, levels = struct.unpack_from("<3IiI", data, 4) self.assertEqual((version, min_z, levels), (2, -1, 2)) self.assertIn(b"storage" + struct.pack("<iI", -1, 1), data) def test_cell_source_above_ground_is_unchanged(self): layer = np.zeros((SIDE, SIDE), np.int64) self.assertEqual(cell_source(0, 0, [], [[layer]], min_z=0)[4:8], struct.pack("<I", 1))

nodes.body_text: class BasementLotsCompile(unittest.TestCase): @classmethod def setUpClass(cls): cls.work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="bsmt-compile-") cls.base = build_town(os.path.join(cls.work, "town"), Settings(seed=1, basement_share=0.0), compile_lots=False) @classmethod def tearDownClass(cls): shutil.rmtree(cls.work, ignore_errors=True) def _copy(self, name): project = os.path.join(self.work, name) shutil.copytree(self.base, project) os.rename(os.path.join(project, "town.pzw"), os.path.join(project, f"{name}.pzw")) for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(project, "town*")): os.rename(f, os.path.join(project, name + os.path.basename(f)[4:])) return project def test_a_basement_lot_compiles_to_level_minus_1(self): project = self._copy("one") name, tx, ty, _lv, w, h = read_lots(project)[0] shutil.copy(os.path.join(project, "buildings", f"{name}.tbx"), os.path.join(project, "buildings", f"{name}_bsmt.tbx")) _add_lot(project, f"{name}_bsmt.tbx", tx, ty, w, h, -1) compile_rust(project) ox, oy = project_origin(project) cell = f"{(ox + tx) // SIDE}_{(oy + ty) // SIDE}.lotheader" levels = _levels(project) self.assertEqual(levels[cell][0], -1) others = [lv for c, lv in levels.items() if c != cell] self.assertTrue(others and all(lo == 0 for lo, _hi in others)) # Two buildings in the house's own cell: the house, and the basement # under it on its own, as the game's maps have them. rooms, buildings = read_header(os.path.join(project, "lots", cell))[3:5] below = [b for b in buildings if all(rooms[i][1] == -1 for i in b)] self.assertEqual(len(below), 1) self.assertFalse(any({-1, 0} <= {rooms[i][1] for i in b} for b in buildings)) def test_an_installation_across_a_cell_edge_gives_both_cells_min_z(self): project = self._copy("wide") ox, oy = project_origin(project) _name, _tx, ty, *_ = read_lots(project)[0] tx = (ox // SIDE + 1) * SIDE - ox - 20 # 20 tiles west of a cell edge plan = build_plan(40, 10, kind="military", ground=False, seed=2) with open(os.path.join(project, "buildings", "wide_bsmt.tbx"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(render_tbx(plan, "wide")) _add_lot(project, "wide_bsmt.tbx", tx, ty, 40, 10, -2) compile_rust(project) cy = (oy + ty) // SIDE west, east = f"{(ox + tx) // SIDE}_{cy}.lotheader", f"{(ox + tx + 39) // SIDE}_{cy}.lotheader" self.assertNotEqual(west, east) levels = _levels(project) self.assertEqual((levels[west][0], levels[east][0]), (-2, -2)) def test_a_cell_s_levels_cover_every_room_it_lists(self): """A basement's rooms are listed in its building's north-west cell, which need not hold any of its squares.""" project = self._copy("east") name, tx, ty, _lv, w, h = read_lots(project)[0] ox, oy = project_origin(project) bx = ((ox + tx) // SIDE + 1) * SIDE - ox # the next cell east shutil.copy(os.path.join(project, "buildings", f"{name}.tbx"), os.path.join(project, "buildings", f"{name}_bsmt.tbx")) _add_lot(project, f"{name}_bsmt.tbx", bx, ty, w, h, -1) compile_rust(project) for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(project, "lots", "*.lotheader")): _names, lo, hi, rooms, _b = read_header(path) zs = [r[1] for r in rooms] if zs: self.assertTrue(lo <= min(zs) and max(zs) <= hi, f"{os.path.basename(path)}: levels {lo}..{hi}, rooms {sorted(set(zs))}")

nodes.body_text: class BasementTbx(unittest.TestCase): def test_holes_are_written_and_leave_no_floor(self): plan = build_plan(9, 8, seed=4) self.assertTrue(plan.grid[3][2]) # a room square, so it has a floor plan.holes = {(2, 2), (2, 3), (2, 4)} b = parse_tbx(render_tbx(plan, "t")) self.assertIn({"type": "hole", "x": "2", "y": "3"}, [{k: o.get(k) for k in ("type", "x", "y")} for o in b.floors[0].objects]) floor_tiles = [t for t in level_layers(b, 0).get((2, 3), []) if t[0] == "Floor"] self.assertEqual(floor_tiles, []) def test_no_roof_floor_when_asked(self): self.assertGreater(len(parse_tbx(render_tbx(_small(2), "t")).floors), 2) b = parse_tbx(render_tbx(_small(2), "t", roof=False)) self.assertEqual(len(b.floors), 2) self.assertFalse(any(o.get("type") == "roof" for f in b.floors for o in f.objects)) def test_a_flight_on_the_top_storey(self): bld = _small(1) bld.stairs = [(2, 1, "N")] b = parse_tbx(render_tbx(bld, "t", roof=False)) self.assertTrue(any(o.get("type") == "stairs" for o in b.floors[0].objects)) def test_no_roof_even_when_the_style_has_one(self): from knoxbuild.catalog import HOUSE_STYLES style = next(s for s in HOUSE_STYLES if s.get("roof")) b = parse_tbx(render_tbx(_small(1), "t", style, roof=False)) self.assertEqual(len(b.floors), 1) self.assertFalse(any(o.get("type") == "roof" for f in b.floors for o in f.objects))
