nodes.body_text: def say(text: str, fraction: float | None) -> None: _set_progress(map_dir.name, stage="buildings", note=text, fraction=fraction)

nodes.name: api_layout_preview
nodes.body_text: def api_layout_preview(): """A picture of what the building step decided - buildings by use, or the zombie heat map - to judge the settings before a long compile.""" from knoxbuild import layout_preview map_dir = _map_dir(request.args.get("map", "")) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 layer = request.args.get("layer", "kinds") if layer not in layout_preview.LAYERS: return jsonify({"error": f"Unknown layer {layer!r}."}), 400 if not (map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_placements.csv").exists(): return jsonify({"error": "Build the buildings first - there is nothing " "to show until then."}), 400 path = layout_preview.render_to(str(map_dir), layer) return send_file(path, mimetype="image/png", max_age=0)

nodes.name: api_zombies
nodes.body_text: def api_zombies(): """Recount a built map's zombies with new settings, without rebuilding. The spawn map only depends on the buildings' footprints, heights and kinds, which the build saved. Redrawing it takes a second or two against the minutes a full building pass takes, so the zombie dials can be tried freely. The map still needs compiling again for the game to see it. """ from knoxbuild.population import recount data = _json_body() map_dir = _map_dir(data.get("mapName", "")) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 # Same rule as Generate buildings: settings sent with the request stand on # their own. Layering them over the saved ones let a saved value outrank # the preset being asked for, so "town" after a recount at 1.5 stayed 1.5. settings = Settings.from_dict(data.get("settings")) if data.get("settings") else _load_settings(map_dir) try: _save_settings(map_dir, settings) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not save this map's settings: {exc}.", 500, exc) try: summary = recount(str(map_dir), settings) except FileNotFoundError as exc: return failed(f"Cannot recount zombies: {exc}.", 400, exc) return jsonify({"population": summary})

nodes.name: api_worlded
nodes.body_text: def api_worlded(): """Open the generated project in PZWorldEd.""" import subprocess data = _json_body() map_dir = _map_dir(data.get("mapName", "")) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 import knoxpaths exe = _worlded_exe() if exe is None: return jsonify({"error": "PZWorldEd not found. Set the PZWORLDED " "environment variable to its full path."}), 400 pzw = map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}.pzw" if not pzw.exists(): return jsonify({"error": "No .pzw yet — generate the buildings first."}), 400 try: subprocess.Popen(knoxpaths.command_for(exe) + [str(pzw)]) except OSError as exc: # Wine missing, or the tool moved since it was found: a request that # cannot start a program is the caller's problem to read, not a 500. return failed(f"Could not start PZWorldEd: {exc}.", 400, exc) return jsonify({"launched": str(pzw)})

nodes.name: _write_readme
nodes.signature: def _write_readme(map_dir: Path, map_name: str, result: renderer.RenderResult) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _write_readme(map_dir: Path, map_name: str, result: renderer.RenderResult) -> None: text = f"""Project Zomboid map: {map_name} Generated by KnoxMap. Bitmap dimensions: {result.width}x{result.height} tiles Cell grid: {result.cells_x} x {result.cells_y} (cells are always 300 tiles) Files ----- {map_name}.bmp Landscape (base terrain — WorldEd's main input) {map_name}_veg.bmp Vegetation (trees, bushes, long grass) {map_name}_ZombieSpawnMap.bmp Zombie population (grayscale, 1/10 scale) {map_name}_preview.png Human-viewable preview of what you'll get {map_name}_buildings.geojson Building footprints from OSM (for reference) {map_name}_info.json Meta: bbox, scale, cell count {map_name}.zip Everything in this folder, from the web UI How to import (per Thuztor's Mapping Guide v0.2, chapter 2) ----------------------------------------------------------- 1. Open WorldEd (part of the Zomboid Mapping Tools). 2. File -> New, and choose a {result.cells_x} x {result.cells_y} cell grid. 3. From your file browser, drag {map_name}.bmp onto the empty grid. (WorldEd reads the matching {map_name}_veg.bmp automatically if it sits next to the landscape bitmap with the same base filename.) 4. File -> BMP to TMX -> All cells. Set an export folder for the .tmx output. 5. Open the resulting project in WorldEd / TileZed to place buildings (.tbx files) on top of the landscape. This tool does NOT place PZ buildings — OSM building footprints are exported as GeoJSON for reference only. 6. File -> Generate Lots. This produces .lotheader + .lotpack files. 7. Copy those into your game's media/maps folder (see chapter 9 of the guide for offset / world-origin details). Notes ----- * Roads render as asphalt (residential = light, secondary = medium, primary/motorway = dark). Paths and tracks render as dirt lines. * Forests render as dense trees in the interior and a grass+tree blend at the edges so the transition isn't a hard rectangle. * The spawn map is generated procedurally: higher density on asphalt, zero on water, slight randomness throughout. * OSM building footprints CANNOT be converted directly to PZ buildings — PZ buildings are a separate thing you assemble in BuildingEd (.tbx). The GeoJSON file lets you see where buildings would sit in the real world and drop matching .tbx lots in the right tiles. """ # UTF-8 whatever the PC's code page: the text has dashes that a Korean or # Japanese Windows cannot write in its own, and the whole generate request # failed on them after the map was already drawn. (map_dir / "README.txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

nodes.name: geo.py
nodes.body_text: """Where things are: the map tiles, the place search, landmarks and the Overpass servers.""" from __future__ import annotations import json import re import shutil import subprocess import threading import time import urllib.parse from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request, send_file from generator import osm, places from web.checks import BIG_LANDMARK_KM2 from web.common import CACHE_DIR, _bbox_area_km2, _json_body, log bp = Blueprint("geo", __name__) # ---- map tiles, fetched the way the OSM tile policy asks ------------------------- # # https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ - an installed app must # identify itself with its own User-Agent (never a browser's), honour the # server's caching headers or keep tiles at least 7 days, and never pre-fetch # or bulk-download. The page's map used to load tiles straight from # tile.openstreetmap.org inside the app window, which sent WebView2's browser # identity and cached nothing. Tiles now come through here: fetched only when # the map shows them, with KnoxMap's User-Agent, kept on disk and revalidated. TILE_URL = "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" TILE_CACHE = CACHE_DIR / "tiles" TILE_MIN_AGE = 7 * 24 * 3600 # How many tiles are fetched at once. A map view is twenty or thirty tiles, # and at two at a time they arrived in a slow ripple; a browser asking # tile.openstreetmap.org directly opens six connections, so four through one # proxy is no heavier than the page would be on its own. This is interactive # browsing, not the bulk downloading the tile policy asks people not to do. TILE_FETCHES = threading.BoundedSemaphore(4) # One connection pool for all of them. Without it every tile paid for a new # TCP connection and a TLS handshake - most of the wait, on a map of tiles # that are only a few kilobytes each. TILE_TIMEOUT = (5, 15) # connect, read _TILE_SESSION = None _TILE_SESSION_LOCK = threading.Lock() # Tiles being revalidated in the background, so a stale one is not fetched # once per request while the first fetch is still running. _TILE_REVALIDATING: set = set() @bp.route("/tiles/<int:z>/<int:x>/<int:y>.png") # Nominatim asks that results are cached on the application's side and that # the same query is not sent again and again # (https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/). _SEARCH_CACHE: dict[tuple, tuple[float, list]] = {} SEARCH_CACHE_SECONDS = 24 * 3600 @bp.route("/api/search") @bp.route("/api/landmarks", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/overpass", methods=["GET", "POST"]) @bp.route("/api/overpass/status") # ---- a server of your own, in Docker --------------------------------------------- # # docs/SELF_HOSTING_OVERPASS.md by hand, as buttons. KnoxMap only starts and # stops one container of its own name; the extract has to come from Geofabrik. LOCAL_NAME = "knoxmap-overpass" LOCAL_PORT = 12345 LOCAL_URL = f"http://localhost:{LOCAL_PORT}/api/interpreter" LOCAL_EXTRACT = re.compile(r"^https://download\.geofabrik\.de/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.osm\.pbf$") # The image saves every download as planet.osm.bz2 before running this hook. LOCAL_PBF_PREPROCESS = ( "mv /db/planet.osm.bz2 /db/planet.osm.pbf && " "osmium cat /db/planet.osm.pbf -o /db/planet.osm.bz2 && " "rm /db/planet.osm.pbf" ) @bp.route("/api/local-overpass", methods=["GET", "POST"]) # ---- the extract a developer picked, and the check on it ----------------------- # A file dialog has to run where a window can be made, so it runs in its own # interpreter and prints the path back: tkinter in the server's thread is not a # thing to rely on, and a cancelled dialog is an empty line. _PICK_SCRIPT = """ import tkinter as tk from tkinter import filedialog root = tk.Tk() root.withdraw() root.attributes("-topmost", True) print(filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose an OpenStreetMap extract", filetypes=[("OpenStreetMap extract", "*.pbf"), ("All files", "*.*")]) or "") """ @bp.route("/api/tools/pbf/browse") @bp.route("/api/tools/pbf/check", methods=["POST"])

nodes.name: _tile_session
nodes.body_text: def _tile_session(): global _TILE_SESSION with _TILE_SESSION_LOCK: if _TILE_SESSION is None: import requests from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter session = requests.Session() adapter = HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=4, pool_maxsize=8) session.mount("https://", adapter) session.headers["User-Agent"] = places.HEADERS["User-Agent"] _TILE_SESSION = session return _TILE_SESSION

nodes.name: _fetch_tile
nodes.signature: def _fetch_tile(z: int, x: int, y: int, path, meta, info: dict) -> bool
nodes.body_text: def _fetch_tile(z: int, x: int, y: int, path, meta, info: dict) -> bool: """Fetch or revalidate one tile. True when it is on disk afterwards.""" import requests headers = {} if path.exists() and info.get("etag"): headers["If-None-Match"] = info["etag"] try: with TILE_FETCHES: r = _tile_session().get(TILE_URL.format(z=z, x=x, y=y), headers=headers, timeout=TILE_TIMEOUT) except requests.RequestException: return path.exists() if r.status_code not in (200, 304): return path.exists() max_age = TILE_MIN_AGE for part in (r.headers.get("Cache-Control") or "").split(","): if part.strip().startswith("max-age="): try: max_age = max(TILE_MIN_AGE, int(part.split("=", 1)[1])) except ValueError: pass if r.status_code == 200: path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) path.write_bytes(r.content) info["etag"] = r.headers.get("ETag") info["expires"] = time.time() + max_age try: meta.write_text(json.dumps(info), encoding="utf-8") except OSError: pass return path.exists()

nodes.name: tile
nodes.signature: def tile(z: int, x: int, y: int)
nodes.body_text: def tile(z: int, x: int, y: int): if not (0 <= z <= 19 and 0 <= x < 2 ** z and 0 <= y < 2 ** z): return ("", 404) path = TILE_CACHE / str(z) / str(x) / f"{y}.png" meta = path.with_suffix(".json") info = {} if path.exists() and meta.exists(): try: info = json.loads(meta.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) except (OSError, ValueError): info = {} fresh = path.exists() and time.time() < info.get("expires", 0) if path.exists() and not fresh: # A tile we already have is served straight away and checked against # the server behind the page's back. Waiting on that round trip made # panning back over somewhere already visited as slow as the first # time, for a picture of a street that had not changed in a week. key = (z, x, y) if key not in _TILE_REVALIDATING: _TILE_REVALIDATING.add(key) def revalidate(): try: _fetch_tile(z, x, y, path, meta, info) finally: _TILE_REVALIDATING.discard(key) threading.Thread(target=revalidate, name=f"tile-{z}-{x}-{y}", daemon=True).start() elif not fresh and not _fetch_tile(z, x, y, path, meta, info): return ("", 502) resp = send_file(path, mimetype="image/png") resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = f"max-age={TILE_MIN_AGE}" return resp

nodes.name: revalidate
nodes.body_text: def revalidate(): try: _fetch_tile(z, x, y, path, meta, info) finally: _TILE_REVALIDATING.discard(key)

nodes.name: api_search
nodes.body_text: def api_search(): """Find a place by name, so the map can jump to it.""" q = request.args.get("q", "") if not q.strip(): return jsonify({"results": []}) viewbox = None try: viewbox = (float(request.args["south"]), float(request.args["west"]), float(request.args["north"]), float(request.args["east"])) except (KeyError, ValueError): pass bounded = request.args.get("bounded") == "1" key = (q.strip().lower(), viewbox and tuple(round(v, 3) for v in viewbox), bounded) cached = _SEARCH_CACHE.get(key) if cached and time.time() - cached[0] < SEARCH_CACHE_SECONDS: return jsonify({"results": cached[1]}) try: results = places.search(q, viewbox=viewbox, bounded=bounded) except Exception as exc: # network, rate limit, bad JSON return jsonify({"error": f"Search failed: {exc}"}), 502 if len(_SEARCH_CACHE) > 500: _SEARCH_CACHE.clear() _SEARCH_CACHE[key] = (time.time(), results) return jsonify({"results": results})

nodes.name: api_landmarks
nodes.body_text: def api_landmarks(): """List the named landmarks inside a bbox.""" data = _json_body() try: south = float(data["south"]) west = float(data["west"]) north = float(data["north"]) east = float(data["east"]) except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError): return jsonify({"error": "Need south, west, north and east."}), 400 landmark_area = _bbox_area_km2(south, west, north, east) if landmark_area > BIG_LANDMARK_KM2: # Slow, not impossible. It used to be refused outright. log.info("landmarks: %.1f km2, over the %g km2 this gets slow at", landmark_area, BIG_LANDMARK_KM2) try: found = places.landmarks(south, west, north, east) except Exception as exc: return jsonify({"error": f"Lookup failed: {exc}"}), 502 return jsonify({"landmarks": found})

nodes.name: api_overpass
nodes.body_text: def api_overpass(): """Which Overpass servers map data is downloaded from. The public ones by default; your own (docs/SELF_HOSTING_OVERPASS.md) when named here. Saved as "overpass_endpoints" in knoxmap_config.json and used at once, so a download started after saving already goes there.""" import knoxpaths if request.method == "POST": body = _json_body() if "osm_source" in body: src = str(body["osm_source"]).strip().lower() if src in ("auto", "overpass", "extract"): knoxpaths.update_config({"osm_source": src}) log.info("osm source set to %s", src) if "pbf_file" in body: import os as _os picked = str(body.get("pbf_file") or "").strip() if picked: picked = _os.path.abspath(_os.path.expanduser(picked)) if not _os.path.isfile(picked): return jsonify({"error": f"There is no file at {picked}."}), 400 knoxpaths.update_config({"pbf_file": picked}) log.info("osm extract picked: %s", picked or "none (by area)") if "endpoints" in body: raw = body.get("endpoints") if raw is None or raw == "": raw = [] if isinstance(raw, str): raw = re.split(r"[\s,;]+", raw) if not isinstance(raw, list): return jsonify({"error": "Give the servers as a list of addresses."}), 400 try: urls = osm.normalise_endpoints(raw) except ValueError as exc: return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 400 if len(urls) > 8: return jsonify({"error": "At most 8 servers."}), 400 knoxpaths.update_config({"overpass_endpoints": urls}) osm.set_endpoints(urls) log.info("overpass servers: %s", urls or "the public ones") try: cfg = knoxpaths.load_config() configured = cfg.get("overpass_endpoints") current_source = cfg.get("osm_source") or "auto" except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 configured = None current_source = "auto" return jsonify({"endpoints": [str(u) for u in configured] if isinstance(configured, list) else [], "using": list(osm.OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS), "public": list(osm._DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS), "osm_source": current_source if current_source in ("auto", "overpass", "extract") else "auto", "pbf_file": str(cfg.get("pbf_file") or "")})

nodes.name: api_overpass_status
nodes.body_text: def api_overpass_status(): """Whether each server in use answers right now, and how fast. One tiny query per server, asked together, so this costs a few seconds in all. "resting" is what the downloads themselves currently think of it.""" from concurrent import futures def one(endpoint: str) -> dict: t0 = time.time() ok = osm._probe(endpoint, 40.0, -74.0) return {"url": endpoint, "host": endpoint.split("/")[2], "ok": ok, "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "resting": osm._is_cooling(endpoint), "regional": any(h in endpoint for h in osm.BLANK_ONLY_HOSTS)} endpoints = list(osm.OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS) with futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, len(endpoints))) as pool: return jsonify({"servers": list(pool.map(one, endpoints))})

nodes.name: one
nodes.body_text: def one(endpoint: str) -> dict: t0 = time.time() ok = osm._probe(endpoint, 40.0, -74.0) return {"url": endpoint, "host": endpoint.split("/")[2], "ok": ok, "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "resting": osm._is_cooling(endpoint), "regional": any(h in endpoint for h in osm.BLANK_ONLY_HOSTS)}

nodes.name: _docker
nodes.body_text: def _docker(*args: str, timeout: int = 30) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess: return subprocess.run(["docker", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, errors="replace")

nodes.name: _local_state
nodes.body_text: def _local_state() -> dict: """Docker present or not, and what the container is doing.""" import requests if not shutil.which("docker"): return {"docker": False, "state": "none", "url": LOCAL_URL} try: ps = _docker("ps", "-a", "--filter", f"name=^{LOCAL_NAME}$", "--format", "{{.State}}") except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError): return {"docker": False, "state": "none", "url": LOCAL_URL} if ps.returncode != 0: return {"docker": False, "state": "none", "url": LOCAL_URL, "error": (ps.stderr or "").strip()[-300:]} running = ps.stdout.strip() if not running: return {"docker": True, "state": "none", "url": LOCAL_URL} out = {"docker": True, "url": LOCAL_URL, "state": "stopped" if running != "running" else "loading"} if running == "running": try: ready = requests.get(f"http://localhost:{LOCAL_PORT}/api/status", timeout=3).ok except requests.RequestException: ready = False out["state"] = "ready" if ready else "loading" if not ready: try: tail = _docker("logs", "--tail", "1", LOCAL_NAME).stdout tail = tail or _docker("logs", "--tail", "1", LOCAL_NAME).stderr out["log"] = (tail or "").strip()[-200:] except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError): pass return out

nodes.name: api_local_overpass
nodes.body_text: def api_local_overpass(): """Run, stop, remove or start using a local Overpass server in Docker.""" import knoxpaths if request.method == "GET": return jsonify(_local_state()) body = _json_body() action = str(body.get("action") or "") state = _local_state() if action in ("start", "stop", "remove") and not state["docker"]: return jsonify({"error": "Docker is not installed or not running. Install Docker " "Desktop, start it, and try again."}), 400 try: if action == "start": if state["state"] == "none": extract = str(body.get("extract") or "").strip() if not LOCAL_EXTRACT.fullmatch(extract): return jsonify({"error": "Give a Geofabrik extract ending in .osm.pbf, " "e.g. https://download.geofabrik.de/north-america/" "us/tennessee-latest.osm.pbf"}), 400 r = _docker("run", "-d", "--name", LOCAL_NAME, "-p", f"127.0.0.1:{LOCAL_PORT}:80", "-v", "knoxmap_overpass_db:/db", "-e", "OVERPASS_MODE=init", "-e", f"OVERPASS_PLANET_URL={extract}", "-e", "OVERPASS_RULES_LOAD=10", "-e", f"OVERPASS_PLANET_PREPROCESS={LOCAL_PBF_PREPROCESS}", "wiktorn/overpass-api", timeout=600) else: r = _docker("start", LOCAL_NAME) elif action == "stop": r = _docker("stop", LOCAL_NAME, timeout=120) elif action == "remove": r = _docker("rm", "-f", LOCAL_NAME, timeout=120) elif action == "use": current = [u for u in osm.OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS if u != LOCAL_URL] urls = [LOCAL_URL] + current knoxpaths.update_config({"overpass_endpoints": urls}) osm.set_endpoints(urls) log.info("overpass servers: %s", urls) return jsonify(_local_state()) else: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown action."}), 400 except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc: return jsonify({"error": f"Docker did not answer: {exc}"}), 502 if r.returncode != 0: return jsonify({"error": (r.stderr or r.stdout or "docker failed").strip()[-400:]}), 502 log.info("local overpass: %s", action) return jsonify(_local_state())

nodes.name: api_pbf_browse
nodes.body_text: def api_pbf_browse(): """Ask Windows for the extract file. Empty answer = the dialog was closed.""" import subprocess as sp import sys try: done = sp.run([sys.executable, "-c", _PICK_SCRIPT], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300) except (OSError, sp.SubprocessError) as exc: return jsonify({"error": f"The file dialog could not open: {exc}"}), 502 if done.returncode != 0: detail = (done.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()[-1:] or ["no window"] return jsonify({"error": f"The file dialog could not open: {detail[0]}"}), 502 return jsonify({"path": (done.stdout or "").strip()})

nodes.name: api_pbf_check
nodes.body_text: def api_pbf_check(): """Check an extract: is it whole, is it the right place, is there anything in it to draw. `path` defaults to the one saved in the settings.""" from generator import pbfcheck body = _json_body() path = str(body.get("path") or "").strip() if not path: from generator import extract path = extract.local_path() # the one picked, env or settings bbox = body.get("bbox") if isinstance(bbox, list) and len(bbox) == 4: bbox = tuple(float(v) for v in bbox) else: bbox = None limit = body.get("limit") kwargs = {"limit": int(limit)} if isinstance(limit, int) and limit > 0 else {} result = pbfcheck.check(path, bbox=bbox, **kwargs) result["report"] = pbfcheck.report_text(result) log.info("pbf check %s: %s", path or "(none)", "usable" if result["ok"] else "not usable") return jsonify(result)

nodes.name: jobs.py
nodes.body_text: """Progress and stop requests for the long jobs: generate, build and compile.""" from __future__ import annotations import threading from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request from web.common import _json_body, failed, log bp = Blueprint("jobs", __name__) # Big maps take minutes, so generation reports where it has got to and the page # polls /api/progress. Keyed by map name; the generate call owns its entry. _PROGRESS: dict[str, dict] = {} _COMPILE: dict[str, dict] = {} _PROGRESS_LOCK = threading.Lock() # Maps the window has asked to stop. A long job looks at this between the # pieces of work it can be interrupted between (knoxstop.py); the name comes # off the list when the job it stopped notices, so the next run is not # stopped before it starts. _STOPPING: set[str] = set() # Every job, at once: the window has closed (knoxmap.py). _STOP_ALL = threading.Event() @bp.route("/api/stop", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/progress")

nodes.name: _set_progress
nodes.body_text: def _set_progress(map_name: str, **fields) -> None: with _PROGRESS_LOCK: _PROGRESS.setdefault(map_name, {}).update(fields) # Discord Rich Presence, if the player asked for it. It is a set on a # background thread and nothing here waits on it: knoxpresence swallows # its own errors so a Discord that is closed, restarting or not installed # cannot interrupt a map halfway through. if "stage" in fields: try: import knoxpresence knoxpresence.stage(str(fields["stage"])) except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - presence is never worth a failure pass

nodes.name: _stopper
nodes.body_text: def _stopper(map_name: str): """A callable the long jobs poll: True once the window has asked.""" return lambda: map_name in _STOPPING or _STOP_ALL.is_set()

nodes.name: stop_all
nodes.body_text: def stop_all() -> None: """Ask every running job to stop, as the window does when it closes.""" _STOP_ALL.set() log.info("stop: every job, the window has closed")

nodes.name: _hold
nodes.body_text: def _hold(map_dir, doing: str): """Take the map's lock for the length of this request, so a second KnoxMap process cannot generate, build or compile the same map alongside it (tools/compile_map.claim). Returns the reply to send instead when another one holds it, else None; the lock goes with the reply.""" import uuid from flask import after_this_request from tools.compile_map import claim, release run = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] try: claim(map_dir, run, doing) except RuntimeError as exc: return failed(str(exc), 409) @after_this_request def _let_go(response): release(map_dir, run) return response return None

nodes.name: _let_go
nodes.body_text: def _let_go(response): release(map_dir, run) return response

nodes.name: _done_stopping
nodes.body_text: def _done_stopping(map_name: str) -> None: _STOPPING.discard(map_name)

nodes.name: _stopped
nodes.body_text: def _stopped(map_name: str, step: str): """The reply for a job the window stopped: not an error, and the map's area and settings are untouched.""" _done_stopping(map_name) log.info("stop %s: %s stopped", map_name, step) with _PROGRESS_LOCK: _PROGRESS.setdefault(map_name, {})["stage"] = "stopped" return jsonify({"stopped": True, "step": step, "mapName": map_name}), 409

nodes.name: api_stop
nodes.body_text: def api_stop(): """Stop making this map, and leave everything else as it is. The drawn area, the settings and whatever has already been written stay where they are: pressing the button again starts the same map over. Used to mean closing the window, which threw the drawn rectangle away with it. """ name = str((_json_body() or {}).get("mapName", "")).strip() if not name: return failed("Which map?", 400) _STOPPING.add(name) log.info("stop %s: asked by the window", name) with _PROGRESS_LOCK: _PROGRESS.setdefault(name, {})["stage"] = "stopping" if _COMPILE.get(name, {}).get("state") == "running": _COMPILE[name] = {**_COMPILE[name], "state": "stopping"} return jsonify({"stopping": True, "mapName": name})

nodes.name: api_progress
nodes.body_text: def api_progress(): with _PROGRESS_LOCK: return jsonify(_PROGRESS.get(request.args.get("map", ""), {}))

nodes.name: mapfiles.py
nodes.body_text: """Files that belong to one map folder: its settings, edits, sketch and design.""" from __future__ import annotations import json from pathlib import Path import knoxfiles import knoxlog from generator import edits as mapedits from generator import osm, renderer from knoxbuild import mapstate from knoxbuild.settings import Settings SETTINGS_FILE = "settings.json" # ---- editing what a map was built from ------------------------------------------ # # The download stays the download: what the mapper changed about it is kept # beside the map as a short list of changes, keyed by each feature's own OSM # id (generator/edits.py). A town is a hundred thousand features and nearly # all of them are untouched, so this is a few lines where a copy would be # megabytes - and a re-download does not throw the editing away. # ---- the drawn map -------------------------------------------------------------- # # What was drawn by hand for a map, as GeoJSON, next to the map it belongs to. # It is kept rather than converted and thrown away because it is the only copy: # the features it becomes go into the render and are gone, so without this a # map could never be opened and its drawing changed.

nodes.name: _settings_path
nodes.body_text: def _settings_path(map_dir: Path) -> Path: return map_dir / SETTINGS_FILE

nodes.name: _load_settings
nodes.body_text: def _load_settings(map_dir: Path) -> Settings: """This map's saved settings, or the defaults.""" try: with open(_settings_path(map_dir), encoding="utf-8") as f: return Settings.from_dict(json.load(f)) except (OSError, ValueError): return Settings()

nodes.name: _save_settings
nodes.signature: def _save_settings(map_dir: Path, settings: Settings) -> None: # Do not start a build with settings that cannot be saved for its next step.
nodes.body_text: def _save_settings(map_dir: Path, settings: Settings) -> None: # Do not start a build with settings that cannot be saved for its next step. knoxfiles.write(str(_settings_path(map_dir)), settings.to_dict(), indent=2)

nodes.name: _osm_cache_for
nodes.signature: def _osm_cache_for(map_dir: Path, bbox, meters_per_tile: float, settings: Settings) -> tuple[str, tuple]
nodes.body_text: def _osm_cache_for(map_dir: Path, bbox, meters_per_tile: float, settings: Settings) -> tuple[str, tuple]: """Where this map's download lives, and the box it covers. A map turned to its street grid reaches past the drawn box at its corners and is fetched as the circle round it, under its own name. The editor and the generator both ask here, so they cannot look in different files. """ south, west, north, east = bbox if bool(settings.align_streets) or bool(settings.rotate_degrees): return (osm.cache_path(str(map_dir), f"{map_dir.name}_turned"), renderer.cover_bbox(south, west, north, east, meters_per_tile)) return osm.cache_path(str(map_dir), map_dir.name), tuple(bbox)

nodes.name: _edits_path
nodes.body_text: def _edits_path(map_dir: Path) -> Path: return map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_edits.json"

nodes.name: _load_edits
nodes.body_text: def _load_edits(map_dir: Path) -> dict: try: with open(_edits_path(map_dir), encoding="utf-8") as f: return mapedits.clean(json.load(f)) except (OSError, ValueError): return mapedits.empty()

nodes.name: _save_edits
nodes.body_text: def _save_edits(map_dir: Path, changes: dict) -> None: map_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) knoxfiles.write(str(_edits_path(map_dir)), mapedits.clean(changes))

nodes.name: _sketch_path
nodes.body_text: def _sketch_path(map_dir: Path) -> Path: return map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_sketch.geojson"

nodes.name: _load_sketch
nodes.body_text: def _load_sketch(map_dir: Path) -> dict: try: with open(_sketch_path(map_dir), encoding="utf-8") as f: drawn = json.load(f) except (OSError, ValueError): return {"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": []} return drawn if isinstance(drawn, dict) else { "type": "FeatureCollection", "features": []}

nodes.name: _save_sketch
nodes.signature: def _save_sketch(map_dir: Path, drawn: dict | None) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _save_sketch(map_dir: Path, drawn: dict | None) -> None: """Written whole through a temporary file, so a crash part way cannot leave a half-written drawing where the drawing was.""" if not isinstance(drawn, dict): return map_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) knoxfiles.write(str(_sketch_path(map_dir)), drawn)

nodes.name: _design_path
nodes.body_text: def _design_path(map_dir: Path) -> Path: return map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_design.json"

nodes.name: _load_design
nodes.body_text: def _load_design(map_dir: Path) -> dict | None: try: with open(_design_path(map_dir), encoding="utf-8") as f: design = json.load(f) except (OSError, ValueError): return None return design if isinstance(design, dict) else None

nodes.name: _save_design
nodes.body_text: def _save_design(map_dir: Path, design: dict) -> None: map_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) knoxfiles.write(str(_design_path(map_dir)), design)

nodes.name: _map_summary
nodes.body_text: def _map_summary(map_dir: Path) -> dict: """What the window shows for a map it did not just make.""" info = {} try: with open(map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_info.json", encoding="utf-8") as f: info = json.load(f) except (OSError, ValueError): pass needs = mapstate.needs(str(map_dir)) stages = mapstate.done(str(map_dir)) inst = mapstate.installed(str(map_dir)) compiled_at = (stages.get("compile") or {}).get("at") # The build as stamped, not guessed from a .pzw: a new Generate forgets it. built = (mapstate.read(str(map_dir)).get("stages") or {}).get("build") return { "mapName": map_dir.name, "width": info.get("width_tiles", 0), "height": info.get("height_tiles", 0), "cellsX": info.get("cells_x", 0), "cellsY": info.get("cells_y", 0), "featureCount": info.get("feature_count") or info.get("building_count", 0), "rotation": round(info.get("rotation", 0.0), 1), "updated": int(map_dir.stat().st_mtime), # What it was made from, so the window can run the steps again # over the same area without asking for it to be drawn afresh. "bbox": info.get("bbox"), "metersPerTile": info.get("meters_per_tile", 1.0), "shape": info.get("shape"), # The settings this map was made with. Upgrading it sent none at all, # so a map drawn with Knox County roads or a tree density of its own # came back with the defaults and looked like a different town. "settings": _load_settings(map_dir).to_dict(), "madeWith": mapstate.made_with(str(map_dir)), "current": knoxlog.version(), "stages": {k: v.get("version") for k, v in stages.items()}, # Its buildings were built and not drawn over since (a new Generate # forgets the build stamp), so it can be compiled as it stands. The # window only offered Compile straight after a build, so after a # restart a built city had to be built again - hours - to compile it. "buildingsReady": bool(built) and (map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}.pzw").exists(), "builtAt": (built or {}).get("at"), "needs": needs, "needsLabels": [mapstate.LABELS[s] for s in needs], # Where it is installed, and whether that copy came after the last # compile - an install from before a recompile is out of date. "installed": None if inst is None else { "modRoot": inst["modRoot"], "at": inst.get("at"), "upToDate": not compiled_at or (inst.get("at") or "") >= compiled_at, }, "files": { "landscape": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/{map_dir.name}.bmp", "vegetation": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/{map_dir.name}_veg.bmp", "spawn": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/{map_dir.name}_ZombieSpawnMap.bmp", "preview": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/{map_dir.name}_preview.png", "buildings": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/{map_dir.name}_buildings.geojson", "meta": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/{map_dir.name}_info.json", "zip": f"/download/{map_dir.name}.zip", "readme": f"/output/{map_dir.name}/README.txt", }, }

nodes.name: _population
nodes.body_text: def _population(map_dir: Path) -> dict | None: try: with open(map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_population.json", encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f) except (OSError, ValueError): return None

nodes.name: maps.py
nodes.body_text: """Maps already made: the list, the files they serve, lots and placement, saving and downloading.""" from __future__ import annotations import io import zipfile from pathlib import Path from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request, send_file, send_from_directory import knoxlog from web import common from web.common import CACHE_DIR, SAFE_NAME, _json_body, _map_dir, failed, log from web.mapfiles import _load_settings, _map_summary, _population bp = Blueprint("maps", __name__) @bp.route("/api/maps") @bp.route("/api/maps/<map_name>", methods=["GET", "DELETE"]) @bp.route("/output/<path:relpath>") @bp.route("/api/lots") @bp.route("/api/placement/<name>", methods=["GET", "POST", "DELETE"]) @bp.route("/api/placement/<name>/link", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/world-picture/<name>") @bp.route("/api/iso-info/<name>") @bp.route("/api/iso-render/<name>") @bp.route("/api/save", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/download/<map_name>.zip")

nodes.name: api_maps
nodes.body_text: def api_maps(): """Every map in output/, newest first, and whether an older KnoxMap made it - so one can be opened again instead of drawn from scratch.""" maps = [] for entry in common.OUTPUT_DIR.iterdir(): if not entry.is_dir() or not (entry / f"{entry.name}_info.json").exists(): continue maps.append(_map_summary(entry)) maps.sort(key=lambda m: -m["updated"]) return jsonify({"maps": maps, "current": knoxlog.version()})

nodes.name: api_map
nodes.body_text: def api_map(map_name: str): """One map: GET shows its summary; DELETE removes its folder in output/ and any installed mod in ~/Zomboid/mods.""" map_dir = _map_dir(map_name) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 if request.method == "DELETE": from web.jobs import _COMPILE, _PROGRESS_LOCK with _PROGRESS_LOCK: compiling = _COMPILE.get(map_dir.name, {}).get("state") in ("running", "stopping") if compiling: return jsonify({"error": "The map is busy. Stop it first."}), 409 # If installed, also clean up the installed mod in ~/Zomboid/mods try: from knoxbuild import mapstate from tools import make_map_mod rec = mapstate.installed(str(map_dir)) if rec and "modRoot" in rec: mod_root = Path(rec["modRoot"]).resolve() if mod_root.is_dir() and mod_root.parent.name == "mods": info_file = mod_root / "mod.info" if info_file.is_file() and "generated from real-world map data with KnoxMap" in info_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"): make_map_mod._clear_folder(str(mod_root)) except Exception as exc: log.warning("Could not remove mod during map delete %s: %s", map_dir.name, exc) import shutil try: shutil.rmtree(map_dir) log.info("deleted map project: %s", map_dir.name) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not delete map folder: {exc}", 500, exc) return jsonify({"deleted": map_dir.name}) summary = _map_summary(map_dir) summary["settings"] = _load_settings(map_dir).to_dict() summary["population"] = _population(map_dir) return jsonify(summary)

nodes.name: serve_output
nodes.body_text: def serve_output(relpath: str): return send_from_directory(common.OUTPUT_DIR, relpath)

nodes.name: api_lots
nodes.body_text: def api_lots(): """Has WorldEd's Generate Lots produced anything yet?""" map_dir = _map_dir(request.args.get("map", "")) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 lots = map_dir / "lots" cells = sorted(lots.glob("*.lotheader")) if lots.is_dir() else [] return jsonify({"compiled": bool(cells), "cells": len(cells)})

nodes.name: api_placement
nodes.body_text: def api_placement(name: str): """Where this map stands in the game's world, and where to put it. GET is the world as the window draws it: Knox County, the maps already installed, and this one. POST moves this one, which rewrites the few files that carry the world origin and says whether the map has to be compiled again (knoxbuild/placement.py). DELETE goes back to having a place picked automatically. """ from knoxbuild import placement as P map_dir = _map_dir(name) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Bad map name."}), 400 if request.method == "GET": return jsonify(P.layout(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, str(CACHE_DIR))) # A compile reads the map's place once, when it starts: moving the map under # it leaves lots named for the old place, refused at install as "moved". from web.jobs import _COMPILE, _PROGRESS_LOCK with _PROGRESS_LOCK: compiling = _COMPILE.get(map_dir.name, {}).get("state") in ("running", "stopping") if compiling: return jsonify({"error": "The map is compiling. Move it, or change Standalone, " "once the compile has finished."}), 409 if request.method == "DELETE": done = P.unplace(str(map_dir), map_dir.name) log.info("placement %s: automatic, now cell %s (was %s)", map_dir.name, done["origin"], done["was"]) out = P.layout(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, str(CACHE_DIR)) out["moved"] = done return jsonify(out) body = _json_body() try: if "standalone" in body and body.get("cell_x") is None: done = P.set_standalone(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, body.get("standalone") is True) log.info("placement %s: standalone %s, now cell %s (was %s)", map_dir.name, body.get("standalone") is True, done["origin"], done["was"]) out = P.layout(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, str(CACHE_DIR)) out["moved"] = done return jsonify(out) done = P.move(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, (body.get("cell_x"), body.get("cell_y"))) log.info("placement %s: now cell %s (was %s)", map_dir.name, done["origin"], done["was"]) except ValueError as exc: return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 400 except OSError as exc: return failed(f"The map could not be moved: {exc}", 500, exc) out = P.layout(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, str(CACHE_DIR)) out["moved"] = done return jsonify(out)

nodes.name: api_placement_link
nodes.body_text: def api_placement_link(name: str): """The sheet for a road drawn between this map and another. The window sends where the road was drawn, in world tiles; what comes back is a map to build (generator/sketch.py): the strip of country it runs through, at the same scale as the map it joins so the road is the same width in tiles as the streets it meets. """ from knoxbuild import placement as P map_dir = _map_dir(name) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Bad map name."}), 400 body = _json_body() try: out = P.link_design(str(map_dir), map_dir.name, body.get("points"), str(body.get("kind") or "primary"), scenery=body.get("scenery", True) is not False) except ValueError as exc: return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 400 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001 - reported return failed(f"That road could not be laid out: {exc}", 500, exc) out["name"] = f"{map_dir.name}_link" return jsonify(out)

nodes.name: api_world_picture
nodes.body_text: def api_world_picture(name: str): """The picture of a map already in the game, for the world view. Assembled from that map's own tile pyramid in the player's install and kept in the cache. It is their copy of the game, read on their own PC and shown in their own window; nothing is copied into a map or shipped. """ from knoxbuild import placement as P where = P.picture_for(name, str(CACHE_DIR)) if not where: return jsonify({"error": "No picture of that map."}), 404 return send_file(where["file"], mimetype="image/png", max_age=86400, conditional=True)

nodes.name: api_iso_info
nodes.body_text: def api_iso_info(name: str): """Metadata about a map's compiled isometric views.""" import json map_dir = _map_dir(name) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 lots = map_dir / "lots" compiled = lots.is_dir() and any(lots.glob("*.lotheader")) info_path = map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_info.json" info = {} if info_path.is_file(): try: info = json.loads(info_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) except Exception: pass pics_dir = map_dir / "pictures" pictures = {} if pics_dir.is_dir(): for p in ("town.png", "close.png", "inside_town.png", "inside.png"): target = pics_dir / p if target.is_file(): pictures[p.replace(".png", "")] = f"/output/{map_dir.name}/pictures/{p}?t={int(target.stat().st_mtime)}" # If inside_town.png exists, use it for "inside" so the full town has all interiors visible if (pics_dir / "inside_town.png").is_file(): pictures["inside"] = f"/output/{map_dir.name}/pictures/inside_town.png?t={int((pics_dir / 'inside_town.png').stat().st_mtime)}" cells_list = [] if lots.is_dir(): for lh in sorted(lots.glob("*.lotheader")): parts = lh.stem.split("_") if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit(): cells_list.append([int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])]) # Focus coordinates centered on the actual town buildings rather than arbitrary midpoint focus_x = None focus_y = None placements_csv = map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}_placements.csv" if placements_csv.is_file(): try: import csv xs, ys = [], [] with open(placements_csv, mode="r", encoding="utf-8") as f: reader = csv.DictReader(f) for row in reader: if "tile_x" in row and "tile_y" in row: xs.append(int(row["tile_x"])) ys.append(int(row["tile_y"])) if xs and ys: focus_x = round(sum(xs) / len(xs)) focus_y = round(sum(ys) / len(ys)) except Exception: pass return jsonify({ "name": map_dir.name, "compiled": compiled, "width_tiles": int(info.get("width_tiles") or 0), "height_tiles": int(info.get("height_tiles") or 0), "cells_x": int(info.get("cells_x") or 0), "cells_y": int(info.get("cells_y") or 0), "building_count": int(info.get("building_count") or 0), "focus_x": focus_x, "focus_y": focus_y, "pictures": pictures, "cells": cells_list, })

nodes.name: api_iso_render
nodes.body_text: def api_iso_render(name: str): """Render an area of the compiled map in 2.5D isometric view.""" map_dir = _map_dir(name) if map_dir is None: return jsonify({"error": "Unknown map."}), 404 lots = map_dir / "lots" if not (lots.is_dir() and any(lots.glob("*.lotheader"))): return jsonify({"error": "Map is not compiled yet."}), 400 from tools import render_lots from knoxbuild.picture import _trim, picture as make_picture # Scale parameter (1.0 = native in-game zoom) try: scale = float(request.args.get("scale", 1.0)) except ValueError: scale = 1.0 scale = max(0.05, min(1.0, scale)) roofs = request.args.get("roofs", "1") in ("1", "true", "yes", "on") floor_arg = request.args.get("floor") if floor_arg is not None and floor_arg != "": try: max_level = int(floor_arg) except ValueError: max_level = None if roofs else 0 else: max_level = None if roofs else 0 if max_level is not None: max_level = max(0, min(int(max_level), 64)) box_arg = request.args.get("box") if box_arg: try: x, y, w, h = [int(float(v)) for v in box_arg.split(",")] except ValueError: return jsonify({"error": "box must be x,y,w,h"}), 400 # A box is drawn whole, never cropped to the first 200 tiles of what # was asked for. The picture grows with the square of the box - 200x200 # at 1:1 is already 12,864x6,624 - so anything larger is rendered at a # smaller scale instead: 528 * (w + h)^2 * scale^2 stays under 90 Mpx # while (w + h) * scale <= 412. w = max(10, w) h = max(10, h) span = w + h if span * scale > 412: scale = max(0.05, 412 / span) else: # Default: if full map requested without box, check existing pictures first pics_dir = map_dir / "pictures" if not roofs and (pics_dir / "inside_town.png").is_file(): return send_file(pics_dir / "inside_town.png", mimetype="image/png") target_name = "town.png" if roofs else "inside_town.png" target_path = pics_dir / target_name if target_path.is_file(): return send_file(target_path, mimetype="image/png") # Otherwise generate full picture try: target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) make_picture(map_dir, target_path, roofs=roofs) if target_path.is_file(): return send_file(target_path, mimetype="image/png") except Exception as exc: return failed(f"Could not draw picture: {exc}", 500, exc) return jsonify({"error": "Could not render picture."}), 500 # Cache key for box renders. The lot files are what the picture is drawn # from, so the newest of them belongs in the key: without it a map that was # compiled again kept showing the town it used to be. cache_dir = map_dir / "pictures" / "cache" cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) newest = max((p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in lots.glob("*.lot*")), default=0) cache_file = (cache_dir / f"iso_{x}_{y}_{w}_{h}_s{scale:.2f}" f"_r{1 if roofs else 0}_m{max_level}_t{newest}.png") if cache_file.is_file(): return send_file(cache_file, mimetype="image/png") try: drawn = render_lots.render(str(map_dir), x, y, w, h, max_level=max_level, scale=scale) except Exception as exc: return failed(f"Render failed: {exc}", 500, exc) if drawn is None: # Return an empty ground canvas so the browser element never breaks from PIL import Image TW = max(4, round(64 * scale)) half, quarter = TW // 2, TW // 4 width = (w + h) * half + TW height = (w + h) * quarter + 2 * TW drawn = Image.new("RGBA", (width, height), (24, 26, 28, 255)) trimmed = _trim(drawn) try: trimmed.save(cache_file, "PNG") return send_file(cache_file, mimetype="image/png") except Exception as exc: return failed(f"Saving render failed: {exc}", 500, exc)

nodes.name: api_save
nodes.body_text: def api_save(): """Save a map's file where the player can find it and show it in Explorer. A download link does nothing in the app window: it is a WebView, not a browser, with nowhere to put a file. Everything is already on disk in the map's own folder, so "downloading" here means making the zip when that is what was asked for, and opening Explorer with the file selected. """ data = _json_body() map_dir = _map_dir(data.get("mapName", "")) if map_dir is None: return failed("Unknown map.", 404) name = str(data.get("name", "")).strip() if name in ("", "zip"): target = map_dir / f"{map_dir.name}.zip" try: with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf: for path in sorted(map_dir.rglob("*")): if not path.is_file() or path.suffix.lower() == ".zip": continue zf.write(path, arcname=str(Path(map_dir.name) / path.relative_to(map_dir))) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not write the zip: {exc}", 500, exc) else: target = (map_dir / name).resolve() if not target.is_relative_to(map_dir.resolve()) or not target.is_file(): return failed("That file is not in this map's folder.", 400) knoxlog.open_folder(target) log.info("saved %s for %s", target.name, map_dir.name) return jsonify({"path": str(target), "name": target.name, "folder": str(target.parent)})

nodes.name: download_all
nodes.body_text: def download_all(map_name: str): """Everything for one map, zipped on demand. Built when asked for rather than at generation time, so it also picks up anything produced later - the .tbx buildings, the .pzw project and the placement CSV that `python -m knoxbuild` writes into the same folder. """ safe = SAFE_NAME.sub("_", map_name) map_dir = (common.OUTPUT_DIR / safe).resolve() if not map_dir.is_relative_to(common.OUTPUT_DIR.resolve()): return jsonify({"error": "Bad map name."}), 400 if not map_dir.is_dir(): return jsonify({"error": f"No output for {safe!r}."}), 404 buf = io.BytesIO() with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf: for path in sorted(map_dir.rglob("*")): if not path.is_file() or path.suffix.lower() == ".zip": continue zf.write(path, arcname=str(Path(safe) / path.relative_to(map_dir))) buf.seek(0) return send_file(buf, mimetype="application/zip", as_attachment=True, download_name=f"{safe}.zip")

nodes.name: presets.py
nodes.body_text: """Saved areas and the building builder: presets.json and the builder's design routes.""" from __future__ import annotations import io import json import os import re import threading import time from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request, send_file import knoxlog from knoxbuild.settings import PRESETS, Settings from web.checks import (MAX_METERS_PER_TILE, MIN_METERS_PER_TILE, _clean_shape, _shape_rings, tidy_scale) from web.common import BASE_DIR, _json_body, _map_dir, failed bp = Blueprint("presets", __name__) @bp.route("/api/presets/buildings", methods=["GET"]) @bp.route("/api/presets/buildings/<name>", methods=["POST", "DELETE"]) # ---- buildings passed from one person to another ---------------------------- # # One file holds a whole hand-built building - the .tbx, the drawing it was # made from and what it stands in for - so it can be sent over Discord and # dropped into anybody's KnoxMap (knoxbuild/share.py). It is also how a # building gets into the library that ships with KnoxMap: send one in, and # tools/add_shared_building.py puts it in presets/library/. @bp.route("/api/presets/buildings/<name>/share", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/presets/buildings/import", methods=["POST"]) # ---- the building editor ---------------------------------------------------- # # Rooms drawn on a sheet, built into a real .tbx by the generator's own passes # (knoxbuild/designer.py). The window holds the drawing and sends it back # whole for each change: the geometry - rooms that may not overlap - is worked # out in one place, and the picture that comes back is drawn from the finished # building rather than from the drawing, so what is on screen is what will be # saved. @bp.route("/api/builder") @bp.route("/api/builder/preview", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/builder/autofill", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/builder/save", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/builder/design/<name>") @bp.route("/api/builder/use", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/builder/kind", methods=["POST"]) # ---- saved areas ---------------------------------------------------------------- # # An area with the scale and settings it was made with, kept by name so a town # can be come back to without drawing it and setting everything up again. One # file next to the program, written whole each time through a temporary file so # a crash cannot leave half of it. PRESETS_FILE = BASE_DIR / "presets.json" _PRESETS_LOCK = threading.Lock() MAX_PRESETS = 200 MAX_PRESET_POINTS = 5000 @bp.route("/api/presets/validate", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/presets/export", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/presets", methods=["GET", "POST"]) @bp.route("/api/presets/<path:name>", methods=["DELETE"])

nodes.name: api_building_preset
nodes.body_text: def api_building_preset(name: str): """Keep a building as a preset, or throw one away. A preset is a .tbx - the same file the generator writes and BuildingEd reads - so it is kept exactly as it came: the point of a hand-built building is that nothing happens to it. """ from knoxbuild import presets as P if request.method == "DELETE": return jsonify({"removed": P.remove(BASE_DIR, name)}) body = _json_body() text = body.get("tbx") if isinstance(body, dict) else None if not isinstance(text, str) and isinstance(body, dict): # Or by pointing at a building of a map that came out well. map_dir = _map_dir(body.get("mapName") or "") wanted = str(body.get("file") or "") if map_dir is not None and wanted and "/" not in wanted and "\\" not in wanted and wanted.endswith(".tbx"): try: with open(map_dir / "buildings" / wanted, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f: text = f.read() except OSError: text = None if not isinstance(text, str): return jsonify({"error": "Send the building as 'tbx', or name a map " "and one of its .tbx files."}), 400 try: about = P.save(BASE_DIR, name, text, kind=body.get("kind") or "") except (ValueError, OSError) as exc: return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 400 return jsonify({k: v for k, v in about.items() if k != "file"})

nodes.name: api_building_share
nodes.body_text: def api_building_share(name: str): """Write out a building as a file to send to somebody.""" from knoxbuild import share as S body = _json_body() body = body if isinstance(body, dict) else {} try: entry = S.of_preset(BASE_DIR, name, author=body.get("author") or "", notes=body.get("notes") or "") except (ValueError, OSError) as exc: return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 400 payload = (json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n").encode("utf-8") filename = S.file_name(entry["name"]) if os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_WINDOW") == "1": folder = BASE_DIR / "preset_exports" try: folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True) target = folder / filename if target.exists(): target = folder / f"{time.time_ns()}_{filename}" target.write_bytes(payload) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not write that building out: {exc}", 500, exc) knoxlog.open_folder(target) return jsonify({"name": target.name, "folder": str(folder)}) return send_file(io.BytesIO(payload), mimetype="application/json", as_attachment=True, download_name=filename)

nodes.name: api_building_import
nodes.body_text: def api_building_import(): """Take in a building somebody else built and shared.""" from knoxbuild import share as S entry, problem = S.read(_json_body()) if problem: return jsonify({"error": problem}), 400 try: about = S.install(BASE_DIR, entry) except (ValueError, OSError) as exc: return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 400 return jsonify({"saved": {k: v for k, v in about.items() if k != "file"}, "author": entry.get("author") or "", "presets": _library_reply()})

nodes.name: _builder_reply
nodes.body_text: def _builder_reply(design: dict, level: int = 0) -> dict: import base64 from knoxbuild import designer as D design = D.clean(design) level = min(max(level, 0), design["storeys"] - 1) # A big building takes seconds to lay out whole, which is too long to wait # for after every drag, so only the storey being drawn is built for the # picture. The whole stack is built when it is saved. alone = D.one_storey_at_a_time(design) built = D.stack(design, only=level if alone else None) image = "" if built.storeys: shot = io.BytesIO() D.preview(design, 0 if alone else level, building=built).save(shot, format="PNG") image = ("data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(shot.getvalue()).decode("ascii")) storey = built.storeys[0 if alone else min(level, len(built.storeys) - 1)] \ if built.storeys else None return {"design": design, "level": level, "scale": D.scale_for(design), "image": image, "oneStoreyAtATime": alone, "storeys": design["storeys"] if alone else len(built.storeys), "tiles": D.tiles_used(design), "tally": [{"kind": kind, "label": D.room_label(kind), "tiles": area, "colour": "#%02x%02x%02x" % D.room_colour(kind)} for kind, area in D.tally(design, level)], "built": {"rooms": len(storey.rooms) if storey else 0, "doors": len(storey.doors) if storey else 0, "windows": len(storey.windows) if storey else 0, "furniture": len(storey.furniture) if storey else 0}, "painted": D.painted(design, level)}

nodes.name: api_builder
nodes.body_text: def api_builder(): """What can be drawn: the rooms, the kinds of building, the wall styles. The rooms are ordered by what is being built, so asking for a police station gets its cells and its gun store first, which is why the kind is a query rather than part of one fixed list. """ from knoxbuild import designer as D from knoxbuild import presets as P kind = (request.args.get("kind") or "").strip().lower() return jsonify({"kinds": P.kinds(), "rooms": D.room_kinds(kind or None), "styles": D.style_choices(kind or None), "use": sorted(P.using(BASE_DIR)), "limits": {"minSide": D.MIN_SIDE, "maxSide": D.MAX_SIDE, "maxStoreys": D.MAX_STOREYS}, "presets": [{k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k != "file"} for entry in P.library(BASE_DIR)]})

nodes.name: _read_presets
nodes.body_text: def _read_presets() -> dict: try: with open(PRESETS_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f: data = json.load(f) except (OSError, ValueError): return {} return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}

nodes.name: _write_presets
nodes.body_text: def _write_presets(presets: dict) -> None: tmp = PRESETS_FILE.with_suffix(".json.tmp") with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(presets, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) os.replace(tmp, PRESETS_FILE)

nodes.name: _count_points
nodes.body_text: def _count_points(shape: dict) -> int: def walk(c): if c and isinstance(c[0], (int, float)): return 1 return sum(walk(x) for x in c) return walk(shape.get("coordinates") or [])

nodes.name: _portable_preset
nodes.signature: def _portable_preset(data: dict) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]
nodes.body_text: def _portable_preset(data: dict) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]: """Check a shared area before it enters the map widget or leaves this PC.""" import math if data.get("format") != "knoxmap-preset" or data.get("version") != 1: return None, "This is not a KnoxMap preset version 1." name = str(data.get("name") or "").strip()[:60] if not name: return None, "Give the area a name." try: south, west, north, east = (float(data[key]) for key in ("south", "west", "north", "east")) scale = float(data["metersPerTile"]) except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError): return None, "The preset needs a valid area and scale." if (not all(math.isfinite(n) for n in (south, west, north, east, scale)) or not (-85.05 <= south < north <= 85.05) or not (-180 <= west < east <= 180) or not MIN_METERS_PER_TILE <= scale <= MAX_METERS_PER_TILE): return None, "The preset area or scale is outside the map's limits." shape = data.get("shape") if shape is not None: if not isinstance(shape, dict): return None, "The preset outline is not a polygon." try: if _count_points(shape) > MAX_PRESET_POINTS: return None, f"A shared outline can hold at most {MAX_PRESET_POINTS:,} points." shape, problem = _clean_shape(shape) if problem: return None, problem for ring in _shape_rings(shape): if any(not (math.isfinite(lon) and math.isfinite(lat) and west - 1e-5 <= lon <= east + 1e-5 and south - 1e-5 <= lat <= north + 1e-5) for lon, lat in ring): return None, "The preset outline falls outside its area." # _wrap_lon can turn 20.01 into 20.00999999999999. Keep # share files stable across repeated imports and exports. for point in ring: point[0], point[1] = round(point[0], 12), round(point[1], 12) except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError, RecursionError): return None, "The preset outline could not be read." given = data.get("settings") if not isinstance(given, dict): return None, "The preset needs map settings." kind = data.get("preset") or given.get("preset") if not isinstance(kind, str) or kind not in PRESETS: kind = None return {"format": "knoxmap-preset", "version": 1, "name": name, "south": south, "west": west, "north": north, "east": east, "metersPerTile": tidy_scale(scale), "shape": shape, "preset": kind, "settings": Settings.from_dict({**given, **({"preset": kind} if kind else {})}).to_dict()}, None

nodes.name: api_preset_validate
nodes.body_text: def api_preset_validate(): preset, problem = _portable_preset(_json_body()) return (jsonify({"error": problem}), 400) if problem else jsonify({"preset": preset})

nodes.name: api_preset_export
nodes.body_text: def api_preset_export(): """Download JSON in a browser; save beside KnoxMap in the desktop window.""" preset, problem = _portable_preset(_json_body()) if problem: return jsonify({"error": problem}), 400 payload = (json.dumps(preset, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8") safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", preset["name"]).strip("_") or "area" filename = f"{safe}.knoxmap.json" if os.environ.get("KNOXMAP_WINDOW") == "1": folder = BASE_DIR / "preset_exports" try: folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True) target = folder / filename if target.exists(): target = folder / f"{safe}_{time.time_ns()}.knoxmap.json" target.write_bytes(payload) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not export the preset: {exc}", 500, exc) knoxlog.open_folder(target) return jsonify({"name": target.name, "folder": str(folder)}) return send_file(io.BytesIO(payload), mimetype="application/json", as_attachment=True, download_name=filename)

nodes.name: api_presets
nodes.body_text: def api_presets(): """GET lists the saved areas; POST saves one under a name, replacing any already called that.""" if request.method == "GET": with _PRESETS_LOCK: presets = _read_presets() return jsonify({"presets": sorted(presets.values(), key=lambda p: p["name"].lower())}) data = _json_body() name = str(data.get("name") or "").strip()[:60] if not name: return jsonify({"error": "Give the area a name."}), 400 try: south, west, north, east = (float(data["south"]), float(data["west"]), float(data["north"]), float(data["east"])) except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError): return jsonify({"error": "Draw an area first."}), 400 if not (-90 <= south < north <= 90) or not (-180 <= west <= 180 and -180 <= east <= 180): return jsonify({"error": "That area is not on the map."}), 400 shape = data.get("shape") if shape is not None: if (not isinstance(shape, dict) or shape.get("type") not in ("Polygon", "MultiPolygon") or _count_points(shape) > MAX_PRESET_POINTS): return jsonify({"error": "That outline is not one a saved area can hold."}), 400 try: scale = float(data.get("metersPerTile", 1.0)) except (TypeError, ValueError): scale = 1.0 scale = min(MAX_METERS_PER_TILE, max(MIN_METERS_PER_TILE, scale)) from knoxbuild.settings import PRESETS as BUILD_PRESETS given = data.get("settings") if isinstance(data.get("settings"), dict) else {} preset = given.get("preset") if given.get("preset") in BUILD_PRESETS else None entry = {"name": name, "south": south, "west": west, "north": north, "east": east, "shape": shape, "metersPerTile": scale, "preset": preset, "settings": Settings.from_dict(given).to_dict(), "saved": int(time.time())} with _PRESETS_LOCK: presets = _read_presets() if name not in presets and len(presets) >= MAX_PRESETS: return jsonify({"error": f"That is {MAX_PRESETS} saved areas. Delete " f"one first."}), 400 presets[name] = entry try: _write_presets(presets) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not save the area: {exc}", 500, exc) return jsonify({"saved": entry})

nodes.name: api_preset_delete
nodes.body_text: def api_preset_delete(name: str): with _PRESETS_LOCK: presets = _read_presets() if name not in presets: return jsonify({"error": "No saved area has that name."}), 404 del presets[name] try: _write_presets(presets) except OSError as exc: return failed(f"Could not delete the area: {exc}", 500, exc) return jsonify({"deleted": name})

nodes.name: system.py
nodes.body_text: """The window's own housekeeping: error and problem reports, language files, setup and health checks, the settings the page reads, Steam libraries and installing a map. """ from __future__ import annotations import io import os import sys import time from pathlib import Path from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request, send_file import knoxlog from generator import osm from knoxbuild import mapstate from knoxbuild.settings import PRESETS, Settings from web import common from web.checks import (BASE_BYTES, BUILD_BASE_BYTES, BUILD_BYTES_PER_TILE, BYTES_PER_TILE, RENDER_SETTINGS) from web.common import BASE_DIR, SAFE_NAME, _json_body, _map_dir, failed, log from web.mapfiles import _load_settings bp = Blueprint("system", __name__) # Room to keep free on the drive after an install, beyond the map's own files. INSTALL_MARGIN_BYTES = 100 * 2**20 @bp.route("/api/client-error", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/report") @bp.route("/api/report-save", methods=["POST"]) # ---- the window in another language --------------------------------------------- # # lang/english.txt lists every line the window says. Copy it to lang/<language> # .txt, translate the right of each "=", and the language appears in the menu at # the top - no code, no rebuild. tools/make_lang_template.py writes the English # one from the page itself. LANG_DIR = BASE_DIR / "lang" @bp.route("/api/languages") @bp.route("/api/language/<name>", methods=["GET", "POST"]) @bp.route("/api/open-logs", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/setup-status") @bp.route("/api/health") @bp.route("/api/steam-libraries", methods=["GET", "POST"]) @bp.route("/api/zomboid-folder", methods=["GET", "POST"]) # Parts of Python itself that KnoxMap cannot do without: the .tbx and paper # map readers (xml), the compressed download beside each map (zlib), the # release downloads (ssl, zipfile, tarfile, hashlib) and the Windows folder # lookups (ctypes). pip cannot put any of them back - they come with Python - # so a copy that is missing one has to be mended or replaced, and saying # which one it is turns "No module named 'xml.etree.ElementTree'" halfway # through a build into something a person can act on. NEEDED_FROM_PYTHON = ("xml.etree.ElementTree", "xml.sax.saxutils", "zlib", "hashlib", "zipfile", "tarfile", "struct", "socket", "ssl", "ctypes", "unicodedata") @bp.route("/api/settings") @bp.route("/api/install", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/uninstall", methods=["POST"]) @bp.route("/api/workshop-check")

nodes.name: api_client_error
nodes.body_text: def api_client_error(): """Errors in the page itself, sent by the script in static/js/app.js.""" data = _json_body() if not (str(data.get("message") or "").strip() or str(data.get("stack") or "").strip()): return jsonify({"errorId": None}) # nothing to report, nothing to log eid = knoxlog.error_id() log.error("%s page error: %s\n at %s\n%s", eid, str(data.get("message", ""))[:500], str(data.get("where", ""))[:300], str(data.get("stack", ""))[:4000]) return jsonify({"errorId": eid})

nodes.name: api_report
nodes.body_text: def api_report(): """A zip of the logs and a description of the PC, for #bug-reports.""" log.info("problem report downloaded") stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M") return send_file(io.BytesIO(knoxlog.report_zip(common.OUTPUT_DIR)), mimetype="application/zip", as_attachment=True, download_name=f"KnoxMap-report-{stamp}.zip")

nodes.name: api_report_save
nodes.body_text: def api_report_save(): """The same zip, saved into logs/ and shown in Explorer: the app window is not a browser, and has nowhere to put a download.""" stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") path = knoxlog.LOG_DIR / f"KnoxMap-report-{stamp}.zip" knoxlog.LOG_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True) path.write_bytes(knoxlog.report_zip(common.OUTPUT_DIR)) log.info("problem report saved: %s", path.name) knoxlog.open_folder(path) return jsonify({"name": path.name, "path": str(path)})

nodes.name: _language_strings
nodes.body_text: def _language_strings(path: Path) -> dict: """The translated lines of one language file, English -> theirs.""" out = {} try: text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") except OSError: return out for line in text.splitlines(): line = line.strip() if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line: continue english, _, theirs = line.partition("=") english, theirs = english.strip(), theirs.strip() # A line left as the English is simply not translated. if english and theirs and english != theirs: out[english] = theirs return out

nodes.name: _language_name
nodes.body_text: def _language_name(path: Path) -> str: """What the language calls itself: a "# name: Português (Brasil)" line near the top, else the file's name - which cannot carry an accent or a bracket.""" try: with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f: for _ in range(30): line = f.readline() if not line: break if line.lower().startswith("# name:"): name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip() if name: return name[:40] except OSError: pass return path.stem[:1].upper() + path.stem[1:]

nodes.name: api_languages
nodes.body_text: def api_languages(): files = sorted(LANG_DIR.glob("*.txt")) if LANG_DIR.is_dir() else [] import knoxpaths return jsonify({ "languages": [{"file": f.stem, "name": _language_name(f), "lines": len(_language_strings(f))} for f in files], "current": knoxpaths.load_config().get("language", "english"), "folder": str(LANG_DIR), })

nodes.name: api_language
nodes.body_text: def api_language(name: str): """One language's lines, and - on POST - the one to open with next time.""" import knoxpaths safe = SAFE_NAME.sub("_", name).strip("_").lower() path = (LANG_DIR / f"{safe}.txt") if safe != "english" and not path.is_file(): return failed(f"No lang/{safe}.txt. Copy lang/english.txt and translate it.", 404) if request.method == "POST": knoxpaths.update_config({"language": safe}) log.info("language set to %s", safe) return jsonify({"file": safe, "strings": _language_strings(path) if path.is_file() else {}})

nodes.name: api_setup_status
